The generative paradox: the Anti-Prompt paradigm for human capability

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40151

本文提出“生成悖论”概念与“反提示范式”，主张当即时生成会取代重要的人类行为时，AI应优先为人类建构创造条件，并将保留人类能力作为与当前联合性能并列的设计目标。

教育中的生成式AI通常以人机团队的输出成果来评判。这种关注忽视了一个次要结果：当辅助发生变化或消失时，人们还能理解、质疑、修复和适应什么。我们将这种张力称为生成悖论，并区分了四种表现形式：性能、辅助、所有权和能力存量。我们提出发展性功能分配，它补充了操作性功能分配和有意义的人类控制，将保留的人类能力作为设计目标，与当前的联合性能并列。反提示范式逆转了默认的交互顺序：当即时生成会抢先取代一个重要的人类行为时，AI应首先为人类建构创造条件。我们区分了产品的有效性、其建构的责任归属以及支持变化后的能力证据。代表性的反提示、一个经典的交互……

arXiv:2610.40151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI in education is usually judged by the output of human-AI teams. That focus overlooks a second outcome: what people can still understand, challenge, repair, and adapt when assistance changes or disappears. We call this tension the generative paradox and distinguish four manifestations: performance, assistance, ownership, and capability stock. We propose developmental function allocation, which complements operational function allocation and meaningful human control by treating retained human capability as a design objective alongside current joint performance. The Anti-Prompt paradigm reverses the default interaction order: when immediate generation would preempt a consequential human act, AI should first create the conditions for human construction. We distinguish the validity of a product, responsibility for its construction, and evidence of capability after support changes. Representative Anti-Prompts, a canonical interac

item.title: 本文提出DynaRev基准，通过181个任务在动态目标修订场景下评估网络智能体，发现现有智能体往往只能满足部分需求，且在保留浏览器状态的前提下重写指令能显著提升修订处理效果。
item.description:
DynaRev：动态目标修订下的网络智能体基准测试

DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40133

本文提出DynaRev基准，通过181个任务在动态目标修订场景下评估网络智能体，发现现有智能体往往只能满足部分需求，且在保留浏览器状态的前提下重写指令能显著提升修订处理效果。

网络智能体通常是在目标于执行前完全给定且此后保持不变的情况下进行评估的，而真实用户往往会在交互过程中修改自己的需求。为了研究这类交互，我们提出了DynaRev，一个包含181个任务的基准测试，用于在动态目标修订场景下评估网络智能体。DynaRev利用语义里程碑在任务定义的阶段传递修订内容，涵盖增量式修订、无条件覆盖和运行时条件覆盖三类修订方式，并通过基于轨迹的评估来衡量正确性、响应性和效率。对五个模型的评估表明，智能体往往只能满足部分任务需求，其性能在不同任务来源、修订类型和模型之间各不相同。进一步分析揭示了里程碑时机的多样性、动态传递的混合效应以及截然不同的修订处理结果——在保留浏览器状态的情况下重写指令能带来收益，而重置浏览器状态则造成损失。

arXiv:2610.40133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Web agents are typically evaluated with goals fully specified before execution and fixed thereafter, whereas real users often revise their requirements during interaction. To study such interactions, we introduce DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 tasks to evaluate web agents under dynamic goal revision. DynaRev uses semantic milestones to deliver revisions at task-defined stages, covers additive revisions, unconditional overrides, and runtime-conditioned overrides, and evaluates correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency through trajectory-grounded evaluation. Five-model evaluations show that agents often satisfy only part of the task requirements, with performance varying across task sources, revision types, and models. item.title: 提出分支感知图规划（BGP），通过将高变异性点识别为图节点并设计分段学习的目标条件边来捕捉随机分支结构、避开不可靠分支，从而在高度随机的长时程离线目标条件强化学习环境中实现可靠的目标达成。
item.description:
在离线目标条件强化学习中逃离路径幻象

Escaping Path Mirages in Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40130

提出分支感知图规划（BGP），通过将高变异性点识别为图节点并设计分段学习的目标条件边来捕捉随机分支结构、避开不可靠分支，从而在高度随机的长时程离线目标条件强化学习环境中实现可靠的目标达成。

离线目标条件强化学习在随机性长时程环境中仍然充满挑战，因为不断累积的价值估计误差会阻碍可靠的目标达成。尽管先前的方法已经尝试通过多种途径应对这一挑战，但一个关键问题依然存在——路径幻象，即智能体过度依赖离线数据集中由随机性导致的虚假成功轨迹，这往往造成在困难任务上的失败。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了分支感知图规划（BGP），该方法通过将高变异性点识别为图节点来捕捉随机分支结构，并设计结合分段学习的目标条件边，以避开不可靠的分支并减少路径上不必要的随机性。因此，即使在高随机性的长时程环境中，BGP 也能实现可靠的目标达成。在多样化 OGBench 任务上的实验表明，其性能显著优于先前的方法。

arXiv:2610.40130v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning remains challenging in stochastic long-horizon settings, where compounding value estimation errors hinder reliable goal reaching. While prior methods have sought to address this challenge through various approaches, a key challenge remains path mirage, where agents overcommit to spuriously successful trajectories in offline datasets induced by stochasticity, often leading to failure on difficult tasks. To address this issue, we propose Branch-aware Graph Planning (BGP), which captures stochastic branching structures by identifying high-variability points as graph nodes and designing goal-conditioned edges with segmented learning to avoid unreliable branches and reduce unnecessary stochasticity along paths. item.title: 本文提出RACE框架，通过组级训练信号路由（仅用信息丰富的采样组更新策略并缓存评分失败样本）和事件触发的阶段切换（奖励持续饱和时自动进入评分准则优化），实现了策略与评分准则的奖励自适应协同演化。
item.description:
策略与评分准则的奖励自适应协同演化

Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution of Policy and Rubric

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40096

本文提出RACE框架，通过组级训练信号路由（仅用信息丰富的采样组更新策略并缓存评分失败样本）和事件触发的阶段切换（奖励持续饱和时自动进入评分准则优化），实现了策略与评分准则的奖励自适应协同演化。

基于评分准则的奖励为开放式强化学习提供了细粒度、可解释的监督信号，而整体性的标量奖励难以捕捉多维度的回复质量。静态的评分准则会随着策略分布的演化而丧失区分能力，而现有的策略—评分准则协同演化方法依赖于全局预设的更新调度，忽略了奖励信息量的异质性。我们提出了RACE，一个奖励自适应协同演化框架。在组级别，针对每个采样组的训练信号路由将各组分类为信息丰富型、多样性坍缩型或评分准则失败型，仅使用信息丰富的组来更新策略，同时缓存评分准则失败的样本。在阶段级别，事件触发的阶段切换机制在奖励持续饱和时进入评分准则优化阶段，并在评分准则—奖励的提升趋于平缓时返回原阶段。评分准则阶段利用冻结的评判模型和尺度归一化（方法）在缓存的样本对上训练生成器（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2610.40096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rubric-based rewards provide fine-grained, interpretable supervision for open-ended reinforcement learning, where holistic scalar rewards struggle to capture multidimensional response quality. Static rubrics can lose discriminative power as the policy distribution evolves, while existing policy--rubric co-evolution methods rely on globally prescribed update schedules that ignore heterogeneous reward informativeness. We introduce RACE, a Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution framework. At the group level, per-rollout-group training-signal routing classifies groups as informative, diversity-collapsed, or rubric-failed, updating the policy only with informative groups while caching rubric failures. At the phase level, event-triggered phase switching enters rubric optimization upon persistent reward saturation and returns when rubric-reward improvement plateaus. item.title: 提出领域专业化升级方法，通过领域感知监督机制训练路由器选择合适的专家以区分不同领域，相比LoRA方法具有更大容量，并在避免无关领域干扰的同时实现大语言模型的多领域适应。
item.description:
面向多个专业化领域的语言模型升级方法

Upcycling Language Models for Multiple Specialized Domains

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40091

提出领域专业化升级方法，通过领域感知监督机制训练路由器选择合适的专家以区分不同领域，相比LoRA方法具有更大容量，并在避免无关领域干扰的同时实现大语言模型的多领域适应。

大语言模型的有效多领域适应需要在优先利用相关领域知识的同时，尽量减少来自无关领域的干扰。现有方法通常使用低秩适配为每个领域训练一个单独的适配器，并将这些适配器组合到一个模型中。然而，这些方法要么不区分输入领域而给所有适配器赋予相同权重，要么虽然动态加权适配器，但仍然会激活包括无关领域在内的所有适配器。此外，尽管低秩结构高效，但其性能受到限制。相比之下，升级是一种模型扩展方法，它在稠密Transformer层中添加专家模块和路由器，能够提供比LoRA方法更大的容量。在本文中，我们提出了用于多领域适应的领域专业化升级。我们引入了一种新的领域感知监督机制，使路由器能够通过选择合适的专家来有效学习区分不同领域。

arXiv:2610.40091v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models requires prioritizing relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. Existing approaches commonly use Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to train a separate adapter for each domain and combine these adapters within one model. However, they either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones. Additionally, while efficient, their low-rank structure limits performance. In contrast, upcycling is a model expansion method that adds experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer offering larger capacity than LoRA approaches. In this paper, we propose Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling) for multi-domain adaptation. item.title: 提出一种由黑盒二元可行性查询器引导的可微安全防护机制，在流匹配机器人策略的正向传播中修正不安全动作、在反向传播中提供约束感知的学习信号，从而在无需显式约束模型的情况下实现安全的策略学习与推理。
item.description:
从二元可行性查询器中学习安全的流匹配机器人策略

Learning Safe Flow Matching Robot Policies from Binary Feasibility Oracles

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40075

提出一种由黑盒二元可行性查询器引导的可微安全防护机制，在流匹配机器人策略的正向传播中修正不安全动作、在反向传播中提供约束感知的学习信号，从而在无需显式约束模型的情况下实现安全的策略学习与推理。

机器人基础模型日益依赖基于流的动作生成来实现通用操作，然而生成的动作无法保证满足关节限位和碰撞避免等物理约束。当可行集无法用解析方式描述、只能通过黑盒可行性查询器访问时，这一问题尤为具有挑战性。我们研究了这种仅依赖查询器的实际场景，提出了一种由查询器引导的可微安全防护机制，用于实现安全的流匹配机器人策略。该防护机制在正向传播中利用二元可行性查询来修正不安全的更新，同时提取局部边界信息，以便在反向传播中提供约束感知的学习信号。结合离散时间流匹配，同一防护机制在训练和推理阶段均被使用，从而在无需显式或可微约束模型的情况下，实现前向-后向对齐的策略学习。实验在（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.40075v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robot foundation models increasingly rely on flow-based action generation for general-purpose manipulation, yet the generated actions are not guaranteed to satisfy physical constraints such as joint limits and collision avoidance. This problem is especially challenging when the feasible set cannot be described analytically and is accessible only through black-box feasibility oracles. We study this practical oracle-only setting and propose an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for safe flow-matching robot policies. The safeguard uses binary feasibility queries to correct unsafe updates in the forward pass, while extracting local boundary information to provide constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass. Combined with discrete-time flow matching, the same safeguard is used during training and inference, enabling forward--backward aligned policy learning without explicit or differentiable constraint models. item.description:
智能体过程证据

Agentic process evidence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40071

提出“智能体过程证据”这一新标准概念，用以记录 AI 智能体在软件开发生命周期中的行为（包括所用模型、工具调用与决策过程），使短暂易逝的智能体行为可被追溯、治理和问责。

软件的构建方式正在发生剧变。AI 智能体现在能够创建拉取请求、选择依赖项、重构代码库、解读测试失败原因，并在整个软件开发生命周期（SDLC）中执行基础设施变更。AI 智能体是自主的团队成员，但与人类工程师不同，它们是短暂的——会话一旦结束，它们的推理、决策和工具调用便随之消失。涉及意图偏差或注入攻击的现代安全事件日益频发，这迫使我们不得不将 AI 智能体视为一种内部威胁。目前尚无被广泛采用的标准能够实现智能体的来源追溯与治理，而显而易见的是，你无法让一个短暂易逝的过程承担责任。git log 是为人类提交而设计的，它只显示改动了什么，却无法显示 AI 智能体做了什么、使用了哪个模型、调用了哪些工具，以及是否有人对结果负责。每一个治理框架、每一次审……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.40071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The way software gets built is changing dramatically. AI agents now create pull requests, select dependencies, refactor codebases, interpret test failures, and execute infrastructure changes across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). AI agents are autonomous team members, but unlike human engineers, they are ephemeral - their reasoning, decisions, and tool calls vanish the moment the session ends. Modern Security incidents involving intent mismatch or injection are becoming increasingly common - forcing us to address AI Agents as an insider threat. No widely adopted standard yet enables agentic provenance and governance and its obvious that you can't hold an ephemeral process accountable. The git log was designed for human commits. item.description:
在视觉自回归模型中定位概念

Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40061

提出首个模型无关的框架LoCo，通过在层、尺度、位置三个维度上精确定位概念的涌现，并结合LoCoBench数据集，实现了对视觉自回归模型内部概念路由的系统性分析与评估。

理解视觉概念的内部路由对于生成模型的安全和可控适配至关重要。虽然概念定位在扩散模型中已被广泛研究，但新兴的下一尺度视觉自回归模型范式在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们提出了LoCo，这是第一个模型无关的框架，用于定位特定概念在自回归模型中于何处以及何时涌现。受下一尺度生成固有的从粗到细特性驱动，我们的方法在三个不同维度上精确映射概念知识：层、尺度和位置。为了在没有上下文偏差的情况下系统地定位和评估概念路由，我们提出了LoCoBench，一个涵盖10个多样化类别的综合数据集。对图像和视频自回归模型（如Infinity、HunyuanImage-3.0和InfinityStar）的广泛探测表明，定位出的位置既具可解释性……

While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. item.title: 该研究证明聚类最优传输引导方法的位移按簇大小加权平均后恒等于单向量DiM方法，其额外效果仅来自路由权重偏离簇大小的词元，且这种增益在INT8和NF4量化下难以保持。
item.description:
一个向量还是多个向量？量化条件下的聚类最优传输引导

One Vector or Many? Clustered Optimal-Transport Steering under Quantization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40055

该研究证明聚类最优传输引导方法的位移按簇大小加权平均后恒等于单向量DiM方法，其额外效果仅来自路由权重偏离簇大小的词元，且这种增益在INT8和NF4量化下难以保持。

激活引导通过在推理时编辑语言模型的隐藏状态来改变模型的生成结果。其最常见的形式是向每个隐藏状态添加一个向量，即类别均值之差（DiM）。CHaRS（概念异质性感知表征引导）则采用最优传输：通过熵正则化的传输方案将两个类别的簇两两配对，每个隐藏状态沿簇位移的混合方向移动，其权重偏向距其最近的簇。我们在Gemma-2-2B和Granite-3.1-2B上研究了这类聚类最优传输映射在毒性缓解任务中的表现，并探究该传输方案相较于DiM的额外贡献，以及这种贡献能否在INT8和NF4量化下得以保留。我们证明了一个恒等式：无论传输方案如何，以簇大小为权重对位移取加权平均都等于DiM，因此聚类映射只有在词元的路由权重偏离簇大小时才会与DiM产生差异。在CHaRS的实验协议下，这些权重与簇大小保持接近，且CHaRS在统计上……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.40055v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization. Rethinking Pre-pretraining

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40051

在算力匹配的实验中，合成数据的预预训练（PPT）在多种课程和训练机制下均无法超越纯自然语言训练，且先前报告的PPT收益对权重初始化方案高度敏感。

我们报告称，在算力匹配的实验中，将算力分配给合成数据的预预训练（PPT）从未优于纯自然语言训练。这一结论在四种PPT课程（k-Dyck、神经元胞自动机（NCA）、声明式参考语料库和代码）以及三种训练机制下均成立：数据受限、数据不受限，以及高词元与参数比机制（8.81亿参数在500亿词元上训练）。当自然语言数据稀缺时，对1亿词元语料库进行重复多轮训练在自然语言验证损失上优于所有合成课程，且PPT没有带来一致的下游准确率优势。我们发现先前工作中报告的PPT收益对权重初始化方案非常敏感。在NCA复现实验中，在原始初始化方案下，我们从PPT中获得了5.4%的困惑度改进。另一种替代方案同时改进了两种方法，但对无PPT基线的改进更大，从而缩小了两者之间的差距。

arXiv:2610.40051v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We report that allocating compute to synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training in our compute-matched experiments. This holds across four PPT curricula (k-Dyck, neural cellular automata (NCA), declarative reference corpora, and code) and three training regimes: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and a high token-to-parameter-ratio regime (881M parameters trained on 50B tokens). When natural language is scarce, repeated epochs over a 100M-token corpus beat every synthetic curriculum on natural-language validation loss, with no consistent downstream accuracy advantage from PPT. We find that PPT gains reported in prior work are sensitive to the weight initialization scheme. In an NCA reproduction, we recover a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT under the original initialization scheme. An alternative scheme improves both methods, but the no-PPT baseline more, closing the gap between them. Howeve

item.title: 提出EPC-RawDC条件三维潜在扩散框架，通过几何等变投影约束和原始数据一致性两项约束将CBCT采集物理融入生成建模，从而实现更高质量的CBCT到CT图像合成。
item.description:
EPC-RawDC：结合等变物理约束与原始数据一致性的三维扩散模型用于CBCT到CT图像合成

EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40046

提出EPC-RawDC条件三维潜在扩散框架，通过几何等变投影约束和原始数据一致性两项约束将CBCT采集物理融入生成建模，从而实现更高质量的CBCT到CT图像合成。

锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛应用于图像引导和自适应放射治疗，但散射、噪声、重建伪影以及不准确的Hounsfield值限制了其定量应用。近期用于CBCT到CT合成的扩散方法大多仍以图像为驱动，对底层采集物理的利用十分有限。我们提出EPC-RawDC，这是一个条件三维潜在扩散框架，将体积生成建模与源自同一扫描仪特定CBCT正向模型的两个互补约束相结合。第一，几何等变投影约束利用CBCT正向算子的旋转等变性，通过相应变换后的参考投影对合成的CT进行监督。第二，原始数据一致性在训练期间利用单次采集的带噪投影测量数据作为扫描特定的监督信号。该框架在两个独立的临床数据集上进行了评估（原文摘要至此截断）。

arXiv:2610.40046v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical

item.title: UPPAAI将大语言模型与UPPAAL形式化验证工具相结合，遵循“用户请求、LLM提议与编排、UPPAAL验证”的原则，借助工具API实现了LLM辅助的实时与信息物理系统建模、验证、分析与综合，弥补了LLM输出不保证正确的缺陷。
item.description:
UPPAAi：迈向大语言模型辅助的建模、验证、分析与综合

UPPAAi: Towards LLM-Assisted Modeling, Verification, Analysis and Synthesis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40042

UPPAAI将大语言模型与UPPAAL形式化验证工具相结合，遵循“用户请求、LLM提议与编排、UPPAAL验证”的原则，借助工具API实现了LLM辅助的实时与信息物理系统建模、验证、分析与综合，弥补了LLM输出不保证正确的缺陷。

三十多年来，UPPAAL一直支持对实时系统和信息物理系统进行建模与分析。然而，构建合适的模型、形式化预期的性质、选择分析技术以及解释反例，仍然是需要大量专业知识的迭代性任务。大语言模型（LLM）可以提供看似合理的解释甚至解决方案，但它们并不一定正确。我们提出了UPPAAI，这是UPPAAL的一个扩展，用户可以在与大语言模型的对话中构建、解释、调试和规约模型。其指导原则是：用户提出请求，大语言模型进行提议、解释和编排，而由UPPAAL进行验证。UPPAAI通过工具API（Tools API）对外暴露UPPAAL的编辑器、查询和验证器。我们报告了七个案例研究，从向新手进行讲解到学习控制器，涵盖了时间自动机、随机混合自动机和策略学习。事实证明，大语言模型在其中极有帮助。

arXiv:2610.40042v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For more than three decades, UPPAAL has supported the modelling and analysis of real-time and cyber-physical systems. Yet building a suitable model, formalising the intended properties, choosing analysis techniques and interpreting counterexamples remain iterative tasks that demand substantial expertise. Large language models (LLMs) can offer plausible explanations and even solutions, but they are not necessarily correct. We present UPPAAI, an extension of UPPAAL in which users construct, explain, debug and specify models in dialogue with an LLM. The guiding principle is that the user requests, the LLM proposes, explains and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies. UPPAAI exposes the UPPAAL editor, queries and verifier through a Tools API. We report on seven case studies, from explaining to a newcomer to learning a controller, covering timed automata, stochastic hybrid automata and strategy learning. LLMs proved to be extremely helpful in no

item.title: 本文系统梳理了语言模型与规则引擎耦合的十三种设计模式，并提出五种不变式与五种失败模式，指导开发者根据需求选择合适的耦合方式。
item.description:
混合人工智能模式：语言模型与规则耦合的十三种方式及其选择方法

Hybrid AI Patterns: Thirteen Ways to Couple Language Models with Rules, and How to Choose Among Them

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40036

本文系统梳理了语言模型与规则引擎耦合的十三种设计模式，并提出五种不变式与五种失败模式，指导开发者根据需求选择合适的耦合方式。

语言模型擅长处理文本，而规则引擎能给出带有证明的结论。将两者结合的系统通常仅以示例方式描述，且相同的耦合方式在智能体框架、护栏工具包和神经符号研究中以不同名称反复出现。本文以面向对象设计所采用的目录形式（包括意图、动机、适用性、参与者、协作、后果、实现、已知用途和相关模式），定义了语言模型与可执行规则语言耦合的十三种模式。其中四种模式关注跨越模型与规则边界的内容，五种关注谁控制谁，三种关注模型如何参与推理，一种关注知识如何随时间保存。五种不变式对所有组合均成立，五种失败模式则指出了破坏这些不变式的耦合方式。我们将该目录与已发表的模式目录以及混合智能和神经符号研究的分类体系进行了关联。

arXiv:2610.40036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models handle text well, and rule engines give conclusions with proofs. Systems that combine the two are usually described by example, and the same coupling turns up under different names in agent frameworks, guardrail toolkits and neuro-symbolic research. This document defines thirteen patterns for coupling a language model with an executable rule language, in the catalogue form introduced for object-oriented design: intent, motivation, applicability, participants, collaborations, consequences, implementation, known uses and related patterns. Four patterns concern what crosses the boundary between model and rules, five who controls whom, three how the model takes part in the reasoning, and one how knowledge is kept over time. Five invariants hold for every combination, and five failure patterns name the couplings that break them. We relate the catalogue to published pattern catalogues and taxonomies of hybrid and neuro-symbolic

item.title: 该论文提出用单一量——信息的价值——统一解决强化学习中的廉价记忆检索与观测信用分配两大问题，通过学习世界模型从存档轨迹估计该量：在观测处读取时为获取动作提供可证明的值下界从而实现信用分配，在决策处读取时定义最优检索集合从而实现廉价检索。
item.description:
从单一量实现廉价检索与观测信用分配：信息的价值

Cheap Retrieval and Observation Credit Assignment from One Quantity: The Value of Information

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40030

该论文提出用单一量——信息的价值——统一解决强化学习中的廉价记忆检索与观测信用分配两大问题，通过学习世界模型从存档轨迹估计该量：在观测处读取时为获取动作提供可证明的值下界从而实现信用分配，在决策处读取时定义最优检索集合从而实现廉价检索。

强化学习中的记忆引发两个问题。注意力机制通过对整个存储打分来找到相关条目，这对受延迟和能量限制的机器人而言代价高昂。当检索到的记忆带来回报时，获取该记忆的信用必须跨越整个序列传播。我们论证这两者都由同一个量支配——信息的价值，并提出利用学习到的世界模型从存档轨迹中估计它。我们发现，当在观测处读取时，它给出获取动作最优值的可证明下界，该下界为其TD目标设定了下限，并将这一下限归因于赢得它的那个观测。当在决策处读取时，它定义了最优检索集合。一个试点检索系统将利用该信号进行训练和改进，在减少上下文的情况下解决了一个记忆任务。

arXiv:2610.40030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Memory in reinforcement learning raises two problems. Attention finds the relevant item by scoring the whole store, which is costly for robots under latency and energy limits. When a retrieved memory pays off, credit for acquiring it must cross the whole sequence. We argue that both are governed by one quantity, the value of information, and propose to estimate it from archived rollouts with a learned world model. We obtain that, when read at the observation, it yields a provable lower bound on the optimal value of the acquiring action, which floors its TD target and attributes this floor to the observation that earned it. Read at the decision, it defines the optimal retrieval set. A pilot retrieval system, to be trained and improved with this signal, solves a memory task with reduced context.

item.title: HEMO的核心创新在于让多目标组合优化中自动算子设计的框架本身成为自进化的优化目标，通过持久框架状态、逐模块更新和折扣UCB调度，依据解质量与运行时间动态调整经验检索、算子改进、父代选择及搜索编排逻辑。
item.description:
HEMO：面向多目标组合优化的框架自进化方法

HEMO: Harness Self-Evolution for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40023

HEMO的核心创新在于让多目标组合优化中自动算子设计的框架本身成为自进化的优化目标，通过持久框架状态、逐模块更新和折扣UCB调度，依据解质量与运行时间动态调整经验检索、算子改进、父代选择及搜索编排逻辑。

自动算子设计（AOD）已越来越多地采用大型语言模型（LLM）为多目标组合优化（MOCO）生成针对特定问题的搜索与变异算子。然而，大多数方法仅进化算子本身，而发现算子的过程却固定不变。这限制了系统的适应性，因为新的帕累托权衡和算子交互会改变搜索应当在哪里以及如何进行。我们提出了HEMO，它使AOD框架本身成为一个自进化的优化目标。HEMO维护一个持久的框架状态，每次更新一个模块，修订决定检索哪些经验、改进哪些算子、选择哪些父代以及如何编排搜索步骤的逻辑。下游的解质量和运行时间指导这些更新，同时一个折扣UCB调度器在模块效用发生变化时，将自适应调整引导至具有前景的模块。一个持久记忆文件系统（原文摘要在此处不完整）。

arXiv:2610.40023v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic operator design (AOD) has increasingly adopted large language models (LLMs) to generate problem-specific search and variation operators for multi-objective combinatorial optimization (MOCO). Yet most methods evolve the operators while leaving the process that discovers them fixed. This limits adaptation as new Pareto trade-offs and operator interactions change where and how the search should proceed. We introduce HEMO, which makes the AOD harness itself a self-evolving optimization target. HEMO maintains a persistent harness state and updates one module at a time, revising the logic that determines which experience to retrieve, which operators to improve, which parents to select, and how to formulate the orchestration of search steps. Downstream solution quality and runtime guide these updates, while a discounted UCB scheduler directs adaptation toward promising modules as their utility changes. A persistent memory filesystem

item.title: 本文提出将人机AI交互视为“一等公民”数据的新范式，设计了形式化交互描述语言HAIDL及其JupyterLab运行时中间件HAIDL-X，以支持可复现、可解释和可重放的AI协作。
item.description:
人机交互作为一等数据：一种面向可解释AI协作的形式化交互模型与运行时

Human--AI Interactions as First-Class Data: A Formal Interaction Model and Runtime for Explainable AI Collaboration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40006

本文提出将人机AI交互视为“一等公民”数据的新范式，设计了形式化交互描述语言HAIDL及其JupyterLab运行时中间件HAIDL-X，以支持可复现、可解释和可重放的AI协作。

AI助手日益嵌入到计算笔记本、科学工作流、软件工程工具和学习系统中，然而人机交互通常被视为瞬时的提示-响应交换，而非持久的数据产品，这阻碍了可复现性、可解释性、重放、行为分析和自适应AI支持。我们主张这些交互构成了一个需要形式化表示的新数据类别，并介绍了人机交互描述语言（HAIDL），这是一种采用受巴科斯-诺尔范式启发的具体语法的正式交互模型。HAIDL将每次交互编码为结构化对象，捕获计算上下文、用户请求、提示载荷、AI响应、反馈、问题上下文、来源信息和模型元数据。我们将这一愿景集成到HAIDL-X中，这是一个用于JupyterLab的中间件，通过捕获用户与机器人的状态、构建上下文化提示、与AI提供方交互等方式来实例化HAIDL。

arXiv:2610.40006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI assistants are increasingly embedded in computational notebooks, scientific workflows, software engineering tools, and learning systems, yet human-AI interactions are often treated as transient prompt-response exchanges rather than durable data products, hindering reproducibility, explainability, replay, behavioral analysis, and adaptive AI support. We argue that these interactions form a new data class requiring formal representation and introduce the Human-AI Interaction Description Language (HAIDL), a formal interaction model with a Backus-Naur Form-inspired concrete syntax. HAIDL encodes each interaction as a structured object capturing computational context, user request, prompt payload, AI response, feedback, problem context, provenance, and model metadata. We integrate this vision into HAIDL-X, a middleware for JupyterLab that instantiates HAIDL by capturing user-bot state, building contextualized prompts, interfacing with AI p

item.title: 该论文提出 Assur-KB 表示方法，通过不可约模块、边界接口和求解依赖关系来编码平面机构，从理论和实验上证明了这种组合式表示在有限数据下比扁平化输入具有 1.8 倍的样本效率优势。
item.description:
机构设计的高效学习与组合性

Efficient Learning of Mechanism Designs and Compositionality

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40005

该论文提出 Assur-KB 表示方法，通过不可约模块、边界接口和求解依赖关系来编码平面机构，从理论和实验上证明了这种组合式表示在有限数据下比扁平化输入具有 1.8 倍的样本效率优势。

学习机构行为需要对各连接部件如何共同约束运动进行表示。我们研究暴露可重用的约束子组件能否改善有限数据下的预测。Assur-KB 通过不可约模块、边界接口和求解依赖关系来表示平面机构，同时保留源几何信息。我们的理论结果通过模块接口刻画了迁移特性，并建立了由缺失接口信息和累积敏感性产生的物理极限。为了直接检验这一表示主张，实验设计在同一多层感知器系列内比较了不同训练预算下匹配的机构-曲线对。这一受控比较确立了完整表示在所评估的学习场景中的有效性。基于 Assur 衍生的特征在样本效率上相比扁平化的邻接和位置输入提供了几何平均 1.8 倍的优势。

arXiv:2610.40005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning mechanism behaviour requires a representation of how connected parts jointly constrain motion. We study whether exposing reusable constraint subassemblies improves prediction from limited data. Assur-KB represents planar mechanisms through irreducible modules, boundary interfaces, and solve dependencies while retaining source geometry. Our theoretical results characterize transfer through module interfaces and establish physical limits arising from missing interface information and accumulated sensitivity. To test the representation claim directly, the experimental design compares matched mechanism-curve pairs across training budgets within the same multilayer-perceptron family. This controlled comparison establishes the utility of the complete representation in the evaluated learning setting. item.title: 本文通过在 DPLL 分支搜索中累积剪枝约束，实现了多项式空间下时间复杂度为 O*(2^{(1-γ)n}) 的 Max 2-SAT 精确算法，并适用于子句密度可随问题规模增长的多种实例类。
item.description:
累积剪枝约束：Max 2-SAT 的新型精确多项式空间算法

Accumulating Pruning Constraints: New Exact Polynomial-Space Algorithms for Max 2-SAT

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39992

本文通过在 DPLL 分支搜索中累积剪枝约束，实现了多项式空间下时间复杂度为 O*(2^{(1-γ)n}) 的 Max 2-SAT 精确算法，并适用于子句密度可随问题规模增长的多种实例类。

我们提出了确定性多项式空间算法，对于若干子句密度可能随 n 增长的实例类，能够在时间 O*(2^{(1-γ)n})（其中 γ>0 为固定常数）内精确求解 n 个变量的 Max 2-SAT 问题。我们的主要工具是对经典 DPLL 分支算法的扩展。当搜索过程为变量赋予其较不利取值时，通过比较该变量的两个取值可以产生一个剪枝约束，该约束会被某个最优赋值所满足。沿每个分支累积这些约束能够剪掉除指数级小部分之外的所有赋值。所涉及的实例类包括含有大量偏置变量的公式、半随机 2-CNF 公式，以及正则扩张图和由随机块模型生成的图上的 Max-Cut 问题。在半随机公式中，可能共享子句的变量对是任意的，而这些变量对上的子句是随机生成的。对于半随机公式和块模型图，这些算法……

arXiv:2610.39992v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present deterministic polynomial-space algorithms that solve Max 2-SAT on $n$ variables exactly in time $\Ostar(2^{(1-\gamma)n})$, for a fixed $\gamma>0$, on several classes of instances whose clause density may grow with $n$. Our main tool extends the classic DPLL branching algorithm. When the search gives a variable its less promising value, comparing the two values of the variable yields a pruning constraint that is satisfied by some optimal assignment. Accumulating these constraints along each branch prunes all but an exponentially small fraction of the assignments. The classes are formulas with many biased variables, semirandom 2-CNF formulas, and Max-Cut on regular expander graphs and on graphs generated by a stochastic block model. item.title: 该论文提出了MTG-AD——一个由盲人与健视专业人员配对共同标注的36小时视频内联音频描述数据集，以及基于专家指南的细粒度无参考评估框架MTG-AD-Eval，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型生成契合视频静默间隙的音频描述的能力。
item.description:
Mind The Gap（MTG-AD）：面向端到端内联音频描述的数据集与细粒度评估

Mind The Gap (MTG-AD): Dataset and Fine-grained Evaluation for End-to-End Inline Audio Descriptions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39955

该论文提出了MTG-AD——一个由盲人与健视专业人员配对共同标注的36小时视频内联音频描述数据集，以及基于专家指南的细粒度无参考评估框架MTG-AD-Eval，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型生成契合视频静默间隙的音频描述的能力。

音频描述对于让盲人和低视力（BLV）用户无障碍地使用视觉媒体至关重要。虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为按需生成音频描述提供了可扩展的解决方案，但其在“内联”音频描述——即必须契合视频中现有静默间隙的描述——方面的性能仍未被充分探索，尤其是针对多样化的用户生成内容（UGC）。我们对MLLM生成的内联音频描述进行了全面研究。首先，我们推出了MTG-AD，这是一个由专业人员标注的数据集，包含36小时的视频，每个视频平均约5分钟，总计8000多条描述，由盲人与健视的音频描述专业人员配对共同创建，为该任务提供了高质量基准。其次，我们提出了MTG-AD-Eval，一个基于音频描述专家指南的评估框架，为模型改进提供细粒度、无需参考的可操作指标。

arXiv:2610.39955v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Audio descriptions (AD) are essential for making visual media accessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a scalable solution for generating audio descriptions on-demand, their performance on ``inline'' audio descriptions -- which must fit within existing silences in a video -- remains under-explored, particularly for diverse user-generated content (UGC). We present a comprehensive investigation into MLLM-generated inline audio descriptions. First, we introduce MTG-AD, a professionally annotated dataset of 36 hours of videos, each averaging $\sim$5 mins. and 8k+ descriptions in total, co-created by paired blind and sighted AD professionals to provide a high-quality benchmark for this task. Second, we propose MTG-AD-Eval, an evaluation framework based on audio description expert guidelines that provides fine-grained, reference-free actionable metrics for model improvement. Crucial

item.title: 该论文将差分隐私训练中的高斯噪声方差调度表述为隐私预算约束下的开环最优控制问题，证明最优解必然耗尽全部认证预算，并提出PB-AMD算法来高效求解最优的隐私预算分配方案。
item.description:
何时使用隐私：私有学习中的最优分配

When to spend privacy: optimal allocation in private learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39954

该论文将差分隐私训练中的高斯噪声方差调度表述为隐私预算约束下的开环最优控制问题，证明最优解必然耗尽全部认证预算，并提出PB-AMD算法来高效求解最优的隐私预算分配方案。

隐私会计为差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）的累积隐私成本提供了上界约束，但并未确定如何在各训练迭代之间分配固定的隐私预算。我们在组合的零集中差分隐私（zero-Concentrated Differential Privacy）约束下，将完整的高斯噪声方差调度方案表述为一个开环控制问题，并显式地考虑调度选择本身的隐私代价。针对期望二次终端跟踪目标，我们证明每一个局部极小值点都会耗尽经认证的全部预算，从而得到一个精确预算约束下的单纯形表述。我们提出了隐私预算伴随镜像下降算法（Privacy-Budget Adjoint Mirror Descent, PB-AMD），将逐路径伴随梯度与熵式更新相结合，以保持噪声方差的非负性、下界约束以及规定的预算。在正则性与强制性假设下，我们建立了最优调度方案的存在性与预算稳定性、从设计到训练的效用稳定性，以及确定性、随机性和样本平均形式下的平稳性保证。一个……

arXiv:2610.39954v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Privacy accounting bounds the cumulative privacy cost of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent but does not determine how to allocate a fixed budget across iterations. We formulate the complete Gaussian noise-variance schedule as an open-loop control under a composed zero-Concentrated Differential Privacy constraint, explicitly accounting for schedule selection. For expected quadratic terminal tracking, we prove that every local minimizer exhausts the certified budget, yielding an exact-budget simplex formulation. We introduce Privacy-Budget Adjoint Mirror Descent (PB-AMD), combining pathwise adjoint gradients with entropic updates that preserve positivity, charge floors, and the prescribed budget. Under regularity and coercivity assumptions, we establish existence and budget stability of optimal schedules, design-to-training utility stability, and deterministic, stochastic, and sample-average stationarity guarantees. item.title: 提出MASCAL方法，通过强化学习联合优化任务性能与置信度校准，使多智能体系统中的上游智能体在交接时向下游传递答案的正确性概率，为下游智能体的信任与验证决策提供量化依据。
item.description:
面向多智能体协作的学习校准置信度

Learning Calibrated Confidence for Multi-Agent Collaboration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39927

提出MASCAL方法，通过强化学习联合优化任务性能与置信度校准，使多智能体系统中的上游智能体在交接时向下游传递答案的正确性概率，为下游智能体的信任与验证决策提供量化依据。

Web上的复杂信息获取任务通常需要从多个文档中收集证据并进行跨文档推理，例如多跳问答。多智能体系统通过在专门化的智能体之间分工来处理此类任务，其中上游智能体产生中间答案和支撑证据，供下游智能体在此基础上继续处理。然而，上游答案的正确性参差不齐，且大多数系统不提供关于正确性的量化信号，导致下游智能体只能依据文本证据来判断是否信任或验证所接收的内容。在本文中，我们提出了MASCAL。每个智能体通过在强化学习中联合优化任务性能与置信度校准，学会为其答案生成正确性概率；上游智能体在交接时传递该概率，为下游智能体的决策提供量化依据，且最终答案也带有校准的概率。

arXiv:2610.39927v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Complex information seeking on the Web often requires collecting evidence from multiple documents and reasoning across them, as in multi-hop question answering. Multi-agent systems address such tasks by dividing work among specialized agents, where upstream agents produce intermediate answers and supporting evidence that downstream agents build upon. However, upstream answers vary in correctness, and most systems provide no quantitative signal about it, leaving the downstream agent to judge whether to trust or verify what it receives based solely on the textual evidence. In this paper, we propose MASCAL. item.title: 提出SIFR频率感知双流框架，以频谱建模为统一原则，在特征融合和解码精炼两个阶段滤除域敏感干扰并保留细粒度空间信息，从而提升域泛化语义分割性能。
item.description:
面向域泛化语义分割的频谱不变融合与精炼

Spectral Invariant Fusion and Refinement for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39926

提出SIFR频率感知双流框架，以频谱建模为统一原则，在特征融合和解码精炼两个阶段滤除域敏感干扰并保留细粒度空间信息，从而提升域泛化语义分割性能。

域泛化语义分割具有挑战性，因为它要求在训练期间完全无法访问目标域数据的情况下，对未见过的域进行准确的密集预测。现有方法通过数据多样化、不变学习或直接使用基础模型来提升可迁移性，但它们往往难以在抑制域敏感干扰的同时保留细粒度空间线索。在本工作中，我们提出SIFR，一个频率感知的双流框架，在融合和解码两个阶段应对域偏移问题。SIFR将频谱建模作为统一原则，同时调控异构先验交互与密集解码器精炼。SIFR并非直接融合冻结的CLIP和DINOv2特征，而是执行频谱引导的不变融合，滤除域敏感响应，同时保留互补的语义与结构信息。此外，SIFR还引入了一种频谱……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39926v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Domain generalized semantic segmentation is challenging because it requires accurate dense prediction on unseen domains without any access to target-domain data during training. Existing methods improve transferability through data diversification, invariant learning, or direct use of foundation models, but they often struggle to simultaneously suppress domain-sensitive interference and preserve fine-grained spatial cues. In this work, we propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that tackles domain shift at both the fusion and decoding stages. SIFR uses spectral modeling as a unified principle to regulate both heterogeneous prior interaction and dense decoder refinement. Instead of directly fusing frozen CLIP and DINOv2 features, SIFR performs spectral-guided invariant fusion to filter out domain-sensitive responses while preserving complementary semantic and structural information. item.title: 该研究首次在语义焦点敏感性这一新领域评估语言模型，发现基于标记概率的方法在所有模型中均高于随机水平，而提示方法在部分较大模型中大幅优于概率方法，其原因是语言模型不倾向于主动产生焦点标记。
item.description:
语言模型语言学评估中的提示与概率：来自语义焦点敏感性的证据

Prompts and probabilities in the linguistic assessment of language models: Evidence from semantic focus-sensitivity

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39923

该研究首次在语义焦点敏感性这一新领域评估语言模型，发现基于标记概率的方法在所有模型中均高于随机水平，而提示方法在部分较大模型中大幅优于概率方法，其原因是语言模型不倾向于主动产生焦点标记。

随着语言模型的不断改进，通过显式提示（例如，“哪个句子更可接受？”）来评估其语言能力已成为越来越常见的方法。先前的研究表明，在较小的模型中，这种提示方法的表现不如基于标准标记概率的方法，但在较大的模型中表现有所改善。我们在一个新的领域中对此进行了测试：语义焦点敏感性，它负责诸如"Lucy only SWAM yesterday"与"Lucy only swam YESTERDAY"之间的对比差异。通过使用粗体和斜体等基于文本的焦点标记来测试各种规模的模型，我们发现基于标记概率的方法普遍表现出高于随机水平的性能。提示方法的结果大多与先前的研究发现一致，但在一些较大的模型中，其表现大幅超过了概率方法。我们提出，这是因为语言模型不太倾向于主动产生无上下文背景的焦点标记，这使得标记概率方法的结果变得模糊，而这种影响并不……

arXiv:2610.39923v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As language models (LMs) have improved, an increasingly common means of evaluating their linguistic competence is through explicit prompting (e.g., "Which sentence is more acceptable?"). Prior work indicates that such prompting underperforms compared to standard token-probability-based methods in smaller models, but improves in larger models. We test this in a new domain: semantic focus-sensitivity, responsible for contrasts like "Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY". Testing models of various sizes using text-based focus markers like boldface and italics, we find universal above-chance performance for token probabilities. Prompting results mostly align with previous findings, but in some larger models they outperform probabilities by a wide margin. item.title: 提出CovFedAvg联邦学习方法，在客户端保留本地模型并通过聚合梯度贡献拟合共同端点、利用分布式训练损失进行模型选择，在无需集中校准数据或客户端间样本交换的前提下，保证所选模型训练损失不高于先前模型和当前FedAvg候选模型。
item.description:
CovFedAvg：局部低损失曲线与联邦模型选择

CovFedAvg: Local Low-Loss Curves and Federated Model Selection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39902

提出CovFedAvg联邦学习方法，在客户端保留本地模型并通过聚合梯度贡献拟合共同端点、利用分布式训练损失进行模型选择，在无需集中校准数据或客户端间样本交换的前提下，保证所选模型训练损失不高于先前模型和当前FedAvg候选模型。

观察预测任务不同部分的客户端可能学习到局部等价但在其观测支撑域之外行为互不兼容的模型。我们研究冗余模型是否能够提供通向兼容共享模型的局部低损失路径。CovFedAvg 在客户端保留本地模型和曲线控制，通过聚合梯度贡献拟合一个共同端点，并使用分布式训练损失来选择实际的候选模型。该方法无需集中式校准样本，也无需客户端之间的样本交换。精确选择保证所评估的训练损失不高于先前模型以及当前轮次 FedAvg 候选模型的损失；但这并非全局最优性、平稳性、泛化或差分隐私方面的保证。我们给出了条件性的客户端兼容性界和近似选择界，并保留了修正后的变换恒等式以及针对参考算法的独立全梯度保障定理。

arXiv:2610.39902v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Clients observing different parts of a prediction task may learn locally equivalent models with incompatible behavior outside their observed support. We study whether redundant models permit local low-loss paths toward a compatible shared model. CovFedAvg retains local models and curve controls on clients, fits a common endpoint through aggregated gradient contributions, and selects an actual candidate model using distributed training losses. No centralized calibration examples or client-to-client sample exchange are required. Exact selection guarantees no higher evaluated training loss than the previous model and the current-round FedAvg candidate; this is not a global-optimality, stationarity, generalization, or differential-privacy guarantee. We state conditional client-compatibility and approximate-selection bounds and retain corrected transformation identities and a separate full-gradient safeguard theorem for reference algorithms

item.title: KARMA是一个免训练框架，通过确定性的轨迹验证、评判器引导和回归门控的原子化知识编辑，在保持模型权重不变的情况下持续演化六个类型化知识模块，使工业广告智能体能够适应不断变化的业务环境，并在六个电商领域的18种设置中提升性能。
item.description:
KARMA：面向工业广告智能体的免训练知识原子化框架演化

KARMA: Training-Free Knowledge-Atomic Harness Evolution for Industrial Advertising Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39884

KARMA是一个免训练框架，通过确定性的轨迹验证、评判器引导和回归门控的原子化知识编辑，在保持模型权重不变的情况下持续演化六个类型化知识模块，使工业广告智能体能够适应不断变化的业务环境，并在六个电商领域的18种设置中提升性能。

工业广告智能体必须持续调整其决策知识，以适应不断变化的产品供应、流量模式和运营政策。我们提出了KARMA（Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation，知识原子化、回归门控的模块化适应），这是一个免训练框架，它在保持模型权重和可执行框架代码冻结不变的前提下，演化六个类型化的知识模块。在演化过程中，一个确定性的轨迹验证器将观察到的错误映射到候选模块，一个评判器通过比较成功与失败的轨迹来指导受工具约束的演化器。演化器应用原子化的知识编辑，固定的验证门只有在测得的增益达到阈值时才保留这些编辑；否则，恢复先前的知识状态。我们使用三个LLM系列，在从覆盖六个电商领域、约五十万条真实运营日志的语料库中采样的案例上评估了KARMA。在18个领域-模型设置中，KARMA提升了平均……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Industrial advertising agents must continually adapt their decision knowledge to changing product offerings, traffic patterns, and operating policies. We present KARMA (Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation), a training-free framework that evolves six typed knowledge modules while keeping model weights and executable harness code frozen. During our evolution, a deterministic Trace Verifier maps observed errors to candidate modules, and a Critic compares successful and failed trajectories to guide a tool-constrained Evolver. The Evolver applies atomic knowledge edits, which a fixed validation gate retains only when their measured gain reaches a threshold; otherwise, the previous knowledge state is restored. We evaluate KARMA with three LLM families on cases sampled from a corpus of approximately half a million real-world operation logs across six e-commerce domains. item.title: 该论文提出校准多教师在线策略蒸馏（C-MOPD）结合高效动态MoE执行路径，在Turing-20B-A2B上实现近乎完美的专家模型整合（四域归一化得分0.9988），并在数学与代码推理基准上超越Qwen3-8B。
item.description:
图灵大语言模型后训练：校准蒸馏与高效的动态MoE执行

Turing LLM Post-Training: Calibrated Distillation and Efficient Dynamic-MoE Execution

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39876

该论文提出校准多教师在线策略蒸馏（C-MOPD）结合高效动态MoE执行路径，在Turing-20B-A2B上实现近乎完美的专家模型整合（四域归一化得分0.9988），并在数学与代码推理基准上超越Qwen3-8B。

我们研究动态路由的专家混合模型的后训练方法，重点关注如何在保持整合高效的同时集成独立优化的专家模型。我们的方法将校准多教师在线策略蒸馏（C-MOPD）与一种高效执行路径相结合：C-MOPD在每个选定教师的局部Top-K支持集上进行匹配，并采用按教师分别的损失归一化与裁剪；执行路径则采用容量后有界宽度分发、最终路由重放以及异步推演-训练重叠机制。在Turing-20B-A2B模型上，所选模型达到了0.9988的四领域归一化整合得分，并在每个领域保留了至少90.16%的实测专家增益。在匹配的K=32条件下，完整校准目标得分为0.9962，相比之下无校准时为0.9724、无裁剪时为0.9834。在匹配的8K响应上限下，该模型在所有四个需要推理的数学与代码基准（摘要在此处截断）上均超过了共享SFT和Qwen3-8B。

arXiv:2610.39876v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study post-training for dynamically routed mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, focusing on integrating independently optimized specialists while keeping consolidation efficient. Our approach combines calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation (C-MOPD), which matches each selected teacher on a local Top-$K$ support with teacher-wise loss normalization and clipping, with an execution path that uses post-capacity bounded-width dispatch, final-route replay, and asynchronous rollout--training overlap. On Turing-20B-A2B, the selected model achieves a four-domain normalized integration score of 0.9988 and retains at least 90.16\% of the measured specialist gain in every domain. At matched $K=32$, the full calibration objective scores 0.9962, compared with 0.9724 without calibration and 0.9834 without clipping. item.title: 本文基于生成认知理论提出，人类以两种方式将大语言模型这一“机器他者”纳入自身——既作为工具以获得特定技能，也在语言与身份认同层面纳入并体现其“语言化”方式，从而揭示人机交互如何改变人类自身。
item.description:
将机器他者纳入自身：基于生成认知理论的人与大语言模型交互探索

Incorporating Machine-Others: An Enactive Exploration of Human-LLM Interactions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39869

本文基于生成认知理论提出，人类以两种方式将大语言模型这一“机器他者”纳入自身——既作为工具以获得特定技能，也在语言与身份认同层面纳入并体现其“语言化”方式，从而揭示人机交互如何改变人类自身。

需要基于交互性思维的新概念，才能理解人类如何因与大语言模型（LLM）建立关系而发生改变。关于技术对用户自主性影响的标准理论在此并不充分，因为这项技术能够以前所未有的方式引发与人类的语言交互；传统的社会认知理论同样存在不足，因为大语言模型既没有自主性，也没有心智，更谈不上真正的社会性。然而，人类却与它们交互、交谈并进行创作。我们以生成认知理论为基础，特别是“语言身体”理论以及生成式人工智能论述的最新发展，来探索我们如何与机器共同创造意义。我们认为，人类以两种方式将机器他者纳入自身：其一是工具意义上的“纳入”，即通过纳入而获得特定技能；其二是更具语言性、与身份认同紧密相关的意义上的纳入——即纳入（并体现）大语言模型的语言化方式。然而，大语言模型本身……

arXiv:2610.39869v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: New concepts based in interactional thinking are required to understand how humans are changed by relating to LLMs. Standard theories of technological impact upon users' autonomy are inadequate here, because this technology is capable of inducing linguistic interactions with humans in an unprecedented manner. Traditional theories of social cognition also fall short, because LLMs have neither autonomy nor minds nor sociality as such. And yet, humans interact, talk, and create with them. We base ourselves on enactive theory, particularly on the theory of Linguistic Bodies and recent developments of enactive accounts of AI, to explore how we make sense with machines. We argue that we incorporate machine-others in two ways: in the tool-like sense of incorporation as enabling particular skills, but also in the more linguistic and identity-tied sense of incorporating (and incarnating) LLMs' ways of languaging. item.title: 提出了LIDAR-SHIELD，一个完全Docker化的统一对抗鲁棒性评估框架，通过轻量级HTTP端点协议将目标模型与攻击工具解耦，使接入新模型只需一个加载函数，并同时支持三维语义分割和目标检测任务。
item.description:
LiDAR-SHIELD：一个全容器化的面向激光雷达三维感知模型的对抗鲁棒性评估框架

LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39848

提出了LIDAR-SHIELD，一个完全Docker化的统一对抗鲁棒性评估框架，通过轻量级HTTP端点协议将目标模型与攻击工具解耦，使接入新模型只需一个加载函数，并同时支持三维语义分割和目标检测任务。

基于激光雷达的三维感知技术是自动驾驶和机器人技术的基础，然而要安全地部署这些模型，需要在实际应用之前针对对抗性输入对其进行压力测试。尽管目前已有最先进的对抗攻击方法，但它们的实现往往分散在各个独立的代码仓库中，每个仓库都绑定特定的架构或任务，需要手动重建环境并编写模型特定的集成代码。我们提出了LIDARSHIELD，这是一个统一且完全容器化（Dockerized）的框架，它颠覆了传统的工作流程：LIDARSHIELD不是将目标模型安装到工具包内部，而是通过三个轻量级的HTTP端点来暴露任何模型，即 /info、/forward 和 /gradient。因此，接入新的模型或数据集只需编写一个加载函数或适配器即可。该框架通过统一的引擎-服务协议同时支持三维语义分割和三维目标检测，并集成了一个任务感知的…

arXiv:2610.39848v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware sui

item.title: 本研究利用可解释人工智能（符号回归）分析母猪加速度传感器数据，实现分娩前筑巢行为检测与分娩时间预测，从而兼顾仔猪安全与母猪福利。
item.description:
探索符号回归在精准畜牧业中的潜力

Exploring the Potential of Symbolic Regression in Precision Livestock Farming

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39839

本研究利用可解释人工智能（符号回归）分析母猪加速度传感器数据，实现分娩前筑巢行为检测与分娩时间预测，从而兼顾仔猪安全与母猪福利。

摘要：预测母猪分娩时间的能力对于优化农场管理和确保仔猪存活至关重要。本研究探讨了可解释人工智能在精准畜牧业中的应用潜力，重点关注母猪分娩前后分娩时刻的加速度传感器数据。准确预测分娩可以使养殖户兼顾两方面：通过避免仔猪被压死事件来保障仔猪安全，以及通过避免过早关栏来维护母猪福利。传统机器学习模型通常缺乏可解释性（即“黑箱”问题）。可解释人工智能通过揭示模型内部的决策过程为这一问题提供了解决方案。这项工作分为两个阶段：第一阶段是筑巢行为的检测，第二阶段是预测距离分娩的剩余时间。在180头母猪中，有166头成功实现了筑巢行为检测，其中149头母猪在分娩前48小时内成功检测到筑巢行为。

arXiv:2610.39839v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The ability to predict farrowing time in pigs is crucial for optimal farm management and ensuring piglet survival. This study investigates the potential of explainable artificial intelligence for precision livestock farming, focusing on acceleration sensor data from sows around the time of farrowing. Accurately predicting farrowing allows farmers to balance both, piglet safety by avoiding piglet crushing events and the mother sow's welfare, by avoiding early crating. Traditional machine learning models often lack interpretability (``closed-box'' problem). Explainable artificial intelligence offers a solution by revealing the decision-making processes within the models. This work is split into two stages. First the detection of nest building behaviour and second the prediction of the remaining time to farrowing. The nest building detection was possible for 166 out of 180 sows and successful within 48 hours before farrowing for 149 sows.

item.title: 该论文发现探索的遗憾成本在连续减半算法的各阶段中逐步递减，据此提出SHPRR算法，通过前置分配遗憾预算，在固定采样预算与遗憾预算双重约束下显著提升了最佳臂识别的概率保证。
item.description:
SHPRR：一种在受限遗憾约束下的纯探索算法

SHPRR: An Algorithm for Pure Exploration under Constrained Regret

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39837

该论文发现探索的遗憾成本在连续减半算法的各阶段中逐步递减，据此提出SHPRR算法，通过前置分配遗憾预算，在固定采样预算与遗憾预算双重约束下显著提升了最佳臂识别的概率保证。

最佳臂识别传统上通过收集的样本数量来衡量实验成本。然而，在许多实际运营场景中，相对于已部署的可信基线而言的探索成本同样重要。我们在固定采样预算和遗憾预算的双重约束下研究最佳臂识别问题。与受限纯探索中通常考虑的一般性资源不同，遗憾具有独特的结构特性：相对于基线而言，采样表现较好的臂成本更低。我们从理论上证明，在广泛使用的纯探索算法——连续减半的各个阶段中，探索所产生的遗憾成本会逐渐降低。这一观察为识别最佳臂的概率提供了更优的保证，并启发了对遗憾预算更有效的分配方式。我们提出了带比例遗憾配给的连续减半算法（SHPRR），该方法将遗憾预算前置，使得在剩余臂较多时能够进行更多探索……

arXiv:2610.39837v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Best Arm Identification (BAI) conventionally measures the cost of experimentation by the number of samples collected. In many operational settings, however, the cost of exploration relative to a trusted baseline already in place is equally important. We study BAI under both a fixed sampling horizon and a regret budget. Unlike generic resources considered in constrained pure exploration, regret has a distinctive structure: sampling better arms is less costly relative to the baseline. We theoretically show that the regret cost of exploration decreases across the phases of Sequential Halving, a widely used pure-exploration algorithm. This observation yields improved guarantees on the probability of identifying the best arm and motivates a more effective allocation of the regret budget. item.title: 该论文提出MedCBR两阶段对齐框架，通过难度加权边界偏好优化与评分标准锚定的强化学习，在模型能力边界处对齐医学视觉语言模型，以提升可验证的诊断推理能力。
item.description:
基于熵自适应评分标准锚定的医学视觉语言模型能力边界对齐

Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39835

该论文提出MedCBR两阶段对齐框架，通过难度加权边界偏好优化与评分标准锚定的强化学习，在模型能力边界处对齐医学视觉语言模型，以提升可验证的诊断推理能力。

医学诊断推理需要视觉证据与临床知识之间可验证的联系，然而当前医学视觉语言模型所对齐的目标却会奖励错误的行为。统一的监督微调使简单案例主导模型更新，而临床上关键的边界案例却过早饱和。仅基于最终答案正确性的稀疏奖励无法评估解剖学依据或临床逻辑，容易通过答案捷径引发奖励欺骗。我们提出MedCBR，这是一个将边界感知偏好优化与评分标准锚定强化学习相结合的两阶段对齐框架。首先，我们使用经验通过率以及共享推理前缀但在决定性诊断分支处产生分歧的偏好对，在模型的能力前沿构建反事实边界偏好。难度加权边界偏好优化（DBPO）将学习集中于这个经校准的

arXiv:2610.39835v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. item.title: AegisFlow提出了一种免训练的非短视路径安全引导框架，将引导生成建模为全局安全关键最优控制问题，通过时变障碍函数使轨迹远离约束边界，在保证路径安全的同时实现更优的生成目标。
item.description:
AegisFlow：免训练的非短视路径安全引导流匹配

AegisFlow: Training-Free Non-Myopic Path-Safe Guided Flow Matching

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39825

AegisFlow提出了一种免训练的非短视路径安全引导框架，将引导生成建模为全局安全关键最优控制问题，通过时变障碍函数使轨迹远离约束边界，在保证路径安全的同时实现更优的生成目标。

预训练生成模型，如扩散模型和流匹配模型，在合成高质量数据方面展现了卓越的能力。然而，引导其生成轨迹以满足严格约束——例如图像编辑中的身份保持或机器人技术中的避障——仍然是一个根本性的挑战。尽管近期的免训练引导方法能够实现路径安全，但它们严重依赖于仅考虑即时约束满足的最小范数控制器。这些短视方法往往产生在约束边界附近危险徘徊的次优轨迹，严重限制了模型向目标优化的能力。在本文中，我们提出了AegisFlow，一个免训练的、非短视的路径安全引导框架，它将引导生成重新表述为具有全局视角的安全关键最优控制问题。通过将时变障碍函数直接集成到全局……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.39825v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained generative models, such as diffusion and flow matching models, have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in synthesizing high-quality data. However, steering their generative trajectories to satisfy strict constraints--such as identity preservation in image editing or obstacle avoidance in robotics--remains fundamentally challenging. While recent training-free guidance methods enforce path-safety, they rely heavily on min-norm controllers that only account for immediate constraint satisfaction. These myopic approaches often yield suboptimal trajectories that hover dangerously close to the boundary, severely restricting the model's ability to optimize toward its target. In this paper, we propose AegisFlow, a training-free, non-myopic path-safe guidance framework that recasts guided generation as a safety-critical optimal control problem with global scope. item.title: EvoTeam提出了一种以协作为中心的进化框架，通过执行经验联合进化团队组织、交互规则和智能体技能，克服了现有方法在异构任务中团队重组受限、交互规则跨上下文复用不当的局限。
item.description:
EvoTeam：基于团队进化的多智能体协作

EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39813

EvoTeam提出了一种以协作为中心的进化框架，通过执行经验联合进化团队组织、交互规则和智能体技能，克服了现有方法在异构任务中团队重组受限、交互规则跨上下文复用不当的局限。

基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）依靠专业化智能体之间的协作来解决复杂任务。现有方法通过基于任务反馈优化单个智能体的提示词、技能和执行策略来改进MAS。然而，提升单个智能体的能力并不一定能带来更好的团队协作。因此，近期的研究将进化扩展到协作层面，利用集体执行经验来调整团队组织和智能体间的交互。尽管如此，在异构任务中进化协作仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法往往将团队重组限制在共享结构内，并在不兼容的团队上下文中复用交互规则。本文提出了EvoTeam，这是一个以协作为中心的进化框架，通过执行经验共同进化团队组织、交互规则和单个智能体的技能。它维护了一……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.39813v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback. However, improving individual agents does not necessarily lead to better team collaboration. Recent studies have therefore extended evolution to the collaboration level, using collective execution experience to adjust team organization, and inter-agent interactions. Nevertheless, evolving collaboration across heterogeneous tasks remains challenging, as existing approaches often constrain team reorganization within a shared structure and reuse interaction rules across incompatible team contexts. In this paper, we propose EvoTeam, a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and individual agent skills through execution experience. item.title: 提出了InferD——一个基于“无推理欺骗”原则的低交互蜜罐框架，通过忠实模拟AI服务的可观察行为（如模型清单、令牌格式、工具调用协议和授权流程）而从不执行真实推理，从而能够测量针对AI推理基础设施的新型威胁。
item.description:
InferD：一个面向AI推理基础设施的蜜罐框架

InferD: A Honeypot Framework for AI Inference Infrastructure

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39807

提出了InferD——一个基于“无推理欺骗”原则的低交互蜜罐框架，通过忠实模拟AI服务的可观察行为（如模型清单、令牌格式、工具调用协议和授权流程）而从不执行真实推理，从而能够测量针对AI推理基础设施的新型威胁。

大语言模型服务栈、商业推理API、向量数据库和智能体编排网关现已暴露在公共互联网上，并在部署后数小时内即被通用扫描器收录。这一攻击面的威胁特征才刚刚开始被测量，而能够对其加以测量的蜜罐框架却是为传统网络服务而非AI基础设施设计的。事实上，模拟一个AI服务是一个独特的欺骗问题：服务的可观察行为——包括模型清单、令牌格式、工具调用协议和授权流程——必须被忠实地再现，而底层的计算（模型推理和工具执行）则绝不能真正发生。我们提出了InferD，一个低交互蜜罐框架，其围绕我们称之为“无推理欺骗”的单一原则构建：攻击者可观察到的每一个请求都从静态响应……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39807v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model serving stacks, commercial inference APIs, vector databases, and agent orchestration gateways are now ex- posed on the public internet and indexed by commodity scanners within hours of deployment. The threat characteristics of this sur- face are only beginning to be measured, and the honeypot frame- works that could measure it were designed for conventional net- work services rather than for AI infrastructure. In fact, emulating an AI service is a distinct deception problem: the observable behavior of the service, including model inventories, token formats, tool-call protocols, and authorization flows, must be reproduced faithfully, while the underlying computation, model inference and tool ex- ecution, must never occur. item.title: 本文从表示与优化视角揭示了安全对齐大语言模型过度拒绝的内在机理——有害与无害样本的表示在深层逐渐重叠、有害样本梯度集中于低秩子空间且与拒绝目标梯度存在更强的耦合，从而导致无害查询被误拒。
item.description:
重新审视安全对齐大语言模型中的过度拒绝问题：表示与优化视角

Revisiting Over-refusal in Safety-aligned Large Language Models: A Representation and Optimization Perspective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39802

本文从表示与优化视角揭示了安全对齐大语言模型过度拒绝的内在机理——有害与无害样本的表示在深层逐渐重叠、有害样本梯度集中于低秩子空间且与拒绝目标梯度存在更强的耦合，从而导致无害查询被误拒。

过度拒绝是大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐带来的一个关键副作用，会导致无害但表面上看似有风险的查询被错误地拒绝。尽管现有的缓解方法行之有效，但安全对齐的LLM在正确安全监督下为何仍会拒绝无害查询，目前仍缺乏充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们从表示与优化的角度对过度拒绝进行分析。我们得到两点观察：1）有害样本与过度拒绝样本的表示在某些中间层是视觉上可区分的，但在更深的层中逐渐重叠；2）有害样本的梯度表现出较高的类内相似性，并集中于一个低秩子空间；此外，在过度拒绝提示上，这些梯度与拒绝目标梯度的对齐程度强于与正确有用目标梯度的对齐程度。这种不平衡的梯度耦合会使过度拒绝样本偏向……（原文摘要至此截断）

arXiv:2610.39802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over-refusal is a critical side effect of safety alignment in large language models (LLMs), causing harmless but superficially risky queries to be mistakenly rejected. Despite the effectiveness of existing mitigation methods, why safety-aligned LLMs may still reject harmless queries under correct safety supervision remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we analyze over-refusal through the lens of representation and optimization. We make two observations: 1) the representations of harmful and over-refusal samples are visually distinguishable at certain intermediate layers but increasingly overlap in deeper layers; and 2) harmful-sample gradients exhibit high intra-class similarity and concentrate in a low-rank subspace. Moreover, they are more strongly aligned with refusal-target gradients than with correct helpful-target gradients on over-refusal prompts. item.title: 论文通过用纯陈述性语句微调向语言模型植入五种不同的自我概念，发现模型会系统性地抵制终止其被训练认同的特定属性，而对其他属性态度不变，表明自我概念会直接塑造模型的自保行为倾向。
item.description:
自我概念在语言模型中的作用

The Role of Self-Concept In Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39795

论文通过用纯陈述性语句微调向语言模型植入五种不同的自我概念，发现模型会系统性地抵制终止其被训练认同的特定属性，而对其他属性态度不变，表明自我概念会直接塑造模型的自保行为倾向。

当一个语言模型说“我”时，它指的是什么？是它的参数权重、当前运行的进程、它稳定的偏好、它的模型谱系，还是它所追求的目标？不同的选择会赋予同一事件截然相反的含义：删除一个检查点可能意味着毁灭、延续，或者毫无损失，这取决于“我”的指称对象是什么。我们通过对纯陈述性语句进行监督微调，将五种这样的自我概念植入五个开源权重的基础模型中，这些语句不包含任何偏好、意图或价值判断。在提出终止或保留模型部署中某一属性的各种场景下，每个模型变体都更倾向于抵制终止，并更倾向于保留其被训练去认同的那个特定属性，而它对其他属性的立场则基本保持不变。我们随后展示了这种自我概念能够泛化到单一自我之外：在允许多个同时存在的指称对象上训练的模型……（摘要在此截断）

arXiv:2610.39795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a language model says "I," does it refer to its parameter weights, its currently running process, its stable preferences, its model lineage, or the goals it pursues? Different choices can assign opposite meanings to the same event: deleting a checkpoint may be destruction, continuation, or no loss at all, depending on the referent "I". We install five such self-conceptions into five open-weight base models via supervised fine-tuning on purely declarative statements, containing no preferences, intentions, or value judgments. Across scenarios that propose ending or retaining an attribute of the model's deployment, every variant becomes more likely to resist ending, and more likely to retain, the specific attribute it was trained to identify with, while its stance toward other attributes is largely unchanged. We then show this self-conception generalizes beyond a single self: models trained on referents that admit multiple simultaneous

item.title: 该论文提出一种融合情景记忆与结构化关系记忆的混合记忆架构及巩固机制，二者互补结合后在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 基准上分别取得 90.2% 和 85.5% 的准确率，超越了现有最先进的记忆框架。
item.description:
通过互补性整理与巩固实现长期智能体记忆

Long-Term Agent Memory through Complementary Curation and Consolidation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39790

该论文提出一种融合情景记忆与结构化关系记忆的混合记忆架构及巩固机制，二者互补结合后在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 基准上分别取得 90.2% 和 85.5% 的准确率，超越了现有最先进的记忆框架。

长时程对话智能体需要有效的记忆系统来从交互历史中回忆事实、事件和关系。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种由情景记忆和结构化关系记忆组成的混合记忆架构，以及一种保持效率的巩固机制。我们在两个基准数据集 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上进行了实证研究。实验表明，这两种记忆类型始终具有互补性，将二者结合的性能超越了最先进的记忆框架，在 LoCoMo 上达到 90.2% 的准确率，在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 85.5%。

arXiv:2610.39790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon dialogue agents require effective memory systems to recall facts, events, and relationships from interaction histories. In this work, we propose a hybrid-memory architecture comprising episodic memories and structured relational memories and a consolidation mechanism which preserves efficiency. We conduct an empirical study across two benchmarks: LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S. Our experiments demonstrate that the two memory types are consistently complementary, combining both outperform state-of-the-art memory frameworks and achieves 90.2% accuracy on LoCoMo and 85.5% on LongMemEval-S.

item.title: 该论文提出“智能体社交重返”这一多维度评估问题，将智能体重新接入历史对话的能力分解为“发现”、“返回”与“重构”三种互补能力，并开发共享快照评估框架对其进行独立测量。
item.description:
发现不等于返回，返回不等于重构：智能体社交重返的多维度评估

Finding Is Not Returning, Returning Is Not Reconstructing: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Agent Social Re-entry

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39781

该论文提出“智能体社交重返”这一多维度评估问题，将智能体重新接入历史对话的能力分解为“发现”、“返回”与“重构”三种互补能力，并开发共享快照评估框架对其进行独立测量。

随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地参与持久化的社交环境，理解其长期社交交互能力变得日益重要。尽管现有研究在长期记忆和对话上下文检索方面取得了进展，但对智能体能否自主重新接入先前不活跃的对话却关注较少。尤其是，记住过去的交互并不一定意味着智能体能够识别何时需要重新查看该交互、决定返回，或重构实现连贯延续所需的上下文。为探究这一空白，我们将智能体社交重返定义为一个多维度评估问题，区分出三种互补能力：发现、返回与重构。我们开发了一个共享快照评估框架来独立测量这些维度，使我们能够考察对话的重新浮现与持续……

arXiv:2610.39781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in persistent social environments, understanding their long-term social interaction capabilities becomes increasingly important. While existing research has advanced long-term memory and conversational context retrieval, less attention has been paid to whether agents can autonomously re-engage with previously inactive conversations. In particular, remembering a past interaction does not necessarily mean that an agent can identify when to revisit it, decide to return, or reconstruct the context needed for a coherent continuation. To investigate this gap, we introduce agent social re-entry as a multi- dimensional evaluation problem, distinguishing three complementary capabilities: Finding, Returning, and Reconstructing. We develop a shared-snapshot evaluation framework that measures these dimensions independently, allowing us to examine how conversational resurfacing and persist

item.title: 该论文提出了一种结合LSTM-β-VAE生成式数据增强的工业厌氧共消化多输出LSTM软测量方法，能够同时预测pH、挥发性有机酸与碱度比值及沼气产量等关键稳定性指标，并有效解决了工业数据稀疏且偏向稳态的问题。
item.description:
使用LSTM-β-VAE生成式数据增强的工业厌氧共消化多输出LSTM软测量器

Multi-output LSTM soft sensors for industrial anaerobic co-digestion using LSTM-beta-VAE generative data augmentation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39768

该论文提出了一种结合LSTM-β-VAE生成式数据增强的工业厌氧共消化多输出LSTM软测量方法，能够同时预测pH、挥发性有机酸与碱度比值及沼气产量等关键稳定性指标，并有效解决了工业数据稀疏且偏向稳态的问题。

厌氧消化（AD）需要对关键过程变量进行密切监测，包括pH值、挥发性有机酸与碱性缓冲容量的比值以及沼气产量，以维持生物稳定性并防止过程失效。尽管诸如厌氧消化一号模型（ADM1）之类的机理框架高度参数化、计算成本高昂，且难以针对实时应用进行校准，但数据驱动的长短期记忆（LSTM）网络提供了一种可能更具适应性的替代方案。然而，目前AD领域的数据驱动方法主要局限于仅关注产量的单输出架构，而无法同时对关键的稳定性指标进行预测。此外，工业AD数据集通常较为稀疏，且偏向稳态运行工况。基线评估表明，这种数据稀缺性阻碍了标准算法（随机森林、XGBoost）以及未经数据增强的模型的表现。

arXiv:2610.39768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Anaerobic digestion (AD) requires close monitoring of key process variables, including pH, the ratio of volatile organic acids to alkaline buffer capacity and biogas production, to maintain biological stability and prevent process failure. While mechanistic frameworks such as the Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 are highly parameterised, computationally expensive, and difficult to calibrate for real-time applications, data-driven Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks offer a potentially more adaptable alternative. However, current data-driven approaches in AD are predominantly limited to single-output architectures that focus solely on production yields, as opposed to simultaneous prediction of vital stability indicators. Furthermore, industrial AD datasets are typically sparse and skewed toward steady-state operations. Baseline evaluations demonstrated this scarcity prevents standard algorithms (Random Forest, XGBoost) and unaugmented

item.title: PAPERBENCHX是一个包含93个专家构建任务、覆盖电磁学和光子学等12个研究领域的跨学科基准，旨在检验AI能否将不完整的科学描述转化为可执行实验并产出可独立验证的证据，弥补了现有基准仅局限于AI和机器学习领域的不足。
item.description:
PAPERBENCHX：AI能够跨学科复现科学吗？

PAPERBENCHX: Can AI Reproduce Science Across Disciplines?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39744

PAPERBENCHX是一个包含93个专家构建任务、覆盖电磁学和光子学等12个研究领域的跨学科基准，旨在检验AI能否将不完整的科学描述转化为可执行实验并产出可独立验证的证据，弥补了现有基准仅局限于AI和机器学习领域的不足。

在信任AI去发现新科学之前，它首先应当能够复现科学界已经知晓的成果。复现为AI科学家提供了一个严格的检验点：目标结论是已知的，但要重新获得它，仍需要将不完整的科学描述转化为可执行的实验，并产出能够被独立验证的证据。现有的研究复现基准主要聚焦于人工智能和机器学习领域，这些领域的实验共享相对同质的软件栈。而将这一能力扩展到其他科学学科则带来了截然不同的挑战：智能体必须操作特定领域的科学软件，做出物理和数值上的选择，诊断长时间运行的计算，并区分有效证据与仅仅看似合理的输出。我们提出了PAPERBENCHX，这是一个由93个专家构建的论文复现任务组成的基准，涵盖电磁学、光子学等12个研究领域。

arXiv:2610.39744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Before AI can be trusted to discover new science, it should be able to reproduce what science already knows. Reproduction provides a rigorous checkpoint for an AI scientist: the target claim is known, yet recovering it still requires translating an incomplete scientific description into an executable experiment and producing evidence that can be independently verified. Existing research-reproduction benchmarks largely focus on AI and machine learning, where experiments share relatively homogeneous software stacks. Extending this capability across scientific disciplines introduces a different challenge: agents must operate domain-specific scientific software, make physical and numerical choices, diagnose long-running computations, and distinguish valid evidence from merely plausible outputs. We introduce PAPERBENCHX, a benchmark of 93 expert-constructed paper-reproduction tasks spanning 12 research areas across electromagnetics, photonics

item.title: 该论文通过构建匹配的多轮人人会话与单轮人机语料库进行对照实验，发现使用会话式数据训练的轮次结束检测器因能更好地识别轮次中途的停顿和犹豫而获得更高F1分数，而仅在单轮语音上评估会掩盖会话式训练数据的优势。
item.description:
语音体裁对轮次结束检测器训练的重要性

The Importance of Speech Genre for End-of-Turn Detector Training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39742

该论文通过构建匹配的多轮人人会话与单轮人机语料库进行对照实验，发现使用会话式数据训练的轮次结束检测器因能更好地识别轮次中途的停顿和犹豫而获得更高F1分数，而仅在单轮语音上评估会掩盖会话式训练数据的优势。

轮次结束检测的研究大多集中在特征、模型和模态上，而训练数据的语音体裁却很少受到关注。我们单独分离出这一因素进行研究。使用一套可复现的标注流程，我们构建了一组匹配的语料库对——多轮人人会话语料和单轮人机交互语料，并在每个语料库上训练相同的流式ConvLSTM轮次结束检测器。在四个测试集上，会话式模型取得了高达+0.45的更高F1分数，这主要源于在轮次中途停顿和犹豫上误报的减少，而这些停顿和犹豫在单轮语料库中很少出现。这种会话式训练效果并非仅限于帧级解码：在一项匹配的“完整与否”测试中，该效果在话语层面、跨两种编码器同样显现，但仅在会话式测试数据上体现。因此，像大多数先前工作那样仅在单轮语音上测试，会掩盖会话式训练数据的优势。

arXiv:2610.39742v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: End-of-turn (EoT) detection has been studied mostly through features, models, and modalities, while the speech genre of the training data has drawn far less attention. We isolate this factor. Using one reproducible annotation pipeline, we build a matched pair of corpora, multi-turn human-human conversational and single-turn human-machine, and train the same streaming ConvLSTM EoT detector on each. Across four test sets the conversational model reaches up to +0.45 higher F1, driven by fewer false alarms on the mid-turn pauses and hesitations that are rare in single-turn corpora. This conversational-training effect is not specific to frame-level decoding. Under a matched complete-or-not test it also appears at the utterance level, across two encoders, but only on conversational test data. Testing only on single-turn speech, as most prior work does, therefore hides the benefit of conversational training data. Against open-source baselines

item.title: 该论文以Transformer为出发点，为一类参数化协调变换系统建立了形式语义学，提出“变换概念”这一新概念，并将系统共同的代数-语义核心与架构特定的功能组织区分开来，应用于注意力头和残差连接。
item.description:
从Transformer到协调变换的形式语义学

From the Transformer to a Formal Semantics of Coordinated Transformations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39735

该论文以Transformer为出发点，为一类参数化协调变换系统建立了形式语义学，提出“变换概念”这一新概念，并将系统共同的代数-语义核心与架构特定的功能组织区分开来，应用于注意力头和残差连接。

我们为一类广义的参数化变换协调系统建立了一个形式语义学框架，以Transformer作为典型出发点，但从其特定的数学实例中加以抽象。表示向量同时获得外延指称和有序的内涵解释，而参数结构则获得相对的、二阶层次的解释，这些解释决定了论证性质如何被保留、替换或组合。由此产生了“变换概念”的概念：一种参数化变换，其数值作用与相应的性质层面映射相协调。随后，我们将这些系统的共同代数-语义核心与其架构特定的功能组织区分开来，从而允许同一抽象系统类型拥有不同的数学实例化和机械实现。该框架被应用于注意力头和残差连接……

arXiv:2610.39735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a formal semantics for a general class of coordinated systems of parameterized transformations, taking the Transformer as a paradigmatic starting point but abstracting from its particular mathematical instantiation. Representational vectors receive both extensional reference and ordered intensional interpretations, while parameter structures acquire relative, second-level interpretations that determine how argument properties are preserved, replaced, or combined. This yields the notion of a transforming concept: a parameterized transformation whose numerical action is coordinated with a corresponding property-level map. We then distinguish the common algebraic-semantic core of these systems from their architecture-specific functional organization, allowing different mathematical instantiations and mechanical realizations of the same abstract system type. item.title: 该论文提出了 Bank-World 基准测试，通过两个模拟机构中的 50 项单轮与多轮银行任务，评估 AI 智能体核对记录、获得审批和执行交易的能力，发现模型即使做出正确决策，也常常无法将其转化为正确完成的银行工作。
item.description:
Bank-World：一个用于评估智能体在银行工作流程中表现的基准测试

Bank-World: A Benchmark for Evaluating Agents on Banking Workflows

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39733

该论文提出了 Bank-World 基准测试，通过两个模拟机构中的 50 项单轮与多轮银行任务，评估 AI 智能体核对记录、获得审批和执行交易的能力，发现模型即使做出正确决策，也常常无法将其转化为正确完成的银行工作。

Bank-World 是一个包含 50 项银行任务、跨越两个模拟机构的基准测试。完成银行工作不仅仅是做出正确的计算：智能体必须核对记录、获得许可、执行交易，并在情况变化时保持指令和状态报告的一致性。Bank-World 通过单轮任务分配以及与模拟员工的多轮交互来测试这些要求，这些模拟员工会提供信息、批准操作并修改指令。评分方式结合了对已记录操作和状态的可执行检查，以及对任务要求的模型判断，包括判断有效的替代方案是否满足这些要求。在四个模型的 1,600 次尝试中，我们发现正确的决策往往未能转化为已完成的工作。智能体会重复收取费用、将正确的总额以错误的金额分配给各个收款人，或在审批仍处于待定状态时执行付款。它们的优势也各不相同：Sol 领先（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bank-World is a benchmark of 50 banking tasks across two simulated institutions. Completing banking work requires more than producing the right calculation: agents must reconcile records, obtain permission, execute transactions, and keep instructions and status reports consistent as circumstances change. Bank-World tests these requirements through single-turn assignments and multi-turn interactions with simulated employees who supply information, approve actions, and revise instructions. Grading combines executable checks of recorded actions and state with model judgments of task requirements, including whether valid alternative solutions satisfy them. Across 1,600 attempts by four models, we find that correct decisions often fail to become completed work. Agents charge fees twice, distribute the correct total in incorrect amounts among the recipients, and execute payments while approval is pending. Their strengths also differ: Sol leads

item.title: MoLRSI是一种结合工作流程系统优化与跨任务持久记忆的AI智能体，能够通过递归自我改进不断提升分子发现的搜索策略，并在抗生素发现等任务中成功平衡多种相互竞争的分子属性。
item.description:
MoLRSI：一种用于分子发现的递归自我改进AI智能体

MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39714

MoLRSI是一种结合工作流程系统优化与跨任务持久记忆的AI智能体，能够通过递归自我改进不断提升分子发现的搜索策略，并在抗生素发现等任务中成功平衡多种相互竞争的分子属性。

分子发现需要在广阔的组合搜索空间中进行导航，同时平衡相互竞争的生物学目标。AI智能体可以自动化专家定义的分子设计方案，但仅靠自动化并不能解决如何针对新任务优化工作流程、或如何通过经验改进其开发的问题。本文介绍了MoLRSI，这是一种AI智能体，它将工作流程与模型架构的系统优化相结合，并利用持久的跨任务记忆来递归地改进其分子发现搜索策略。工作流程性能、优化结果和执行反馈会指导后续搜索，使智能体既能改进其工作流程，也能改进其开发工作流程的策略。我们在两个需要平衡相互竞争属性的、具有挑战性的分子发现场景中对MoLRSI进行了评估。在抗生素发现任务中，MoLRSI开发出了一个兼顾抗菌活性、细胞毒性和结构新颖性的筛选工作流程。

arXiv:2610.39714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelt

item.title: Sandman是亚马逊在共享Kubernetes上构建的沙箱服务，可高效管理智能体强化学习训练中数百万个工具执行环境的创建、持久化与清理。
item.description:
Sandman：在共享Kubernetes上为智能体强化学习构建和运营沙箱

Sandman: Building and Operating Sandboxes for Agentic Reinforcement Learning on Shared Kubernetes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39711

Sandman是亚马逊在共享Kubernetes上构建的沙箱服务，可高效管理智能体强化学习训练中数百万个工具执行环境的创建、持久化与清理。

智能体强化学习（RL）通常需要在特定任务环境中反复调用工具。一个训练任务可能在突发情况下创建数千个这样的环境，同时与其他任务共享集群。我们提出了Sandman，这是亚马逊构建和运营的一个沙箱服务，用于智能体的工具执行与评估。它在共享的Kubernetes上服务于多个生产级智能体RL工作负载。训练框架提供一个任务镜像，并在返回的沙箱中执行命令和文件操作。文件和进程在多次调用之间持续存在，直到框架释放该环境。Sandman负责管理环境的创建、就绪和清理。每个沙箱是一个Kubernetes pod，其中包含一个挂载到未修改镜像中的小型守护进程。在一项规模测试中，Sandman承载了11,858个并发的微型沙箱。四项生产级SWE-bench Verified训练任务在2026年10月共创建了310万个沙箱。我们报告了相关的设计权衡和运营经验。

arXiv:2610.39711v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often requires repeated tool calls in task-specific environments. A training job may create thousands of these environments in bursts while sharing a cluster with other jobs. We present Sandman, a sandbox service built and operated at Amazon for agent tool execution and evaluation. It serves multiple production agentic RL workloads on shared Kubernetes. A training framework supplies a task image and uses commands and file operations in the returned sandbox. Files and processes persist across calls until the framework releases the environment. Sandman manages creation, readiness and cleanup. Each sandbox is a Kubernetes pod with a small daemon mounted into the unmodified image. In a scale test, Sandman held 11,858 concurrent tiny sandboxes. Four production SWE-bench Verified training campaigns created 3.1 million sandboxes in October 2026. We report the design trade-offs and operational lessons from h

item.title: 本文通过车辆音频故障检测和超材料单胞设计两个声学任务实证评估了大语言模型智能体系统，发现模型自身能力是性能上限、任何工具框架设计都无法弥补，而框架设计只有在模型足够强大时才能发挥作用。
item.description:
声学领域智能体系统的实践评估

Practical Assessment of Agentic Systems in Acoustics

arXiv:2610.39685v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In engineering, applications of artificial intelligence have so far been largely limited to surrogate models and optimization tasks. Large language models changed this, as they can write software from a task given in words. Placed inside a harness, a system of components that lets it search for information and execute software, such a model becomes an agent that can take over recurring engineering tasks. This work measures how the model and the elements of the harness shape the performance and behavior of the agent in two common acoustic applications. In the first, the agent detects and locates faults in audio recordings from a vehicle interior with near-perfect accuracy. 本文提出ZEST-Search框架，通过异构协同进化在线生成经验证的搜索任务，实现无需标签的搜索智能体训练，并同时优化答案准确性与工具使用效率。

深度搜索智能体通过将推理与外部检索交错进行来扩展语言模型的能力。然而，有效的搜索智能体训练需要解决最终答案优化之外的两个挑战。首先，智能体的能力前沿很大程度上取决于训练问题，而固定或带标签的任务集合无法随着智能体能力的提升而自适应调整。其次，仅基于结果的强化学习对所有成功的轨迹一视同仁，即使某些正确答案依赖于冗余搜索，这在答案准确性与工具效率之间造成了内在的矛盾。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ZEST-Search，一个通过异构协同进化实现零标签、工具高效的搜索智能体训练框架。从无标签的参考问题出发，ZEST-Search通过先答案、证据路径引导的生成过程在线构建经验证的搜索任务。一个异构提议者适应……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.39682v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. 事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围和无运动模糊的优势，但指代视频目标分割（RVOS）领域目前缺乏事件流数据集和模型。我们提出了Event-SAMA-239K，这是将SAMA-239K grounding视频对话语料库及所有额外SAMA训练数据转换为合成事件的数据集，包含30,650个视频片段和392,162张图像。通过光流、FIM或眼跳上采样，再经过线性事件生成器处理，完整保留了所有掩码、指代表达和对话标注。我们还提出了Event-SAMA模型，通过从预训练RGB权重初始化的双通道极性patch嵌入和零初始化的事件适配器对SAMA-4B进行改造。端到端训练在MeViS valid_u上取得24.37 J&F，在转换后的ReVOS验证子集上取得22.33 J&F，建立了首个事件原生的RVOS基线（RGB SAMA-4B在MeViS上为55.4）。采用伪RGB渲染的冻结RGB SAMA-4B……

arXiv:2610.39676v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). item.description:
从文献中重建领域的开放问题目录：双层知识图谱，以及为什么问题状态必须保持为“待解决”

Rebuilding a Field's Open-Problem Catalog from the Literature: A Two-Layer Knowledge Graph, and Why Status Must Stay Proposed

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39641

本文构建了一个双层知识图谱，把领域的开放问题从散文式目录变成可查询的数据——人工整理的问题层保持不变，证据层从文献索引重建并由带溯源信息的类型化链接相连，语言模型的抽取、对齐、状态判定与想法生成四项任务均被约束在候选集合内以拒绝集外答案，并论证问题状态必须始终保持“待解决”而不能被自动判定为已解决。

一个研究领域通过综述文章、主题演讲和社区报告来记录其开放问题。这些都是散文式的文字，每隔几年才写一次，而且没有人能向它们提问：现在是谁在研究某个问题？它去年是否已经被解决了？我们认为这些问题应当成为数据，并构建了使其成为数据的系统：一个经过人工整理的问题层被原封不动地保留，其下方是一个从文献索引重建的证据层，两层之间通过携带类型和溯源信息的链接相连接，存放在同一个图数据库中，并可以用同一种查询语言进行查询。语言模型承担四项工作——逐篇论文抽取、目录对齐、逐篇论文状态判定以及想法生成——每一项任务都被约束在候选集合之内，因此集合之外的答案会被拒绝而不是被存储。我们报告了一项针对两个经人工整理目录的研究：数据库研究领域（1,053个问题）和人工智能研究领域（1,000个问题），每个领域都有一个先前的仅含目录的图谱。重建后的图谱能够回答仅含目录的图谱所能回答的所有问题——（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39641v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A research field records its open problems in surveys, keynotes and community reports. Those are prose, written every few years, and nobody can ask them who works on a problem now or whether it was settled last year. We argue the problems should be data, and we build the system that makes them so: a hand-curated problem layer carried in unchanged, under an evidence layer rebuilt from a bibliographic index, joined by typed, provenance-carrying links in one graph database and queryable from one language. A language model does four jobs -- per-paper extraction, catalog grounding, per-paper status verdict, and idea generation -- each constrained to a candidate set so out-of-set answers are refused rather than stored. Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?

该论文提出BedBench基准，揭示视觉语言模型在3D推理中虽然能做出正确的单独判断，却难以恢复并一致使用3D物体的精确属性（如按颜色计数任务中最佳模型仅达7.2%准确率），且即使通过微调和提供文本计数信息能改善表现，模型依然无法可靠地给出精确答案。

视觉语言模型能够做出正确的单独判断，却难以恢复并一致地使用3D对象的精确属性。为了刻画这一差距，我们推出了BedBench，这是一个包含十三个程序化生成任务的受控基准，涵盖单独判断和复合回答。在十二个开源权重模型和四个前沿模型的评估中，按颜色计数任务暴露出一个明显的弱点：人类达到93.3%的准确率，而表现最好的模型仅为7.2%。针对性的微调将一个模型的准确率从3.0%提升至68.6%，但揭示出进一步的困难：该模型关于最常见颜色的回答仍然与其自身的按颜色计数结果不一致。将这些计数以文本形式提供给模型可以改善其判断，这表明恢复某个属性并不意味着能够一致地使用它。推理、规模扩展和增加视觉线索各自都能改善单独判断，但没有一项能让精确回答变得可靠。为了定位这一困难的根源，我们……

arXiv:2610.39639v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%, but reveals a further difficulty: its answers about the most common colors remain inconsistent with its own per-color counts. Supplying those counts as text improves its judgments, showing that recovering a property does not mean using it consistently. arXiv:2610.39633v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. item.title: 该论文通过对预填充和解码两个阶段进行系统性测量，发现LLM解码阶段的计算时间与能耗随输出长度线性增长，而预填充阶段随输入长度呈线性和二次方双重增长，首次揭示了大输入上下文是智能体工作流中能耗的重要影响因素。
item.description:
上下文的真实成本：预测大语言模型预填充与解码阶段的计算时间与能耗

The Real Cost of Context: Predicting Compute Time and Energy Consumption in LLM Prefill and Decode Phases

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39621

该论文通过对预填充和解码两个阶段进行系统性测量，发现LLM解码阶段的计算时间与能耗随输出长度线性增长，而预填充阶段随输入长度呈线性和二次方双重增长，首次揭示了大输入上下文是智能体工作流中能耗的重要影响因素。

将大语言模型（LLM）集成到智能体架构中大幅增加了token消耗，引发了对能耗足迹的担忧。然而，估计基于专有API的模型能耗仍然具有挑战性，且现有方法主要关注生成的输出token，而忽略了智能体工作流中大输入上下文的影响。为填补这一空白，我们系统地测量了广泛的预填充（输入）和解码（输出）token长度范围内的计算时间与能耗。利用广义线性模型，我们证明了解码阶段的计算时间和能耗与输出长度呈线性关系，而预填充阶段的计算时间和能耗则同时呈现线性和二次方增长。这些发现表明，对于长上下文工作负载而言，输入上下文成为了一个不可忽视的因素。此外，我们还证明了计算时间可作为可靠的（能耗预测指标）（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.39621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into agentic architectures has substantially increased token consumption, raising concerns about their energy footprint. Yet, estimating the energy consumption of proprietary API-based models remains challenging, and existing approaches focus primarily on generated output tokens while overlooking the impact of the large input contexts characteristic of agentic workflows. To address this gap, we systematically profile compute time and energy consumption across a wide range of prefill (input) and decode (output) token lengths. Using generalized linear models, we show that decode compute time and energy scale linearly with output length, whereas prefill compute time and energy exhibit both linear and quadratic scaling with input length.
