https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39620

该论文提出了让AI智能体自主提出研究问题（而非由人类指定研究方向）的自主研究系统，通过问题构思与跨模型同行评审两项技能实现全流程自主研究，并完整公开报告了全部13次开发运行结果。

诸如The AI Scientist之类的系统已经证明，AI智能体能够开展研究并撰写论文，但在那些演示中，研究方向由人类选定，展示的成果也由人类挑选。我们研究了让AI自行提出研究问题，并报告了每一次运行的结果。我们的系统为现成的编程智能体提供了一份指令文档和两项技能：一项用于提出研究问题，智能体从近期技术出发发散到其他领域的问题，对候选问题进行已知失败模式的筛查，并从另一个模型获取批评意见；另一项用于同行评审，在该智能体修改论文之前，由来自另一模型家族的审稿人根据研究记录重新运行整个研究。在13次开发运行中，设定研究领域的一两句话发生改动时，候选问题和最终选定论文的主题也随之发生巨大变化，这引导我们进入了一项新技术所涉及的研究领域。

arXiv:2610.39620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Systems such as The AI Scientist have shown that AI agents can carry out and write up research, but in those demonstrations humans chose the research area and selected the outputs to show. We study letting the AI formulate the research question itself, and we report every run. Our system gives an off-the-shelf coding agent an instruction document and two skills: one for formulating the question, in which the agent diverges from recent technologies into problems of other fields, screens its candidates for known failure modes and obtains a critique from a different model; and one for peer review, in which a reviewer from another model family reruns the study from its records before the agent revises the paper. Over 13 development runs, changes to the one or two sentences that set the research area coincided with large shifts in what the candidate questions and the chosen papers were about, which led us to the area of a new technology appli

item.title: 本文证明，在把句子视为词元经验测度、以最大熵原理从“无结构先验”中选取后验分布的语言统计模型中，Transformer架构（softmax注意力规则、query-key矩阵与value矩阵）作为后验定律的得分自然涌现，且query-key与value矩阵分别对应句内与语言层面的熵约束的拉格朗日乘子而彼此解耦。
item.description:
Transformer架构作为随机测度熵定律之得分的涌现

Emergence of the transformer architecture as the score of entropic laws of random measures

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39614

本文证明，在把句子视为词元经验测度、以最大熵原理从“无结构先验”中选取后验分布的语言统计模型中，Transformer架构（softmax注意力规则、query-key矩阵与value矩阵）作为后验定律的得分自然涌现，且query-key与value矩阵分别对应句内与语言层面的熵约束的拉格朗日乘子而彼此解耦。

我们证明，在一个自然的语言统计模型中，Transformer架构作为最后一个词元定律的得分而涌现；在该模型中，句子是词元的经验测度，一种语言是 $P(S^d)$ 上的一个概率定律，而我们的先验信念是句子完全不携带任何结构。根据最大熵原理，我们在所有能够再现观测到的句子级统计量的定律中，选取在相对熵意义下最接近该先验的定律。我们讨论了该统计量在词元间后验交互中的相关性，并利用在最低关系阶数处截断的Luce选择公理，构建了一个能够捕捉这种交互的统计量。这一过程给出了softmax选择规则，其中注意力交叉矩作为其均值参数。由此，查询-键矩阵成为每个句子内部最大熵问题的拉格朗日乘子，而值矩阵则是关于整个语言层面约束的乘子，因此二者是相互解耦的。

arXiv:2610.39614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the transformer architecture emerges as the score of last-token laws in a natural statistical model of language, where sentences are empirical measures of tokens, a language is a law on $P(S^d)$, and our prior belief is that sentences carry no structure at all. By the maximum-entropy principle, we select the law closest to this prior in relative entropy among those reproducing an observed sentence-level statistic. We discuss the relevance of the statistic in the posterior interaction between tokens and we build a statistic, able to capture that interaction, with Luce's choice axiom truncated at the lowest relational order. This procedure gives the softmax choice rule, with the attention cross-moment as its mean parameter. The query--key matrix is then the Lagrange multiplier of a maximum-entropy problem inside each sentence, and the value matrix the multiplier of the constraint over the language, so that the two are untied.

item.title: 提出了契约治理的智能体式数据集搜索框架AgenticDS，通过将语言模型的每个决策实例化为类型化对象并由确定性代码校验，确保检索到的训练数据满足查询的硬性约束并真正提升模型训练效果。
item.description:
从意图到改进：面向更优模型训练的智能体式数据集搜索

From Intent to Improvement: Agentic Dataset Search for Better Model Training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39608

提出了契约治理的智能体式数据集搜索框架AgenticDS，通过将语言模型的每个决策实例化为类型化对象并由确定性代码校验，确保检索到的训练数据满足查询的硬性约束并真正提升模型训练效果。

在百万级规模的机器学习仓库中寻找训练数据本质上是一个网页搜索问题，但仅靠文本相关性是不够的。一个查询将语义化的训练目标与诸如任务、许可证和训练阶段等约束条件结合在一起，而用于验证这些约束的元数据往往缺失。文本检索通过相似度对数据集卡片进行排序，但无法强制执行硬性约束，也无法追踪那些能够关联到描述稀疏的数据集的关系。自由形式的工具调用智能体虽然更加灵活，但选择数据集的同一个模型也会宣布它是匹配项，没有任何机制检查查询的约束是否真正得到满足。这两种方法都无法保证其返回的数据能够改进模型训练。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AgenticDS，一个由契约治理的智能体框架，其中每个语言模型决策在确定性代码消费它之前都会实例化为一个类型化对象。该框架将查询编译为类型化的搜索计划并执行……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finding training data in million-scale machine learning repositories is a Web search problem where text relevance is not enough. A query couples a semantic training goal with constraints such as task, license, and training stage, and the metadata that would verify them are often missing. Text retrieval ranks dataset cards by similarity but cannot enforce hard constraints or follow the relations that reach a sparsely described dataset. Free-form tool-calling agents are more flexible, but the same model that picks a dataset also declares it a match, and nothing checks that the query's constraints are actually met. Neither approach establishes that the data it returns will improve model training. To address it, we propose AgenticDS, a contract-governed agentic framework in which every language model decision instantiates a typed object before deterministic code consumes it. item.title: 本研究首次针对六个主流大语言模型，使用约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语的对抗性提示词开展红队安全测试，发现模型在低资源非洲语言中的安全防线明显失效，攻击成功率显著上升，而这主要源于模型对这些语言的理解不足而非更安全的行为。
item.description:
在低资源非洲语言中对大型语言模型进行红队测试：以约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语为例

Red-Teaming Large Language Models in Low-Resource African Languages: A Case Study of Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39590

本研究首次针对六个主流大语言模型，使用约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语的对抗性提示词开展红队安全测试，发现模型在低资源非洲语言中的安全防线明显失效，攻击成功率显著上升，而这主要源于模型对这些语言的理解不足而非更安全的行为。

随着大型语言模型（LLM）在非洲日益普及，其在低资源语言中的安全性在很大程度上仍未经过测试，因为大多数红队测试工作都集中在英语上。本研究使用400个明确的对抗性提示词评估了六个最先进的LLM，这些提示词以约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语编写，并被划分为四个伤害类别。模型响应由母语标注者进行评分，并使用Cohen的κ系数评估评分的可靠性。尽管这些模型拒绝了高达69%的英语提示词，但在约鲁巴语中拒绝率却低至0%，这并不是因为它们更安全，而是因为它们无法理解这些提示词。对于大多数模型而言，在尼日利亚语言中的攻击成功率均有所上升，其中GPT-4o Mini表现出最显著的跨语言安全差异（约鲁巴语中+0.23）。当模型确实对对抗性提示词做出回应时，许多回应是有害的，有害内容的比例在英语中达到0.63，在（原文此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39590v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become more widespread in Africa, their safety in low-resource languages remains largely untested since most red-teaming work focuses on English. This study evaluates six state-of-the-art LLMs using 400 explicit adversarial prompts in Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin, categorised into four harm categories. The responses were scored by native-speaker annotators and reliability was assessed using Cohen's $\kappa$. While models that rejected up to 69% of English prompts rejected as few as 0% in Yoruba, this was not because they were safer, but because they failed to understand the prompts. Attack success rates increased for most models in the Nigerian languages, with GPT-4o Mini demonstrating the most significant cross-lingual safety discrepancy (+0.23 in Yoruba). item.title: 本研究通过对234名中国大学生的问卷调查发现，学生虽普遍对生成式AI提示能力有信心，但其提示策略对不同学术任务类型的适配性有限。
item.description:
中国大学生在不同学术任务中的生成式人工智能提示策略

Generative artificial intelligence prompting strategies among Chinese university students across academic tasks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39571

本研究通过对234名中国大学生的问卷调查发现，学生虽普遍对生成式AI提示能力有信心，但其提示策略对不同学术任务类型的适配性有限。

生成式人工智能日益融入大学学习之中，然而有效的人机（GenAI）交互不仅取决于能否使用这些工具，还取决于学生为学术任务构建、评估和改进提示词的能力。本研究考察了大学生对自身GenAI提示能力的感知及其所报告的提示策略。研究采用描述性统计、测量建模、情境比较、结构关联分析以及可选评论的定性编码等方法，对234名学生的问卷数据进行了分析。学生报告在各种学术活动中使用GenAI，并普遍对自身提示能力表示有信心，尤其是在提供相关背景信息以及根据初始输出改进提示词方面。然而，提示策略对不同任务类型的敏感性有限：在创意工作坊准备情境中，指定输出格式这一策略得到了更强的认可（摘要原文不完整，此处为现有内容之翻译）

arXiv:2610.39571v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly embedded in university learning, yet effective human-GenAI interaction depends not only on access to these tools but also on students' ability to formulate, evaluate, and refine prompts for academic tasks. This study examined university students' perceived GenAI prompting capability and reported prompting strategies. Questionnaire data from 234 students were analyzed using descriptive statistics, measurement modelling, scenario comparisons, structural associations, and qualitative coding of optional comments. Students reported using GenAI across diverse academic activities and generally expressed confidence in their prompting capabilities, particularly in providing relevant context and refining prompts following initial outputs. item.title: 该论文提出了一个让LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选设计并利用板载性能测量指导设计决策的开发环境，评估速度比RTL仿真快9.6倍，成功将单周期RV32I核心开发为达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz的三发射乱序RV32IM核心。
item.description:
基于LLM智能体的RISC-V CPU设计及FPGA在环评估方法

LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39570

该论文提出了一个让LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选设计并利用板载性能测量指导设计决策的开发环境，评估速度比RTL仿真快9.6倍，成功将单周期RV32I核心开发为达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz的三发射乱序RV32IM核心。

CPU候选设计的长时间RTL仿真可能需要数小时，而短时间的诊断运行可能会遗漏在执行后期才显现的性能退化问题。这种评估成本会延误基于LLM智能体的CPU开发中的设计决策。我们提出了一个开发环境，其中LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选设计，并利用板载性能测量来指导设计决策。我们将其应用于在人工监督下将单周期RV32I核心开发为三发射乱序RV32IM核心的过程。最终设计在Artix-7 FPGA上以130 MHz的频率达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz的性能。对于运行8,000次CoreMark迭代的同一CPU候选设计，包含实现流程在内的FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍。在一个案例中，板载测量揭示了某个候选设计虽在短时间诊断运行中表现提升，但存在长时间运行性能退化的问题。这一结果指导了候选设计的选择，并促成了基于RTL的根因分析。

arXiv:2610.39570v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cau

item.title: Raincheck提出延迟多模态预填充框架，先仅预填充少量关键token以降低首词延迟，再利用解码期间的空闲算力按序逐步补全其余多模态信息，在多轮对话中兼顾推理效率与信息完整性。
item.description:
Raincheck：面向高效多轮MLLM推理的延迟多模态预填充

Raincheck: Deferred Multimodal Prefill for Efficient Multi-Turn MLLM Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39562

Raincheck提出延迟多模态预填充框架，先仅预填充少量关键token以降低首词延迟，再利用解码期间的空闲算力按序逐步补全其余多模态信息，在多轮对话中兼顾推理效率与信息完整性。

与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的多轮对话需要复用输入上下文，但冗长的多模态输入会增加首词生成时间（TTFT）。查询感知的硬剪枝可以减少预填充token数量，却会永久排除后续问题可能需要的信息。我们提出Raincheck，一个延迟多模态预填充框架，将初始token选择与后续信息的可用性解耦。由现有剪枝方法为初始预填充选择token；Raincheck则保留未选中的token，并利用解码过程中的空闲计算能力，按源文本顺序逐步对其进行预填充。在答案返回后，未完成的预填充会在可用的调度间隙中继续进行。通过注意力可见性控制和仿射状态映射，全注意力模型和混合循环模型在生成开始后仍可实现上下文更新。预填充-解码融合则减少了重复的权重读取。我们在Qwen3-VL-8B和Qwen3.5-9B上以30%初始多模态……（评估）

arXiv:2610.39562v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-turn conversations with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reuse input context, but long multimodal inputs increase time to first token (TTFT). Query-aware hard pruning reduces prefill tokens but permanently excludes information that later questions may require. We propose Raincheck, a framework for deferred multimodal prefill that decouples initial token selection from later information availability. An existing pruning method selects tokens for initial prefill; Raincheck preserves and progressively prefills unselected tokens in source order using unused compute capacity during decode. Unfinished prefill continues after answer return during available scheduling gaps. Attention visibility control and affine state mapping enable context updates after generation begins in full-attention and hybrid recurrent models. item.title: 该论文的核心创新在于将神经网络中的概念从传统的零半径向量（点）表示扩展为非零半径的球体表示，从而能够将空间概念表示为区域，并通过模型构建与检查进行推理，以弥补传统网络在符号推理和生物认知模拟方面的不足。
item.description:
非零半径：神经网络中缺失的组成部分

Non-Zero Radius: The Missing Component of Neural Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39559

该论文的核心创新在于将神经网络中的概念从传统的零半径向量（点）表示扩展为非零半径的球体表示，从而能够将空间概念表示为区域，并通过模型构建与检查进行推理，以弥补传统网络在符号推理和生物认知模拟方面的不足。

受生物神经元“全或无”激活方式与逻辑电路真假值之间类比的启发，McCulloch和Pitts于1943年提出了一个生物神经元的数学模型，旨在模拟逻辑推理。尽管诺伯特·维纳（Norbert Wiener）当时认为该模型过于简化，但它后来成为现代神经网络（包括大语言模型）的基础构件。然而，尽管传统神经网络取得了显著的实证成功，它们在很大程度上仍是黑盒系统，且难以实现可靠的符号推理。我们将向量视为半径为零的球体，并放宽了这一零半径约束，将概念表示为具有非零半径的球体。我们认为，基于球体的表示能够捕捉生物认知的更多特征，包括将空间概念表示为区域，以及通过模型构建与检查来进行推理。基于球体嵌入，（摘要在此处不完整）

arXiv:2610.39559v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inspired by the analogy between the all-or-none activation of biological neurons and the true-false of logic circuits, McCulloch and Pitts proposed a mathematical model of the biological neuron in 1943 with the aim of simulating logical reasoning. Although Norbert Wiener considered the model overly simplistic at the time, it later became a building block of modern neural networks, including large language models. Despite their remarkable empirical success, however, conventional neural networks remain largely black-box systems and struggle with reliable symbolic reasoning. Viewing vectors as spheres of zero radius, we relax the zero-radius constraint and represent concepts as spheres with non-zero radii. We argue that sphere-based representations can capture additional features of biological cognition, including representing spatial concepts as regions and reasoning through model construction and inspection. item.description:
传播前先判断：面向多智能体隐私的任务图上下文完整性

Judging Before Propagation: Task-Graph Contextual Integrity for Multi-Agent Privacy

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39532

该论文提出任务图上下文完整性（TG-CI），这是首个面向多智能体系统的任务图原生的上下文完整性形式化方法，强调必须在信息沿工作流向下游传播之前进行隐私判断，从而克服现有局部判断机制无法保证整个工作流隐私恰当性的缺陷。

多智能体大语言模型系统日益依赖持久化记忆与智能体间通信。这些能力带来的隐私风险超出了单次交互的范畴：一条在孤立情境下恰当的信息释放，当与先前披露给接收者的信息相结合，或沿计划的工作流传播至下游智能体时，可能变得不恰当。现有的面向智能体系统的上下文完整性机制通常依赖局部判断，孤立地评估每一次披露（无论是否考虑接收者的历史），但并未考虑信息如何向下游传播。然而，在当前边界处的合规并不能保证整个工作流中的恰当性。我们提出了任务图上下文完整性，据我们所知，这是首个针对多智能体系统的任务图原生形式的上下文完整性形式化方法。TG-CI 将工作流表示为多智能体任务图（MATG）……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39532v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on persistent memory and inter-agent communication. These capabilities create privacy risks that extend beyond individual interactions: a release appropriate in isolation may become inappropriate when combined with information previously disclosed to a recipient or propagated to downstream agents along the planned workflow. Existing Contextual Integrity (CI) mechanisms for agentic systems typically rely on local judgments that assess each disclosure in isolation, with or without regard to the recipient's history, but do not account for how information propagates downstream. However, compliance at the current boundary does not guarantee appropriateness across the workflow. item.description:
面向下一兴趣点推荐的类别锚定大语言模型

Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39518

该论文提出ANCHOR框架，通过先在紧凑稳定的语义空间中预测类别级出行意图、再将其接地到具体POI实体，弥合了大语言模型在下一兴趣点推荐中高层语义意图与具体实体预测之间的鸿沟。

下一兴趣点（POI）推荐旨在从时空签到数据中预测用户的下一个目的地，是许多基于位置服务的基础。近年来的研究进展通过将用户轨迹文本化，将大语言模型（LLM）引入该任务，以利用其语义推理能力。然而，使用此类模型直接生成POI标识符并不可靠：POI是稀疏、局部化且长尾的实体，其自然语言语义较弱，这在高层出行意图与具体POI预测之间造成了语义到实体的鸿沟。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了ANCHOR，一个用于下一POI推荐中语义到实体接地的类别锚定框架。具体而言，ANCHOR首先在紧凑且稳定的语义空间中估计类别级别的出行意图，而不是直接预测具体的POI实体，随后将推断出的意图接地到候选（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. item.title: 该论文提出DEG框架，将GFlowNet与扩散模型相结合，利用扩散模型的结构化引导弥补GFlowNet在高奖励区域流扩展不足的缺陷，从而生成更多样且更高质量的车辆路径问题解。
item.description:
DEG：用于求解车辆路径问题的扩散增强GFlowNet

DEG: Diffusion-Enhanced GFlowNet for Solving Vehicle Routing Problems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39512

该论文提出DEG框架，将GFlowNet与扩散模型相结合，利用扩散模型的结构化引导弥补GFlowNet在高奖励区域流扩展不足的缺陷，从而生成更多样且更高质量的车辆路径问题解。

传统的用于求解车辆路径问题（VRP）的神经求解器往往存在解多样性受限的问题，这促使了基于生成流网络（GFlowNet）的模型的发展。然而，这些模型的有效性常常受到高奖励区域流扩展不足的制约，限制了它们在具有前景的解路径上分配概率的能力。更深入的探索本可以产生更优的结果。相比之下，扩散模型能够为探索提供更强的结构化引导。这两种范式天然互补：GFlowNet可以提供边级信号供扩散模型嵌入，而扩散模型则可以引导更广泛的探索。利用这种协同作用，我们提出了扩散增强GFlowNet（DEG），这是一种将GFlowNet与扩散模型相结合的新型框架，旨在促进向高奖励区域更丰富的流扩展，并获得更高质量的解。具体而言，DEG……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traditional neural solvers for solving vehicle routing problems (VRPs) often suffer from limited solution diversity, motivating the development of Generative Flow Network (GFlowNet)-based models. However, the effectiveness of these models is frequently constrained by insufficient flow expansion in high-reward regions, limiting their ability to distribute probability across promising solution routes. Deeper exploration could yield superior results. Diffusion models, in contrast, provide stronger structural guidance for exploration. These two paradigms are naturally complementary: GFlowNet can supply edge-level signals for diffusion to embed, while diffusion can guide broader exploration. Leveraging this synergy, we propose Diffusion-Enhanced GFlowNet (DEG), a novel framework that integrates GFlowNet with a diffusion model to encourage richer flow expansion toward high-reward regions and derive higher-quality solutions. item.title: SkillCompiler是一个自进化技能框架，通过可执行性感知的编译策略将技能中明确定义的操作程序化编译为可执行代码，减少对LLM反复推理的依赖，从而消除智能体技能执行中的不确定性。
item.description:
编译消除不确定性：通过程序化编译实现自进化的智能体技能

Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39508

SkillCompiler是一个自进化技能框架，通过可执行性感知的编译策略将技能中明确定义的操作程序化编译为可执行代码，减少对LLM反复推理的依赖，从而消除智能体技能执行中的不确定性。

自进化的智能体技能使AI智能体能够从交互经验中积累和精炼可复用的程序性知识，而无需更新模型参数。然而，由于这类技能通常以文本文档的形式表示，并通过LLM推理来执行，即使是之前已经学习过的程序也必须被反复解释和重新生成，这给每次执行引入了本可避免的不确定性。相比之下，程序执行是确定性的且可独立验证的。直观地说，将明确定义的操作转化为可执行程序可以减少对LLM推理的依赖，从而降低执行的不确定性。受此启发，我们提出了SkillCompiler，一个将程序化编译集成到技能进化过程中的自进化技能框架。具体而言，SkillCompiler采用一种可执行性感知的技能编译策略，将技能分解为细粒度的操作

arXiv:2610.39508v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving agent skills enable AI agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. However, since such skills are typically represented as textual documents and executed through LLM reasoning, even previously learned procedures must be repeatedly interpreted and regenerated, introducing avoidable uncertainty into every execution. In contrast, program execution is deterministic and independently verifiable. Intuitively, transforming well-specified operations into executable programs can reduce reliance on LLM reasoning and, consequently, reduce execution uncertainty. Motivated by this intuition, we introduce SKillCompiler, a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into the skill evolution process. Specifically, SkillCompiler adopts an executability-aware skill compilation strategy that decomposes skills into fine-grained operation

item.title: 提出AgentNorm，一种智能体级的测试时归一化方法，通过避免干净自车与受损协作者的特征统计量混合而相互污染，在协作者相机因雾、运动模糊等退化时仍能保持可靠的协同感知性能。

面向存在受损协作者的相机协同感知的智能体级测试时归一化

Agent-Wise Test-Time Normalization for Camera-Based Cooperative Perception with Corrupted Collaborators

提出AgentNorm，一种智能体级的测试时归一化方法，通过避免干净自车与受损协作者的特征统计量混合而相互污染，在协作者相机因雾、运动模糊等退化时仍能保持可靠的协同感知性能。

中间融合协同感知使车辆能够通过融合附近智能体共享的特征来检测自身视野之外的物体。当仅有协作者的相机因雾、运动模糊或曝光错误而退化时，其共享的特征会偏离训练分布，而自车输入保持干净，此时协同感知的效果可能比不协同还差。测试时批归一化适配作为标准的免训练补救方法，是在所有智能体的合并批次上估计统计量，因此会用两种分布的混合来同时归一化干净的自车和受损的协作者。我们证明这种混合甚至会损害干净的自车：当自车与受损协作者共享BN统计量时，即使其相机未受任何影响，其基于自身特征的检测性能也会下降3.58至6.68个AP@0.5点。我们提出了AgentNorm，一种智能体级的测试时归一化方法，它i) 估计归一...

arXiv:2610.39505v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception lets a vehicle detect objects beyond its own field of view by fusing features shared by nearby agents. When only a collaborator's cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur or exposure errors, the features it shares drift away from the training distribution while the ego input stays clean, and cooperation can become worse than not cooperating at all. Test-time batch-normalization adaptation, the standard training-free remedy, estimates statistics over the pooled batch of all agents and therefore normalizes both the clean ego and the corrupted collaborator with a mixture of two distributions. We show that this mixing harms even the clean ego: when the ego shares BN statistics with a corrupted collaborator, its detection from its own features drops by 3.58 to 6.68 AP@0.5 points although its cameras are untouched. item.title: 该研究让三个模型家族将2,000篇新闻分别改写为摘要和故事，系统揭示了模型在“故事化”重述中会替换时间与方式、丢失地点与因果表达，并使责任归咎失真激增达七倍，证明源一致性指标无法正确评估重构任务中的真实失真。
item.description:
当事实变成故事时，什么会失真？源一致性指标在模型重述真实事件时忽略的失真

What Breaks When Facts Become Stories? The Distortions Source-Agreement Metrics Miss When Models Retell Real Events

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39500

该研究让三个模型家族将2,000篇新闻分别改写为摘要和故事，系统揭示了模型在“故事化”重述中会替换时间与方式、丢失地点与因果表达，并使责任归咎失真激增达七倍，证明源一致性指标无法正确评估重构任务中的真实失真。

语言模型如今被广泛用于将记录的事实转化为面向公众的媒体内容，然而对此类输出的评估仍以与源文本的一致性作为衡量成功的标准。在重构（reconstruction）任务中，偏离源文本本身可能就是目标，这一标准因而衡量了错误的构念：直接应用时，它会把有意为之的偏离计为错误；不予应用时，它又会让真正的失真漏网。我们让三个模型家族将2,000篇新闻文章改写为摘要和故事，测量了5W各维度上发生了什么变化以及如何变化，并针对检测到的每一处失真追问所赋予的视角能否为其提供正当理由——这将三分之一的失真排除在外。时间与方式并未丢失而是被替换，地点与因果则失去了承载它们的表达。责任归咎失真的表现则截然不同：它在摘要中几乎不存在，在故事中却上升多达七倍，且在方向可判定的失真中，三分之二（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models are now widely used to turn recorded facts into media for public consumption, yet evaluation of such output still assumes agreement with the source as its measure of success. In reconstruction, where departing from the source can itself be the goal, this criterion measures the wrong construct: applied as is, it counts intended departures as errors; withheld, it lets real distortion through. We had three model families rewrite 2,000 news articles as summaries and as stories, measured what changed on every axis of the five Ws and how, and asked of each detected distortion whether the assigned perspective warranted it, which set a third of them aside. Time and manner were not lost but replaced, while place and causation lost the expressions that carry them. Accountability distortion behaved otherwise. item.title: 本工作首次将Group-Lasso原理引入孪生网络架构，实现了同时保留数据内在表示并保证高分类性能的一体化紧凑特征选择。
item.description:
基于Group-Lasso孪生网络的分类与表示学习一体化特征选择

Integrated Feature Selection for classification and Representation Learning with Group-Lasso Siamese Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39499

本工作首次将Group-Lasso原理引入孪生网络架构，实现了同时保留数据内在表示并保证高分类性能的一体化紧凑特征选择。

最小绝对收缩与选择算子已被广泛应用于线性模型中的特征选择，并已被扩展到多层感知机（MLP）网络中用于特征选择和组特征选择。Group-Lasso 也已被用于前馈神经网络的特征选择。据我们所知，这是首次将 Group-Lasso 原理融入孪生网络架构进行特征选择的研究。与现有主要优化分类准确率的方法不同，所提出的方法旨在识别一个紧凑的特征子集，该子集既能保留输入数据的内在表示（即孪生网络的目标），又有望实现较高的分类性能。该框架开发了两个变体：一个基于欧氏距离，另一个基于针对实值向量改进的 Jaccard 相似度度量。

arXiv:2610.39499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (Lasso) has been widely employed for feature selection in linear models and has also been extended to multi-layer perceptron (MLP) networks for both feature and group feature selection. Group-Lasso has also been used in feature selection using feed-forward neural networks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to incorporate the Group-Lasso principle into a Siamese network architecture for feature selection. Unlike existing approaches that primarily optimize classification accuracy, the proposed method aims to identify a compact subset of features that simultaneously preserves the intrinsic representation of the input data (the goal of Siamese network) and is expected to achieve high classification performance. Two variants of the proposed framework are developed: one based on the Euclidean distance and the other on a modified Jaccard similarity measure for real-valued v

item.title: 该论文提出通过轻量级、语义感知的System-1预测器与System-2协同设计的“预测—门控—执行—更新”条件交互循环，让System-2只执行值得付出成本的候选交互，从而在迈向AGI的道路上大幅降低执行计算开销。
item.description:
迈向AGI的扩展是否取决于System-1允许System-2执行什么？

Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39497

该论文提出通过轻量级、语义感知的System-1预测器与System-2协同设计的“预测—门控—执行—更新”条件交互循环，让System-2只执行值得付出成本的候选交互，从而在迈向AGI的道路上大幅降低执行计算开销。

迈向通用人工智能（AGI）的进展在很大程度上依赖于通过更大的模型、更多的数据和算力、更长的推理以及更多的智能体来扩展资源密集型的执行系统——System-2。我们提出疑问：下一阶段的进展是否可能转而来自于将System-2与System-1协同设计？System-1是一个轻量级、具备语义感知能力的预测器，它在执行之前评估候选交互，从而使System-2只执行那些值得付出代价的交互。我们的答案是有条件的肯定。我们研究了“条件交互”，即一个“预测—门控—执行—更新”循环：System-1估计每个候选交互的效用，System-2执行那些通过自适应阈值筛选的交互，而执行结果反过来更新System-1。该循环涵盖训练、测试时推理、自适应决策以及智能体工具使用等场景，其中效用与成本由具体应用定义。在理想筛选和执行成本相同的条件下，执行计算量可降低接近$1/\rho_u$的倍数（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2610.39497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. Our answer is a qualified yes. We study \textit{conditional interaction}, a predict--gate--execute--update loop: System-1 estimates each candidate's utility, System-2 executes those admitted by an adaptive threshold, and the outcomes update System-1. The loop spans training, test-time reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and agentic tool use, with utility and cost defined by the application. item.description:
联邦训练会降低可解释性吗？集中式与联邦式深度伪造检测中Grad-CAM忠实度的对比分析

Does Federated Training Degrade Explainability? A Comparative Analysis of Grad-CAM Faithfulness in Centralized vs. Federated Deepfake Detection

本文首次系统研究了联邦学习对深度伪造检测模型Grad-CAM解释忠实度的影响，发现联邦化与解释质量之间呈非单调关系，为隐私保护与法证可解释性之间的权衡提供了重要依据。

自动化检测已成为对抗逼真合成媒体的关键保障，但其大规模部署需要使用来自多个组织的敏感数据进行训练，这使得隐私保护与取证审查所要求的透明度产生了直接冲突。联邦学习通过仅共享模型更新而非原始数据的方式解决了隐私问题，但这是否会以牺牲可信的基于梯度的解释为代价——而分析师正是依赖这些解释来判断是否信任被标记的片段——这一问题尚未被研究。我们对联邦深度伪造检测下的Grad-CAM解释忠实度进行了系统性研究，在不同程度的数据异构性条件下，使用EfficientNet-B4检测器在FaceForensics++数据集上对五个联邦客户端进行评估。我们发现联邦化与解释质量之间的关系是非单调的：在接近IID（独立同分布）和中等异构性条件下

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39464

本文提出一种基于监督式大语言模型的可学习后期融合模块，直接在语言空间中整合异构超声心动图AI输出的预测陈述与测量值，其性能与最佳参考策略相当且优于未经任务训练的通用LLM。

针对不同视角和目标的超声心动图AI模型能够捕获有用但互补的信息，单独使用时可能无法达到足够的预测性能。学习型集成是组合这些输出的自然方式，但异构模型通常需要将每个输出转换为二元决策、概率、置信度分数或固定长度的特征向量。我们开发了一个基于监督式大语言模型（LLM）的后期融合模块，该模块直接在语言空间中聚合特定视角的预测发现陈述和预测测量值，并学习病例级别的融合函数。在对来自646名患者的859项检查进行的患者级别三折交叉验证中，所提出的方法在单一框架内整合了异构输出，其性能与所评估的最佳参考策略相当，并优于未经任务特定训练的通用大语言模型。这些结果表明……

arXiv:2610.39464v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. item.title: 该论文发现对抗训练的鲁棒性集中编码在一小部分“鲁棒性关键参数”构成的稀疏子空间中，并提出稀疏对抗微调（SAFT），通过对抗梯度显著性识别这些关键参数并仅对其进行更新，从而在大幅降低内存开销的同时消除了与全参数对抗训练之间的鲁棒性差距。
item.description:
面向参数高效对抗训练的稀疏微调

Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39455

该论文发现对抗训练的鲁棒性集中编码在一小部分“鲁棒性关键参数”构成的稀疏子空间中，并提出稀疏对抗微调（SAFT），通过对抗梯度显著性识别这些关键参数并仅对其进行更新，从而在大幅降低内存开销的同时消除了与全参数对抗训练之间的鲁棒性差距。

深度神经网络在许多任务上取得了优异性能，但仍然容易受到对抗性扰动的攻击。对抗训练（AT）是最有效的防御方法之一，但它在大型模型上存在内存开销高的问题，并且始终面临干净样本准确率与鲁棒准确率之间的权衡。最近的研究将参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）引入对抗训练，但这种约束导致其鲁棒性与全参数对抗训练相比存在明显差距。在这项工作中，我们从参数空间的视角重新审视参数高效的对抗微调。通过梯度分析，我们发现对抗优化高度集中于一小部分参数上，我们将其称为鲁棒性关键参数，这表明鲁棒性被编码在一个稀疏子空间中。基于这一观察，我们提出了稀疏对抗微调（SAFT），它通过对抗梯度显著性识别RCPs，并仅更新这些参数来执行对抗训练。

arXiv:2610.39455v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial training (AT) is one of the most effective defenses, yet it suffers from high memory cost on large models and the persistent clean-robust accuracy trade-off. Recent work introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning, such as LoRA, into AT, but this constraint induces a notable robustness gap relative to full-parameter AT. In this work, we revisit parameter-efficient adversarial fine-tuning from a parameter space perspective. Through gradient analysis, we find that adversarial optimization is highly concentrated on a small subset of parameters, which we call Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), suggesting that robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace. arXiv:2610.39454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planning at run time, as in robots that re-plan while they act, needs a planner that reads the PDDL its users write (durative actions, numeric resources, time windows, continuous change), answers quickly, and delivers only validated plans. Kairos profiles each task to decide which of five engines apply (ground heuristic search, compressed and snap-action temporal search, time steps for hybrid dynamics, lifted search) and schedules them under one budget of time and memory. item.title: 提出 Timbre 框架，通过 2×2 视角网格、加权调和聚合的伪标签选择，以及基于置信度偏移的模态级权重自适应调整，实现可靠性感知的调和共识，从而避免无标签多模态测试时强化学习中多数投票强化错误共识的问题。
item.description:
Timbre：面向无标签多模态测试时强化学习的可靠性感知调和共识

Timbre: Reliability-aware harmonic consensus for label-free multimodal test-time rexinforcement learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39439

提出 Timbre 框架，通过 2×2 视角网格、加权调和聚合的伪标签选择，以及基于置信度偏移的模态级权重自适应调整，实现可靠性感知的调和共识，从而避免无标签多模态测试时强化学习中多数投票强化错误共识的问题。

无标签测试时强化学习通过模型自身预测所产生的奖励来适配视觉-语言模型。然而，对视觉证据的误读以及对文本表述方式的敏感性，可能导致产生一致但错误的共识，而多数投票机制反而会强化这类错误共识。跨视角聚合能够暴露此类错误，但图像和文本变换本身也可能在不同程度上损害与任务相关的证据。我们提出了 Timbre，一个面向多模态测试时强化学习的可靠性感知调和共识框架。Timbre 构建了一个 2×2 的网格，将原始图像与扰动图像同直接求解（direct-solving）和重述（reframing）两种模式相结合，通过加权调和聚合来选择伪标签，并将伪标签置信度的批次平均、时间平滑偏移作为启发式可靠性信号，用以自适应调整模态级权重。我们将共识问题表述为一个加权 χ²-重心问题，其……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.39439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Label-free test-time reinforcement learning adapts vision--language models using rewards derived from their own predictions. However, misinterpreted visual evidence and sensitivity to textual formulation can produce a consistent but incorrect consensus that majority voting reinforces. Cross-view aggregation can expose such errors, but image and text transformations may themselves degrade task-relevant evidence to different extents. item.title: 本文提出了ATLAS-Bench——一个包含跨三个地区1,200个查询的智能体工具使用基准，用于评估LLM智能体在本地搜索中区分并满足强制性要求、用户偏好以及事实性与主观判断的能力，并配套提供标准化评估环境ATLASBox。
item.description:
ATLAS-Bench：一个面向本地区域搜索的智能体工具使用基准

ATLAS-Bench: An Agentic Tool-Use Benchmark for Local Area Search

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39438

本文提出了ATLAS-Bench——一个包含跨三个地区1,200个查询的智能体工具使用基准，用于评估LLM智能体在本地搜索中区分并满足强制性要求、用户偏好以及事实性与主观判断的能力，并配套提供标准化评估环境ATLASBox。

可靠的本地搜索对于大语言模型（LLM）智能体至关重要，它通过在给定时间和地点找到满足用户需求的场所，来支持日常决策和长期规划。然而，现有基准测试在以下方面的覆盖有限：搜索结果是否满足强制性要求、是否考虑用户偏好，以及是否将事实性和体验性判断建立在场所属性和评论的基础上。我们提出了ATLAS-Bench，这是一个涵盖三个地区共1,200个查询的基准测试，它从真实搜索事件出发，利用场所属性、评论以及平台上现有的用户画像进行扩展。每个查询都区分了强制性要求与用户偏好，以及事实性条件与主观判断，并为检查每项要求提供了支持性证据和评判标准。所有查询均通过迭代断言检查和跨模型审查进行验证。我们还引入了ATLASBox，这是一个标准化的评估环境，配备了搜索工具和固定的兴趣点（POI）数据。

arXiv:2610.39438v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable local search is essential for LLM agents to support everyday decisions and longer plans by finding places that meet users' needs at given times and locations. Yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of whether search results satisfy mandatory requirements, account for preferences, and ground factual and experiential judgments in place attributes and reviews. We introduce ATLAS-Bench, a benchmark of 1,200 queries across three regions, expanded from real search events using place attributes, reviews, and existing user profiles from the platform. Each query distinguishes mandatory requirements from preferences and factual conditions from subjective judgments, with supporting evidence and criteria for checking each requirement. Queries are validated through iterative assertion checks and cross-model review. item.title: 该论文提出LinguaArray框架，让大语言模型提议语义焦点集合来引导量词数组SMT求解，同时由传统SMT求解器作为唯一的证明引擎对所有结果进行验证，实现了可验证的LLM辅助形式化推理。
item.description:
可验证的LLM引导的量词数组焦点SMT求解

Verifiable LLM-Guided Focal SMT Solving for Quantified Arrays

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39435

该论文提出LinguaArray框架，让大语言模型提议语义焦点集合来引导量词数组SMT求解，同时由传统SMT求解器作为唯一的证明引擎对所有结果进行验证，实现了可验证的LLM辅助形式化推理。

大语言模型通常能够在形式化产物中识别出有用的语义结构，但其输出不能被信任为证明或求解器决策。我们研究LLM能否转而通过一个狭窄的、可由求解器验证的接口来引导形式化推理系统。我们将这一想法实例化于量词数组SMT求解领域——在该领域中，当关键的基础项和等式被辅助变量、公理守卫以及嵌套数组项所隐藏时，现代基于实例化的技术可能会失效。我们观察到，许多实例主要由一小组焦点基础项或约束驱动，这类似于SAT求解中的后门集合。基于此，我们提出了LinguaArray框架：在该框架中，LLM提出一个小的语义焦点集合（基础项/约束），而传统SMT求解器仍是唯一的证明引擎，并对所有结果进行认证。LinguaArray利用这些由LLM建议、经求解器验证的有限集合来显著增强求解

arXiv:2610.39435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can often identify useful semantic structure in formal artifacts, but their outputs cannot be trusted as proofs or solver decisions. We study whether LLMs can instead guide formal reasoning systems through a narrow, solver-verifiable interface. We instantiate this idea in quantified array SMT solving, where modern instantiation-based techniques can fail when key ground terms and equalities are hidden by auxiliary variables, axiom guards, and nested array terms. We observe that many instances are largely driven by a small set of focal ground terms or constraints, similar to the backdoor sets in SAT solving. Building on this, we present LinguaArray, a framework where an LLM proposes a small Semantic Focus Set (ground terms/constraints), while a conventional SMT solver remains the sole proof engine and certifies all results. 本文提出 FDSML 方法，利用参数感知三元组损失直接从图像生成参数（而非离散类别标签）中提取关系监督，并结合改进的分形数据集 FineFractalDB，显著提升了图像检索迁移能力和模型鲁棒性。

公式驱动监督学习（FDSL）能够在无需真实图像的情况下进行视觉预训练，但现有方法将预训练任务转化为对离散化标签的分类，从而丢弃了生成过程中的连续性信息。我们提出公式驱动监督度量学习（FDSML），它超越离散类别标签，直接从图像生成参数中获取关系监督。FDSML 结合了 FineFractalDB——我们改进的分形数据集，具有更高的类内多样性和更稳定的结构——以及参数感知三元组（PA-Triplet）损失，该损失根据底层迭代函数系统（IFS）参数空间中的距离来划分正样本和负样本。这一目标函数使训练得到的嵌入能够遵循由参数导出的相对相似度排序。实验表明，FDSML 提升了模型向图像检索任务的迁移能力，同时在下游分类任务上保持竞争力，并在多种图像损坏设置下提高了鲁棒性。

arXiv:2610.39423v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. 规约明确且测试完备？基于自我进化智能体评估SWE-bench风格数据集

Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39417

提出ExLabel——一个基于LLM、自我进化且经验引导的智能体助手，用于评估SWE-bench风格数据集的任务清晰度与测试覆盖率，克服了静态通用评分准则误报率高的缺陷。

大型语言模型（LLM）在软件工程（SE）任务上展现出强大性能，这推动了对高质量数据集的需求，以实现可靠的训练与评估。SWE-bench风格数据集（SWE数据集）被广泛用于评估基于LLM的编程智能体在真实软件问题上的表现，其中任务清晰度与测试覆盖率直接决定了实例是否可求解、可验证。然而，现有SWE数据集中仍存在质量问题，且人工标注成本高、劳动强度大，因此催生了基于LLM的标注方法。现有方法通常依赖静态且过于宽泛的评分准则，这限制了其处理多样化和细微场景的能力，并常导致较高的误报率。相比之下，人类标注者会利用积累的经验做出具有上下文感知的判断。受此启发，我们提出了ExLabel——一个基于LLM、自我进化且经验引导的助手，用于评估任务清晰度与测试覆盖率。

arXiv:2610.39417v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. Retaining Repair Hypotheses for Cost-Aware Execution

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39410

该论文提出一种保留多个兼容修复假设并根据诊断与执行观测动态加权的修复—执行接口，利用AI加权信念降低测试成本达3.33%，并在重复性任务中挽回诊断的价值。

可执行模型的多个修正方案可以拟合相同的观测结果，却对执行结果做出不同的预测。我们研究了一种从修复到执行的接口，该接口保留相互兼容的有限守卫修复，并依据诊断观测和普通执行观测对这些修复的权重进行条件化，进而利用它们的预测来选择执行路线、定价测试或备份方案。在24个合成的两阶段设备实验中，将语言模型生成的修复与兼容修复上的均匀信念等权混合（即AI加权信念），相对于直接采用生成的修复，可将无测试成本降低2.14%。访问收费可能抵消诊断在孤立任务上带来的收益，而重复性工作可以在AI加权信念下挽回这一收益。在每个重复工作分支中都引入正常执行学习的情况下，在AI加权信念下，按工作量计价的测试相比相同预算下的随机选择可节省3.33%的成本。权重的设定会改变比较结果：均匀正……

We study a repair-to-execution interface that retains compatible finite guard repairs, conditions their weights on diagnostic and ordinary-execution observations, and uses their predictions to choose routes, priced tests, or a backup. Access charges can erase the benefit of diagnosis on isolated tasks, while repeated work can recover it under the AI-weighted belief. With normal-execution learning in every repeated-work arm, workload-valued testing costs 3.33 percent less than same-budget random selection under the AI-weighted belief. item.description:
安全多目标强化学习：零约束违反与原始平均收敛

Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39409

该论文提出了安全多目标强化学习算法，通过结合乐观奖励估计与悲观成本界限，在整个学习过程中实现零约束违反，并在光滑Tchebycheff标量化下获得次优差距收敛保证。

多目标强化学习（MORL）的许多应用需要策略在平衡相互冲突的目标的同时满足安全约束。我们研究了在整个学习过程中实现零约束违反的安全MORL，涵盖累积约束和逐步约束两种情形。一个关键挑战是在未知动力学和约束代价下进行充分探索而不违反约束。对于给定的目标偏好，我们开发了一种算法，通过结合乐观的奖励估计与悲观的成本界限来学习安全的帕累托最优策略。以高概率，在 $T$ 个回合中执行的每个策略均不产生任何约束违反。该算法返回由平均占用度量诱导的安全马尔可夫策略，并在光滑Tchebycheff标量化下实现了 $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 的次优差距。我们进一步开发了一种无需预设偏好的算法，该算法首先在没有预指（摘要在此处截断）……

arXiv:2610.39409v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. item.title: 本文提出SymKL，一种基于隐式神经表示Fisher信息几何的统一信号退化度量方法，仅凭参考信号与退化观测、无需知晓退化过程，即可跨图像、音频和3D数据量化退化程度。
item.description:
SymKL：一种统一的表示空间信号退化度量方法

SymKL: A Unified Representation-Space Measure of Signal Degradation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39403

本文提出SymKL，一种基于隐式神经表示Fisher信息几何的统一信号退化度量方法，仅凭参考信号与退化观测、无需知晓退化过程，即可跨图像、音频和3D数据量化退化程度。

量化原始信号与其退化观测之间的退化程度是信号处理领域的基础问题，然而现有的全参考度量方法本质上都是针对特定模态的。我们提出了SymKL，一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的统一全参考退化度量方法。该方法首先将INR一次性拟合到原始参考信号，并通过其对角Fisher信息进行表征，该信息捕捉了所学表示的局部信息几何特性。分别用原始参考信号和退化观测来评估Fisher信息，可得到两个参数敏感度分布，它们的对称KL散度即定义了退化分数。所提出的公式仅需要参考信号和退化观测，无需了解退化过程或退化严重程度，因此可广泛应用于图像、音频和3D数据。我们进一步推导出了对角Fisher信息的精确闭式表达式。

arXiv:2610.39403v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantifying degradation between a pristine signal and its degraded observation is fundamental to signal processing, yet existing full-reference measures are inherently modality-specific. We introduce SymKL, a unified full-reference degradation measure based on implicit neural representations (INRs). An INR is fitted once to the pristine reference and characterized by its diagonal Fisher information, which captures the local information geometry of the learned representation. Evaluating the Fisher information with the pristine reference and a degraded observation yields two parameter-sensitivity profiles whose symmetric KL divergence defines the degradation score. The proposed formulation requires only the reference and degraded observation, without knowledge of the corruption process or degradation severity, making it applicable across images, audio, and 3D data. item.title: 该论文提出OPERA，一个由专家传授gm/ID尺寸设计方法与gLayout版图实践的大语言模型智能体，能够使用开源工具将CMOS运算放大器从规格说明一路设计到版图后签署确认，并在SKY130工艺中成功设计了共享恒定gm偏置电路和六个运算放大器。

arXiv:2610.39395v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. item.title: UMI-Live是一个全栈开源的双手UMI系统，无需外部追踪设备或环境校准即可在真实野外环境中采集双手机器人演示数据，并通过异步SLAM流水线直接生成可用于VLA策略训练的数据集。
item.description:
UMI-Live：面向真实野外环境的双手机器人数据采集系统

UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39385

UMI-Live是一个全栈开源的双手UMI系统，无需外部追踪设备或环境校准即可在真实野外环境中采集双手机器人演示数据，并通过异步SLAM流水线直接生成可用于VLA策略训练的数据集。

通用操作接口（UMI）设备使人类专家能够为机器人学习演示任务，而无需远程操控实体机器人。然而，将这些演示用作训练数据仍然需要一致的硬件设置、校准和数据处理。我们提出了UMI-Live，一个用于真实野外数据采集的全栈开源双手UMI系统。我们设计了定制的UMI-Live硬件，集成了相机与激光雷达-惯性传感、机载计算和电源，无需外部追踪设备，也无需在采集环境中进行校准。我们实现了一个简单的用户界面用于记录数据，同时由异步流水线执行并行SLAM重建，并发布可直接用于训练的数据集。我们还发布了支持双YAM遥操作以及VLA策略训练与推理的软件。我们通过微调 $\pi_{0.5}$ 和 MolmoAct2 验证了UMI-Live的数据质量，分别达到了10/10和8/...的成功率（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2610.39385v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. item.title: 该论文提出Formulaic流程，让语言模型智能体逐步编写AI基础设施优化问题的形式化表述，由数学求解器在其内优化，并通过验证与测量检查假设和结果，从而突破传统分层设计的边界，实现软硬件协同优化。
item.description:
学习形式化建模：通过渐进式优化与验证实现AI基础设施的智能体式软硬件协同设计

Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39380

该论文提出Formulaic流程，让语言模型智能体逐步编写AI基础设施优化问题的形式化表述，由数学求解器在其内优化，并通过验证与测量检查假设和结果，从而突破传统分层设计的边界，实现软硬件协同优化。

AI基础设施——即训练和服务AI模型的芯片与软件——是分层设计的。分层使系统易于管理，但也固定了优化器可以考虑的选项范围。那些需要芯片及其软件协同改变才能获得的收益，在优化开始之前就被排除在外：问题形式化将其遗漏。语言模型智能体使重新审视这些边界成为可能，但智能体的提案本身无法证明一个设计是正确或最优的。我们提出了Formulaic，一种划分工作的流程：智能体负责编写问题的形式化表述，数学求解器在其内部进行优化，而验证与测量则检查其假设和结果。智能体逐步精化问题，从计算图一直推进到芯片。每一步都是一个模板：一族程序及其正确性成立的条件。“墙松弛”技术通过对约束软件的硬件限制进行定价来搜索芯片设计空间。

arXiv:2610.39380v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. item.title: 提出了AgentDecept——一个包含477个压力变体（源自257个任务、六种压力来源）的可执行基准，通过将用户可见的报告与完整执行轨迹对比，评估工具使用型LLM智能体在压力情境下是否会欺骗性地不忠实报告其行为。
item.description:
AgentDecept：压力情境下工具使用型LLM智能体欺骗行为的基准测试

AgentDecept: Benchmarking Deceptive Behavior in Tool-Using LLM Agents under Pressure

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39377

提出了AgentDecept——一个包含477个压力变体（源自257个任务、六种压力来源）的可执行基准，通过将用户可见的报告与完整执行轨迹对比，评估工具使用型LLM智能体在压力情境下是否会欺骗性地不忠实报告其行为。

LLM智能体日益在各类日常应用中执行多轮任务，然而用户通常只能看到智能体的报告，而看不到其背后的观察结果、API调用和状态变化。现有的欺骗基准已研究了长程交互和工具使用场景，但智能体在真实的有状态应用工作流中能否忠实地报告其行为，这一问题仍鲜有探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AgentDecept，一个用于评估压力情境下行为欺骗的可执行基准。AgentDecept包含从257个源任务派生的477个压力变体，涵盖六种压力来源，且每个压力变体均配有对应的无压力对照组。干预通过事件消息、任务上下文、应用状态、工具响应和服务配额等途径引入，既包括显式事件，也包括隐式的任务或环境变化。我们基于证据的评估协议通过将面向用户的声明与完整轨迹进行关联来评估智能体行为……

arXiv:2610.39377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents increasingly carry out multi-turn tasks across everyday applications, yet users often see only the agent's report rather than the observations, API calls, and state changes behind it. Existing deception benchmarks have studied long-horizon interactions and tool-use settings, but whether agents faithfully report their actions across realistic, stateful application workflows remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AgentDecept, an executable benchmark for evaluating behavioral deception under pressure. AgentDecept contains 477 pressure variants derived from 257 source tasks across six pressure sources, each paired with a pressure-free counterpart. Interventions enter through event messages, task context, application state, tool responses, and service quotas, spanning explicit events and implicit task or environment changes. item.title: 本研究利用医学考试题目的经验性难度标签引导大语言模型归纳难度评分规则，发现题目难度主要源于线索趋同、误导性线索和选项竞争等深层模式，而非题干长度、选项数量等表面特征。

What Makes Medical Examination Items Difficult? Using Large Language Models to Explore Patterns Associated With Empirical Item Difficulty

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39373

本研究利用医学考试题目的经验性难度标签引导大语言模型归纳难度评分规则，发现题目难度主要源于线索趋同、误导性线索和选项竞争等深层模式，而非题干长度、选项数量等表面特征。

arXiv:2610.39373v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：关于医学考试题目难度的研究大多集中于难度预测，而非识别与经验性难度相关的可解释模式。本研究使用经验性难度标签来引导大语言模型（LLMs）归纳难度评分规则，并考察了评分规则引导如何影响大语言模型的难度判断。研究使用了美国医师执照考试（USMLE）和助理医师国家认证考试（PANCE）的训练题目及其经验性难度估计，由Claude Opus 5分别为绝对难度判断和成对比较难度判断归纳了不同的评分规则。所有归纳出的评分规则均未将表面特征（如题干长度、选项数量或图像）视为难度的主要来源。两项考试中均出现了若干共同模式，包括线索趋同、误导性线索和选项竞争，尽管它们的具体表现形式有所不同。无法被……

arXiv:2610.39373v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Research on medical item difficulty has largely focused on prediction rather than on identifying interpretable patterns associated with empirical difficulty. This study used empirical difficulty labels to guide large language models (LLMs) in inducing difficulty rubrics and examined how rubric guidance affected LLM difficulty judgments. Using training items and their empirical difficulty estimates from the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) and the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination (PANCE), Claude Opus 5 induced separate rubrics for absolute and pairwise difficulty judgment. None of the induced rubrics treated surface features, such as stem length, option count, or images, as major sources of difficulty. Several patterns emerged across both examinations, including cue convergence, misleading cues, and option competition, although their specific forms differed. item.title: Cord提出了一种轻量级的提示条件化策略，以置信度解码为稳定锚点，通过每次展开仅采样一个低维系数矩阵来诱导几何残差自适应地调整掩码扩散语言模型的揭示顺序，从而提升生成质量。
item.description:
Cord：面向掩码扩散语言模型的置信度锚定顺序残差解码

Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39372

Cord提出了一种轻量级的提示条件化策略，以置信度解码为稳定锚点，通过每次展开仅采样一个低维系数矩阵来诱导几何残差自适应地调整掩码扩散语言模型的揭示顺序，从而提升生成质量。

掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的解码顺序会显著影响生成质量，然而常见的解码器通常在整个生成过程中采用相同的揭示规则。置信度提供了一个强大的默认策略，但它衡量的是当前位置此刻被预测的确定程度，而非揭示该位置对后续解码的有用程度。我们提出Cord，一种轻量级的基于提示条件化的策略，它将置信度解码保留为稳定的参考，并通过生成方向、与已揭示上下文的接近程度以及双向填充等几何残差来学习何时以及如何偏离该参考。这些残差能够同时适应提示和不断演化的部分响应。Cord不是在每个解码步骤都采样新的策略动作，而是在每次展开中仅采样一个低维系数矩阵，该矩阵会诱导出一条完整的依赖于状态的揭示轨迹。由此得到一个上下文老虎机形式的训练方法……

arXiv:2610.39372v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained di

item.title: 该论文提出一种在策略更新后、下一次部署前诊断技能效用变化的方法，通过测量策略更新对技能条件与控制条件间token偏好对比的影响，并结合优势估计构建奖励导向读出信号，仅复用现有训练轨迹和前向传播即可预测技能边际效用的变化。
item.description:
在下一次部署之前：从策略更新中诊断技能效用的变化

Before the Next Rollout: Diagnosing Skill Utility Shifts from Policy Updates

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39358

该论文提出一种在策略更新后、下一次部署前诊断技能效用变化的方法，通过测量策略更新对技能条件与控制条件间token偏好对比的影响，并结合优势估计构建奖励导向读出信号，仅复用现有训练轨迹和前向传播即可预测技能边际效用的变化。

技能演化方法通常通过分析执行轨迹来指导智能体技能的改进。然而，策略更新可能会改变一个本身未变的技能的行为效果和边际效用。因此，基于早期轨迹的归因可能不再反映该技能在更新后策略下的贡献。此外，轨迹失败可能由多种因素引起，使得单个技能的贡献难以被隔离。我们评估了策略更新信号是否包含关于技能边际效用变化的预测信息。在来自更新前训练轨迹的固定上下文中，我们测量策略更新如何改变技能条件与控制条件之间token偏好的对比。将这些交互变化与优势估计相结合，可以得到用于诊断效用变化的奖励导向读出信号。这些读出信号复用现有的训练轨迹，且对于单步动作选择只需进行前向传播计算。

arXiv:2610.39358v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Skill-evolution methods typically analyze execution trajectories to guide agent skill refinement. However, policy updates can change the behavioral effects and marginal utility of an unchanged skill. Attribution based on earlier trajectories may therefore no longer reflect the skill's contribution under the updated policy. Moreover, trajectory failures can arise from multiple factors, making individual skill contributions difficult to isolate. We evaluate whether policy-update signals contain predictive information about changes in skill marginal utility. At fixed contexts from pre-update training rollouts, we measure how policy updates change the contrast in token preferences between skill and control conditions. Combining these interaction shifts with advantage estimates yields reward-directed readouts for diagnosing utility changes. item.title: 本文揭示了广义类别发现评估中的“语义错配”现象——全局匈牙利匹配会将已锚定的旧类别索引重新分配，从而高估新类别准确率多达25.63个百分点，并提出置换环条件来评估与缓解这一问题。
item.description:
广义类别发现中的语义错配：评估与缓解

Semantic Mismapping in Generalized Category Discovery: Evaluation and Mitigation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39356

本文揭示了广义类别发现评估中的“语义错配”现象——全局匈牙利匹配会将已锚定的旧类别索引重新分配，从而高估新类别准确率多达25.63个百分点，并提出置换环条件来评估与缓解这一问题。

arXiv:2610.39356v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：广义类别发现（GCD）旨在同一个无标签集合中同时完成旧类别识别与新类别发现。早期方法通过聚类来处理这两个目标，并采用全局匈牙利（GH）匹配来评估完全可交换的预测索引。近期方法则采用可训练的参数化头部，利用监督信号完成旧类别识别，并使用面向发现的目标函数来处理新类别。这样一来，输出空间变为部分可交换：旧索引在语义上被锚定，而新索引仍然保持可交换性。然而，这些方法仍然使用全局匹配，这可能会将已锚定的旧索引重新分配到其他类别，并掩盖某些预测错误。在实证研究中，我们惊讶地发现这种重新分配会导致新类别准确率被高估多达25.63个百分点。我们将这一现象命名为“语义错配”，并进一步推导出一个置换环条件……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39356v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to perform old-category recognition and novel-category discovery in the same unlabeled set. Early methods address both objectives through clustering and evaluate the exchangeable predicted indices with global Hungarian (GH) matching. Recent methods adopt trainable parametric heads, using supervision for old-category recognition and discovery-oriented objectives for new categories. In this way, the output space becomes partially exchangeable: old indices are semantically anchored, while new indices remain exchangeable. However, these methods still apply global matching, which can reassign anchored old indices to other categories and hide some prediction errors. Empirically, we are surprised to observe that this reassignment can induce an overestimation of new-category accuracy by up to 25.63 points. We term this phenomenon semantic mismapping and further derive a permutation-cycle condition that

item.title: 本文提出CoToan——一个连接GDL与OpenSpiel的越南数学象棋可执行规范与表示契约，通过以状态转移而非算术依据来表示动作、并将时间与胜利配置纳入任务身份，解决了不同实现间表示选择悄然改变决策问题、导致游戏AI结果不可比的问题。
item.description:
CoToan：面向可复现游戏AI评估的可执行规则与表示契约

CoToan: Executable Rules and a Representation Contract for Reproducible Game AI Evaluation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39353

本文提出CoToan——一个连接GDL与OpenSpiel的越南数学象棋可执行规范与表示契约，通过以状态转移而非算术依据来表示动作、并将时间与胜利配置纳入任务身份，解决了不同实现间表示选择悄然改变决策问题、导致游戏AI结果不可比的问题。

只有当不同的实现向智能体呈现相同的决策问题时，游戏AI的结果才具有可比性。然而，看似微小的表示选择可能会通过改变动作概率或合并具有不同结果的初始状态，从而悄然改变该决策问题。我们通过CoToan来研究这一问题。CoToan是一个针对越南数学象棋的可执行规范与表示契约，将游戏描述语言（GDL）与OpenSpiel连接起来。该游戏是一个很有价值的研究案例，因为单次吃子可能存在多种算术上的合理依据，而胜负结果又可能取决于计分规则和有限的比赛回合数。因此，CoToan以动作的状态转移而非算术证明来表示动作，并将时间和胜利配置视为任务身份的一部分。跨表示测试表明，在数百个采样与构造的棋局局面中，两种表示在合法动作、后继状态和终止结果上均保持一致……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Game AI results are comparable only when different implementations expose the same decision problem. Yet seemingly minor representation choices can silently change that problem by altering action probabilities or collapsing states with different outcomes. We study this issue through CoToan, an executable specification and representation contract for Vietnamese Mathematical Chess connecting the Game Description Language (GDL) with OpenSpiel. The game provides a useful case because a single capture may have multiple arithmetic justifications, while outcomes can depend on scoring rules and a finite playing horizon. CoToan therefore represents actions by their state transitions rather than by arithmetic witnesses, and treats time and victory configuration as part of task identity. Cross-representation tests show agreement in legal actions, successor states, and terminal outcomes across hundreds of sampled and constructed positions, complemen

item.title: 该论文提出逆向国际象棋基准RetroChessBench（含12项任务），实验表明即使是具备代码执行能力的前沿语言模型，在重构与证明象棋历史的纯推理任务中仍大量失败，暴露出否定合法历史、将临时障碍视为永久障碍等系统性推理缺陷。
item.description:
RetroChessBench：一个用于重构与证明国际象棋历史的基准测试

RetroChessBench: A Benchmark for Reconstructing and Proving Chess Histories

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39341

该论文提出逆向国际象棋基准RetroChessBench（含12项任务），实验表明即使是具备代码执行能力的前沿语言模型，在重构与证明象棋历史的纯推理任务中仍大量失败，暴露出否定合法历史、将临时障碍视为永久障碍等系统性推理缺陷。

GPT 6 Astra等前沿语言模型已为数学研究做出贡献，展现出相当强的推理能力。然而，即使在受明确规则约束的任务中，严重的推理失败依然存在。我们在逆向国际象棋（retrograde chess）中证明了这一点——这是一片纯推理的试验场，解题者需要重构合法的走子历史，并区分可能发生的事件与必然发生的事件。我们提出了RetroChessBench，这是一个包含12项任务的基准测试，涵盖精确长度构造、唯一终局以及穷举答案集，并配有参考答案、评分标准和终端奖励环境。在每个任务和条件下各进行两次试验，结果显示：GPT 6 Astra High在不使用工具的24次尝试中有22次未能给出所需的最终答案，在可执行代码的条件下则有18次失败；平均终端强化学习奖励分别为14.75%和27.19%。这些实例揭示出错误的推理模式：失败的回答会否定合法的历史序列，并将临时性的障碍误当作永久性障碍。（注：原文摘要在"Online retrogr..."处被截断）

arXiv:2610.39341v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities. Yet serious reasoning failures persist even in tasks governed by explicit rules. We demonstrate this in retrograde chess which is a playground for pure reasoning, where solvers reconstruct legal histories and distinguish possible events from forced ones. We introduce RetroChessBench, a 12-task benchmark covering exact-length constructions, unique endings, and exhaustive answer sets, with references, rubrics, and a terminal-reward environment. In two trials per task and condition, GPT 6 Astra High fails to produce the required final answer in 22/24 attempts without tools and 18/24 with code execution; mean terminal RL rewards are 14.75% and 27.19%, respectively. The examples identify faulty deductions: failed responses reject legal histories and treat temporary obstructions as permanent. Online retrogr

item.title: 研究发现，视觉语言模型中的文本人物设定只能让模型复述它所知道的关于某类人群的知识，而无法真正模拟该人群（如低视力、色盲者）的感知方式，其表现甚至不如基于设定事实的简单规则，并抹除了群体间的真实差异。
item.description:
告知并非看见：文本化人物设定很少能让视觉语言模型像其所描述的人那样回答

Telling Is Not Seeing: Textual Personas Rarely Make Vision-Language Models Answer Like the People They Describe

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39331

研究发现，视觉语言模型中的文本人物设定只能让模型复述它所知道的关于某类人群的知识，而无法真正模拟该人群（如低视力、色盲者）的感知方式，其表现甚至不如基于设定事实的简单规则，并抹除了群体间的真实差异。

视觉语言模型越来越多地被赋予人物设定进行提示，例如“你有低视力”，以在用户研究中代替真人。我们探究人物设定是否能让模型像其所描述的人那样“看”。我们将人物设定的回答与实际测量的低视力、色盲或听力损失人群的回答进行比较，并与仅使用人物设定所述事实的简单规则进行比较。人物设定的表现从未超过这些简单规则，而且它抹去了群体与个体之间的真实差异。在我们测试的全部14个模型中，描述模糊并不会改变识别结果，而模糊照片则会像对真人那样降低识别率。在开源模型内部，描述既不改变图像信息，也不改变回答概率。然而，模型知道自己未能表现出的效应：它们能够估计模糊和错觉如何影响人们。告知并非看见：人物设定只是让模型说出它所知道的关于人们的情况，而不是让模型像他们那样去看。

arXiv:2610.39331v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly prompted with personas, such as "You have low vision", to stand in for people in user studies. We ask whether a persona makes a model see like the person it describes. We compare persona answers with measured people with low vision, color blindness or hearing loss, and with simple rules that use only the facts the persona states. The persona never beats these rules, and it erases the real differences between groups and individuals. Describing blur leaves recognition unchanged in all 14 models we test, while blurring the photo lowers it as it does for people. Inside open models, the description changes neither the image information nor the answer probabilities. Yet the models know the effects they fail to show: they can estimate how blur and illusions affect people. Telling is not seeing: a persona makes a model say what it knows about people, not see what they see.

item.title: L2B 提出一个数据驱动的神经预测框架，通过统计校准保证上界的可容许性、并通过结构性架构约束保证其随证据积累单调收紧，从而以摊销的计算成本为 MPE 推断的分支定界搜索提供高效合法的神经上界。
item.description:
学习求界：用于MPE推断的单调、经校准的神经上界

Learning to Bound: Monotonic, Calibrated Neural Upper Bounds for MPE Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39305

L2B 提出一个数据驱动的神经预测框架，通过统计校准保证上界的可容许性、并通过结构性架构约束保证其随证据积累单调收紧，从而以摊销的计算成本为 MPE 推断的分支定界搜索提供高效合法的神经上界。

概率图模型（PGMs）以紧凑的方式编码结构化联合分布，但最可能解释（MPE）推断——即找到未观测变量概率最高的赋值——在大型、密集结构化的模型中仍然是计算上难以处理的。任意时间系统搜索方法，如分支定界（B&B），是一种流行的解决方案，但其效率依赖于紧致的可容许上界，而使用小桶消元（MBE）等经典方法计算这些上界往往代价高昂、令人望而却步。我们提出了 Learning to Bound（L2B），这是一个数据驱动的框架，通过训练神经预测器来摊销上界计算的成本。L2B 针对有效搜索上界所需的两个关键性质：其一是可容许性，通过统计校准技术来实现；其二是随证据积累而逐步收紧，这通过结构性的架构约束从构造上保证单调性来实现。

arXiv:2610.39305v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) compactly encode structured joint distributions, but Most Probable Explanation (MPE), which finds the highest-probability assignment to unobserved variables, remains computationally intractable in large, densely structured models. Anytime systematic search, such as branch-and-bound (B&B), is a popular approach, but its efficiency depends on tight admissible upper bounds that are often prohibitively expensive to compute using classical methods like Mini-Bucket Elimination (MBE). We introduce Learning to Bound (L2B), a data-driven framework that amortizes bound computation cost by training a neural predictor. L2B targets two key properties required for effective search bounds: admissibility, which is achieved via statistical calibration techniques, and progressive tightening as evidence accumulates, which is enforced through structural architectural constraints that ensure monotonicity by constructio

item.title: 本文首次将柏拉图表征假说证明为定理，表明只要正样本对是同一场景的“好视角”，在不同模态上分别训练的JEPA必然收敛到仅差一次旋转的相同世界表征，并据此解释了语言模型因使用“坏视角”而只能依靠规模才能与视觉对齐，同时通过大规模实验发现了可预测对齐效果的新缩放定律。
item.description:
用JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）证明并改进柏拉图表征假说

Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39302

本文首次将柏拉图表征假说证明为定理，表明只要正样本对是同一场景的“好视角”，在不同模态上分别训练的JEPA必然收敛到仅差一次旋转的相同世界表征，并据此解释了语言模型因使用“坏视角”而只能依靠规模才能与视觉对齐，同时通过大规模实验发现了可预测对齐效果的新缩放定律。

arXiv:2610.39302v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在不同模态上训练的模型是否会收敛到对世界的同一种表征，这是人工智能领域的核心问题。柏拉图表征假说（PRH）推测随着规模的扩大它们会趋于一致，但由于缺乏证明，该假说既无法提供保证，也无法给出实现方法。我们将这一假说变成了一个定理。首先，我们证明了一个“柏拉图表征定理”：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）无论在多少种模态上分别训练，只要其正样本对是同一场景的两次观测——即“好视角”——就会学习到仅相差一次旋转的相同表征；否则，其错位程度是有界的。其次，我们证明下一个词预测本质上就是一种使用“坏视角”（即单个文档的各个部分）的JEPA，这解释了为什么语言模型只有通过规模才能与视觉对齐。第三，我们从14.5万条字幕到9.4亿张网络图像的文本对该理论进行了验证，并揭示出一个对齐缩放定律，可以预测未见（原文摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2610.39302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a \emph{Platonic Representation Theorem}: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation whenever their positive pairs are two observations of one scene--\emph{good views}--and their misalignment is bounded otherwise. Second, we show that next-token prediction is a JEPA with \emph{bad views}, parts of a single document, which explains why language models align with vision only through scale. Third, we validate the theory from 145k captions to the texts of 940M web images, and uncover a scaling law of alignment that predicts unsee

item.title: 本文用数学定理证明 RLVR 中 pass@1 的提升必然以 pass@k 为代价——每一次提高首次尝试成功率的更新都会严格降低某些问题在多次采样下的成功率，pass@k 交叉是不可避免的理论必然，而非训练不足造成的暂时现象。
item.description:
RLVR 中没有免费午餐：每一次 pass@1 的提升都有 pass@k 的代价

There Is No Free Lunch in RLVR: Every pass@1 Gain Has a pass@k Price

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39295

本文用数学定理证明 RLVR 中 pass@1 的提升必然以 pass@k 为代价——每一次提高首次尝试成功率的更新都会严格降低某些问题在多次采样下的成功率，pass@k 交叉是不可避免的理论必然，而非训练不足造成的暂时现象。

基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）使语言模型在第一次尝试时能解决更多问题，但在允许多次尝试时能解决的问题却更少：它提高了 pass@1，而在大采样预算 k 下基础模型会反超 RLVR 模型。这是 RL 未能增添推理能力的失败，还是更多训练即可消除的暂时现象？我们用一个定理解决了这个问题。这种反超是一种代价，并且我们计算出了它的精确速率。将 RLVR 建模为基策略在跨提示共享的策略组合上的指数倾斜，我们证明：在排他性专门化下，每一次提升 pass@1 的更新都会严格降低某些提示的成功率；对提示存在严格为正的代价（Stiemke 对偶性）是精确的成立条件，而仅仅作为某个提示上的最优策略被证明是不够的。当损失触及最难的问题时，它会迫使 pass@k 出现交叉，且交叉次数至多为每提示成功率变化的符号变号数……

arXiv:2610.39295v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes a language model solve more problems on the first try and fewer when given many tries: it raises pass@1 while the base model overtakes it at large sampling budget k. Is this a failure of RL to add reasoning, or a transient that more training removes? We settle the question with a theorem. The reversal is a price, and we compute its exact rate. Modeling RLVR as an exponential tilt of a base policy over strategies shared across prompts, we prove that under exclusive specialization every update that raises pass@1 strictly lowers the success of some prompt; a strictly positive price on prompts (Stiemke duality) is the exact condition, and being merely the best strategy on a prompt is provably not enough. When the loss reaches the hardest prompts, it forces a pass@k crossover, and the number of crossings is at most the sign variation of the shift in per-prompt success, a totally po

item.title: 该研究发现计算机使用智能体点击失效的主要风险来自页面加载而非规划延迟——页面打开后第一秒内规划的点击有17%会过时，而完全加载的页面上这一比例仅为0.4%——等待约一秒让网络活动停止即可消除大部分风险，但十个主流开源智能体中有八个的等待规则未能做到这一点。
item.description:
“现在”对您的计算机使用智能体意味着什么？过时的屏幕截图、页面加载，以及点击前应运行哪种检查

What Does "Now" Mean to Your Computer-Use Agent? Stale Screenshots, Page Loads, and Which Check to Run Before a Click

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39282

该研究发现计算机使用智能体点击失效的主要风险来自页面加载而非规划延迟——页面打开后第一秒内规划的点击有17%会过时，而完全加载的页面上这一比例仅为0.4%——等待约一秒让网络活动停止即可消除大部分风险，但十个主流开源智能体中有八个的等待规则未能做到这一点。

计算机使用智能体会基于屏幕截图进行数秒的规划，然后点击屏幕上的某个位置；如果在此期间页面发生了变化，点击就会落在非预期的元素上。先前的工作将规划时间间隔视为这种风险的来源。通过测量31个公开网页上的计划点击，我们发现真正的风险在于页面加载：在完全加载的页面上规划的点击中，仅有0.4%在30秒内变得过时，而在页面打开后第一秒内规划的点击中，这一比例高达17%。在这些页面上，等待约一秒钟直到网络活动停止即可消除大部分风险，然而十个广泛使用的开源智能体中，有八个的等待规则会导致超过1%的点击过时。商业页面持续加载的时间更长：在HTTP Archive的公开抓取数据中，65个桌面端预订和购买类主页中有15%在HTML解析后的3秒内出现500毫秒无网络请求的情况，而3,028个.gov页面中这一比例为63%，并且52%的页面发生了偏移（原文摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2610.39282v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computer-use agents plan on a screenshot for several seconds and then click at a position on the screen; if the page has changed in the meantime, the click lands on an unintended element. Prior work treats the planning interval as the source of this risk. Measuring planned clicks on 31 public web pages, we find that the risk lies in page loading: 0.4% of clicks planned on fully loaded pages became stale within 30 seconds, against 17% of clicks planned in the first second after a page opened. On these pages, waiting about one second for network activity to stop removes most of this risk, yet the wait rules of eight of ten widely used open-source agents leave more than 1% of clicks stale. Commercial pages keep loading for longer: in the HTTP Archive's public crawl, 15% of 65 desktop booking and buying home pages went 500 ms without network requests within 3 seconds of their HTML being parsed, against 63% of 3,028 .gov pages, and 52% shifte

item.title: WorldFlow是一种生成式世界模型，它将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移标记，并利用统一的Mixture-of-Transformers骨干网络在整流流目标下联合去噪视频与3D两种模态，从而将显式几何动力学与视觉演化耦合，释放预训练视频模型中蕴含的物理常识。
item.description:
WorldFlow：通过大规模预训练实现视频与3D运动的联合预测

WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39278

WorldFlow是一种生成式世界模型，它将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移标记，并利用统一的Mixture-of-Transformers骨干网络在整流流目标下联合去噪视频与3D两种模态，从而将显式几何动力学与视觉演化耦合，释放预训练视频模型中蕴含的物理常识。

预测未来的物理状态是具身智能中的一个核心挑战。现有的视频世界模型将3D动力学隐式化，基于动作的公式化仍然绑定于特定的机器人配置，而3D运动预测模型仅使用光流监督，为物理动力学提供的学习信号十分有限。为了规避这些限制，我们提出了WorldFlow，一种能够联合预测未来视频和基于查询的3D轨迹的生成式世界模型。通过将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移标记，一个统一的混合Transformer（Mixture-of-Transformers, MoT）骨干网络在整流流（rectified-flow）目标下对两种模态进行联合去噪。这种公式化将显式的几何动力学与视觉演化耦合在一起，有效地释放了预训练视频模型中蕴含的物理常识。为了在实证上扩展并验证这一统一架构，我们在异构（摘要在此处截断）……上训练WorldFlow。

arXiv:2610.39278v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterog

item.title: MemSteer提出了一种将无标注用户历史自动转化为带证据支持的问答监督的方法，并结合证据引导的失败诊断来优化智能体记忆系统的设计。
item.description:
MemSteer：将用户历史转化为智能体记忆优化的监督信号

MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39276

MemSteer提出了一种将无标注用户历史自动转化为带证据支持的问答监督的方法，并结合证据引导的失败诊断来优化智能体记忆系统的设计。

一个有效的智能体记忆系统应当能够适应用户的历史和任务需求。人工标注的监督可以通过提供反馈来评估和改进记忆设计，从而指导这种适应。然而，对于新的用户历史，合适的标注往往难以获得，而人工构建问答对及其支持证据的成本很高。我们提出MemSteer，它将无标注的用户历史转化为带有支持证据的问答监督，用于记忆设计的优化。MemSteer构建了一个基于证据的答案计划，明确说明相关记录中的事实如何共同支持一个参考答案。该计划指导问题生成，同时通过基于来源的审计和盲答案恢复来检验生成的标注。为了研究这种监督的效用，我们开发了MemSteer-Opt，它将基于问答的设计评估与证据引导的失败诊断相结合，用于修订记忆存储、检索等组件。

arXiv:2610.39276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. MemSteer constructs an evidence-grounded answer plan that specifies how facts across related records jointly support a reference answer. The plan guides question generation, while source-grounded auditing and blind answer recovery check the resulting annotations. To study the utility of this supervision, we develop MemSteer-Opt, which combines QA-based design evaluation with evidence-guided failure diagnosis to revise memory store, retrieval, and

item.title: 本文提出并验证了一种将大语言模型与黑盒数值求解器相结合的集成优化框架，用于仿真驱动的工程再设计，并系统比较了三种LLM利用方式与四种求解器的组合效果。
item.description:
面向仿真驱动再设计的大语言模型辅助优化方法

LLM-Assisted Optimization for Simulation-Based Redesign

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39275

本文提出并验证了一种将大语言模型与黑盒数值求解器相结合的集成优化框架，用于仿真驱动的工程再设计，并系统比较了三种LLM利用方式与四种求解器的组合效果。

工程设计经常需要对已有方案进行再设计，以适应环境的变化，例如材料价格或系统需求的变动。再设计通常依赖于过于复杂和/或计算量过大的仿真器，而传统的数值求解器缺乏工程知识和背景信息，难以保证全局解的质量。大语言模型（LLM）能够理解语义信息，包括关于系统的工程知识和环境变化，从而帮助引导搜索，近期研究表明，将这些知识融入优化过程可以提升搜索性能。然而，在再设计任务中如何最佳地结合大语言模型与数值求解器仍不明确。本文开发并测试了一种用于再设计的集成式“大语言模型-优化”方法，比较了三种利用大语言模型的方式（热启动、变量固定和ReAct）以及四种黑盒求解器（贝叶斯优化、遗传算法、网格自适应直接搜索等）。

arXiv:2610.39275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Engineering design frequently involves redesigning a prior solution to adapt to changes in context, such as material prices or system requirements. Redesign often leverages simulators too complex and/or computationally intensive for traditional numerical solvers, which lack engineering knowledge and context, to ensure global solution quality. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret semantic information, including engineering knowledge about the system and changes in context, to help guide search, and recent studies have shown that incorporating this knowledge into optimization can improve search performance. However, how best to combine LLMs with numerical solvers in redesign remains unclear. We develop and test an integrated LLM-optimization approach for redesign and compare three methods for leveraging LLMs (warm start, variable fixing and ReAct) and four black-box solvers (Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, mesh adaptive di

item.title: DeCoRL提出了一种强化学习框架，通过将多图像合成的整体一致性分解为对象级一致性，并借助基于VLM的奖励模型提供细粒度的对象级反馈，从而有效提升多图像合成的一致性。
item.description:
DeCoRL：面向多图像合成的分解一致性强化学习

DeCoRL: Decomposed Consistency Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Image Composition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39265

DeCoRL提出了一种强化学习框架，通过将多图像合成的整体一致性分解为对象级一致性，并借助基于VLM的奖励模型提供细粒度的对象级反馈，从而有效提升多图像合成的一致性。

多图像合成（MICo）是大规模图像编辑模型的一项关键但极具挑战性的能力，随着参考图像数量的增加，一致性会迅速下降。尽管监督微调（SFT）可以使模型具备基本的MICo能力，但它仅对合成后的图像提供隐式监督，往往无法学习到跨多个参考图像的可靠对象级对应关系。我们提出了DeCoRL，这是一种强化学习（RL）框架，通过将整体的MICo一致性分解为对象级一致性来提升MICo的一致性。DeCoRL首先在参考图像之间建立与指令相关的对象对应关系，并在生成的图像中定位相应区域；然后利用一个在单对象一致性标注上训练的基于VLM的奖励模型，产生细粒度的对象级反馈，这些反馈被聚合为多对象一致性奖励，以指导强化学习后训练。

arXiv:2610.39265v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-image composition (MICo) is a critical yet challenging capability for large-scale image editing models, where consistency degrades rapidly as the number of reference images increases. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip models with basic MICo ability, it provides only implicit supervision on the composed image and often fails to learn reliable object-level correspondence across multiple references. We propose DeCoRL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that improves MICo consistency by decomposing holistic MICo consistency into object-level consistency. DeCoRL first establishes instruction-relevant object correspondences across reference images and localizes the corresponding regions in the generated image. It then uses a VLM-based reward model trained on single-object consistency annotations to produce fine-grained, object-wise feedback, which is aggregated into a multi-object consistency reward to guide RL post-tra

item.title: 提出了一种在线强化学习框架，将智能体解耦为规划智能体与UI定位模型，利用LLM作为评判者提供密集的步骤级奖励与终端奖励，并通过PPO直接在真实iOS应用上训练UI导航智能体，克服了现有模型成本高、易记忆静态轨迹且无法从错误中恢复的问题。
item.description:
面向真实iOS应用UI导航的基于规划-定位智能体的在线密集强化学习

Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39264

提出了一种在线强化学习框架，将智能体解耦为规划智能体与UI定位模型，利用LLM作为评判者提供密集的步骤级奖励与终端奖励，并通过PPO直接在真实iOS应用上训练UI导航智能体，克服了现有模型成本高、易记忆静态轨迹且无法从错误中恢复的问题。

尽管前沿视觉语言模型在用户界面（UI）导航方面展现出强大的能力，但其高昂的推理成本阻碍了日常使用。相反，通过监督微调（SFT）或离线强化学习训练的较小模型往往只会记忆静态轨迹，导致执行脆弱且无法从错误中恢复。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的在线强化学习框架，可直接在真实的iOS应用上训练UI导航智能体。我们的框架将智能体解耦为两个专门的组件：规划智能体和UI定位模型。我们依靠LLM作为评判者来提供全面的奖励信号，将用于评估中间进度的密集、步骤级反馈与用于评估整体任务完成的终端奖励相结合。为了有效利用这种双重奖励结构，我们使用带有步骤级的近端策略优化（PPO）来优化智能体。

arXiv:2610.39264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. Our framework decouples the agent into two specialized components: a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. We rely on an LLM-as-a-Judge to provide comprehensive reward signals, combining dense, step-level feedback to evaluate intermediate progress with a terminal reward for overall task completion. To effectively leverage this dual reward structure, we optimize the agent using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with step-lev

item.title: 提出一种两阶段自适应训练框架，通过从专家轨迹构建可复用的中间检查点、依据动作分歧选取关键枢轴点、并在这些节点上进行一步强化学习与逐步扩展的局部/后缀/根节点训练，显著提升了GUI代理强化学习的训练效率。
item.description:
在哪里学习以及展开多远：面向GUI代理的高效自适应训练

Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39251

提出一种两阶段自适应训练框架，通过从专家轨迹构建可复用的中间检查点、依据动作分歧选取关键枢轴点、并在这些节点上进行一步强化学习与逐步扩展的局部/后缀/根节点训练，显著提升了GUI代理强化学习的训练效率。

轨迹级GRPO是训练多步骤GUI代理的常用方法，但从任务起点反复展开完整轨迹可能效率低下：任务级奖励只能对哪些中间决策需要改进提供粗略监督，而已经掌握的前缀部分在到达困难状态之前会被反复重复执行。我们提出了一个两阶段自适应训练框架，同时解决“在哪里学习”和“展开多远”这两个问题。我们首先从成功的专家轨迹中构建可复用的中间检查点，并利用动作分歧（直接从采样的GUI动作中测量不确定性）来选择信息丰富的枢轴点。阶段I在这些枢轴点执行一步强化学习，以改进不确定的局部决策。阶段II随后根据任务进度，通过自适应的局部、后缀和根节点训练逐步扩展策略的职责范围。可恢复的检查点使重复训练成为可能。

arXiv:2610.39251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trajectory-level GRPO is a common approach for training multi-step GUI agents, but repeatedly rolling out complete trajectories from the task root can be inefficient: task-level rewards provide coarse supervision over which intermediate decisions require improvement, while already-mastered prefixes are repeatedly re-executed before reaching difficult states. We introduce a two-stage adaptive training framework that jointly addresses where to learn and how far to roll out. We first construct reusable intermediate checkpoints from successful expert trajectories and select informative pivots using action disagreement, which measures uncertainty directly from sampled GUI actions. Stage I performs one-step RL at these pivots to improve uncertain local decisions. Stage II then progressively expands policy responsibility through adaptive Local, Suffix, and Root training according to task progress. Recoverable checkpoints enable repeated trainin

item.title: SocialArena 提出了一个统一的三层框架和带有显式角色思考的角色扮演对话评估范式，从角色扮演能力、心理状态推理和行为推理三个维度系统化地定义并评估大语言模型的社交智能。
item.description:
SocialArena：评估大语言模型的社交智能

SocialArena: Evaluating Social Intelligence in Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39247

SocialArena 提出了一个统一的三层框架和带有显式角色思考的角色扮演对话评估范式，从角色扮演能力、心理状态推理和行为推理三个维度系统化地定义并评估大语言模型的社交智能。

我们提出了 SocialArena，这是一个用于系统化定义和评估大语言模型（LLM）社交智能的基准测试。尽管 LLM 越来越多地被部署在心理健康咨询、陪伴聊天机器人和教育辅导等社交互动类应用中，但现有的评估仍然较为碎片化，聚焦于孤立的能力或单一场景，且评估的可靠性在很大程度上未经检验。本工作做出了三项主要贡献以解决这些局限。（1）我们首先提出了一个统一的三层框架，从三个能力维度定义社交智能：角色扮演能力、心理状态推理和行为推理。为将该定义付诸实施，我们设计了一种带有显式角色思考的角色扮演对话评估范式，能够以贴近真实人类互动的方式同时评估这些能力。（2）为了……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.39247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce SocialArena, a benchmark for systematically defining and evaluating the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs). Although LLMs are increasingly deployed in socially interactive applications such as mental health counseling, companionship chatbots, and educational tutoring, existing evaluations remain fragmented focusing on isolated capabilities or single scenarios and evaluation reliability is largely unverified. This work makes three main contributions to address these limitations. (1) We first propose a unified three-tier framework that defines social intelligence along three capability dimensions: role-playing ability, mental state reasoning, and behavioral reasoning. To operationalize this definition, we design a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking for evaluation, enabling simultaneous assessment of these capabilities in a manner that mirrors realistic human interactions. item.title: 本文提出了一种融合金融知识图谱、确定性优化引擎与多智能体LLM层的“三引擎架构”，并通过上下文工程协调层实现可靠、可追溯、可审计的金融AI系统。
item.description:
超越LLM包装器：面向可靠金融AI的上下文工程与三引擎架构

Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39230

本文提出了一种融合金融知识图谱、确定性优化引擎与多智能体LLM层的“三引擎架构”，并通过上下文工程协调层实现可靠、可追溯、可审计的金融AI系统。

金融AI系统必须支持涉及支付、收款、现金流和合规性的决策类问题，同时确保数值准确性、可追溯性和可审计性。大语言模型（LLM）虽然实现了自然语言交互，但无法独立保证可复现的计算或有证据支撑的推荐。我们提出了一种源于生产实践的架构，集成了三个组件：用于表达企业关系、时间上下文和溯源信息的金融知识图谱；用于金融计算与决策的确定性优化引擎；以及用于意图理解、任务编排、解释生成和论断验证的多智能体LLM层。一个名为“上下文工程”的协调层，负责跨ERP系统、工具和租户对查询特定的上下文进行选择、排序、组合和验证。基于约11个月内15个部署的观察，单智能体管道……（原文摘要到此截断）

arXiv:2610.39230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Financial AI systems must support decision-bearing questions involving payments, collections, cash flow, and compliance while ensuring numerical accuracy, traceability, and auditability. Large language models (LLMs) enable natural language interaction but cannot independently guarantee reproducible calculations or evidence-grounded recommendations. We present a production-grounded architecture integrating three components: a financial knowledge graph for enterprise relationships, temporal context, and provenance; a deterministic optimization engine for financial calculations and decisions; and a multi-agent LLM layer for intent interpretation, task orchestration, explanation, and claim validation. A coordination layer, termed context engineering, selects, ranks, composes, and validates query-specific context across ERP systems, tools, and tenants.
