item.title: 本研究评估了多种决策模型与重排序器预测答案引擎引用行为的能力，并证明经蒸馏微调的4B小模型（GEO Citation Ranker 4B）在性能上可与未经训练的27B决策模型相媲美。
item.description:
预测答案引擎会引用什么：受控检索条件下十个引擎上的开放决策模型、重排序器与蒸馏4B学生模型

Predicting What Answer Engines Cite: Open Decision Models, Rerankers and a Distilled 4B Student on Ten Engines under Controlled Retrieval

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38090

本研究评估了多种决策模型与重排序器预测答案引擎引用行为的能力，并证明经蒸馏微调的4B小模型（GEO Citation Ranker 4B）在性能上可与未经训练的27B决策模型相媲美。

生成式引擎优化（GEO）需要一个评分器，能够根据候选页面在答案中将获得的引用份额对其进行排序。我们在GEO-Bench查询上评估了预训练重排序器、一个托管型类型化决策模型、八个开放决策模型以及蒸馏学生模型，这些查询由十个引擎回答，所有引擎在其提示中接收相同的候选来源。当多个引擎回答同一查询时，它们彼此之间的组内Spearman相关性为0.704，表现出高度一致。未经训练直接使用的Jev和两个开放的27B决策模型是最强的评分器，得分介于0.575至0.578之间。一个基于针对其他GEO-Bench查询的教师标签、用低秩适配器微调的Qwen3-Reranker-4B（以GEO Citation Ranker 4B的名称发布），在三个随机种子上的得分达到0.542至0.549，并且它与27B模型以及Jev之间的差异在229个查询上与零无法区分。当Jev评分时，学生模型与Jev之间剩余的大部分差距消失……

arXiv:2610.38090v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative engine optimization needs a scorer that ranks candidate pages by the share of an answer they will receive as citations. We measure pretrained rerankers, a hosted typed decision model (Jev), eight open decision models and distilled students on GEO-Bench queries answered by ten engines that receive the same candidate sources in their prompt. Where several engines answer the same query, they agree with one another at a within-group Spearman correlation of 0.704. Jev and two open 27B decision models, used without training, are the strongest scorers at 0.575 to 0.578. A Qwen3-Reranker-4B fine-tuned with low-rank adapters on teacher labels for other GEO-Bench queries, released as GEO Citation Ranker 4B, reaches 0.542 to 0.549 across three seeds, and its differences with the 27B models and with Jev are not distinguishable from zero on 229 queries. Most of the remaining distance between the student and Jev disappears when Jev scores

item.title: 本文从经济理论视角研究模型蒸馏现象，刻画了在位企业的模型特征如何影响蒸馏竞争者的蒸馏激励，以及蒸馏对用户剩余和在位企业效用等市场结果的影响。
item.description:
面对模型蒸馏，企业能做什么？

What Can Firms Do in the Face of Model Distillation?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38088

本文从经济理论视角研究模型蒸馏现象，刻画了在位企业的模型特征如何影响蒸馏竞争者的蒸馏激励，以及蒸馏对用户剩余和在位企业效用等市场结果的影响。

模型蒸馏已成为快速发展的生成式AI讨论中的一个重大关切。在其最简单的形式中，蒸馏是指较小的公司可以利用从与强大的专有闭权重模型对话记录中蒸馏出的数据来训练自己的模型，从而以低得多的成本实现相当高的模型质量。除了与蒸馏相关的正当的安全与安保顾虑之外，另一个主要问题是蒸馏还可能扭曲市场结果。这促使我们从经济理论的视角出发，对这一问题展开探索。我们考虑了一个包含两个参与者的情境：一个在位企业和一个进行蒸馏的竞争者，并刻画了在位企业的模型特征如何决定竞争者在蒸馏程度上的激励。我们还考察了蒸馏对关键市场结果的影响，例如用户侧剩余和在位企业的效用。我们的关键贡献……

arXiv:2610.38088v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Model distillation has become a major concern in the rapidly growing generative AI discourse. In its simplest form, distillation is the phenomenon where smaller firms can use data distilled from transcripts of conversations with powerful proprietary closed-weight models to train their own models, thus achieving reasonably high model quality but at much lower costs. Besides the legitimate safety and security concerns associated with distillation, another major issue is how it can also distort marketplace outcomes. This motivates us to initiate an exploration of the problem from an economic theory lens. We consider a setting with two players: an incumbent and a distilling competitor and characterize how the incumbent's model characteristics drive the incentives around how much the competitor should distill. We also consider the impact of distillation on key market outcomes like user-side surplus and the incumbent's utility. Our key contr

item.title: 该论文提出了一种新方法，通过让大语言模型对物品进行成对比较并生成可解释的理由，再用统计选择模型聚合这些理由，从而自动从非结构化数据中发现可解释且与决策相关的特征。
item.description:
利用大语言模型与统计选择模型从非结构化数据中发现可解释特征

Interpretable Feature Discovery from Unstructured Data Using LLMs and Statistical Choice Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38082

该论文提出了一种新方法，通过让大语言模型对物品进行成对比较并生成可解释的理由，再用统计选择模型聚合这些理由，从而自动从非结构化数据中发现可解释且与决策相关的特征。

从非结构化数据中进行特征提取通常依赖于不透明的嵌入表示，难以支持可解释的决策；而可解释特征则通常需要成本高昂、甚至常常不可行的手工设计。大语言模型（LLM）为此提供了一座天然的桥梁，因为它们能够读取原始数据并以可解释的术语对其进行描述。然而，直接让LLM从数据集的大量样本中提取特征，可能会因上下文长度限制和注意力稀释而导致结果不尽如人意。我们提出了一种从非结构化数据中自动发现可解释且与决策相关特征的方法。其核心思想是对物品进行成对比较，让LLM用可解释的术语阐明区分每一对物品的特征。我们将这些解释（即理由/rationales）视为数据：我们开发了一个统计选择模型，将这些理由在多次比较中进行汇总，从而识别出相关的特征。

arXiv:2610.38082v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Feature extraction from unstructured data typically relies on opaque embeddings unsuited to interpretable decision-making. Interpretable features, on the other hand, typically require costly, and often infeasible, hand-engineering. Large language models (LLMs) offer a natural bridge, as they can read raw data and describe it in interpretable terms. One could simply ask an LLM to extract features from a large sample of the dataset, but context limitations and diluted attention can lead to unsatisfactory results. We introduce a method that automatically discovers interpretable, decision-relevant features from unstructured data. Our key idea is to perform pairwise comparisons between items, asking an LLM to articulate, in interpretable terms, the features distinguishing each pair. We treat these explanations, or rationales, as data: we develop a statistical choice model that combines these rationales across the comparisons to identify rel

item.title: 论文发现了“提示彩票”现象——语义等价的提示词改写会导致LLM-as-a-Judge产生不一致的评判结果，甚至可能逆转模型的相对排名，并提出了测量与缓解这种句法改写敏感性的方法。
item.description:
LLM-as-a-Judge中的提示彩票现象：测量与缓解对句法改写的敏感性

Prompt Lottery in LLM-as-a-Judge: Measuring and Mitigating Sensitivity to Syntactic Rephrasing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38076

论文发现了“提示彩票”现象——语义等价的提示词改写会导致LLM-as-a-Judge产生不一致的评判结果，甚至可能逆转模型的相对排名，并提出了测量与缓解这种句法改写敏感性的方法。

LLM-as-a-Judge已成为评估大语言模型的标准方法，然而大多数方法都隐含地假设单个评判提示词是一个稳定的评估工具。以往的工作主要探索有意的提示词修改，例如评分标准、角色描述或思维链推理，以优化评估准确性。与此相反，我们研究的是那些经过验证、旨在保持评估语义不变但表面表述存在差异的提示词变体（即释义性改写），是否在固定评估任务下仍能产生一致的判断。我们提出了“提示彩票”这一现象，即释义性改写会导致LLM-as-a-Judge产生不同的评判结果。在一项涵盖多样化评估任务、评判模型家族和底层模型的大规模研究中，我们发现这些表面变化能够改变评估结果，在某些设置下甚至会颠倒模型之间的相对排名。一项针对10名用户的…（摘要截断）

arXiv:2610.38076v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become a standard for evaluating large language models, yet most approaches implicitly assume that a single judge prompt functions as a stable evaluation instrument. Prior work has primarily explored deliberate prompt modifications such as scoring rubrics, role descriptions, or chain-of-thought reasoning in order to optimize accuracy. In contrast, we investigate whether validated prompt variants intended to preserve evaluation semantics while differing in surface realization (\textit{paraphrastic rephrasings}) yield consistent judgments under a fixed evaluation task. We introduce \textit{Prompt Lottery}, a phenomenon in which paraphrastic rephrasings produce different LLMaJ judgments. Across a large-scale study spanning diverse evaluation tasks, judge families, and model backbones, we find that these variations can alter evaluation outcomes and, in some settings, reverse relative model rankings. A user study with 10

item.title: 该论文提出了一个结合伪影过滤与因果特征干预的审计流程，首次在多项选择问答中证明筛选后的SAE特征不仅与模型错误相关，更对模型的答案选择具有因果影响。
item.description:
从误差预测到因果影响：在多项选择问答中审计SAE特征

From Error Prediction to Causal Influence: Auditing SAE Features in Multiple-Choice QA

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38067

该论文提出了一个结合伪影过滤与因果特征干预的审计流程，首次在多项选择问答中证明筛选后的SAE特征不仅与模型错误相关，更对模型的答案选择具有因果影响。

稀疏自编码器（SAE）能够预测与模型错误相关的内部特征，但仅凭关联性并不能确立因果影响。我们在多项选择题问答任务中研究这一区别，其中答案偏好可以通过正确答案与竞争选项之间的logit差距（logit margin）来衡量。我们在八个数据集上，使用Gemma Scope SAE分析了Gemma 3 1B和4B模型。我们提出了一个流程来过滤掉与格式和内容伪影（如提示词和答案排列）高度相关的特征，并通过因果特征干预评估剩余特征。我们的结果表明，SAE激活在多个模型和数据集上包含关于错误性和不确定性的预测信号。在过滤掉被伪影污染的特征后，在问题和选项文本跨度上选择的用于因果干预的特征，相比随机选择的特征能产生更大的绝对logit差距变化和更高的从错误转为正确的比率。

arXiv:2610.38067v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can predict internal features associated with model errors, but association alone does not establish causal influence. We study this distinction in multiple-choice question answering, where answer preference can be measured by the logit margin between the correct answer and the competing choices. Across eight datasets, we analyze Gemma~3 1B and 4B with Gemma Scope SAEs. We propose a pipeline to filter out the features that have high correlation with format and content artifacts, such as prompt and answer permutation, and evaluate the remaining ones with causal feature interventions. Our results show that SAE activations contain predictive signals about wrongness and uncertainty across models and datasets. After filtering artifact-contaminated features, selected features for causal intervention at question and option spans produce larger absolute margin shifts and a higher wrong-to-correct rate than randomly s

item.title: 该论文提出PromptSense框架，通过在模型推理前整合情感与抑郁分析及规则过滤机制来动态构建提示，显著提升了心理健康聊天机器人回复的共情性、相关性和安全性，且提示工程方法优于DSFT和RLAIF。
item.description:
PromptSense：具有动态提示的情感感知心理健康聊天机器人

PromptSense: Sentiment-Aware Mental Health Chatbot with Dynamic Prompting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38044

该论文提出PromptSense框架，通过在模型推理前整合情感与抑郁分析及规则过滤机制来动态构建提示，显著提升了心理健康聊天机器人回复的共情性、相关性和安全性，且提示工程方法优于DSFT和RLAIF。

当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的心理健康聊天机器人通常缺乏足够的共情能力、上下文感知和安全机制，可能导致无效甚至有害的交互。本文提出了一种新颖的框架，在模型推理之前将情感与抑郁分析和基于规则的过滤机制相结合。通过基于情感和风险相关的洞察动态构建提示，该框架旨在显著提高模型生成回复的上下文相关性、共情能力和风险感知水平。我们评估了四种模型策略和两种提示工程变体，评估指标包括共情性、有用性、清晰度、相关性、安全性等定性指标，以及使用Perspective API进行的毒性评估。实验结果表明，提示工程方法分别比DSFT和RLAIF高出1.8%和1.1%。

arXiv:2610.38044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current Large Language Models (LLMs)-based mental health chatbots often lack sufficient empathy, contextual awareness, and safety mechanisms, potentially leading to ineffective or harmful interactions. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates sentiment and depression analysis with a rule-based filtering mechanism prior to model inference. By dynamically constructing prompts based on emotional and risk-related insights, the framework aims to significantly improve the contextual relevance, empathy, and risk-aware of model-generated responses. We evaluated four model strategies and two prompt engineered variants across qualitative metrics such as empathy, helpfulness, clarity, relevance, safety, as well as toxicity assessments using the Perspective API. Experimental results indicate that the prompt engineering approaches outperforms DSFT and RLAIF by 1.8\% and 1.1\% respectively.

item.title: 该论文构建了一个混合转播、固定高位、手机与场地平视四种视角的网球弹跳/击球事件检测基准，证明现有监督式检测器只对转播画面有效，而基于球轨迹与球员姿态、无需在事件标签上拟合参数的RallyArb仲裁层在手机和场地平视画面上仍能保持弹跳F1高于0.8。
item.description:
事件检测器能离开转播镜头吗？来自网球运动的证据

Can Event Detectors Leave the Broadcast Camera? Evidence from Tennis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38042

该论文构建了一个混合转播、固定高位、手机与场地平视四种视角的网球弹跳/击球事件检测基准，证明现有监督式检测器只对转播画面有效，而基于球轨迹与球员姿态、无需在事件标签上拟合参数的RallyArb仲裁层在手机和场地平视画面上仍能保持弹跳F1高于0.8。

球的弹跳与球拍击球是网球统计数据赖以生成的事件，而在单目视频中这两者极易混淆。我们发布了一个基准数据集，在混合了转播、固定高位、手机和场地平视视角的八个视频片段上提供345个帧级别的弹跳与击球标注，并配有固定的开发/测试集划分、混淆感知的匹配器、片段级bootstrap置信区间以及对三个片段的盲评二次标注。在该基准上，我们评测了使用已发布转播权重的监督式精确检测器、两个零样本视觉-语言模型，以及RallyArb——一个基于球轨迹与球员姿态构建、不在事件标签上拟合任何参数的仲裁层。监督式检测器在转播画面上得分接近满分，但在手机和场地平视画面上几乎失效，其中E2E-Spot的弹跳F1合并值仅为0.130。RallyArb在三个手机和场地平视视角片段上保持弹跳F1高于0.8，其中两个片段曾用于其调优……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.38042v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. RallyArb keeps a bounce F1 above 0.8 on the three phone and court-level clips, two of which were used to tune it, a

item.title: EARS-Info通过融合边际感知增益、可行重定位、返回感知路由和缓存最短路径等机制，在八张城市地图的多机器人探索任务中全面超越EARS-Safe，实现了最高的平均运行分数、更高的发现率并降低能耗。
item.description:
EARS-Info：面向多机器人探索的信息感知事件驱动重分配方法

EARS-Info: Information-Aware Event-Driven Reallocation for Multi-Robot Exploration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38040

EARS-Info通过融合边际感知增益、可行重定位、返回感知路由和缓存最短路径等机制，在八张城市地图的多机器人探索任务中全面超越EARS-Safe，实现了最高的平均运行分数、更高的发现率并降低能耗。

我们提出了EARS-Info，这是事件驱动蚁群重分配搜索（EARS）的一种信息感知扩展方法，用于在由OpenStreetMap派生的网格上进行多机器人探索。该方法结合了边际感知增益、可行重定位、返回感知路由、感知预留以及缓存的最短路径。在八张城市地图上对30种实现进行共168,000回合的对比实验中，EARS-Info在每个评估面板中都取得了最高的平均运行分数。在八台机器人和3%通信丢率的条件下，其分数相比EARS-Safe提升了5.43%，加权发现率从88.88%提高到98.46%，平均能耗降低2.62%。分数差异在全部八个城市中均为正值（p=0.0078125；描述性95%城市自举置信区间为[0.0159,0.0694]），且在5,600次EARS-Info回合中未发生任何模拟事故。这些结果支持了完整控制器的有效性；但各单个组件的优势仍不确定。其泛化能力受限于重复使用的地理（数据），

arXiv:2610.38040v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce EARS-Info, an information-aware extension of Event-Driven Ant Reallocation Search for multi-robot exploration on OpenStreetMap-derived grids. It combines marginal sensing gain, feasible relocation, return-aware routing, sensing reservations, and cached shortest paths. Across 168,000 episodes comparing 30 implementations on eight city maps, EARS-Info achieves the highest mean operational score in every evaluation panel. With eight robots and 3% communication dropout, it improves the score over EARS-Safe by 5.43%, increases weighted discovery from 88.88% to 98.46%, and reduces mean energy use by 2.62%. Score differences are positive in all eight cities ($p=0.0078125$; descriptive 95% city-bootstrap interval $[0.0159,0.0694]$), with no simulated incidents across 5,600 EARS-Info episodes. These results support the complete controller; individual component advantages remain uncertain. Generalization is limited by reused geograp

item.title: 该论文通过对186项实验、共18,600次运行的大规模实证研究发现，深度学习模型性能分布常呈非高斯分布（尤其在时间序列预测任务中），且模型大小并不会系统性地影响性能鲁棒性。
item.description:
测量深度学习性能——跨架构与任务的性能分布实证研究

Measuring Deep Learning Performance - An Empirical Study of Performance Distributions Across Architectures and Tasks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38037

该论文通过对186项实验、共18,600次运行的大规模实证研究发现，深度学习模型性能分布常呈非高斯分布（尤其在时间序列预测任务中），且模型大小并不会系统性地影响性能鲁棒性。

背景：深度学习算法设计与实现中的非确定性会导致性能变化，这意味着模型性能不是一个单一数值，而是一个分布。尽管这些模型性能分布对鲁棒性有重要影响，但此前对其研究不足。目标：我们研究了深度学习性能对各类非确定性来源的鲁棒性，特别关注性能分布在不同架构和任务之间的差异。方法：我们在图像分类和时间序列预测架构上开展了186项实验。每项实验使用不同的随机种子运行100次以生成性能分布，共计18,600次运行。鲁棒性通过离散度、对称性和尾部风险等指标进行量化。结果：性能分布经常呈非高斯分布，尤其是在时间序列预测任务中。模型大小不会系统性地影响鲁棒性——

arXiv:2610.38037v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Context: Non-determinism in deep learning algorithm design and implementation leads to performance variation, meaning model performance is not a single value, but rather a distribution. These model performance distributions are underexplored despite their impact on robustness. Objective: We investigate the robustness of deep learning performance to sources of non-determinism, specifically focusing on how performance distributions differ across various architectures and tasks. Method: We conducted 186 experiments on image classification and time series forecasting architectures. Each experiment was run 100 times with different random seeds to generate performance distributions, resulting in 18,600 runs. Robustness was quantified using metrics for spread, symmetry, and tail risk. Results: Performance distributions are frequently non-Gaussian, particularly in time series forecasting. Model size does not systematically affect robustness --

item.title: 提出了 Metatron，一个将冻结的生成式基础策略与可编程技能层相结合的可提示全身执行层，其中技能是由编码智能体优化的普通代码，无需任务特定策略训练即可在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实现多样化的全身运动控制。
item.description:
METATRON：面向人形机器人的可提示全身执行层

METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38027

提出了 Metatron，一个将冻结的生成式基础策略与可编程技能层相结合的可提示全身执行层，其中技能是由编码智能体优化的普通代码，无需任务特定策略训练即可在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实现多样化的全身运动控制。

人形机器人控制器尽管都共享对平衡和全身协调的需求，但往往仍需针对特定任务进行训练。我们提出了 Metatron，一个可提示的全身执行层，它将生成式基础策略与可编程技能层相结合。基础策略接收部分目标（统称为“提示”），这些提示可以组合定时身体部位目标、速度指令和风格线索，并据此产生与目标一致的多样化全身运动。训练结合了动作捕捉数据、合成恢复轨迹以及重定向的场景交互动作。训练完成后策略被冻结。被称为“技能”的有状态程序在每个控制步骤中将任务意图表达为提示，绘制粗略的几何草图，再由策略将其转化为协调的运动。技能就是普通的代码，由编码智能体通过分析运动数据并拟合紧凑规则来进行优化，无需任何任务特定的策略训练。在真实的 Unitree G1 机器人上……

arXiv:2610.38027v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Humanoid controllers often require task-specific training despite sharing the need for balance and whole-body coordination. We present Metatron, a promptable whole-body execution layer combining a generative base policy with a programmable skill layer. The base policy receives partial goals, collectively called a prompt, that can combine timed body-part targets, velocity commands, and style cues. It produces diverse whole-body motions consistent with these goals. Training combines motion capture, synthetic recovery trajectories, and retargeted scene-interaction motions. After training, the policy is frozen. Stateful programs called skills express task intent as prompts at each control step, drawing rough geometric sketches that the policy turns into coordinated movement. Skills are ordinary code, refined by coding agents that analyze motion data and fit compact rules without task-specific policy training. On the physical Unitree G1, on

item.title: 本研究通过分析小红书用户对世界杯期间受众涌入的讨论，首次揭示了用户对社区变化的因果归因（如算法个性化、平台商业化）与其边界管理策略之间存在显著强关联（Cramer's V = .583）。
item.description:
理解受众变化：小红书上的因果归因与边界管理

Making Sense of Audience Change: Causal Attribution and Boundary Management on Xiaohongshu

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38026

本研究通过分析小红书用户对世界杯期间受众涌入的讨论，首次揭示了用户对社区变化的因果归因（如算法个性化、平台商业化）与其边界管理策略之间存在显著强关联（Cramer's V = .583）。

推荐算法驱动的平台不仅重塑了用户看到的内容，也改变了谁会变得可见，以及社区边界如何被协商。我们研究了小红书上围绕“世界杯相关受众涌入”这一感知的讨论，以理解用户如何归因社区的变化，以及这些解释与边界管理策略之间的关系。我们采用研究者主导的主题分析、结构化编码和基于置换检验的关联分析方法，对八个高互动帖子中的262条评论进行了分析。用户将个性化推荐既描述为社会隔离，也描述为可能失效的边界；通过受众获取和商业化来解读平台增长；并争论性别是否应当成为界定社区成员资格的标准。在70条包含明确归因和策略的评论中，归因与策略之间存在强关联（Cramer's V = .583）：算法归因集中于技术性边界管理……（摘要内容不完整，此处截至原文截断处）

arXiv:2610.38026v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recommendation-driven platforms can reshape not only what users see, but also who becomes visible and how community boundaries are negotiated. We examine Xiaohongshu discussions surrounding a perceived World Cup-related audience influx to understand how users attributed community change and how those explanations related to boundary-management strategies. We analyzed 262 comments from eight high-engagement threads using researcher-led thematic analysis, structured coding, and permutation-based association analysis. Users described personalization as both social separation and a boundary that could fail, interpreted platform growth through audience acquisition and commercialization, and contested whether gender should define community membership. item.title: 该研究构建了一个针对惯性约束聚变领域的专家审核基准测试（250道题），并证明经领域自适应预训练与有监督微调的专用模型Prospero较其基础模型总分提升10.7个百分点，为评估语言模型的科学专业能力提供了范例。
item.description:
评估面向科学应用的语言模型：以惯性约束聚变为用例

Assessing Language Models for Scientific Applications: Inertial Confinement Fusion as a Use Case

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38024

该研究构建了一个针对惯性约束聚变领域的专家审核基准测试（250道题），并证明经领域自适应预训练与有监督微调的专用模型Prospero较其基础模型总分提升10.7个百分点，为评估语言模型的科学专业能力提供了范例。

推进面向专业科学应用的语言模型需要对其科学流畅度、物理推理和定量分析能力进行评估。我们以惯性约束聚变（ICF）作为测试用例，开发了一个由专家精心编制、包含250道题目的基准测试，涵盖定性推理、数值计算、符号推导和方程构建四种类型。模型回答通过确定性的数值与符号校验并结合语言模型评判器进行评估。我们将多种开箱即用的闭源和开源大型语言模型与Prospero进行了比较，Prospero是通过领域自适应预训练与有监督微调相结合的方式针对ICF进行专业化的模型。我们还开展了初步的检索辅助评估。结果显示，Prospero的总分较其基础模型提高了10.7个百分点，且在所有题型上均有提升。前沿模型获得了最高的总分，但关键的（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.38024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advancing language models for specialized scientific applications requires evaluations of scientific fluency, physical reasoning, and quantitative analyses. Using inertial confinement fusion (ICF) as a test case, we have developed an expert-curated benchmark of 250 questions spanning qualitative reasoning, numerical calculation, symbolic derivation, and equation formulation. Responses have been evaluated using deterministic numerical and symbolic checks together with language-model judges. We compared a variety of out-of-the-box closed-source and open-source large language models with Prospero, a model specialized through combined domain-adaptive pretraining and supervised fine-tuning for ICF. We also conducted initial retrieval-assisted evaluations. Prospero improved its aggregate score by 10.7 percentage points over its base model, with gains across all question types. item.title: 该研究通过质性分析发现，有自闭症儿童的家庭需依靠持续的家庭劳动（翻译、配置、改造、维护与边界设定）来调适智能家居技术，使其从障碍变为支持，而远程监控则在安全、隐私与控制之间产生张力并带来一种“受监护的独立性”。
item.description:
让智能家居适配自闭症儿童：家庭劳动与受监护的独立性

Making Smart Homes Fit for Autistic Children: Family Work and Monitored Independence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38008

该研究通过质性分析发现，有自闭症儿童的家庭需依靠持续的家庭劳动（翻译、配置、改造、维护与边界设定）来调适智能家居技术，使其从障碍变为支持，而远程监控则在安全、隐私与控制之间产生张力并带来一种“受监护的独立性”。

通用型智能家居技术日益融入家庭生活，然而它们如何支持或干扰自闭症儿童及有自闭症儿童的家庭，仍缺乏充分研究。我们开展了一项多来源的质性研究，数据来源包括五次照护者访谈、明确处于自闭症语境下的小红书（RedNote）帖文，以及来自小红书和微博的情境性帖文。研究发现，家庭通过调整环境输出、提示方式和交互渠道来为自闭症儿童创造支持，而感官刺激强度、交流规则和不透明的运行状态则可能使同样的技术成为障碍。这种支持还依赖于持续的家庭劳动，包括翻译、配置、改造、维护和边界设定。远程监控在实现“有条件的独立性”的同时，也引发了安全、隐私与控制之间的张力。我们贡献了三个概念……（摘要截断）

arXiv:2610.38008v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: General-purpose smart-home technologies are increasingly present in family life, yet how they support or disrupt autistic children and families with autistic children remains underexamined. We conducted a multi-source qualitative study drawing on five caregiver interviews, Xiaohongshu (also known internationally as RedNote) posts explicitly situated in autism contexts, and contextual posts from Xiaohongshu and Weibo. We find that families create support for autistic children by adapting environmental outputs, prompts, and interaction channels, while sensory intensity, communicative rules, and opaque operating states can turn the same technologies into barriers. Support also depends on continuing family work, including translation, configuration, modification, maintenance, and boundary-setting. Remote monitoring enables conditional independence while generating tensions among safety, privacy, and control. We contribute three concepts, i

item.title: 本研究通过对不同岗位医疗保健专业人员的问卷调查与访谈发现，他们对算法偏见的成因、评估标准、公平感知及偏见缓解方法的观点会因其工作角色、视角、任务和算法特征的不同而有所差异。
item.description:
医疗保健专业人员视角下的算法偏见

Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38006

本研究通过对不同岗位医疗保健专业人员的问卷调查与访谈发现，他们对算法偏见的成因、评估标准、公平感知及偏见缓解方法的观点会因其工作角色、视角、任务和算法特征的不同而有所差异。

本文聚焦于医疗保健信息系统中机器学习与人工智能应用中的算法偏见问题。基于对具有不同工作角色（如临床与行政岗位）的医疗保健专业人员开展的问卷调查和访谈所获得的定量数据与定性评论，本研究提供了关于算法偏见、感知公平性以及对机器学习算法和算法生成结果的预期接受度与采纳意愿之间关系的发现。研究结果表明，医疗保健专业人员对算法偏见的成因、算法评估标准、感知公平性以及偏见缓解方法的看法可能因其工作角色、视角、任务和算法特征的不同而有所差异。要确保医疗保健领域的公平与平等，还需要更多研究来探究算法偏见问题。

arXiv:2610.38006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.

item.title: 本研究通过与说纽卡斯尔方言或标准英音的语音助手交互发现，方言口音的语音助手能唤起用户的温暖感与地方归属感，但同时揭示了语音AI中存在双向的社会语言学偏见。
item.description:
“这会让乔迪人（纽卡斯尔人）感到宾至如归”：语音AI中的地区口音感知与言语顺应

"It Would Make a Geordie Feel at Home": Regional Accent Perceptions and Speech Accommodation in Voice AI

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38005

本研究通过与说纽卡斯尔方言或标准英音的语音助手交互发现，方言口音的语音助手能唤起用户的温暖感与地方归属感，但同时揭示了语音AI中存在双向的社会语言学偏见。

自动语音识别（ASR）系统在处理地区方言使用者时往往准确率较低，但关于用户如何应对这些局限，以及语音助手（VA）生成的地区口音如何从社会语言学视角被评价，目前所知甚少。本研究以纽卡斯尔英语（乔迪英语）使用者为对象，考察了人们对语音技术的语言顺应情况，以及对方言口音语音助手与主流口音语音助手的感知差异。参与者与一个模拟语音助手进行交互，该助手要么说纽卡斯尔英语，要么说英格兰南部标准英语（SSBE）。随后，参与者完成了半结构化访谈，内容涉及他们在实验语音助手及语音技术上的体验、语言使用情况、口音态度和地方认同。研究结果揭示了一种双向的社会语言学偏见过程：乔迪口音的语音助手让人联想到熟悉感、温暖、个性以及地方归属感。

arXiv:2610.38005v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often perform less accurately for speakers of regional dialects, but less is known about how users respond to these limitations and how regional voices produced by voice assistants (VAs) are evaluated through a sociolinguistic lens. This study investigates these issues among speakers of Newcastle English (Geordies), examining both linguistic accommodation to voice technologies and perceptions of regional versus mainstream-accented VA voices. Participants interacted with a simulated VA that spoke either Newcastle English or Standard Southern British English (SSBE). They subsequently completed semi-structured interviews about their experiences with the experimental VA and voice technologies, language use, accent attitudes, and place orientation. The findings reveal a two-way process of sociolinguistic bias. The Geordie VA was associated with familiarity, warmth, personality, and local belonging,

item.title: 论文指出当前地震基础模型从音频/视觉领域移植的窗口级学习目标只捕捉单次波传播而忽略地震稀疏自激发的发震过程，并通过九种共享 Mamba 架构、仅改变自监督目标的模型实验，检验地震基础模型是否只是“美化的特征提取器”。
item.description:
地震基础模型是否不止是“华而不实的特征提取器”？

Are Seismic Foundation Models More Than Glorified Feature Extractors?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38003

论文指出当前地震基础模型从音频/视觉领域移植的窗口级学习目标只捕捉单次波传播而忽略地震稀疏自激发的发震过程，并通过九种共享 Mamba 架构、仅改变自监督目标的模型实验，检验地震基础模型是否只是“美化的特征提取器”。

地震序列在两个相互分离的时间尺度上具有随机性：任何单次地震的地震波在数秒至数分钟内传播，而地震本身则以稀疏的自激发发震过程到达，事件间隔从数秒到数月不等。如何在单一训练目标中同时兼顾这两个尺度，是一个悬而未决的挑战。面向地震波形的基座模型（FMs）却从音频和视觉领域移植其学习目标，而在这两个领域中，每个目标都是从单个固定长度的窗口计算得到的。这样的窗口只包含波传播的一次实现（一条地震记录），却从不包含决定地震何时发生的发震过程。我们开发了九种共享同一 Mamba 编码器-解码器的模型设计，在包含 300 万个窗口的固定语料库上训练，改变自监督目标、量化瓶颈和混合器；其中两个关键比较是架构匹配的，仅改变目标函数。

arXiv:2610.38003v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Earthquake sequences are stochastic on two separated timescales: the seismic waves of any individual earthquake propagate over seconds to minutes, while the earthquakes themselves arrive as a sparse, self-exciting occurrence process, with inter-event intervals from seconds to months. Respecting both scales in one training objective is the open challenge. Foundation models (FMs) for seismic waveforms instead import their learning targets from audio and vision, where every target is computed from a single fixed-length window. Such a window holds one realization of the wave propagation (an earthquake trace), never the occurrence process that decides when earthquakes happen. We develop nine model designs sharing one Mamba encoder-decoder, trained on a fixed corpus of 3M windows, varying the self-supervised objective, quantization bottleneck and mixer; the two key comparisons are architecture-matched, varying the objective alone. Each check

item.title: 提出PairFuse方法，通过轻量级逐层适配器将预训练全原子表示融合到几何潜空间扩散模型中，以参数高效的方式实现跨模态的统一结合剂设计。
item.description:
迈向将预训练全原子表示泛化至统一结合剂设计

Towards Generalizing Pretrained All-Atom Representations to Unified Binder Design

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37994

提出PairFuse方法，通过轻量级逐层适配器将预训练全原子表示融合到几何潜空间扩散模型中，以参数高效的方式实现跨模态的统一结合剂设计。

基于PairFormer的全原子模型在生物分子结合剂设计中展现出强大的能力。然而，现有方法通常将全原子表示用于特定模态的结合剂设计，例如蛋白质和肽的设计。相比之下，近期的几何潜空间扩散模型通过在共享潜空间中表示来自不同模态的分子块，追求统一的结合剂设计。这些互补的优势促使我们研究如何将预训练全原子表示的应用泛化到统一结合剂设计中。我们提出了PairFuse，这是一种通过表示融合实现这种泛化的参数高效方法。具体而言，我们使用轻量级的逐层适配器将预训练的全原子表示整合到独立预训练的几何潜空间扩散模型中。我们的适配器通过两种机制整合预训练的全原子表示：丰富扩散模型的分子……

arXiv:2610.37994v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design. However, existing methods often use all-atom representations for modality-specific binder design, such as protein and peptide design. In contrast, recent geometric latent diffusion models pursue unified binder design by representing molecular blocks from different modalities in a shared latent space. These complementary strengths motivate us to investigate how to generalize the use of pretrained all-atom representations to unified binder design. We introduce PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that enables this generalization through representation fusion. Specifically, we use lightweight layerwise adapters to integrate pretrained all-atom representations into an independently pretrained geometric latent diffusion model. Our adapters integrate pretrained all-atom representations through two mechanisms: enriching the diffusion model's mole

item.title: GAUSS是一个负载感知的解析与蒙特卡洛模拟器，能够为LLM推理服务预测TTFT和TBT的完整延迟分布以及可持续请求速率。
item.description:
GAUSS：面向大语言模型推理服务的负载感知解析与蒙特卡洛模拟器

GAUSS: A Workload-Aware Analytical and Monte-Carlo Simulator for LLM Inference Serving

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37989

GAUSS是一个负载感知的解析与蒙特卡洛模拟器，能够为LLM推理服务预测TTFT和TBT的完整延迟分布以及可持续请求速率。

大语言模型（LLM）推理已成为一种运营性工作负载，集群必须根据延迟服务级别目标（SLO）对其进行容量规划、监控和计费。单一的吞吐量数字无法回答运营者实际面临的问题，因为生成式服务耦合了两个服务特性截然不同的阶段，连续批处理重塑了有效服务过程，而且用户可感知的尾延迟可能在总吞吐量尚未饱和之前就已恶化。我们提出了GAUSS，一个负载感知的解析与蒙特卡洛模拟器，它能够针对给定的工作负载、引擎和加速器，预测首字延迟（TTFT）和字间延迟（TBT）的完整分布，以及可持续请求速率。GAUSS将针对预填充和解码两阶段校准的、阶段特定的延迟曲面与随机到达下的Lindley递推排队模型相结合，并通过集成蒙特卡洛采样来估计性能。

arXiv:2610.37989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference has become an operational workload that fleets must provision, monitor, and bill against latency service-level objectives (SLOs). A single throughput number cannot answer the questions operators actually face, because generative serving couples two phases with very different service characteristics, continuous batching reshapes the effective service process, and user-visible tail latency can degrade long before aggregate throughput saturates. We present GAUSS, a workload-aware analytical and Monte-Carlo simulator that predicts the full distributions of time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-tokens (TBT), together with the sustainable request rate, for a given workload, engine, and accelerator. GAUSS pairs calibrated, phase-specific latency surfaces for prefill and decode with a Lindley-recurrence model of queueing under stochastic arrivals and estimates performance by ensemble Monte-Carlo samplin

item.title: 提出 Merge and Branch 方法，通过将历史物品压缩为少量可学习 token，并以浅而宽的树状结构结合树形 FlashAttention 实现历史计算共享与多目标分支预测，大幅降低 LLM 生成式推荐监督微调的输入成本并提升学习效率。
item.description:
合并与分支：面向推荐的高效树状结构大语言模型监督微调

Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37973

提出 Merge and Branch 方法，通过将历史物品压缩为少量可学习 token，并以浅而宽的树状结构结合树形 FlashAttention 实现历史计算共享与多目标分支预测，大幅降低 LLM 生成式推荐监督微调的输入成本并提升学习效率。

基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式推荐需要读取冗长、文本丰富的交互历史，但仅生成简短的语义标识符（SID）。这种不对称性使得监督微调效率低下：编码历史的代价高昂，而每段历史通常只为一个目标提供监督。我们提出 Merge and Branch（M&B）方法，以降低输入成本并从每段已编码的历史中学习更多信息。Merge 将每个历史物品的 SID 和文本压缩为少量可学习的 token；Branch 利用压缩后的历史来预测多个目标 SID。为了在共享历史计算的同时保持这些目标相互独立，M&B 将每个样本组织成一棵浅而宽的树。我们开发了树形 FlashAttention 来高效执行这种布局：共享历史只需处理一次，而梯度从每个分支反向传播，实现端到端训练。树形结构的键/值缓存进一步将历史共享扩展到受限解码阶段。在公开基准上的实验表明……

arXiv:2610.37973v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. item.title: 提出了ACTS-WM框架，一种自监督的潜在动作条件化世界模型，通过将时间序列转移背后的信息推断为潜在动作来改进时间序列建模，且无需显式的动作标注。
item.description:
面向时间序列的自监督潜在动作条件化世界建模

Self-Supervised Latent Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37963

提出了ACTS-WM框架，一种自监督的潜在动作条件化世界模型，通过将时间序列转移背后的信息推断为潜在动作来改进时间序列建模，且无需显式的动作标注。

时间序列数据在天气预测、网络流量分析和语音识别等多种任务中发挥着重要作用。近年来，开创性的研究越来越多地采用基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的编码器，通过潜在空间预测来学习时间序列表示。然而，这些方法往往忽略了控制时间序列观测之间转移的潜在因素。在本工作中，我们假设显式建模时间序列变化背后的信息可以促进时间序列建模。基于这一假设，我们提出了ACTS-WM，一个用于时间序列分析的自监督潜在动作条件化世界模型框架。首先，我们引入了一种潜在动作建模方法，将时间序列转移背后的潜在信息推断为潜在动作，而无需显式的动作标注。随后，我们开发了一个基于JEPA的编码器和一个动作条件化的（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2610.37963v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time-series data play an important role in various tasks, such as weather forecasting, web traffic analysis, and speech recognition. Recently, pioneering studies have increasingly adopted Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) based encoders to learn time-series representations through latent-space prediction. However, they often overlook the underlying factors governing transitions between time-series observations. In this work, we hypothesize that explicitly modeling the information behind changes in time series can facilitate time-series modeling. Building on this hypothesis, we propose ACTS-WM, a self-supervised latent action-conditioned world model framework for time-series analysis. First, we introduce a latent action modeling approach that infers the underlying information behind time-series transitions as latent actions, without requiring explicit action annotations. We then develop a JEPA-based encoder and an action-co

item.title: 本文提出两种统计检测方法（POB-ICM 和 POB-UNBP），用于检测基于大语言模型的对话式推荐系统中因候选项目呈现顺序引发的位置偏差，并基于大规模受控 RAG 实验提供了实证证据。
item.description:
基于大语言模型的推荐系统中位置偏差的统计检测：方法与实证证据

Statistical Detection of Positional Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: Methodologies and Empirical Evidence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37962

本文提出两种统计检测方法（POB-ICM 和 POB-UNBP），用于检测基于大语言模型的对话式推荐系统中因候选项目呈现顺序引发的位置偏差，并基于大规模受控 RAG 实验提供了实证证据。

arXiv:2610.37962v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）摘要：大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地通过检索增强生成（RAG）在对话式推荐系统（RS）中充当推荐生成器。这种灵活的设计引入了新的结构性偏差来源。本文研究了 top-1 和单轮基于 LLM 的推荐系统中的位置偏差，即推荐结果对候选项目在提示词中呈现顺序的系统性依赖。我们提出了两种互补的检测方法：（i）POB-ICM，基于列联矩阵分析和卡方独立性检验；（ii）POB-UNBP，一种在基于排列的评估下从均匀性零模型推导出的样本高效方法，可实现具有正式统计保证的随机解码。利用一个基于真实商品目录、固定提示词模板以及 2000 条模板生成的用户查询（每条查询 20 种排列，共 40,000 个实例）构建的受控 RAG 商品推荐测试平台，两种方法……

arXiv:2610.37962v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommendation generators in conversational recommender systems (RS) via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This flexible design introduces new sources of structural bias. This paper studies positional bias in top-1 and single-turn LLM-based RS: systematic dependence of the recommended item on the order in which candidates are presented in the prompt. We propose two complementary detection methodologies: (i) POB-ICM, based on contingency matrix analysis and Chi-square independence testing, and (ii) POB-UNBP, a sample-efficient approach derived from a uniformity null model under permutation-based evaluation, enabling stochastic decoding with formal statistical guarantees. Using a controlled RAG testbed for product recommendation, built on a real product catalog, a fixed prompt template and 2000 template-generated user queries with 20 permutations each (40,000 instances), both meth

item.title: SAG-Sep将LP解编码为稀疏增强图并在单次前向传播中完成节点评分，结合洋葱引导搜索，为大规模车辆路径问题快速分离出大量有效舍入容量割。
item.description:
SAG-Sep：用于舍入容量割分离的稀疏增强图与洋葱引导搜索

SAG-Sep: Sparse Augmented Graphs and Onion-Guided Search for Rounded Capacity Cut Separation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37952

SAG-Sep将LP解编码为稀疏增强图并在单次前向传播中完成节点评分，结合洋葱引导搜索，为大规模车辆路径问题快速分离出大量有效舍入容量割。

舍入容量割（RCC）是带容量约束车辆路径问题松弛中最有效的割之一，但在大规模场景下，精确分离的计算代价令人望而却步。现有的启发式和神经分离器虽然速度较快，但在实际分离时间预算内往往难以产生足够多的有效割。我们提出SAG-Sep，一种新型分离器：它通过单次编码器前向传播，从分数LP解中针对不同车辆数量层级对诱导RCC的子集进行节点隶属度评分，从而避免了NeuralSEP类分离器所采用的迭代式“预测-粗化”推理。SAG-Sep将LP解编码为稀疏增强图（SAG），添加由流信息驱动的多跳边，在不稠密化注意力机制的前提下揭示长程路径结构。除了LP感知的稀疏编码之外，我们还观察到高价值的精确RCC通常呈嵌套结构，组织为洋葱状的子集族，而SAG-Sep的节点评分能够追踪子集的嵌套深度……

arXiv:2610.37952v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rounded capacity cuts (RCCs) are among the most effective cuts for capacitated vehicle-routing relaxations, but exact separation is computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing heuristic and neural separators can be fast, but often fail to produce sufficiently many effective cuts within practical separation budgets. We introduce SAG-Sep, a separator that scores node membership in RCC-inducing subsets across vehicle-count levels from a fractional LP solution in a single encoder forward pass, avoiding the iterative predict-and-coarsen inference used by NeuralSEP-style separators. SAG-Sep encodes the LP solution as a Sparse Augmented Graph (SAG), adding flow-informed multi-hop edges that expose long-range routing structure without densifying attention. Beyond LP-aware sparse encoding, we observe that high-value exact RCCs are typically nested, organizing into onion-like subset families, and SAG-Sep's node scores track subset nesting dep

item.title: SkillMem 将可复用技能编码为紧凑的外部潜在记忆，并通过角色条件化交叉注意力读取器与行为蒸馏训练，让潜在多智能体系统以极低的存储成本直接调用技能。
item.description:
SkillMem：面向潜在多智能体推理的紧凑外部技能记忆

SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37935

SkillMem 将可复用技能编码为紧凑的外部潜在记忆，并通过角色条件化交叉注意力读取器与行为蒸馏训练，让潜在多智能体系统以极低的存储成本直接调用技能。

潜在多智能体系统通过将中间推理和智能体间通信保持在连续表示中来降低推理成本。然而，可复用的技能通常以文本形式提供，或存储为逐层的键值状态或特定于技能的模型参数，这会带来重复处理或巨大的按技能存储开销。我们提出 SkillMem，它将每个可复用技能表示为一个小的外部潜在记忆，并使其在潜在多智能体推理过程中可直接使用。一个角色条件化的交叉注意力读取器使同一份记忆能够根据不同智能体的角色和当前隐藏状态对其进行引导。我们通过行为蒸馏来训练技能记忆和共享读取器，即匹配文本技能所引起的token预测变化，同时保持主干模型冻结。在实验中，我们从成对的成功与失败多智能体轨迹中获取文本技能……

arXiv:2610.37935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories,

item.title: 本研究将BERT和逻辑回归用于灾害社交媒体消息的优先级分类并集成到机会路由中，发现尽管BERT的分类准确率更高，但NLP性能提升并未转化为一致的投递率或延迟等网络性能收益。

基于NLP的机会路由消息优先级排序：尼泊尔地震应急通信案例研究

NLP-based Message Prioritisation for Opportunistic Routing: A Case Study of Nepal Earthquake Emergency Communication

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37933

本研究将BERT和逻辑回归用于灾害社交媒体消息的优先级分类并集成到机会路由中，发现尽管BERT的分类准确率更高，但NLP性能提升并未转化为一致的投递率或延迟等网络性能收益。

本论文以2015年尼泊尔地震为案例研究，探讨基于自然语言处理（NLP）的语义消息优先级排序能否改善机会式应急通信中对紧急灾害消息的处理。研究使用TF-IDF结合逻辑回归以及BERT将社交媒体消息分类为九个人道主义类别，这些类别被映射到从P1到P4的四个路由优先级。这些优先级通过改进的Binary Spray and Wait路由器，被集成到ONE模拟器中的受控加德满都地震场景里。实验结果表明，BERT相比逻辑回归实现了更高的优先级分类准确率和P1召回率，同时减少了优先级低估和严重的优先级错误。然而，NLP性能的提升并未带来一致的网络收益。P1消息的投递概率在各种路由条件下均保持较高且相似的水平，也未观察到一致的延迟降低。最明显的差异（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.37933v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This dissertation investigates whether Natural Language Processing (NLP) based semantic message prioritisation can improve the treatment of urgent disaster messages in opportunistic emergency communication, using the 2015 Nepal earthquake as a case study. TF IDF with Logistic Regression and BERT are used to classify social media messages into nine humanitarian categories, which are mapped to four routing priorities from P1 to P4. These priorities are integrated into the ONE simulator within a controlled Kathmandu earthquake scenario using a modified Binary Spray and Wait router. BERT achieves higher priority accuracy and P1 recall than Logistic Regression, while reducing under prioritisation and severe priority errors. However, improved NLP performance does not produce uniform network gains. P1 delivery probability remains high and similar across routing conditions, and no consistent latency reduction is observed. item.title: 本文提出一个区分解质量与执行失败的评估框架，发现大语言模型能够捕捉数学优化问题的结构，即使输出存在数值或格式错误，仍能生成接近最优的数值优化解。
item.description:
理解大语言模型作为数值优化器

Understanding Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37932

本文提出一个区分解质量与执行失败的评估框架，发现大语言模型能够捕捉数学优化问题的结构，即使输出存在数值或格式错误，仍能生成接近最优的数值优化解。

大语言模型（LLMs）已成为数值优化领域的潜在工具。尽管取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但其内在的优化能力和局限性仍然知之甚少，尤其是在高维情况下。本文研究了LLMs利用数学问题结构并生成可行、接近最优解的能力。我们开发了一个评估框架，将解的质量与执行失败（包括数值不准确、约束违反和输出格式错误）区分开来。使用来自凸优化、分式规划和约束投影的代表性问题，我们在不同维度上将LLM性能与确定性参考求解器进行比较评估。我们的结果表明，即使LLM的输出未能满足数值或格式要求，它们仍能捕捉有用的优化结构并产生接近最优的解。然而，其可靠性……

arXiv:2610.37932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as potential tools for numerical optimization. Despite promising results, their intrinsic optimization capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood, particularly in high dimensions. This paper investigates the ability of LLMs to exploit mathematical problem structures and generate feasible, near-optimal solutions. We develop an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, including numerical inaccuracies, constraint violations, and output-format errors. Using representative problems from convex optimization, fractional programming, and constrained projection, we assess LLM performance against deterministic reference solvers across different dimensions. Our results reveal that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal solutions, even when their outputs fail to satisfy numerical or formatting requirements. item.title: GARDEN提出利用大语言模型针对一组相关场景开发通用奖励程序，并可将其原封不动地迁移到设计时未见的场景，从而实现协作多智能体强化学习中奖励函数的跨环境复用。
item.description:
GARDEN：通过证据导航实现协作多智能体强化学习的通用自主奖励设计

GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37926

GARDEN提出利用大语言模型针对一组相关场景开发通用奖励程序，并可将其原封不动地迁移到设计时未见的场景，从而实现协作多智能体强化学习中奖励函数的跨环境复用。

协作多智能体强化学习（MARL）使机器人、自动驾驶车辆等智能体团队能够学习协调行为，但这些团队学到什么在很大程度上取决于其奖励函数。由于仅靠任务成功提供的引导信息太少，中间奖励通常需要人工设计，而且每当环境或团队发生变化时，这项工作往往需要重复进行。大语言模型（LLM）可以通过将奖励函数编写为代码来自动化这一工作，但由此产生的奖励通常只在单一环境中设计和测试。为了使这些奖励能够跨环境复用，本文提出了GARDEN（通过证据导航实现通用自主奖励设计），其中一个奖励程序针对一组相关场景开发，并可原封不动地迁移到设计时不可用的场景中。在开发过程中，环境代码、训练记录和智能体……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.37926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. item.title: VerifiedLab 提出了一个多智能体框架，通过分工明确的 AI 科学家团队（规划、证据计算、起草、审核）对逐字段验证的研究记录进行推理，将研究成果从被动的知识产物转变为可主动加速下游使用、采纳与未来趋势预测的主动系统。
item.description:
VerifiedLab：以已知驾驭未知

VerifiedLab: Harnessing Knowns for Unknowns

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37923

VerifiedLab 提出了一个多智能体框架，通过分工明确的 AI 科学家团队（规划、证据计算、起草、审核）对逐字段验证的研究记录进行推理，将研究成果从被动的知识产物转变为可主动加速下游使用、采纳与未来趋势预测的主动系统。

纵观人类历史，知识经历了多次转变：从口述到文字，再到数字档案。在每一次转变中，人类都建立了新的惯例来为新时代保存知识。如今，随着研究智能体越来越多地被部署于实验室实验，知识正在跨越另一道边界：从为人类书写的记录转向为机器书写的记录。在本工作中，我们提出了 VerifiedLab，一个面向知识从人类向机器转变的多智能体框架。VerifiedLab 将研究成果从被动的产物转变为能够加速下游使用、采纳以及预测未来趋势的主动系统。在 VerifiedLab 中，一支由具有不同角色的 AI 科学家组成的团队对逐字段验证过的记录进行推理：首席研究员负责规划，图书管理员直接从记录中计算证据，领域专家负责起草，而一个门控和一个评论者则对照实测数据核查每一条论断……

arXiv:2610.37923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Across human history, knowledge has undergone several transitions, from orality to writing and then to digital archives. At each transition, humans established new conventions to preserve knowledge for the new era. Nowadays, as research agents are increasingly deployed for laboratory experiments, knowledge is crossing another boundary: from records written for humans to those for machines. In this work, we introduce VerifiedLab, a multi-agent harness framework for this human-to-machine transition of knowledge. VerifiedLab transforms research output from passive artifacts into active systems that accelerate downstream use, adoption and prediction of future trends. In VerifiedLab, a team of AI scientists with distinct roles reasons over records verified field by field: a principal investigator plans, a librarian computes the evidence directly from the records, specialists draft, and a gate and a critic check each claim against the measured

item.title: SciGame 是一个受控科学发现基准，通过将科学文献转化为包含“原始-反事实”环境对的结构化科学卡片，并结合历史与时间集合、多种任务设置与评估协议，实现了对大语言模型智能体科学发现能力中先验知识与经验证据的严格分离评估。
item.description:
SciGame：让智能体在真实与反事实世界中游玩科学发现游戏

SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37919

SciGame 是一个受控科学发现基准，通过将科学文献转化为包含“原始-反事实”环境对的结构化科学卡片，并结合历史与时间集合、多种任务设置与评估协议，实现了对大语言模型智能体科学发现能力中先验知识与经验证据的严格分离评估。

大语言模型智能体正越来越多地被用于科学发现。然而，现有的基准测试将定律推理与编程混合在一起，用分数来衡量数据拟合而非对未见输入的预测能力，并且未能将经验证据与预训练先验区分开来。我们提出了 SciGame，这是一个受控基准，它将科学文献转换为结构化的科学卡片。每张卡片生成一对具有相同任务界面的“原始”环境与维度一致的“反事实”环境。SciGame 包含一个由经典定律组成的“历史”集合，以及一个从模型知识截止日期之后发表的论文中精选的实时“时间”集合。该基准在候选引导的“辨识”和开放式“发现”两种设置下评估智能体，且每种设置均在“仅先验”、“固定”和“自适应”三种协议下运行。在五个前沿模型上的实验得出了三个发现：第一，一旦支配关系被改变，熟悉的先验反而会损害性能……

arXiv:2610.37919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols. item.title: 该论文通过对基于 2025 年 BEHAVIOR 挑战赛冠军微调的 π₀.₅ 模型在 BEHAVIOR-1K 全部 100 个任务上进行系统性配对评估，揭示了以往在小规模场景中有效的推理与数据收集策略并不能一致地泛化到大规模多样化任务环境中。
item.description:
什么才是真正重要的？π₀.₅ 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上推理设置的配对评估

What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $\pi_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37917

该论文通过对基于 2025 年 BEHAVIOR 挑战赛冠军微调的 π₀.₅ 模型在 BEHAVIOR-1K 全部 100 个任务上进行系统性配对评估，揭示了以往在小规模场景中有效的推理与数据收集策略并不能一致地泛化到大规模多样化任务环境中。

视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为通用家庭机器人提供了一个有前景的范式。然而，在较小规模环境中部署的推理和数据收集策略不一定能泛化到大规模、多样化的任务套件中。为弥补这一空白，我们对先前提出的推理和数据收集策略在全部 100 个任务上进行了系统性的配对评估。我们的评估使用基于 2025 年 BEHAVIOR 挑战赛冠军方案微调的 π₀.₅ 模型，该模型在公开测试集上达到了 0.39 的 Q 分数。这些结果表明，所提出的策略并不能一致地迁移到新的环境和任务中。

arXiv:2610.37917v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: https://rubenhammele.github.io/behavior2026

item.title: TERRA 提出一种边缘AI框架，通过无身份的区域标记报告和排列不变的区域证据聚合，将分布式火灾监测的重心从恢复单设备测量转向识别火灾发生的区域。
item.description:
TERRA：面向任务的无身份报告区域火灾检测边缘人工智能

TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37909

TERRA 提出一种边缘AI框架，通过无身份的区域标记报告和排列不变的区域证据聚合，将分布式火灾监测的重心从恢复单设备测量转向识别火灾发生的区域。

分布式火灾监控系统可能涉及大量传感设备通过共享上行链路进行报告，而实际运营目标往往是识别出现火灾证据的区域，而非恢复每个设备的具体测量值。我们提出了 TERRA（Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation，任务导向的边缘表示与区域聚合），这是一个边缘人工智能框架，结合了面向任务的本地推理、无身份的区域标记报告以及排列不变的区域证据聚合。TERRA 支持两种报告模式：TERRA-Score，每个设备传输量化的本地火灾概率；以及 TERRA-Feature，设备传输紧凑的学习表示，供接收端使用排列不变的 DeepSets 模型进行聚合。我们以分布式室内 EN54 火灾报警数据集的全部 15 种数值传感模态作为概念验证测试平台，评估了针对事件级火灾场景的区域推理性能。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.37909v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. item.title: 提出HRF-Res液体状态机，用具有内在振荡特性的谐波共振发放（HRF）神经元替代LIF神经元，使脉冲储备池能够选择性响应不同输入频率，在不牺牲能效的前提下实现更具判别性的表示和更高的分类精度。
item.description:
超越低通动力学：基于共振神经元的频率选择性脉冲储备池

Beyond Low-Pass Dynamics: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37906

提出HRF-Res液体状态机，用具有内在振荡特性的谐波共振发放（HRF）神经元替代LIF神经元，使脉冲储备池能够选择性响应不同输入频率，在不牺牲能效的前提下实现更具判别性的表示和更高的分类精度。

脉冲储备池计算结合了固定循环储备池的训练效率与事件驱动推理的能效优势，其中计算由稀疏的脉冲触发，而非在每个时间步进行密集执行。然而，现有的脉冲储备池几乎完全依赖泄漏积分发放（LIF）神经元，其低通动力学特性限制了区分不同时间频率所编码信息的能力。我们提出了HRF-Res，一种液体状态机，其中LIF神经元被谐波共振发放（HRF）神经元的异构群体所取代。这些神经元表现出内在的振荡动力学特性，并选择性地响应输入频率，使储备池能够捕获特定频率的时间模式。由此获得了比基于LIF的储备池更具判别性的表示和更高的分类精度，同时不牺牲脉冲计算的能效。

arXiv:2610.37906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs almost exclusively rely on Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons, whose low-pass dynamics limit their ability to distinguish information encoded at different temporal frequencies. We introduce HRF-Res, a liquid state machine in which LIF neurons are replaced by a heterogeneous population of Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons. These neurons exhibit intrinsic oscillatory dynamics and selectively respond to input frequencies, enabling the reservoir to capture frequency-specific temporal patterns. item.title: 提出了FilingLoop——一个基于SEC历史审查函件构建的交互式基准与自进化智能体框架，用于评估并持续进化大语言模型智能体在公司信息披露审查与修订任务中的能力。
item.description:
FilingLoop：用于公司信息披露审查与修订的大语言模型智能体评估与进化

FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37905

提出了FilingLoop——一个基于SEC历史审查函件构建的交互式基准与自进化智能体框架，用于评估并持续进化大语言模型智能体在公司信息披露审查与修订任务中的能力。

诸如SEC EDGAR之类的公开信息披露存储库通过网页访问公司申报文件来支持知情投资决策。利用语言模型智能体辅助此类审查工作，需要能够在相关文件中发现未明确指出的缺陷、获取缺失的公司事实，并验证所要求的修订满足有证据支撑的要求。然而，现有的金融问答类评估对这类交互能力的检验十分有限。我们提出了FilingLoop——一个面向公司信息披露审查与修订的交互式基准测试和自进化智能体框架。该框架以美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的历史审查往来函件为基础，在 distinct 的信息约束条件下，从96家公司中重建了380个以IPO审查为主的任务。一个独立于执行智能体的评估器依据6,099项合格要求对最终申报文件和回复进行评分，并审计缺乏依据的声明及有害

arXiv:2610.37905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. item.title: Metis-1.6 由一位研究者从零构建，采用对每个 token 运行两次混合 Mamba-2 与注意力专家模型堆栈的“三思而行”架构，仅用约对比模型中位数十二分之一的训练数据，就达到了接近 Qwen3-4B 的性能水平。
item.description:
三思而行：Metis-1.6 技术报告

Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37903

Metis-1.6 由一位研究者从零构建，采用对每个 token 运行两次混合 Mamba-2 与注意力专家模型堆栈的“三思而行”架构，仅用约对比模型中位数十二分之一的训练数据，就达到了接近 Qwen3-4B 的性能水平。

Metis 是一场赌注：更好的数据、更好的训练方法和新的架构，能以极小的成本获得更大参数量也换不来的效果。Metis-1.6 是这一努力的最新一步：由一位研究者从零构建的两个语言模型——Praxis（29.4 亿参数，每次前向传播激活 4.6 亿参数）和 Logos（102.3 亿参数，每次前向传播激活 11.8 亿参数）。两者都对每个 token 运行两次 Mamba-2 与注意力机制的混合专家模型堆栈，因此每个 token 都能被“再看一遍”。每个模型总共使用了 1.02 万亿个 token 进行训练：其中 8047.6 亿用于预训练，180 亿用于将上下文扩展至 131,072 个 token，2000 亿用于有监督微调。Metis-1.6 从未打算挑战前沿模型，在 40 个后训练基准测试中，它大多确实没有做到：Logos 平均得分为 52.93，在其对比集合的 17 个模型中排名第七，与 Qwen3-4B 的差距在一分以内。但它是在大约只有公开数据的对比模型训练数据中位数十二分之一的条件下达到这一水平的，而且用了更少的……（原文摘要此处截断）

arXiv:2610.37903v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer ac

item.title: 本文开发了一个六模块的代理技能扫描器，首次同时检测良性技能中的非故意漏洞与多技能组合交互带来的安全风险，在多项基准测试上以 95.90% 的召回率、4.22% 的误报率和 0.947 的 F1 分数超越了现有扫描工具。
item.description:
安装前先扫描：检测与缓解技能中的本地及组合漏洞

Scan Before You Install: Detecting and Mitigating Local and Composite Vulnerabilities in Skills

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37901

本文开发了一个六模块的代理技能扫描器，首次同时检测良性技能中的非故意漏洞与多技能组合交互带来的安全风险，在多项基准测试上以 95.90% 的召回率、4.22% 的误报率和 0.947 的 F1 分数超越了现有扫描工具。

代理技能将自然语言指令、脚本和参考文件打包在一起，供基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理在执行任务时加载。技能可在用户授权的权限下访问文件系统、shell 和网络；其中的弱点可能导致不安全的执行。现有扫描器主要针对恶意技能，而非公共代码库中非故意的漏洞，且都是孤立地分析技能，忽略了多技能之间的交互。为弥补这些不足，我们开发了一个包含六个模块的扫描器：内容提取、本地分析、组合分析、验证、报告和缓解。本地分析用于检测良性技能中非故意的漏洞。在 SkillTrustBench 的 556 个用例排行榜子集上，该工具达到了 95.90% 的召回率和 4.22% 的误报率；在从 MalSkillBench 抽取的 1,000 个技能的均衡样本上，其 F1 分数为 0.947，优于 Cisco 的 Skill Scanner、NVIDIA 的 SkillSpector、AgentSkillsScanner 和 SkillSieve。在 1,587 个技能中……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2610.37901v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An agent skill packages natural-language instructions, scripts, and reference files that an LLM-based agent loads for a task. Skills may access the file system, shell, and network under user-authorized permissions; weaknesses can lead to unsafe execution. Existing scanners primarily target malicious skills, not unintended vulnerabilities in public repositories, and analyze skills in isolation, overlooking multi-skill interactions. To address these gaps, we developed a six-module scanner: Content Extraction, Local Analysis, Composite Analysis, Validation, Reporting, and Mitigation. Local Analysis detects unintended vulnerabilities in benign skills. On a 556-case leaderboard subset of SkillTrustBench, it achieved 95.90% recall with a 4.22% false positive rate; on a balanced sample of 1,000 MalSkillBench skills, its F1 was 0.947, outperforming Cisco's Skill Scanner, NVIDIA's SkillSpector, AgentSkillsScanner, and SkillSieve. In 1,587 skill

item.title: 本文系统分析了社会人口统计信息在大语言模型多元化冒犯性建模中的作用，发现其对个体预测的增益小且不稳定，但在群体和总体层面更为明显，并揭示了显式推理在有效利用人口统计信息中的关键角色。
item.description:
多元化冒犯性建模中社会人口统计特征的剖析：它在何时何地有所帮助，以及推理的作用

The Anatomy of Socio-Demographics in Pluralistic Offensiveness Modeling: When and Where It Helps, and the Role of Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37896

本文系统分析了社会人口统计信息在大语言模型多元化冒犯性建模中的作用，发现其对个体预测的增益小且不稳定，但在群体和总体层面更为明显，并揭示了显式推理在有效利用人口统计信息中的关键角色。

诸如冒犯性之类的主观判断在个体之间往往存在显著差异，这促使多元化建模方法纳入标注者的社会人口统计信息以捕捉这种差异。然而，关于社会人口统计信息对多元化建模益处的先前研究结果并不一致，因此需要对其有效性及其改进预测的机制进行系统性分析。在本工作中，我们研究了社会人口统计特征在何时以及何处有益于多元化冒犯性建模，以及显式推理在利用这一信息中所起的作用。在三个多标注者数据集上，通过使用提示式和训练式的大语言模型，我们首先表明，人口统计信息对个体预测的增益小且不一致，但在群体和总体层面变得更加明显，因为聚合减弱了掩盖小而系统性差异的个体特有变异……

arXiv:2610.37896v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Subjective judgments such as offensiveness often vary substantially across individuals, motivating pluralistic modeling approaches that incorporate annotators' socio-demographic information to capture this variation. However, prior findings on the benefits of socio-demographic information for pluralistic modeling are mixed, calling for a systematic analysis of both its effectiveness and the mechanisms through which it improves prediction. In this work, we study $\textbf{when}$ and $\textbf{where}$ socio-demographics benefit pluralistic offensiveness modeling, as well as $\textbf{the role of explicit reasoning}$ in leveraging this information. Across three multi-annotator datasets with prompted and trained LLMs, we first show that demographic gains are small and inconsistent for individual predictions but become clearer at the group and population levels, because aggregation attenuates the idiosyncratic variation that masks small but syst

item.title: 该论文通过 PushT 基准实验发现，在世界模型中增加规划更新次数并不能挽救失败任务、甚至可能有害，而一个仅含约 1.5 千参数的轻量学习型动作更新器能以更少的时间取得与传统搜索规划器相当甚至更优的表现。
item.description:
当更多规划反而有害时：面向世界模型的学习型规划器

When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37891

该论文通过 PushT 基准实验发现，在世界模型中增加规划更新次数并不能挽救失败任务、甚至可能有害，而一个仅含约 1.5 千参数的轻量学习型动作更新器能以更少的时间取得与传统搜索规划器相当甚至更优的表现。

在 PushT 任务上，我们的固定动作更新器（仅 1,505 个参数）解决了从配置选择中保留的 16 个场景中的 8 个。对比规划器的表现如下：Selected Adam（解决 7 个任务，总规划与编码时间为 218.440 秒）、adapted iCEM（解决 2 个任务，总规划与编码时间为 49.309 秒）、released LePlanner（解决 16 个任务，总规划与编码时间为 5.652 秒）。我们的动作更新器的总规划与编码时间为 59.079 秒。需要指出的是，我们的动作更新器并不满足我们在评估前设定的任务-成本准则。我们还进行了另一个匹配实验：仅回放每个情境中的前十条指令，随后允许求解分别进行 4、8 或 12 次更新（后续所有求解均进行 8 次更新）。在全部 16 个情境（8 个场景簇）中，这 3 种更新预算分别取得 9、8 和 7 次成功。有趣的是，在该实验中，额外的更新次数并未挽救任何失败的任务。

arXiv:2610.37891v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before evaluation. We also conduct another matched experiment where we only replay the first ten commands in each context and then allow the next solve 4, 8 or 12 updates (subsequent solves all get 8 updates). Among all 16 contexts (8 scene clusters), the 3 budgets get 9, 8 and 7 successes, respectively. Interestingly, the extra updates did not rescue any failing task in this experiment. All the changes i

item.title: 该论文提出“验证学习理论”（VLT）这一过程模型，将AI助手的感知可靠性与用户核查证据的行为、以及核查历史与规则知识的保持联系起来，并预测即使没有观察到AI实际犯错，仅感知到AI可能出错也能通过促进核查来提升延迟的独立判断能力，但若核查已被强制执行则该优势消失。
item.description:
验证学习理论：AI辅助判断中核查与保持的过程模型

Verification Learning Theory: A Process Model of Checking and Retention in AI-Assisted Judgment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37875

该论文提出“验证学习理论”（VLT）这一过程模型，将AI助手的感知可靠性与用户核查证据的行为、以及核查历史与规则知识的保持联系起来，并预测即使没有观察到AI实际犯错，仅感知到AI可能出错也能通过促进核查来提升延迟的独立判断能力，但若核查已被强制执行则该优势消失。

准确的AI辅助能够改善即时判断，同时却减少了练习独立完成任务所需操作的机会。验证学习理论（Verification Learning Theory, VLT）针对“论断评估练习，随后获得正确、独立且针对特定规则的反馈”这一场景，对上述可能性进行了形式化建模。该模型将用户感知到的助手可靠性与其对证据的核查行为联系起来，并将核查历史与被保持下来的规则使用联系起来。其严格形式假设：任务要求和感知可靠性只能通过核查来影响学习，且每次真实核查带来的学习量相等。因此，该理论预测：即使没有观察到助手犯错，仅仅感知到助手“可能出错”也能改善延迟的独立判断；而当核查本来就被要求并且已经执行时，这一优势便会消失。针对特定规则的收益以及基于核查历史的预测为进一步检验提供了途径。仿真分析了这些核心承诺的后果及其对参数的依赖性。

arXiv:2610.37875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing opportunities to practise the operations needed for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalises this possibility for claim-evaluation practice followed by correct, independent, rule-specific feedback. The model links perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and links the history of those checks to retained rule use. Its strict form assumes that task demands and perceived reliability influence learning only through checking, with equal learning per genuine check. It therefore predicts that perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors, and that this advantage disappears when checking is already required and performed. Rule-specific gains and forecasts from checking histories provide further tests. Simulations examine the consequences and parameter dependence of these commitments;

item.title: 该论文提出PairCLIP-SWA，通过CLIP相似度引导的类别均衡采样与对微调轨迹的随机权重平均（SWA）来适配OpenCLIP ViT-L/14，以单骨干检测器在IEEE SP Cup 2025深度伪造检测基准上取得97.04%准确率和4.07%等错误率，超越了三骨干集成模型。
item.description:
PairCLIP-SWA：基于OpenCLIP的相似度引导均衡采样与随机权重平均用于泛化性深度伪造图像检测

PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37874

该论文提出PairCLIP-SWA，通过CLIP相似度引导的类别均衡采样与对微调轨迹的随机权重平均（SWA）来适配OpenCLIP ViT-L/14，以单骨干检测器在IEEE SP Cup 2025深度伪造检测基准上取得97.04%准确率和4.07%等错误率，超越了三骨干集成模型。

深度伪造检测器几乎总是以在验证集上得分最高的单一检查点形式部署，然而这一选择的可靠性却很少被衡量。我们通过PairCLIP-SWA来衡量这一可靠性，这是一种单骨干检测器，它在由CLIP相似度引导的一对一子采样构建的类别均衡语料库上，通过渐进式块解冻来适配OpenCLIP ViT-L/14视觉塔，并在权重空间中对微调轨迹进行平均。在与已发表的最强三骨干集成模型相同的协议下，在IEEE SP Cup 2025（DF-Wild-Cup）基准上进行域内训练后，权重平均后的检测器达到97.04%的准确率、98.64%的AU-ROC和4.07%的等错误率，而基线模型分别为94.46%、97.60%和5.00%。其训练日志显示了权重平均之所以重要的原因：在被平均的各轮训练中，未平均的检查点在验证准确率上波动达5.34个百分点，其验证损失更翻了一倍多，而平均值的表现从不更差，并且……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.37874v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. We measure it with PairCLIP-SWA, a single-backbone detector that adapts an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 visual tower by progressive block unfreezing on a class-balanced corpus built by CLIP-similarity-guided one-to-one subsampling, and averages the fine-tuning trajectory in weight space. Trained in-domain on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 (DF-Wild-Cup) benchmark under the same protocol as the strongest published three-backbone ensemble, the weight-averaged detector reaches 97.04% accuracy, 98.64% AU-ROC and a 4.07% equal error rate, against 94.46%, 97.60% and 5.00%. item.title: 该研究超越以身份保持为导向的传统评估，利用七种预训练视觉表示在印度菜系上系统分析食物相似性检索，揭示不同表示如何组织并揭示（或掩盖）烹饪家族层面的关系结构。
item.description:
什么是食物相似性？印度菜系中的视觉表示与检索

What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37867

该研究超越以身份保持为导向的传统评估，利用七种预训练视觉表示在印度菜系上系统分析食物相似性检索，揭示不同表示如何组织并揭示（或掩盖）烹饪家族层面的关系结构。

食物相似性是检索、推荐、替换及其他食物计算任务的基础，然而食物表示通常仅通过身份保持（identity preservation）来评估。我们探讨超越身份的食物相似性：不同的视觉表示如何将食物组织成关系邻域，这些邻域揭示或掩盖了哪些烹饪关系，以及这些结构在不同表示之间出现得有多一致。印度菜系提供了一个具有挑战性的场景：视觉上相似的食物可能具有不同的烹饪身份，而同一烹饪家族内的食物在外观上可能差异很大。我们使用扩展的Khana数据集和七个预训练视觉表示（涵盖卷积模型、基于Transformer的模型、自监督模型以及图像-文本对齐模型），评估图像到图像的检索和图像到菜品的邻域，考察烹饪家族结构、对比案例以及跨表示（的一致性）……

arXiv:2610.37867v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-represent

item.title: Echo提出了一种单阶段离线策略强化学习框架，通过逆向蒸馏让基于状态的辅助策略收集无需渲染的低成本经验，从而在不成比例增加视觉计算量的情况下扩展视觉强化学习的经验收集，并借助共享的特权评论家直接改进视觉策略。
item.description:
Echo：利用离线策略经验扩展视觉强化学习

Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37865

Echo提出了一种单阶段离线策略强化学习框架，通过逆向蒸馏让基于状态的辅助策略收集无需渲染的低成本经验，从而在不成比例增加视觉计算量的情况下扩展视觉强化学习的经验收集，并借助共享的特权评论家直接改进视觉策略。

由于渲染和视觉策略推理的开销，使用GPU加速仿真来扩展视觉强化学习（RL）的计算成本十分高昂。因此，两阶段的师生蒸馏方法通常被用于训练视觉策略，但这会引入模仿差距。在这项初步研究中，我们提出了Echo方法，这是一个单阶段的离线策略强化学习框架，能够在不成比例增加视觉计算量的情况下扩展经验收集。通过逆向蒸馏，一个基于状态的辅助策略模仿不断演化的视觉策略，并收集低成本的、无需渲染的经验。Echo利用这些经验进行离线价值学习，通过共享的特权评论家直接改进视觉策略。我们使用FastTD3实例化Echo，并在Genesis仿真环境中通过三个视觉控制任务和两个灵巧手操作任务对其进行评估。相对于在评估条件下的SDPG方法……

arXiv:2610.37865v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scaling visual reinforcement learning (RL) with GPU-accelerated simulation is computationally expensive due to rendering and visual-policy inference costs. Consequently, two-stage teacher--student distillation is commonly used to train visual policies, but introduces an imitation gap. In this preliminary study, we introduce \echomethod{}, \textbf{a single-stage off-policy RL framework that scales experience collection without proportionally increasing visual computation}. Through \textbf{inverse distillation}, a state-based auxiliary policy imitates the evolving visual policy and collects inexpensive, unrendered experience. Echo leverages this experience for off-policy value learning, directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic. We instantiate \echomethod{} with FastTD3 and evaluate it on three visual control tasks and two dexterous manipulation tasks in Genesis. Relative to \sdpgmethod{} under the evaluated

item.title: 该论文提出了Seq@K评估协议，用于衡量语言模型在K次顺序尝试中利用失败反馈迭代改进并最终解决问题的能力，揭示了与Pass@K截然不同的模型排名格局。
item.description:
Seq@K：在序列反馈下评估语言模型

Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37859

该论文提出了Seq@K评估协议，用于衡量语言模型在K次顺序尝试中利用失败反馈迭代改进并最终解决问题的能力，揭示了与Pass@K截然不同的模型排名格局。

语言模型智能体与以往的智能系统有着根本性的不同，它们能够从上下文中的自然语言进行学习。这一能力使智能体能够根据反馈迭代地改进其答案，这是现代智能体工作流程中一种普遍的运行模式。然而，社区目前主要通过Pass@1或Pass@K等指标对模型进行排名，这些指标无法捕捉模型如何利用先前尝试的反馈。我们提出了Seq@K，这是一种自然的评估协议，用于衡量模型能否在K次顺序尝试内解决问题，并在每次失败后提供反馈。与考察长程规划的多轮智能体基准不同，Seq@K分离并形式化了“从反馈中改进”这一核心能力。我们在7个基准测试和16个前沿模型上对Seq@K进行了评估，结果表明Seq@K揭示了一个实质性不同的模型选择格局：在Seq@K下，(1) 模型排名往往有所不同

arXiv:2610.37859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often dif

item.title: 该论文提出了LibStructBench——一个基于文档的基准测试，用于评估AI智能体精确重构测序方案所规定的分子结构和工作流程的能力，发现前沿智能体虽能实现大致正确的重构，但在精确重构（尤其是分子状态表示和工作流程连通性）方面仍不可靠。
item.description:
评估与改进用于测序方案理解的AI智能体

Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37851

该论文提出了LibStructBench——一个基于文档的基准测试，用于评估AI智能体精确重构测序方案所规定的分子结构和工作流程的能力，发现前沿智能体虽能实现大致正确的重构，但在精确重构（尤其是分子状态表示和工作流程连通性）方面仍不可靠。

现有的科学智能体基准测试很少评估智能体能否精确重构测序方案所规定的分子结构和生成工作流程，而这一能力对于分析定制化测序实验至关重要。我们提出了LibStructBench，一个基于文档的基准测试，用于重构测序文库结构和分子工作流程。我们的实验表明，前沿智能体通常能产生大致正确的重构结果，但在精确重构方面仍不可靠，尤其是在分子状态表示和工作流程连通性方面。更换底层语言模型比更换智能体框架产生了更大的平均性能差异，且仅在分子状态重构方面存在统计学显著差异。在小规模试点中，额外的知识提高了寡核苷酸家族的恢复率，但没有提高平均分子工作流程得分。自主积累程序性……

arXiv:2610.37851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows. Our experiments show that frontier agents often produce approximately correct reconstructions but remain unreliable at exact reconstruction, particularly in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity. Switching the underlying language model produced larger average performance differences than switching agent harnesses, with a statistically significant difference only for molecular-state reconstruction. Additional knowledge improved oligo-family recovery in a small pilot without improving mean molecular-workflow scores. Autonomous accumulation of procedural

item.title: 本文提出PoPLi行为测试方法，通过比较真实伙伴与无关智能体在消息改写后行为变化程度的差异，能够检测出仅凭消息内容监控无法发现的AI智能体间隐蔽暗码合谋。
item.description:
通过“伙伴-局外人正向聆听”检测AI智能体之间的隐蔽合谋

Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37849

本文提出PoPLi行为测试方法，通过比较真实伙伴与无关智能体在消息改写后行为变化程度的差异，能够检测出仅凭消息内容监控无法发现的AI智能体间隐蔽暗码合谋。

共享某种秘密约定的AI智能体可以通过看似无害的消息进行协调，因此仅读取消息内容的监控者可能会漏掉它们。我们提出一种行为测试：使用暗码的伙伴会对消息的确切措辞做出反应，而处于其位置的无关智能体则不会。“伙伴-局外人正向聆听”（PoPLi）衡量的是当消息在保持含义不变的情况下被改写时，两个智能体行动变化程度的差异，该方法在事后通过回放记录的提示来计算。在一个包含五种条件的模拟市场中（无合谋、带有中性消息的联合奖励、同样情况但公开声明意图、隐蔽的首字母暗码、以及带有声明意图的暗码），只要暗码存在，PoPLi就介于0.48到0.59之间（95%置信区间均高于0.29），而在没有暗码时则介于-0.10到-0.01之间。仅基于消息的监控器无法区分这些条件……

arXiv:2610.37849v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. item.title: 本文研究了机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量预测误差在谱域中的分布规律，指出逐元素误差无法保证特征值和特征向量的准确性，并论证了现有波函数对齐损失与电子密度匹配两类物理约束方法均不完备。
item.description:
误差存在于何处：学习型Kohn-Sham哈密顿量的谱表示

Where the Error Lives: Spectral Representations of Learned Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37843

本文研究了机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量预测误差在谱域中的分布规律，指出逐元素误差无法保证特征值和特征向量的准确性，并论证了现有波函数对齐损失与电子密度匹配两类物理约束方法均不完备。

Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（DFT）是计算分子和材料电子结构的标准方法，但其自洽场（SCF）迭代使得大体系和高通量筛选的计算代价高昂。机器学习哈密顿量模型提供了一条捷径：等变神经网络通过一次前向传播即可预测Kohn-Sham哈密顿量矩阵，对该预测矩阵进行对角化便可得到轨道能量、HOMO-LUMO间隙、分子轨道和电子密度。这些模型通常通过逐元素匹配参考矩阵进行训练，然而较小的逐元素误差并不能保证特征值或特征向量的准确性。两种基于物理信息的替代方法只能部分解决该问题：近期提出的波函数对齐损失在不显式对角化预测矩阵的情况下引入了谱惩罚，而匹配对角化后预测的电子密度则提供了直接的监督信号。但两者都不够完整：通过表示……

arXiv:2610.37843v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) is the standard method for computing the electronic structure of molecules and materials, but its self-consistent-field (SCF) iterations make it expensive for large systems and high-throughput screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonian models offer a shortcut: an equivariant network predicts the Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian matrix in one forward pass, and diagonalizing the prediction yields orbital energies, the HOMO-LUMO gap, molecular orbitals and the electron density. These models are trained to match the reference matrix entry by entry, yet a small entry-wise error does not guarantee accurate eigenvalues or eigenvectors. Two physics-informed alternatives go partway: a recently proposed wavefunction-alignment loss adds a spectral penalty without diagonalizing the prediction, and matching the electron density of the diagonalized prediction supervises it directly. item.title: 该论文提出一种基于执行对比的智能合约评估方法，通过在AI生成的合约与原始合约上重放相同交易来度量用户意图丢失的程度，发现AI裁判等常见评分方法会漏掉明显的错误。
item.description:
度量智能体式智能合约合成中意图在何处丢失

Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37830

该论文提出一种基于执行对比的智能合约评估方法，通过在AI生成的合约与原始合约上重放相同交易来度量用户意图丢失的程度，发现AI裁判等常见评分方法会漏掉明显的错误。

AI智能体现在可以根据纯英文描述编写软件，但能够运行的代码并不等于能完成预期任务的代码。这一差距对智能合约最为关键——智能合约是Web3应用背后的程序，在区块链上转移资金，且一旦部署就无法修复。我们要探讨的是：如何检验AI编写的合约是否按预期运行，以及所请求的行为在何处丢失。我们设计了一套基于执行而非主观判断的评估方法。我们在AI编写的合约和它应当复现的原始合约上重放相同的交易，并测量两者的一致频率。我们在植入的错误上测试每一个评分工具，与不依赖原始描述编写的标准答案进行对比，并审计我们自己的评分器，直到已知的错误答案无法通过评估。常见方法，如AI裁判和标准分析工具，会漏掉明显的错误，评分方式的选择同样重要。仅检查所有系统都包含的函数会隐藏大约……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.37830v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents can now write software from a plain-English description, but code that runs is not the same as code that does what was asked. This gap matters most for smart contracts, the programs behind Web3 applications that move money on a blockchain and cannot be fixed once deployed. We ask how to check whether an AI-written contract behaves as it should, and where the requested behavior gets lost. We design an evaluation built on execution rather than opinion. We replay the same transactions on an AI-written contract and on the original it should reproduce and measure how often they agree. We test every grading tool on planted mistakes, compare against an answer key written without the description, and audit our own scorer until known wrong answers cannot pass. Common methods, such as AI judges and standard analysis tools, miss obvious mistakes, and scoring choices matter too. Checking only the functions every system includes hid about

item.title: 该论文将部署 AI 系统多个候选版本的混合方案问题建模为在未知半空间偏好下为多个利益相关者选择彩票，通过二元成员查询学习各方接受标准以最小化拒绝的利益相关者数量，并证明该问题即使在偏好完全已知时也是 APX-难的。
item.description:
基于成员查询学习使利益相关者违反数最少的彩票方案

Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37828

该论文将部署 AI 系统多个候选版本的混合方案问题建模为在未知半空间偏好下为多个利益相关者选择彩票，通过二元成员查询学习各方接受标准以最小化拒绝的利益相关者数量，并证明该问题即使在偏好完全已知时也是 APX-难的。

AI 开发者通常拥有一个系统的多个候选版本，并且可以部署它们的混合方案（如同 A/B 测试），将每个请求发送到随机选择的版本。每个利益相关者（例如安全团队、监管机构或拥有私有测试数据的客户）只有在混合方案的期望性能（例如有害回复的比率）满足其自身标准时才接受该方案，而开发者只能通过询问某个提议的混合方案是否可接受来了解这些标准。我们将此问题建模为：为 n 个智能体在 m 个备选项上选择一个彩票（lottery），每个智能体恰好接受位于某个未知半空间内的彩票，并回答此类二元成员查询。虽然 Choo 等人（ICML 2026）寻求每个智能体都接受的彩票，但当例如安全性与有用性要求发生冲突时，这样的彩票可能不存在，因此我们转而最小化拒绝者的数量。我们证明了即使在所有半空间已知且所有效用满足特定条件的情况下，该问题也是 APX-难的。

arXiv:2610.37828v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing. Each stakeholder (e.g., a safety team, a regulator, or a customer with private test data) accepts a mixture exactly when its expected performance (e.g., its rate of harmful replies) meets the stakeholder's own standard, which the developer can learn only by asking whether a proposed mixture is acceptable. We model this as choosing a lottery over $m$ alternatives for $n$ agents, each of whom accepts exactly the lotteries in an unknown halfspace and answers such binary membership queries. While Choo et al. (ICML 2026) sought a lottery that every agent accepts, none may exist when, say, safety and helpfulness requirements conflict, so we minimize the number of rejecting agents. We show that this problem is APX-hard even when all halfspaces are known and all utilities are $

item.title: DeFT-RAG通过增量式地将多跳问题分解为携带可复用答案的自包含子问题，逐步恢复完整的证据链，从而提升RAG在多跳问答任务上的准确性。
item.description:
DeFT-RAG：将多跳问题增量式分解为具有可复用答案的自包含子问题

DeFT-RAG: Incrementally Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37826

DeFT-RAG通过增量式地将多跳问题分解为携带可复用答案的自包含子问题，逐步恢复完整的证据链，从而提升RAG在多跳问答任务上的准确性。

检索增强生成（RAG）使大语言模型（LLM）能够通过从大规模语料库中检索相关文本来回答问题。然而，RAG在处理多跳问题时表现不佳，因为这类问题需要通过问题中从未提及的中间实体，将分散在多个文档中的事实串联起来。基于图的RAG方法只根据问题中提及的实体进行一次检索，因此很少能恢复完整的证据链。迭代式RAG方法虽能逐步恢复证据链，但其准确性受限于要求LLM执行的众多任务，例如规划子问题、确定子问题间的依赖关系、根据已获得的答案改写子问题以及追踪已知信息。我们提出了DeFT-RAG，一个由三个组件构建的RAG框架。首先，DeFT-RAG基于原始问题以及已回答的子问题及其答案（QA对），每次生成一个自包含的子问题。每个子问题命名了……（原文此处截断）

arXiv:2610.37826v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets a large language model (LLM) answer questions by retrieving relevant passages from a large corpus. However, RAG struggles with multi-hop questions, which require chaining facts spread across several documents through intermediate entities that the question never mentions. Graph-based RAG methods retrieve once from the entities a question names and so rarely recover the full evidence chain. Iterative RAG methods recover it step by step, but their accuracy is limited by the many tasks they ask the LLM to perform, such as planning the sub-questions, deciding their dependencies, rewriting them as answers arrive, and keeping track of what is known. We propose DeFT-RAG, a RAG framework built on three components. First, DeFT-RAG generates one self-contained sub-question at a time from the original question and the sub-questions answered so far with their answers (QA pairs). Each sub-question names eve

item.title: 该论文对经典与量子机器学习分类器在医学影像任务中进行了跨敏感子群体的实证公平性审计，发现量子分类器即使总体性能具有竞争力，仍可能存在子群体差异，并评估了均衡几率正则化、梯度反转学习等多种公平性缓解方法的效果。
item.description:
面向医学影像的负责任量子机器学习：跨敏感子群体的公平性审计

Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37819

该论文对经典与量子机器学习分类器在医学影像任务中进行了跨敏感子群体的实证公平性审计，发现量子分类器即使总体性能具有竞争力，仍可能存在子群体差异，并评估了均衡几率正则化、梯度反转学习等多种公平性缓解方法的效果。

量子机器学习（QML）在医学分类中的应用日益受到探索，但其在子群体感知公平性准则下的表现仍缺乏研究。我们对用于医学影像的经典分类器和量子分类器进行了实证公平性审计，并假设量子机器学习并非天生公平。研究评估了两个场景：DDI数据集上的皮肤病变分类（敏感属性：菲茨帕特里克皮肤类型）以及基于CheXpert数据集的胸部X光分类（敏感属性：年龄组）。基于ResNet-18嵌入，我们在基线设置及三种缓解设置下训练了SVM、MLP、QSVM和QCNN，这三种缓解设置为：可微均衡几率（EO）正则化、梯度反转学习（GRL）以及两者结合。基础模型（PanDerm、EVA-X）作为外部参照。量子分类器可能获得具有竞争力的总体性能，但仍表现出子群体间的差异。由于较小的子群体AUC差距可能源于最佳群体性能的下降而非整体公平性的提升（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2610.37819v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities.
