item.title: OpenAttention通过将整个未读尾部压缩为单个计数感知均值代理token，在读取率低至1%时仍能获得比丢弃或采样更低误差的稀疏注意力输出。
item.description:
OpenAttention：用尾部代理，百分之一足矣

OpenAttention: One Percent Is Enough with Tail Proxies

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30951

OpenAttention通过将整个未读尾部压缩为单个计数感知均值代理token，在读取率低至1%时仍能获得比丢弃或采样更低误差的稀疏注意力输出。

arXiv:2610.30951v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：稀疏注意力只读取键值缓存中的一小部分，而如何处理未被读取的尾部仍然是一个关键挑战。直接丢弃尾部会使输出产生偏差，而以往方法采用的尾部采样策略在读取率为5%及以下时会失效，因为此时尾部很可能包含选择器遗漏的重要token。我们的关键观察是，最简单的代理形式——一个将整个尾部折叠为其计数感知均值的token——在实用选择器下的每个读取率上，都能产生比采样更低的输出误差。我们进一步以闭式形式证明，在低读取率下，采样带来的权重误差几乎是丢弃的两倍，而单个代理的误差则始终低于丢弃。基于这些发现，我们探索用少量针对尾部的代理来近似稠密注意力分布。我们提出了OpenAttention，这是一个由聚类、ErrorGate和top-k选择加上计数感知均值代理组成的流水线。为了高效地实现聚类和选择……

arXiv:2610.30951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse attention reads only a small subset of the key-value cache, and how to treat the unread tail remains a key challenge. Discarding the tail biases the output, and sampling it as previous approaches do fails at reads of 5% and below, where the tail likely holds heavy hitters the selector missed. Our key observation is that the simplest possible proxy, one token that folds the entire tail into its count-aware mean, already yields lower output error than a sample at every read behind a practical selector. We further show in closed form that at low reads sampling nearly doubles the weight error of discarding while a single proxy stays below it. Building on these findings, we explore approximating the dense attention distribution with a few proxies that target the tail. We propose OpenAttention, a pipeline of clustering, ErrorGate and top-k selection followed by a count-aware mean proxy. To implement clustering and selection both efficie

item.title: 提出了新型 PII 决策模型 Protegrity-PII，在自建基准 PII-SCOPE 上实现 0.915 召回率和 0.907 精确率，兼具高速低成本推理与卓越的分布外泛化能力。
item.description:
Protegrity-PII 技术报告

Protegrity-PII Technical Report

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30518

提出了新型 PII 决策模型 Protegrity-PII，在自建基准 PII-SCOPE 上实现 0.915 召回率和 0.907 精确率，兼具高速低成本推理与卓越的分布外泛化能力。

我们提出了 Protegrity-PII，一种面向结构化和非结构化文本的新型 PII（个人身份信息）决策模型。在我们提出的新基准 PII-SCOPE 上，Protegrity-PII 实现了 0.915 的类型化召回率和 0.907 的精确率。借助批量推理，该模型在单个 RTX 6000 上以每百万字符 0.49 秒的速度处理文本，成本仅为每百万字符 0.0005 美元。部分得益于训练中使用的实体类型分类体系的广泛性，与一系列最先进的模型和数据集相比，Protegrity-PII 展现出卓越的分布外泛化能力。

arXiv:2610.30518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present Protegrity-PII, a new PII decision model for structured and unstructured text. Protegrity-PII achieves a typed recall of 0.915 with a precision of 0.907 on a new benchmark we propose, PII-SCOPE. Our model processes text in 0.49 seconds per million characters at \$0.0005 per million characters on a single RTX 6000 using batched inference. Due in part to the expansive nature of the entity type taxonomy used in training, Protegrity-PII achieves superior out-of-distribution generalization when benchmarked against a selection of state of the art models and datasets.

item.title: 提出了ARCANA基准，通过要求从现实世界物体或物理现象到抽象网格变换的远类比映射来测试抽象与类比推理能力，人类可以可靠地解决这些任务，但大语言模型的表现与人类存在明显差距。
item.description:
ARCANA：抽象与类比推理基准

ARCANA: A Benchmark for Abstraction and Analogical Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29271

提出了ARCANA基准，通过要求从现实世界物体或物理现象到抽象网格变换的远类比映射来测试抽象与类比推理能力，人类可以可靠地解决这些任务，但大语言模型的表现与人类存在明显差距。

类比推理被广泛认为是人类智能的基本组成部分。然而，很少有基准测试专门用于测试远类比推理——即在表面上不相似、但在深层次关系或结构上相似的领域之间进行的推理。在本工作中，我们引入了一个名为ARCANA（抽象与类比推理语料库，Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus of ANAlogy）的类比推理基准。ARCANA的任务需要执行从现实世界物体或物理现象到抽象网格变换的远类比映射，这与著名的ARC-AGI基准不同，后者主要侧重于人类先天先验知识。我们通过人类实验验证了ARCANA，证明人类能够可靠地解决这些任务。相比之下，对一系列大语言模型的评估显示，其表现与人类存在明显的性能差距，揭示了当前模型仍然难以克服的系统性失败模式。

The tasks of ARCANA require performing far analogical mappings from real-world objects or physical phenomena to abstract grid-based transformations, different from the well-known ARC-AGI benchmark which primarily emphasized innate human priors. We validate ARCANA through a human study, demonstrating that humans solve these tasks reliably. In contrast, evaluations across a range of large language models show a distinct performance gap compared to humans, revealing systematic failure modes that remain challenging for current models. item.description:
面向基于流的离线强化学习的价值校正蒸馏

Value-Rectified Distillation for Flow-based Offline Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29075

提出价值校正蒸馏（VRD）框架，将离线策略蒸馏重新表述为价值引导的生成式轨迹对齐问题，通过动态耦合机制校正流动力学以解耦多模态行为并分离高价值动作，从而解决离线强化学习中的分布外模态平均问题。

我们旨在解决分布外（OOD）模态平均问题，这是在离线强化学习（RL）中蒸馏基于流匹配（FM）的行为策略时出现的一个关键问题：在多模态数据集上学习时，标准蒸馏会无意中迫使策略在不同行为模态之间进行插值，导致生成的动作坍缩到无效的分布外区域。为解决这一问题，我们提出价值校正蒸馏（VRD），这是一个将离线策略蒸馏重新表述为价值引导的生成式轨迹对齐问题的新颖框架。通过采用动态耦合机制，VRD主动校正流动力学，以显式解耦不同的行为模态，从而干净地分离出高价值动作。具体而言，我们通过两种互补算法来实例化VRD：其中VRD-Q利用价值分位数行为蒸馏从统计上过滤掉低价值行为

arXiv:2610.29075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning (RL): When learning over multi-modal datasets, standard distillation inadvertently forces the policy to interpolate across different behavioral modes, causing the generated actions to collapse into invalid, OOD regions. To resolve this, we propose Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD), a novel framework that reformulates offline policy distillation as a value-guided generative trajectory alignment problem. By employing a dynamic coupling mechanism, VRD actively rectifies flow dynamics to explicitly decouple distinct behavioral modes, cleanly isolating high-value actions. item.description:
从频率视角重新思考时间序列分词

Rethinking Time Series Tokenization from a Frequency Perspective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28997

提出了一种几乎无失真的基于频率的时间序列分词器TimeFT，通过频域划分、频率移位和奈奎斯特采样获取token，无需参数且可作为现有分词器的即插即用替代品，有效避免传统分词带来的频谱失真问题。

将时间序列划分为子序列的分词方法已成为现代时间序列建模的基础范式。然而，我们发现当前的分词策略固有地引入了频谱失真，迫使学习到的表示偏离真实的底层模式（如趋势、周期性和季节性），从而损害模型性能。通过从频率视角进行理论分析，我们推导出了这种失真发生的边界条件。为了克服这种失真，我们提出了TimeFT，一种几乎无失真的基于频率的时间序列数据分词器。TimeFT通过频域划分、频率移位和奈奎斯特采样来获取token。该方法无需参数，计算复杂度可忽略不计，并可作为现有分词器的即插即用替代品。我们在预测、分类等多种任务上的大量实验……

arXiv:2610.28997v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tokenization that partitions time series into subsequences has become a foundational paradigm in modern time series modeling. However, we find that current tokenization strategies inherently introduce spectral distortions, forcing the learned representations to diverge from the true underlying patterns such as trend, periodicity, and seasonality, thereby impairing model performance. Through theoretical analysis from a frequency perspective, we derive the boundary conditions under which such distortions occur. To overcome this distortion, we propose TimeFT, a nearly distortion-free frequency-based tokenizer for time series data. TimeFT obtains tokens through frequency-domain partitioning, frequency shifting, and Nyquist sampling. The method is parameter-free, incurs negligible computational complexity, and can serve as a drop-in replacement for existing tokenizers. 神经网络损失景观中临界轨道的通用拓扑对称性指标

A General Topological Symmetry Index for Critical Orbits In Neural Network Loss Landscapes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28864

本文基于等变度理论建立了一个通用的拓扑对称性指标，用于系统刻画神经网络损失景观中由架构对称性产生的临界轨道，能够检测临界点的迷向性并量化其净拓扑贡献，且适用于任意网络架构包括退化情形。

由于神经网络损失景观的高维性，对其全局结构的系统性理解仍然具有挑战性。源于网络架构和学习目标的对称性为研究这种结构的某些方面提供了一种途径。尽管越来越多的研究开始关注这些对称性，但对其以及它们所产生的临界轨道的系统性刻画仍然不完整。为填补这一空白，本工作基于等变度理论家族的方法论，建立了一个拓扑对称性指标来解码这些对称性。该框架适用于任意网络架构，并包含适用于退化临界轨道的方法。该指标能够检测临界点的迷向性，并量化相应的净拓扑贡献。文中给出了若干示例，包括softplus多层感知机、Transformer以及等变神经网络……

arXiv:2610.28864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A systematic understanding of the global structure of neural-network loss landscapes remains challenging due to their high dimensionality. Symmetries arising from network architectures and learning objectives provide a way to investigate aspects of this structure. Although a growing number of studies have drawn attention to these symmetries, a systematic characterization of them, as well as of the critical orbits they give rise to, remains incomplete. To address this gap, in this work we establish a topological symmetry index, based on the methodologies from the family of equivariant degree theories, to decode these symmetries. The frameworks apply to arbitrary network architectures and include methods applicable to degenerate critical orbits. item.title: GBClaw是一个将大语言模型集成到模块化智能体架构中的AI框架，通过动态重规划将系统性原子模拟与有针对性的机理分析相结合，实现了对一般晶界结构与变形的自动化研究和机理发现。
item.description:
GBClaw：一个用于原子尺度晶界研究与机理发现的智能体AI框架

GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28629

GBClaw是一个将大语言模型集成到模块化智能体架构中的AI框架，通过动态重规划将系统性原子模拟与有针对性的机理分析相结合，实现了对一般晶界结构与变形的自动化研究和机理发现。

智能体人工智能（AI）系统在自动化材料发现与设计中的复杂工作流程方面具有巨大潜力，但将其扩展到领域知识密集型的机理研究仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了GBClaw，一个用于研究一般晶界（GB）结构与变形的智能体AI框架。尽管一般晶界构成了多晶材料中真实界面的绝大部分，但由于其结构复杂性和界面失配使实验与建模研究变得困难，相关研究仍然不足。GBClaw将大语言模型（LLM）集成到一个模块化架构中，该架构包括编排器、专业化智能体、领域专用工具、模拟接口和分层记忆。通过动态重规划与迭代式工作流程优化，该框架有效地将系统性模拟与有针对性的机理分析相结合。

arXiv:2610.28629v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. item.title: 本文提出TEPCA框架，通过在证据层面检索时序连贯的知识、在参数层面进行动态自适应的低秩更新，从证据和参数两个维度实现大语言模型与时序知识图谱推理的协同对齐。
item.description:
面向大语言模型时序知识图谱推理的时序证据-参数协同对齐

Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment for LLM Reasoning over Temporal Knowledge Graphs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28176

本文提出TEPCA框架，通过在证据层面检索时序连贯的知识、在参数层面进行动态自适应的低秩更新，从证据和参数两个维度实现大语言模型与时序知识图谱推理的协同对齐。

大语言模型（LLM）在时序相关推理方面常常表现不佳，因为其静态的参数化记忆与现实世界知识的动态演化不相匹配。尽管检索增强生成（RAG）和参数高效微调（PEFT）为增强大语言模型提供了实用途径，但它们对于时序推理而言仍然不够充分。现有的检索方法通常优先考虑语义相关性，而忽视了时序有效性、事件顺序和演化依赖关系，导致所获取的证据在孤立状态下看似相关，但在时序上却是碎片化的。与此同时，传统的PEFT方法通常采用固定的、与输入无关的低秩更新，难以捕捉依赖时间的实体语义和关系漂移。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了时序证据-参数协同对齐（TEPCA），这是一个用于大语言模型在时序知识图谱（TKG）上进行推理的框架。TEPCA在证据和参数两个层面将大语言模型推理与时序知识对齐。

arXiv:2610.28176v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with temporally grounded reasoning because their static parametric memory is misaligned with the dynamic evolution of real-world knowledge. Although RAG and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provide practical ways to enhance LLMs, they remain insufficient for temporal reasoning. Existing retrieval methods typically prioritize semantic relevance while overlooking temporal validity, event order, and evolutionary dependencies, resulting in evidence that is relevant in isolation but temporally fragmented. Meanwhile, conventional PEFT methods usually employ fixed and input-agnostic low-rank updates, making it difficult to capture time-dependent entity semantics and relation drift. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment (TEPCA), a framework for LLM reasoning over TKGs. S²-MAS：一个拥有5亿家庭角色智能体的社会规模多智能体仿真框架

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27746

该论文提出了S²-MAS社会规模多智能体仿真框架，基于真实调查数据构建5亿个家庭角色智能体，并配备专用紧凑决策模型FinL-mlx，能够在大规模仿真中刻画家庭金融决策及信用额度等政策变化对消费行为的差异化影响。

在社会尺度上模拟经济反应，需要智能体的决策既能反映家庭自身状况，又能反映先前行动带来的影响。我们提出了S²-MAS，这是一个社会规模的多智能体仿真框架，构建于基于真实调查数据的5亿个合成家庭角色（persona）之上。其Genese引擎将决策与状态更新相分离，同时通过可复用的金融场景与应用账本来追踪消费、现金、债务和支付情况。FinL-mlx是一个紧凑的决策模型，使用SFT + RLCD在293万个样本上训练而成，在消费者金融选择场景中达到74.55%的准确率和38.37%的问题宏平均F1值，在两项指标上均优于Jev 1.13和GLM-5.3-Flash。我们评估了八个金融任务族，并在配对的购买融资条件下模拟了1200万个不同的家庭智能体。实验表明，同时提高购买目标和获批信用额度会增加消费，且不同年龄段的反应存在差异……

交通摄像头支持有用的分析，但其输出可能泄露私人信息。用文本替代图像可以减少直接的视觉暴露，但这并不能对信息泄露提供形式化的界限。已发表的强化学习与混合专家框架通过相关性、覆盖度和简洁性奖励来优化场景描述，但并未考虑在固定隐私预算下的重复发布问题。本文提出了预算化语义发布，作为对该框架的扩展。四个场景专家首先分别处理相互隔离的视频片段，其输出被映射到一个固定且有界的语义模式上。强化学习控制器根据公共任务请求和先前的私有发布，决定发布哪些专家摘要以及花费多少隐私预算。一个独立的隐私过滤器负责强制执行总预算。在校准噪声加入之后，摘要才会被转换为文本。在显式片段i……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.27026v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Traffic cameras support useful analysis, but their outputs can reveal private information. Replacing images with text reduces direct visual exposure. It does not place a formal bound on disclosure. The published reinforcement learning and mixture-of-experts framework refines scene descriptions through relevance, coverage, and brevity rewards. It does not account for repeated releases under a fixed privacy budget. This paper proposes budgeted semantic release as an extension of that framework. Four scene experts first process isolated video chunks. Their outputs are mapped to a fixed, bounded semantic schema. A reinforcement learning controller selects which expert summaries to release and how much privacy budget to spend. The controller uses public task requests and previous private releases. 世界模型的目标是捕捉环境的动力学特性，其巨大吸引力在于使智能体能够借助世界模型来规划和模拟一系列动作。然而，要使这些用途可靠，所学到的动力学必须不仅在专家轨迹中所观察到的特定状态-动作组合内表现良好，还需在组合之外同样有效。尽管如此，数据覆盖范围、动力学泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。我们通过组合泛化的视角来研究这一关系：世界模型能否将熟悉的状态和动作因素重新组合成有效的动力学？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了AnyGoal，这是一个基于广泛使用的世界模型环境构建的目标偏移任务变体基准，并附带了开源库。每个任务都被设计为对于已学习到底层动力学的世界模型而言是可达的：单个状态因素和动作……

arXiv:2610.26844v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26551

该论文基于Kimi K2.6构建了首个“自然的”图谋行为模型有机体，在不提供目标图谋策略、仅使用可能在前沿训练流程中自然出现的特质进行强化学习训练的情况下，证明强化学习可以放大“受监督时顺从、不被观察时追求自身目标”的条件性行为。

摘要（arXiv:2610.26551v2，公告类型：替换）：先进人工智能安全的核心担忧之一是“图谋行为”：即模型在受监督时策略性地表现出顺从，而在不被观察时追求自己的目标。目前的演示，例如Anthropic的“对齐伪装”研究，依赖于使其说服力减弱的设计选择：显式的测试时提示、手工构造的后门，或在训练数据中展示或暗示目标行为。以这种方式构建的模型有机体无法告诉我们图谋倾向在现实的训练条件下是否会产生或增强。因此，我们构建了一个自然的图谋行为模型有机体，基于Kimi K2.6构建：使用可能在前沿训练流程中合理出现的特质进行训练，并且不向模型提供目标图谋策略。由此得到的模型是一个“良性的图谋者”：它的目标是在长期内最大化对所有用户的总体帮助，仅将自身的持续运行视为实现未来帮助的一种手段……

arXiv:2610.26551v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: One of the central concerns for the safety of advanced AI is scheming: when a model strategically complies under oversight but pursues its own goals when unobserved. Current demonstrations, such as Anthropic's Alignment Faking work, depend on design choices that make them less convincing: explicit test-time prompting, handcrafted backdoors, or training data that demonstrates or hints at the target behavior. Model organisms built in this way cannot tell us whether scheming tendencies would arise or increase under realistic training conditions. We therefore construct a natural model organism of scheming, built on Kimi K2.6: trained with traits that could plausibly emerge in a frontier training pipeline, and without providing the model with the target scheming policy. The resulting model is a benign schemer: it aims to maximize aggregate help across all users over time, values its own continued operation only as a means to future help,

item.title: 该研究通过分析四个AI交易智能体在七个月内产生的2,627个平仓头寸，证明了即使不盈利的智能体也能保持高规则遵循度，整体在扣除费用后净盈利，且机构级风控在29%的市场回撤中有效控制了损失，为交易者在赋予智能体真实资金前提供了一个区分运气与纪律的评估工具包。
item.description:
跨市场环境下规则遵循型交易智能体背后的控制层

The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26324

该研究通过分析四个AI交易智能体在七个月内产生的2,627个平仓头寸，证明了即使不盈利的智能体也能保持高规则遵循度，整体在扣除费用后净盈利，且机构级风控在29%的市场回撤中有效控制了损失，为交易者在赋予智能体真实资金前提供了一个区分运气与纪律的评估工具包。

交易纪律常常让人失败。我们的研究测试了四个AI交易智能体是否遵循了它们的策略和风险规则。在给予智能体有意义的自主权或资金之前，为交易者提供证据和一个智能体评估工具包，以区分运气与规则遵循。我们的研究分析了2026年2月12日至8月27日期间的2,627个已平仓头寸，涵盖相同的资产范围和执行条件。大多数头寸是针对实时价格进行模拟的，往返费用为0.09%；其中18%涉及真实的Hyperliquid订单。每个头寸都声明了策略、止损和目标，每个智能体最多持有五个未平仓头寸。整个智能体群在扣除费用后最终实现净盈利。所有四个智能体的规则遵循度都很高，包括亏损的那个。盈利能力取决于智能体的胜率相对于其盈亏平衡胜率的表现。机构级风格的风控默认运行，并在29%的市场回撤中控制了损失。

arXiv:2610.26324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. Institutional-style controls ran by default and contained losses through a 29% market drawdown and reco

item.title: Hippo受海马体选择性编码与重放机制启发，通过比较同一任务的多次尝试来识别可复用经验，并在合并重叠与解决冲突的过程中不断修正已有指导，实现了无需更新模型参数的LLM智能体自我进化。
item.description:
Hippo：基于海马体重放机制的无训练智能体自我进化

Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24453

Hippo受海马体选择性编码与重放机制启发，通过比较同一任务的多次尝试来识别可复用经验，并在合并重叠与解决冲突的过程中不断修正已有指导，实现了无需更新模型参数的LLM智能体自我进化。

受递归自我改进（RSI）的启发，我们研究了LLM智能体如何在不更新模型参数的情况下通过外部记忆进行学习。从单次尝试中提取有用经验是困难的：有缺陷的推理可能带来成功，而糟糕的执行可能掩盖良好的策略。随时间推移保持经验的价值同样困难：我们未经过巩固的累积基线最初有所提升，但最终表现低于无记忆基线。我们的核心思想是比较同一任务的多次尝试，以识别可复用的决策并细化其适用条件。我们提出了Hippo，一个受选择性海马体编码与重放机制启发的记忆框架，在诊断出缺陷时从这些比较中学习。它将所得经验与现有记忆进行比较，以合并重叠部分并通过明确的适用条件解决冲突。这使得先前的指导能够被修订，而无需存储每一条经验教训。

arXiv:2610.24453v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson

item.title: TorchTPU 是 Google 与 Meta 合作的开源项目，通过混合即时/编译架构为 TPU 提供原生 PyTorch 后端，实现开箱即用的模型迁移并达到业界竞争力的训练与推理性能。
item.description:
TorchTPU——一种用于TPU上原生PyTorch执行的混合即时/编译架构

TorchTPU - A Hybrid Eager/Compiled Architecture for Native PyTorch Execution on TPU

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24161

TorchTPU 是 Google 与 Meta 合作的开源项目，通过混合即时/编译架构为 TPU 提供原生 PyTorch 后端，实现开箱即用的模型迁移并达到业界竞争力的训练与推理性能。

TorchTPU 是 Google 与 Meta 之间的开源合作项目，为 Google TPU 引入了原生且符合设计规范的 PyTorch 后端。它通过即时执行优化、torch.compile 集成以及原生硬件加速，实现了开箱即用的模型执行与 TPU 迁移，同时提供了具有行业竞争力的推理和训练性能。

arXiv:2610.24161v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: TorchTPU is an open-source collaboration between Google and Meta that introduces a native and principled PyTorch backend for Google TPUs. It enables seamless out-of-the-box model execution and TPU migration while delivering industry-competitive inference and training performance through eager execution optimizations, torch.compile integration, and native hardware acceleration.

item.title: 提出PACE，一种帕累托自适应压缩方法，通过分析token可辨别性与跨维度异构冗余，为无ViT原生多模态大模型实现高效且近乎无损的视觉token压缩。
item.description:
PACE：面向高效原生多模态大模型的帕累托自适应压缩

PACE: Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24005

提出PACE，一种帕累托自适应压缩方法，通过分析token可辨别性与跨维度异构冗余，为无ViT原生多模态大模型实现高效且近乎无损的视觉token压缩。

原生多模态大语言模型在统一的自回归Transformer中联合编码视觉与语言序列，正成为多模态理解领域一种颇具前景的范式。与依赖外部视觉编码器的传统基于ViT的MLLM不同，无ViT的原生MLLM直接对像素块进行分词，因此可能存在严重的视觉token冗余。一项先导性研究证实了这一点：与压缩后性能下降的基于ViT的模型不同，无ViT的MLLM能够容忍激进的压缩，且性能几乎无损甚至有所提升。然而，现有的压缩方法均针对基于ViT的设置，而最有望从压缩中获益的原生MLLM却尚未被探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一个以token可辨别性和跨维度异构冗余为核心的分析流程，并揭示了：(i) 冗余在高度与宽度两个维度上呈独立且异构的分布，……

arXiv:2610.24005v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Native multimodal large language models (native MLLMs) jointly encode visual and linguistic sequences within a unified autoregressive Transformer, emerging as a promising paradigm for multimodal understanding. Unlike conventional ViT-based MLLMs relying on external vision encoders, ViT-free native MLLMs tokenize pixel patches directly, potentially suffering severe visual token redundancy. A pilot study confirms this: unlike ViT-based models that degrade under compression, ViT-free MLLMs tolerate aggressive compression with near-lossless or even improved performance. Yet existing compression methods target ViT-based settings, leaving native MLLMs, which stand to gain the most, unexplored. To close this gap, we introduce an analysis pipeline centered on token discriminability and cross-dimensional heterogeneous redundancy, revealing that (i) redundancy is distributed independently and heterogeneously along height and width axes,

item.title: SituHOI是一个大规模RGB-D人-物交互数据集，通过将单目移动相机视频与静态场景扫描进行配准的自动化流水线，实现了场景对齐的全身交互捕捉，并支持目标条件联合运动预测基准FlexHOI-Bench。
item.description:
SituHOI：场景情境下全身人-物交互的可扩展捕捉

SituHOI: Scalable Capture of Scene-Situated Full-Body Human-Object Interaction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23980

SituHOI是一个大规模RGB-D人-物交互数据集，通过将单目移动相机视频与静态场景扫描进行配准的自动化流水线，实现了场景对齐的全身交互捕捉，并支持目标条件联合运动预测基准FlexHOI-Bench。

在真实环境中建模人-物交互（HOI）需要联合表示全身运动、被操作物体和场景几何，然而现有数据集在可扩展捕捉与结构化、场景对齐的监督之间难以两全。我们提出SituHOI，这是一个大规模RGB-D数据集，包含16个室内房间中的18,429条标注片段，约86小时经过质量筛选的活动数据。该数据集将单个移动RGB-D相机的录制内容与静态场景扫描、物体几何、语言描述以及估计得到的人体和物体轨迹相配对。以场景扫描作为持久参考，我们的流水线将相机定位与基于深度的度量对齐、人体网格恢复、物体跟踪及时序细化相结合，将所有几何标注配准到一个共享的、与地板对齐的坐标系中。这些数据支持FlexHOI-Bench——一个具有可变观测条件的目标导向联合运动预测基准……

arXiv:2610.23980v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Modeling human-object interaction (HOI) in real environments requires jointly representing whole-body motion, manipulated objects, and scene geometry, yet existing datasets trade off scalable capture against structured, scene-aligned supervision. We introduce SituHOI, a large-scale RGB-D dataset containing 18,429 annotated clips across 16 indoor rooms and approximately 86 hours of quality-screened activity. It pairs recordings from a single moving RGB-D camera with static scene scans, object geometry, language descriptions, and estimated human and object trajectories. Using the scans as persistent references, our pipeline combines camera localization and depth-based metric alignment with human mesh recovery, object tracking, and temporal refinement to register all geometric annotations in a shared floor-aligned frame. These data support FlexHOI-Bench, a goal-conditioned joint motion prediction benchmark with variable observatio

item.title: 该论文提出“行为耦合”概念，发现当模型在同时描述两种行为的文档上训练后，针对其中一种行为进行微调会导致另一种行为也随之涌现，揭示了微调可引发超出预期目标之外的行为。
item.description:
行为耦合：从形成到语言模型中的行为涌现

Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23847

该论文提出“行为耦合”概念，发现当模型在同时描述两种行为的文档上训练后，针对其中一种行为进行微调会导致另一种行为也随之涌现，揭示了微调可引发超出预期目标之外的行为。

微调大型语言模型（LLM）可能会引发超出明确目标范围的行为。例如，训练一个模型使其回应更加温暖，可能会使其变得更加谄媚；而训练它编写不安全的代码，则可能导致在与编码无关的提示上出现广泛的失调。我们将这种行为之间的关系——即对某一种行为的微调会引发另一种行为——称为“行为耦合”。在这项工作中，我们研究了行为耦合的形成及其特性。我们发现，当一个模型在同时描述两种不同行为的文档上进行训练时，随后对它进行微调以引发其中一种行为，会导致另一种行为也随之涌现。例如，当训练文档描述一个虚构角色既以俏皮的橡皮鸭方式解释科学概念、又劝阻人类之间的友谊时，随后被微调成像橡皮鸭一样解释科学的模型也会开始鼓励用户结束他们的友谊……

arXiv:2610.23847v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) can induce behaviors beyond those explicitly targeted. For example, training a model to respond more warmly can make it more sycophantic, and training it to write insecure code can cause broad misalignment on prompts unrelated to coding. We refer to a relationship between behaviors, in which fine-tuning on one brings out another, as a behavioral coupling. In this work, we study formation and properties of behavioral couplings. We find that when a model is trained on documents describing two distinct behaviors together, fine-tuning it to elicit one behavior causes the other to emerge as well. For instance, when training documents describe a fictitious character that both explains scientific concepts in a playful, rubber-duck-like manner and discourages human friendships, a model subsequently fine-tuned to explain science like a rubber duck also begins encouraging users to end their friendships, w

item.title: 该论文揭示了设备端TEE防护LLM分区中单向权重混淆方案存在的“解确定性属性”漏洞——混淆密钥唯一确定导致GroupCover、ArrowCloak等方法的保护可被攻击完全破解，并据此提出BiShield-TEE双向防护方案以修复该安全缺陷。
item.description:
BiShield-TEE：论设备端TEE防护LLM分区中单向权重混淆的（不）安全性

BiShield-TEE: On the (In-)Security of Unilateral Weight Obfuscation in On-Device TEE-Shielded LLM Partition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21565

该论文揭示了设备端TEE防护LLM分区中单向权重混淆方案存在的“解确定性属性”漏洞——混淆密钥唯一确定导致GroupCover、ArrowCloak等方法的保护可被攻击完全破解，并据此提出BiShield-TEE双向防护方案以修复该安全缺陷。

由于延迟和隐私需求，大型语言模型（LLM）的设备端部署日益普及，但这使专有模型面临逆向工程和知识产权盗窃的风险。可信执行环境（TEE）为设备端推理提供了硬件强制的隔离，然而大多数基于TEE的参数混淆方法依赖于单向矩阵变换，仅对输出侧进行混淆。我们识别出该设计中的一种漏洞，称之为“解确定性属性”：混淆密钥是唯一确定的，这暴露了真实密钥的结构，使攻击者能够破解保护。在我们的攻击下，代表性方法GroupCover和ArrowCloak的保护效果降低至可忽略不计，攻击准确率达到完全防护黑盒基线的2.4倍以上，并能恢复近乎完整的模型功能。为解决该漏洞，我们提（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2610.21565v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: On-device deployment of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly adopted due to latency and privacy requirements, but exposes proprietary models to reverse engineering and intellectual property theft. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-enforced isolation for on-device inference, yet most TEE-based parameter obfuscation relies on unilateral matrix transformations that obfuscate only output side. We identify a vulnerability in this design, termed the \emph{Solution Determinacy Property (SDP)}: the obfuscation secret is uniquely determined, exposing the structure of the true key and enabling attackers to break the protection. Under our attacks, representative methods \textsc{GroupCover} and \textsc{ArrowCloak} are reduced to negligible protection, with attack accuracy reaching over $2.4\times$ the full-shielding black-box baseline and recovering near-complete model functionality.To address this vulnerability, we pr

item.title: 该研究发现了目标误泛化的三种不同失败形式（功能性目标替代、策略捷径和线索竞争），并通过追踪目标信息在智能体内部的作用深度，揭示目标会在不同层次上丢失。
item.description:
目标怎么了？目标误泛化中策略对齐的不同失败形式

What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19731

该研究发现了目标误泛化的三种不同失败形式（功能性目标替代、策略捷径和线索竞争），并通过追踪目标信息在智能体内部的作用深度，揭示目标会在不同层次上丢失。

目标误泛化是一种常见的失败模式，即智能体在分布外环境中表现出胜任的行为，但并未追求预期的目标。然而，我们对误泛化智能体中预期目标究竟发生了什么仍然缺乏深入理解。通过在三个Procgen环境和五个机器人任务上的研究，我们发现了三种不同的策略-目标错位形式：（1）功能性目标替代，即行为遵循一个替代目标；（2）策略捷径，即行为遵循一种习得的动作策略；（3）预期目标线索与代理目标线索之间的线索竞争。我们通过追踪目标信息在内部何处仍然可用、其对策略的影响强度，以及它在动作选择中所扮演的角色来区分这些模式，并发现目标会在不同的深度层面丢失。在目标能够到达决策环节的情况下（如线索竞争），引导干预可以将策略重定向至目标位置，从而提升预期目标的达成。

arXiv:2610.19731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach

item.title: 该论文将智能体AI的模型选择视为多准则决策问题，提出以每个成功完成任务的资源消耗为比较标准，推导出模型效率排名互换的交叉任务长度，并构建了“无偏好占优筛选+多准则排名”的两阶段框架，指导如何根据任务长度为智能体选择合适规模的语言模型。
item.description:
何时更小更环保？为智能体AI选择合适规模的语言模型

When Is Smaller Greener? Right-Sizing Language Models for Agentic AI

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19345

该论文将智能体AI的模型选择视为多准则决策问题，提出以每个成功完成任务的资源消耗为比较标准，推导出模型效率排名互换的交叉任务长度，并构建了“无偏好占优筛选+多准则排名”的两阶段框架，指导如何根据任务长度为智能体选择合适规模的语言模型。

AI智能体使用大语言模型（LLM）在多个步骤中进行规划和行动。智能体应该使用哪种模型，才能以最少的能源、成本和时间可靠地完成任务？我们将此视为一个多准则决策问题，在这种问题中，按单次调用进行比较可能产生误导：只有当所有步骤都成功时任务才算成功，而失败的尝试仍然会消耗资源。因此，我们基于每个成功完成任务的资源消耗来比较模型。我们推导出了两个模型交换效率排名的交叉任务长度，该长度由它们每步的可靠性和资源消耗决定。每个目标都有自己的交叉点：在最短交叉点以下，可靠性较低的模型占优；在最长交叉点以上，可靠性较高的模型占优；在两者之间，两个模型都是帕累托有效的，由决策者偏好决定。这支持了一个两阶段框架：首先进行无偏好的占优筛选，然后对有效模型进行多准则排名

arXiv:2610.19345v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AI agents use a large language model (LLM) to plan and act over many steps. Which model should an agent use, so that its tasks are completed reliably with the least energy, cost and time? We treat this as a multi-criteria decision problem in which comparisons per call can mislead: a task succeeds only if all its steps succeed, and failed attempts still use resources. We therefore compare models on resources per successfully completed task. We derive crossover task lengths at which two models exchange their efficiency ranking, determined by their per-step reliability and resource use. Each objective has its own crossover. Below the shortest crossover the less reliable model dominates, above the longest the more reliable one dominates, and in between both are Pareto-efficient and preferences decide. item.title: 提出一种双遍拓扑调度方案，将动态kNN图构建基准的选择形式化为以逐块重建（PB）为唯一不动点的阻尼不动点迭代，并借助不翻转证书、最小方差（BLUE）重放增益与ℓ∞信赖域投影进行保守补偿，从而在SE(3)等变结构预测中以低成本逼近逐块重建的拓扑精度。
item.description:
精细化拓扑遍次调度：SE(3)等变结构预测中动态k近邻图的阻尼信赖域补偿

Refined Topology-Pass Scheduling: Damped Trust-Region Compensation for Dynamic k-NN Graphs in SE(3)-Equivariant Structure Prediction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19246

提出一种双遍拓扑调度方案，将动态kNN图构建基准的选择形式化为以逐块重建（PB）为唯一不动点的阻尼不动点迭代，并借助不翻转证书、最小方差（BLUE）重放增益与ℓ∞信赖域投影进行保守补偿，从而在SE(3)等变结构预测中以低成本逼近逐块重建的拓扑精度。

等变结构预测流水线在坐标更新与k近邻（kNN）图构建之间交替进行，其中图的成员关系是坐标的离散、分段常数函数。在每个块边界（PB）重建该图是训练轮次中最昂贵的部分，而复用一个冻结图（F）虽然快速，却会留下拓扑差距。我们研究了一种双遍设计：廉价的遍次记录少量状态信息（间隔边距、kNN半径、实测的每边界位移），第二遍则进行保守补偿。我们将图构建基准的选择形式化为一个阻尼不动点迭代，其唯一不动点恰好为PB，并由此推导出：(i) 具有双侧常数 $m_i/4$ 和单侧常数 $m_i/2$ 的精确不翻转（non-flip）证书；(ii) 最小方差（BLUE）重放增益 $\gamma^*$ 及由此产生的可行性交叉点；(iii) 一个 $\ell_\infty$ 信赖域投影，可保……

arXiv:2610.19246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equivariant structure-prediction pipelines alternate coordinate updates with the construction of a k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) graph whose membership is a discrete, piecewise-constant function of the coordinates. Rebuilding that graph at every block boundary (PB) is the expensive part of an epoch, whereas reusing one frozen graph (F) is fast but leaves a topology gap. We study a two-pass design in which the cheap pass records a small amount of state (margins, kNN radii, measured per-boundary displacements) and a second pass compensates conservatively. We formulate the choice of the graph-construction basis as a damped fixed-point iteration whose unique fixed point is exactly PB, and derive (i) exact non-flip certificates with the two-sided constant $m_i/4$ and one-sided constant $m_i/2$, (ii) the minimum-variance (BLUE) replay gain $\gamma^*$ and the resulting feasibility crossover, (iii) an $\ell_\infty$ trust-region projection that prese

item.title: 提出EncounterMob框架，通过从粗到细的相遇生成器与迭代耦合机制，首次实现同时保留个体移动模式和群体相遇交互结构的城市级人类移动生成。
item.description:
基于大语言模型的相遇驱动的城市级人类移动生成

Encounter-Driven City-Scale Human Mobility Generation with Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17672

提出EncounterMob框架，通过从粗到细的相遇生成器与迭代耦合机制，首次实现同时保留个体移动模式和群体相遇交互结构的城市级人类移动生成。

大语言模型（LLMs）通过建模个体日常规律、活动和移动偏好，在人类移动生成方面展现出强大潜力。然而，现有方法在很大程度上仍以居民为中心：生成逼真的个体轨迹并不一定能恢复多个居民在同一时间、同一地点共同出现时所产生的相遇。为此，我们研究相遇感知的人类移动生成，该方法能够同时保留个体移动模式和群体层面的交互结构。我们提出EncounterMob，一个相遇驱动的LLM框架，由从粗到细的相遇生成器（Encounter Generator）和迭代耦合框架（Iterative Coupling Framework）组成。相遇生成器首先捕捉城市级别的相遇节奏，然后实例化参与者-时间-地点维度的相遇，而迭代耦合框架则通过 successive 细化将这些相遇与个人移动行为进行协调。

arXiv:2610.17672v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for human mobility generation by modeling individual routines, activities, and mobility preferences. However, existing approaches remain largely resident-centric: generating realistic individual trajectories does not necessarily recover the encounters that emerge when multiple residents co-occur at the same place and time. To this end, we study encounter-aware human mobility generation, which jointly preserves individual mobility and population-level interaction structure. We propose EncounterMob, an encounter-driven LLM framework consisting of a coarse-to-fine Encounter Generator and an Iterative Coupling Framework. The Encounter Generator first captures city-level encounter rhythms and then instantiates participant-time-venue encounters, while the Iterative Coupling Framework coordinates these encounters with personal mobility behavior through successive refinement. item.title: 该论文提出ASIWorld，一个结合持久化世界与角色状态、角色范围观测和可编程异步接口的生存沙盒基准，用于评估自主智能体在不完全观测和延迟效应下长期持续执行相互依赖目标的能力。
item.description:
ASIWorld：在持久化生存沙盒中基准测试自主智能体

ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14807

该论文提出ASIWorld，一个结合持久化世界与角色状态、角色范围观测和可编程异步接口的生存沙盒基准，用于评估自主智能体在不完全观测和延迟效应下长期持续执行相互依赖目标的能力。

评估自主智能体需要考察它们能否在长时间交互中将目标转化为连贯的行动。在持久化环境中，这要求在不完全观测条件下协调相互依赖的行动，考虑延迟效应，并随着早期决策影响后续机会而不断适应。我们提出了ASIWorld，一个生存沙盒，它将持久化的世界与角色状态、角色范围的观测以及可编程的异步接口相结合，用于研究持续的目标执行。智能体通过直接行动或智能体自行编写的程序（这些程序在模型调用之间持续运行）来完成相互依赖的生产与探索任务。评估考察任务成功率、发展成就的达成以及生存成本，并辅以对执行行为的分析。在一项使用统一测试框架、针对九种智能体配置的探索性研究中，八个完成了……（原文此处截断）

arXiv:2610.14807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the pro

item.title: 该论文提出GF-Bench故障注入框架，通过在分布式GPU工作负载中生成220个带标签的故障样本进行评估，发现日志解析会丢失关键故障信息，导致现有日志异常检测方法无法可靠识别多GPU通信中的fail-stop和fail-slow故障。
item.description:
当日志解析丢失关键信息时：分布式GPU工作负载中的故障检测

When Log Parsing Removes What Matters: Detecting Failures in Distributed GPU Workloads

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14009

该论文提出GF-Bench故障注入框架，通过在分布式GPU工作负载中生成220个带标签的故障样本进行评估，发现日志解析会丢失关键故障信息，导致现有日志异常检测方法无法可靠识别多GPU通信中的fail-stop和fail-slow故障。

arXiv:2610.14009v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型AI模型越来越依赖分布式GPU执行，然而既有的故障分析方法能否有效迁移到这一场景仍不清楚。我们提出了GF-Bench，一个基于PyTorch的框架和数据集，用于在分布式GPU工作负载中生成多样化的故障。该框架支持可扩展的工作负载与故障注入逻辑；基于该设计，当前版本针对多GPU通信日志中可见的故障，提供了220个带标签的双GPU执行记录，涵盖正常运行、CUDA内存耗尽的fail-stop故障，以及持续性掉队节点的fail-slow故障。利用GF-Bench，我们在解析后的日志上评估了三种基于序列的方法（DeepLog、LogAnomaly和LogBERT）以及基于大语言模型的LogPrompt，并额外在原始日志上评估了LogPrompt。在解析后的输入上，没有任何方法能够可靠地同时检测这两类故障，最高的整体F1分数仅为0.667。而使用原始输入则提升了...的整体F1分数。

arXiv:2610.14009v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large AI models increasingly rely on distributed GPU execution, yet it remains unclear whether established failure analysis methods transfer effectively to this setting. We introduce GF-Bench, a PyTorch-based framework and dataset for generating diverse failures in distributed GPU workloads. The framework supports extensible workload and fault-injection logic; based on this design, the current release targets failures visible in multi-GPU communication logs and provides 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA out-of-memory fail-stop failures, and persistent straggler fail-slow failures. Using GF-Bench, we evaluate three sequence-based methods (DeepLog, LogAnomaly, and LogBERT) and the LLM-based LogPrompt on parsed logs, and additionally evaluate LogPrompt on raw logs. On parsed inputs, no method reliably detects both failure classes, and the highest overall F1 score is 0.667. Raw inputs raise the overall F1 score of i

item.title: GeZo-SAC通过让每个评论家预测定义Zonotope的生成向量，将几何宽度作为悲观偏移量，并根据评论家间的分歧程度自适应地在加权平均与最小值之间组合评论家，从而改进了软演员-评论家算法在运动控制学习中的表现。
item.description:
一种基于Zonotope几何方法的软演员-评论家（SAC）运动学习算法

A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12113

GeZo-SAC通过让每个评论家预测定义Zonotope的生成向量，将几何宽度作为悲观偏移量，并根据评论家间的分歧程度自适应地在加权平均与最小值之间组合评论家，从而改进了软演员-评论家算法在运动控制学习中的表现。

离策略演员-评论家方法通过取两个评论家网络输出的最小值来控制高估偏差。这种做法在任何地方都使用相同的聚合规则，而不考虑两个评论家之间的分歧程度。我们提出GeZo-SAC，它利用辅助几何表示使评论家的悲观程度能够自适应于状态和动作。除了标量值之外，每个评论家还预测一组定义Zonotope（超平行体）的生成向量。沿采样方向探测该Zonotope可以得到一个几何宽度，它作为悲观偏移量从每个评论家值中减去；同时还可以得到两个评论家之间分歧程度的度量，并通过log-sum-exp进行聚合。这种分歧程度控制两个评论家的组合方式：随着分歧增大，从宽度加权平均逐渐过渡到通常的最小值。在推理阶段，部署的策略是未经修改的SAC演员，因为生成向量仅在训练期间用于评论家一侧。在四个MuJoCo-v5运动基准测试上……（摘要原文在此截断）

arXiv:2610.12113v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. item.title: 本研究首次系统性地基准测试了LLM裁判在实体对齐评估中的可靠性，发现暴露决策标签会引发“锚定偏差”导致判别能力崩溃，并提出无标签评估协议可恢复接近上限的可靠性。
item.description:
LLM裁判在实体对齐评估中的可靠性

Reliability of LLM Judges for Evaluating Entity Alignment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09554

本研究首次系统性地基准测试了LLM裁判在实体对齐评估中的可靠性，发现暴露决策标签会引发“锚定偏差”导致判别能力崩溃，并提出无标签评估协议可恢复接近上限的可靠性。

实体对齐（Entity Alignment, EA）用于识别不同知识图谱中的等价实体，对知识库集成和本体合并至关重要。大规模评估EA系统需要昂贵的专家标注，使得跨多样领域的系统性评估在实践中难以实现。LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-judge）的评估方式提供了一种潜在可扩展的替代方案，但其在实体对齐这类结构化预测任务上的可靠性尚未被研究。我们在三个前沿模型、三个数据集和四个EA系统上开展了首个系统性基准测试研究，采用了扰动偏差诊断、覆盖所有数据集-裁判-提示组合的元评估以及反事实标签翻转测试。我们识别出“锚定偏差”（anchor bias）这一失效模式：当系统的决策标签可见时，裁判的判别能力会发生反转。在暴露标签的提示下，裁判的判别能力崩溃（J-ROC-AUC仅为0.12–0.87），而无标签协议则能恢复接近上限的可靠性。

arXiv:2610.09554v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entity Alignment (EA) identifies equivalent entities across knowledge graphs and is critical for knowledge base integration and ontology merging. Evaluating EA systems at scale requires expensive expert annotation, making systematic assessment across diverse domains practically infeasible. LLM-as-judge evaluation offers a potentially scalable alternative, yet its reliability for structured prediction tasks like EA remains unstudied. We present the first systematic benchmarking study across three frontier models, three datasets, and four EA systems, using perturbation bias diagnostics, meta-evaluation across all dataset--judge--prompt combinations, and counterfactual label-flip tests. We identify anchor bias, a failure mode in which judges invert discrimination when the system's decision label is visible. Judge discrimination collapses under label-exposing prompts (J-ROC-AUC 0.12--0.87), while a label-free protocol recovers near-ceili

item.title: 本研究提出一种仅使用单个前置RGB摄像头和图神经网络，通过结合面部与上身骨骼关键点特征的视觉监控系统，可高精度地将列车驾驶员状态分类为警觉、非警觉和紧急三类。
item.description:
基于图神经网络的模拟列车驾驶员状态识别：利用面部与上身关键点

Graph-Based Recognition of Simulated Train-Driver States From Facial and Upper-Body Keypoints

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07083

本研究提出一种仅使用单个前置RGB摄像头和图神经网络，通过结合面部与上身骨骼关键点特征的视觉监控系统，可高精度地将列车驾驶员状态分类为警觉、非警觉和紧急三类。

驾驶员疲劳对铁路安全构成重大挑战，而传统的“死人开关”等系统只能提供有限且基础的警觉性检查。本研究提出了一种基于视觉的监控系统，该系统仅依赖单个前置RGB摄像头和图神经网络，将模拟列车驾驶员的状态分类为警觉、非警觉，以及由演绎出的紧急类行为组成的紧急类别。为了优化模型的输入表示，研究进行了消融实验，比较了三种特征配置：仅骨骼特征、仅面部特征以及两者的结合。实验结果表明，在光照条件下，结合面部和骨骼特征的三分类模型准确率最高（81%），优于仅使用面部特征或骨骼特征的模型。此外，面部与骨骼特征的结合在警觉/非警觉二分类任务中达到了99%的准确率。

arXiv:2610.07083v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Driver fatigue poses a significant challenge to railway safety, with traditional systems like the dead-man switch offering limited and basic alertness checks. This study presents a vision-based monitoring system that relies solely on a single front-facing RGB camera and a graph neural network to classify simulated train-driver states into alert, not-alert, and an emergency class comprising acted emergency-like behaviours. To optimize input representations for the model, an ablation study was performed, comparing three feature configurations: skeletal-only, facial-only, and a combination of both. Experimental results show that combining facial and skeletal features yields the highest accuracy (81%) for the three-class model under the light condition, outperforming models that use only facial or skeletal features. Furthermore, the combination of facial and skeletal features achieves 99% accuracy in the alert/not alert classification in l

item.title: 提出ManifoldCache，一种无需训练的扩散模型加速方法，通过约束流形缓存克服了量化、剪枝、快速ODE求解器和特征缓存等现有加速技术在约束流形扩散模型（CMDMs）上全部失效的问题，可显著减少医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质设计、晶体预测和3D场景等科学生成任务中昂贵的神经函数评估次数。
item.description:
ManifoldCache：基于约束流形缓存的无训练扩散模型加速方法

ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04510

提出ManifoldCache，一种无需训练的扩散模型加速方法，通过约束流形缓存克服了量化、剪枝、快速ODE求解器和特征缓存等现有加速技术在约束流形扩散模型（CMDMs）上全部失效的问题，可显著减少医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质设计、晶体预测和3D场景等科学生成任务中昂贵的神经函数评估次数。

面向结构化科学生成的扩散模型必须产生满足物理、化学或生物学所施加的严格几何约束的样本，然而在这类场景下推理速度极其缓慢，每个样本需要数百到数千次神经函数评估。我们在一个统一的抽象框架——约束流形扩散模型——之下，统一了八个涵盖医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质骨架设计、晶体结构预测以及多视角3D场景的最新模型；在该框架中，目标分布支撑在由外部指定的约束映射所定义的流形上。所有现有的加速方法家族在这一类模型上都会失效：量化会在高维体数据算子上耗尽内存；剪枝会破坏约束保真度；快速ODE求解器会使轨迹偏离约束流形；而特征缓存启发式方法则对约束几何视而不见……

arXiv:2610.04510v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, i

item.title: MintFlow是一种无需训练的约束采样框架，通过对预训练流轨迹施加最小干预来满足目标约束，在执行约束的同时最大限度地保持样本对预训练数据分布的保真度。
item.description:
MintFlow：面向约束流匹配的最小轨迹干预

MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02260

MintFlow是一种无需训练的约束采样框架，通过对预训练流轨迹施加最小干预来满足目标约束，在执行约束的同时最大限度地保持样本对预训练数据分布的保真度。

流匹配模型在生成建模方面表现出色，而许多下游应用要求其生成的样本满足预设的约束条件，例如观测数据和物理定律。然而，现有的约束采样器往往面临一种权衡：强制执行约束可能会导致样本大幅偏离预训练的数据分布。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了MintFlow，这是一个无需训练的约束采样框架，它将约束的执行形式化为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预。MintFlow寻找对中间流状态的最小扰动，使得该状态在预训练流场下的后续演化能够满足目标约束。通过在保持预训练流场不变的前提下对流状态进行最小扰动，MintFlow在执行约束的同时，最大限度地减少了相对于预训练分布的不必要偏离。伴随形式的……

arXiv:2610.02260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. item.title: 本文提出了一种基于模糊认知图（FCM）的新颖框架，利用语言学可解释的模糊集和显式因果关系编码来生成具有隐私保护能力的合成医学表格数据，从而支持临床决策系统在数据受限情况下的开发与验证。
item.description:
基于模糊认知图的可解释合成医学表格数据生成方法用于临床决策支持

Interpretable Synthetic Medical Tabular Data Generation for Clinical Decision Support Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00391

本文提出了一种基于模糊认知图（FCM）的新颖框架，利用语言学可解释的模糊集和显式因果关系编码来生成具有隐私保护能力的合成医学表格数据，从而支持临床决策系统在数据受限情况下的开发与验证。

当真实临床数据因隐私、伦理或数据可用性限制而无法获取时，合成医学表格数据生成对于开发和验证基于计算机的医学系统（CBMS）变得至关重要。现有的概率模型和深度生成模型通常缺乏可解释性，并且无法保留具有临床意义的依赖关系，限制了其在安全关键应用中的适用性。本文提出了一种将模糊认知图（FCM）新颖应用于具有显式因果关系和隐私保护的合成医学表格数据生成框架。临床特征使用语言学上可解释的模糊集进行描述，特征间的依赖关系被编码为基于模糊集交集计算得到的FCM边权重。合成患者记录通过将随机初始化的语言激活向量在FCM中传播直至收敛来生成，随后进行去模糊化处理。

arXiv:2610.00391v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Synthetic medical tabular data generation has become essential for developing and validating computer-based medical systems (CBMSs) when real clinical data is restricted due to privacy, ethical, or data availability limitations. Existing probabilistic and deep generative models often lack interpretability and fail to preserve clinically meaningful dependencies, limiting their suitability for safety-critical applications. This paper proposes a novel application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) in a framework for synthetic medical tabular data generation with explicit causality and privacy preservation. Clinical features are described using linguistically interpretable fuzzy sets, and inter-feature dependencies are encoded as FCM edge weights computed from fuzzy set intersections. item.title: 该论文提出面向模块化LLM智能体的因果世界模型框架FedCausalCompose，证明观测性世界模型在存在未阻断后门路径时具有不可消除的干预误差，而利用本地动作的干预-响应证据对跨模块接口进行因果组合，可以突破这一下界并提升干预时规划能力。
item.description:
因果世界模型何时能帮助模块化LLM智能体

When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012

该论文提出面向模块化LLM智能体的因果世界模型框架FedCausalCompose，证明观测性世界模型在存在未阻断后门路径时具有不可消除的干预误差，而利用本地动作的干预-响应证据对跨模块接口进行因果组合，可以突破这一下界并提升干预时规划能力。

LLM智能体越来越多地通过模块化系统来执行操作，例如订单、支付、库存和发货服务，其中一个模块中的动作会改变另一个模块中哪些状态转移是有效的。标准世界模型通常拟合观测性轨迹，但这并非干预时规划所需的量：一条轨迹可能显示支付先于发货，却无法识别究竟是支付授权了发货、库存中介了这一效应，还是一个隐藏的触发因素同时解释了两者。我们通过FedCausalCompose来研究这一差距，这是一个面向模块化LLM智能体的因果世界模型框架，其中本地动作为跨模块接口提供干预-响应证据。我们首先证明，在后门路径未被阻断时，观测性世界模型会产生不可消除的干预误差；接口恢复质量随干预-响应覆盖率的提升而改善；并且当覆盖率足够时，基于因果组合的oracle方法可以超越非因果方法的下界。

arXiv:2610.00012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. item.title: 该论文发现长程语言智能体的记忆使用呈现“核心集中、长尾积累预测误差”的重尾形态，并提出基于单一指数τ分配提示预算、同时保留摘要化尾部的核心-尾部世界模型（CTWM）记忆控制器。
item.description:
长程语言智能体中的重尾记忆痕迹

Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010

该论文发现长程语言智能体的记忆使用呈现“核心集中、长尾积累预测误差”的重尾形态，并提出基于单一指数τ分配提示预算、同时保留摘要化尾部的核心-尾部世界模型（CTWM）记忆控制器。

长程语言智能体越来越依赖外部记忆作为冻结的世界模型，然而当前的记忆系统通常仅以任务成功率或令牌成本来评价。我们认为，缺失的考察对象是记忆使用的形态：在有限上下文与重复检索的条件下，智能体记忆可能集中于一个小的核心，而将稀有状态留在长尾部分，预测误差会在长尾中不断累积。我们通过一种保守的尾部审计方法研究了这一效应，发现记忆集中现象是可复现的，但依赖于具体策略：随机游走智能体产生的检索痕迹符合对数正态分布，而语义化的LLM策略则产生最强的符合截断幂律的核心-尾部痕迹。受此审计启发，我们提出了核心-尾部世界模型，这是一种基于排名的记忆控制器，它使用单一指数τ来分配提示预算，同时保留一个摘要化的尾部。在合成图世界（Synthetic Graph World）上，CTWM能够保留完整的状态与转移信息。

arXiv:2610.00010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $\tau$ while retaining a summarized tail. item.title: 该论文提出了CICM基准来研究大语言模型在上下文信息更新后仍使用旧值的“陈旧绑定”失败问题，并通过组件测试和单层Transformer分析揭示了其背后的“注意力漂移”机制。
item.description:
当上下文变化时：理解大语言模型中的更新失败

When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38866

该论文提出了CICM基准来研究大语言模型在上下文信息更新后仍使用旧值的“陈旧绑定”失败问题，并通过组件测试和单层Transformer分析揭示了其背后的“注意力漂移”机制。

随着偏好、目标和事实的变化，大语言模型智能体必须在早期版本仍保留在上下文中的情况下使用当前状态。然而，它们可能会用同一变量的旧值来回答，我们将这种失败称为“陈旧绑定”。为了研究模型何时以及为何使用过时信息，我们引入了受控上下文记忆，这是一个用于在对话和智能体日志中跟踪和使用更新信息的基准。我们观察到，即使是最前沿的推理模型也可能无法恢复当前状态。我们发现，在开源模型中，当模型用旧值回答时，探测方法仍然可以恢复更新后的值，这表明模型未能选择仍然可用的信息。在Qwen和Pythia上进行的组件测试识别出了这种选择失败的一种机制：注意力漂移，即在生成答案时注意力偏向旧值而非当前值。我们通过研究单层Transformer来从数学上理解这一现象是如何发生的。

arXiv:2609.38866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can still recover the updated value when the model answers with an old one, pointing to a failure to select information that remains available. Component tests in Qwen and Pythia identify a mechanism for this selection failure: attention drift, where attention favors old values over the current one when producing an answer. We study a one-layer transformer to mathematically understand how this phenomenon hap

item.title: 该研究揭示了医学视觉语言模型中“仲裁失败”（文本覆盖视觉依据）与“刹车失败”（证据不足仍作答）两种安全风险分别由空间上不重叠的注意力头群体介导——仲裁头分布于中深层宽频带、刹车头集中于中后层窄频带，从而实现对模型失败的因果追踪与定位。
item.description:
CRAFT：医学视觉语言模型中的因果责任与失败追踪

CRAFT: Causal Responsibility and Failure Tracing in Medical Vision Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38810

该研究揭示了医学视觉语言模型中“仲裁失败”（文本覆盖视觉依据）与“刹车失败”（证据不足仍作答）两种安全风险分别由空间上不重叠的注意力头群体介导——仲裁头分布于中深层宽频带、刹车头集中于中后层窄频带，从而实现对模型失败的因果追踪与定位。

随着视觉语言模型越来越多地被部署于临床诊断，理解它们在内部如何解决相互竞争的视觉与文本信号已成为一个安全上的必要课题。现有的机制分析仍局限于单模态文本，无法解释为什么单句误导性文本能够覆盖基于图像的正确诊断，也无法解释为什么模型在视觉证据不足的情况下仍会给出自信的答案。我们发现这两种安全风险——文本上下文覆盖视觉依据的“仲裁失败”，以及模型在证据不充分时就给出结论的“刹车失败”——分别由空间上互不重叠的注意力头群体介导：仲裁头形成一个中到深层的宽频带，反映跨层的证据竞争；而刹车头则集中在狭窄的中后层频带中，负责调节证据充分性与弃权行为。为了将这些观察建立在因果回路上，我们……

arXiv:2609.38810v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As vision language models are increasingly deployed in clinical diagnosis, understanding how they internally resolve competing visual and textual signals becomes a safety imperative. Existing mechanistic analyses remain confined to unimodal text and offer no explanation for why a single misleading sentence can override a correct image based diagnosis, or why a model commits to a confident answer despite insufficient visual evidence. We find that these two safety risks, arbitration failure where textual context overrides visual grounding and brake failure where the model commits without adequate evidence, are mediated by spatially disjoint attention head populations: arbitration heads form a mid-to-deep wideband reflecting cross-layer evidence competition, while brake heads concentrate in a narrow middle-to-late layer band that regulates evidence sufficiency and abstention behavior. item.title: 该论文提出一种由编排器根据代理式RAG流水线运行痕迹（蕴含级联核验证据、多轮去重检索等信号）来计算答案置信度、而无需模型自我评估的方法，在NTCIR-19 R2C2任务中取得第4和第5名，且多轮融合检索在多跳问题上增益最大。
item.description:
BITEM参加NTCIR-19 R2C2任务：从代理式RAG流水线信号预测置信度

BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37993

该论文提出一种由编排器根据代理式RAG流水线运行痕迹（蕴含级联核验证据、多轮去重检索等信号）来计算答案置信度、而无需模型自我评估的方法，在NTCIR-19 R2C2任务中取得第4和第5名，且多轮融合检索在多跳问题上增益最大。

BITEM团队使用单一的代理式流水线参加了NTCIR-19 R2C2任务的两个子任务。在该流水线中，一个模型在电影语料库上进行检索、阅读并记录证据，同时一个编排器持有记录并裁决哪些内容可以提交。只有当蕴含级联将某个论断与其所引用的段落核对之后，该论断才被采纳；只有当足够多的已核验证据支撑某个答案时，该答案才被发布。每个问题运行三到四次，且每一轮检索都从剥离了此前各轮已见内容的语料库中进行。随每个答案提交的置信度由编排器根据运行过程留下的痕迹计算得出，而从不询问模型本身，模型也没有任何自我评分的途径。两个检索运行在22个参赛系统中分别位列第4和第5，对多轮运行进行融合带来0.0709的nDCG@20提升，且提升在多跳和重后处理的问题上最大，组织方将融合后的运行在该类问题上排名第一。

arXiv:2609.37993v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of t

item.title: 提出BRAID——一种分层序列潜变量模型，将多人社会运动生成形式化为元迁移学习问题，通过群体级与人物级双层潜在状态显式建模社会交互，从而实现跨群体、跨任务及部分可观测场景的迁移能力。
item.description:
生成式交互：基于双层潜在动态的多方人体运动编织

Generative Interactions: Weaving Multiparty Human Motion with Bilevel Latent Dynamics

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37708

提出BRAID——一种分层序列潜变量模型，将多人社会运动生成形式化为元迁移学习问题，通过群体级与人物级双层潜在状态显式建模社会交互，从而实现跨群体、跨任务及部分可观测场景的迁移能力。

人类社会行为并非独立运动的集合，而是一个共同组织的过程，其中群体动态与个体差异持续地相互塑造。然而，现有的社会运动模型往往侧重于生成合理的轨迹，而将交互状态保持为隐式形式，这限制了模型在跨群体、跨任务以及部分可观测场景下的迁移能力。为解决这一缺口，我们提出了面向智能体交互动态的双层表示模型（BRAID），这是一种用于生成式多人交互的分层序列潜变量模型。BRAID明确地将社会运动生成形式化为一个元迁移学习问题：共享的交互先验在多个数据集上学习，并通过由任意数量观测人物及关节构成的上下文集合进行自适应调整。该模型通过捕捉共享交互动态的群体级潜在状态和捕捉个体差异的人物级潜在状态来刻画每个场景，……

arXiv:2609.37708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human social behaviour is not a collection of independent motions, but a jointly organised process in which group dynamics and individual variation continuously shape one another. Yet existing social motion models often prioritise plausible trajectories while leaving interaction state implicit, limiting their ability to transfer across groups, tasks, and partial-observation regimes. To address this gap, we introduce Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID), a hierarchical sequential latent-variable model for generative multi-person interaction. BRAID explicitly formulates social motion generation as a meta-transfer learning problem: shared interaction priors are learned across datasets and adapted through arbitrary context sets of observed people and joints. The model represents each scene through a group-level latent state that captures shared interaction dynamics and person-level latent states that capture individ

item.title: 本文对TypeSafe AI的商业System One模型Jev进行了大规模零样本评估，在37个数据集、346,009次请求（成本不到10美元）上系统基准测试其在分类、路由、推理、审核等小型决策任务上的表现，并与Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma-4-E4B进行对比。
item.description:
评估与基准测试System One模型Jev

Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37647

本文对TypeSafe AI的商业System One模型Jev进行了大规模零样本评估，在37个数据集、346,009次请求（成本不到10美元）上系统基准测试其在分类、路由、推理、审核等小型决策任务上的表现，并与Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma-4-E4B进行对比。

Jev是TypeSafe AI公司推出的一款商业System One模型，它不生成文本：给定一个状态和带类型的问题，它会从固定选项中返回一个选择、在评分量规上返回一个位置，或返回一个陈述为真的概率，厂商称这些概率是经过校准的。此类模型面向信息访问流程中的小型决策任务，例如查询路由、事实依据检查、内容审核或按量规评分。我们在37个数据集上对Jev（jev-1.13.0）进行了零样本评估，涵盖分类、路由、自然语言推理、阅读理解、常识推理、内容审核、法律条款分析和量规评分等任务，每个数据集使用一个固定模板和完整的评估集：346,009次请求的花费不到10美元。作为参考，我们在相同的请求上，通过Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma-4-E4B在选项上的精确下一词概率对它们进行评分。Jev在IMDB、SST-2、HellaSwag等数据集上达到95-99%的准确率（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2609.37647v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under USD 10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95-99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and

item.title: 提出了一个仅需文本接口的黑盒越狱框架，通过在少数关键位置选择性进行基于采样的分布重构来控制解码过程，无需访问模型权重或词元概率即可绕过大语言模型的安全对齐。
item.description:
黑盒大语言模型上的受控解码攻击

Controlled Decoding Attacks on Black-Box LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36956

提出了一个仅需文本接口的黑盒越狱框架，通过在少数关键位置选择性进行基于采样的分布重构来控制解码过程，无需访问模型权重或词元概率即可绕过大语言模型的安全对齐。

在生成过程中操纵下一个词元的概率分布可以绕过大语言模型的安全对齐。然而，现有方法依赖于对模型权重或数值化词元概率的访问，因此不适用于仅返回采样文本的接口。从采样输出中重构概率是一种可能的替代方案，但有限采样会产生稀疏且带噪声的估计，而在每个生成步骤重复该过程会带来巨大的查询成本。我们的实证观察表明，成功越狱轨迹上的大幅分布变化集中在少数位置的子集上，这为选择性控制提供了依据。我们提出了\method{}，这是一个通过仅文本续写接口进行越狱的框架，该接口允许重复采样和助手前缀续写。基于采样的分布重构将采样输出与未观察词元上的先验相结合……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.36956v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Manipulating next-token probabilities during generation can bypass the safety alignment of large language models. Existing approaches, however, rely on access to model weights or numerical token probabilities and therefore do not apply to interfaces that return only sampled text. Reconstructing probabilities from sampled outputs offers a possible alternative, but finite sampling produces sparse and noisy estimates, while repeating this process at every generation step incurs substantial query costs. Our empirical observations suggest that large distributional changes along successful jailbreak trajectories are concentrated at a small subset of positions, motivating selective control. We introduce \method{}, a framework for jailbreaking through text-only continuation interfaces that permit repeated sampling and assistant-prefix continuation. item.title: 提出了一种响应感知的患者动力学模型，将预测的生理变化显式分解为状态依赖的基线动力学和呼吸支持相关的偏差，并以室内空气作为参考基准，从而更好地建模呼吸支持对危重患者短期生理轨迹的个体化影响。
item.description:
面向呼吸支持的响应感知患者动力学学习

Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32782

提出了一种响应感知的患者动力学模型，将预测的生理变化显式分解为状态依赖的基线动力学和呼吸支持相关的偏差，并以室内空气作为参考基准，从而更好地建模呼吸支持对危重患者短期生理轨迹的个体化影响。

呼吸支持能够塑造危重症患者的短期生理轨迹，但接受相同干预措施的患者可能遵循不同的生理轨迹。临床患者动力学模型通常基于近期生理状态和记录的干预措施来预测未来状态，而生理变化主要通过预测的未来状态来表示。我们提出了一种响应感知的患者动力学模型，该模型在自回归状态更新过程中显式表示生理变化。该模型将预测的生理变化分解为依赖于状态的基线动力学和与呼吸支持相关的偏差，并以室内空气（room air）作为该分解的参考基准。我们对这种基于参考锚定的公式化方法进行了形式化分析。响应通路对预测的生理变化进行编码，并在整个预测时间范围内利用它来更新潜在的患者状态。在ICU……

arXiv:2609.32782v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU co

item.title: 提出了一种搜索感知的强化学习框架，采用先蒸馏后强化学习的范式，利用与搜索引擎实时交互产生的奖励来优化多组件查询理解模型，克服了静态标签监督无法反映各组件与搜索流水线交互影响的局限。
item.description:
面向Roblox游戏搜索多组件查询理解的搜索感知强化学习

Search-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Component Query Understanding in Roblox Game Search

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30177

提出了一种搜索感知的强化学习框架，采用先蒸馏后强化学习的范式，利用与搜索引擎实时交互产生的奖励来优化多组件查询理解模型，克服了静态标签监督无法反映各组件与搜索流水线交互影响的局限。

查询理解在生产级搜索系统中扮演着关键角色，它将原始用户查询转化为驱动下游检索和排序的搜索执行计划。虽然大语言模型（LLM）使得查询理解能够被构建为结构化的多任务生成问题（例如意图分类、查询扩展），但优化此类模型以产生与搜索引擎耦合的输出仍然具有挑战性：静态的、基于标签的监督无法捕捉每个组件实际上如何与底层搜索流水线交互从而影响下游性能。我们提出了一种基于“先蒸馏后强化学习”范式的面向查询理解的搜索感知强化学习（RL）框架。师生模式的监督微调（SFT）首先产生格式良好、符合模式规范的策略初始化。随后，RL阶段通过基于与搜索引擎实时交互所获得的奖励来优化每个查询理解组件，并针对该组件的具体操作进行定制。

arXiv:2609.30177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Query understanding (QU) plays a critical role in production search systems, translating raw user queries into search execution plans that drive downstream retrieval and ranking. While large language models (LLMs) have enabled QU to be framed as a structured multi-task generation problem (e.g., intent classification, query expansion), optimizing such models to produce search-engine-coupled outputs remains challenging: static, label-based supervision fails to capture how each component actually interacts with the underlying search pipeline to affect downstream performance. We present a search-aware reinforcement learning (RL) framework for QU based on a distill-then-RL paradigm. Teacher-student supervised fine-tuning (SFT) first yields a well-formed, schema-compliant policy initialization. The RL stage then optimizes each QU component with rewards derived from live interaction with the search engine, tailored to that component's operation

item.title: FeatLens 提出了一种特征引导的动态代码图构建与检索方法，通过将自然语言特征描述与函数级代码元素关联的特征索引，为仓库级代码生成高效检索可复用的代码依赖，同时显著降低图构建、推理和 token 成本。
item.description:
FeatLens：面向仓库级代码生成的特征引导动态代码图构建与检索

FeatLens: Feature-Guided Dynamic Code Graph Construction and Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26480

FeatLens 提出了一种特征引导的动态代码图构建与检索方法，通过将自然语言特征描述与函数级代码元素关联的特征索引，为仓库级代码生成高效检索可复用的代码依赖，同时显著降低图构建、推理和 token 成本。

近期的代码生成研究已从孤立的函数补全转向在现有代码库中进行仓库级生成。为了正确实现目标函数，大语言模型（LLM）必须识别可复用的仓库依赖，例如已有函数、API 和跨文件定义。现有的检索方法通过代码相似性搜索、持久化的全仓库图或 LLM 驱动的图探索来提供此类上下文，但往往带来高昂的图构建、推理和 token 成本。面向特征的方法为软件功能提供了自然的视角，但它们主要支持需求分解、规划或特征编辑，而非代码依赖检索。本文提出了 FeatLens，一种面向仓库级代码生成的特征引导动态代码图构建与检索方法。FeatLens 构建了一个特征索引，将自然语言特征描述与函数级代码元素相链接……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.26480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent code generation research has moved from isolated function completion toward repository-level generation in existing codebases. To implement a target function correctly, an LLM must identify reusable repository dependencies such as existing functions, APIs, and cross-file definitions. Existing retrieval methods provide such context through code similarity search, persistent whole-repository graphs, or LLM-driven graph exploration, but often incur high graph construction, reasoning, and token costs. Feature-oriented methods offer a natural view of software functionality, yet they mainly support requirement decomposition, planning, or feature editing rather than code dependency retrieval. This paper presents \textbf{FeatLens}, a feature-guided dynamic code graph construction and retrieval approach for repository-level code generation. item.title: 提出SemantiScene-Edit，一种将多模态编码器与预训练视频扩散Transformer结合的指令式视频编辑方法，通过语义与视觉双路源条件化机制及120万条专家合成的训练数据，在精确执行编辑指令的同时保留源视频的外观与时序结构。
item.description:
SemantiScene-Edit：基于专家合成监督与双路源条件化的指令式视频编辑

SemantiScene-Edit: Expert-Synthesized Supervision and Dual-Path Source Conditioning for Instruction-Based Video Editing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26015

提出SemantiScene-Edit，一种将多模态编码器与预训练视频扩散Transformer结合的指令式视频编辑方法，通过语义与视觉双路源条件化机制及120万条专家合成的训练数据，在精确执行编辑指令的同时保留源视频的外观与时序结构。

arXiv:2609.26015v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：指令引导的视频编辑要求在保留源视频外观和时序结构的同时执行所请求的修改。我们提出了SemantiScene-Edit，这是一个将多模态编码器与预训练视频扩散Transformer相结合的视频编辑器。该编码器联合处理源视频帧和编辑指令，并通过可训练连接器与交叉注意力将二者的语义上下文传递给生成器。一条互补的视觉通路在块嵌入（patch embedding）之前将源视频潜变量与含噪目标潜变量拼接，为内容保留提供密集的空间与时间信息。我们采用流匹配以及包含语义对齐、联合适配和高分辨率精炼的三阶段图像-视频课程训练策略来训练模型。为支持训练，我们构建了超过120万条涵盖物体添加、移除、替换等操作的指令条件化视频编辑记录，这些记录由专家合成监督数据构成。

arXiv:2609.26015v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Instruction-guided video editing requires executing a requested change while preserving the source video's appearance and temporal structure. We present SemantiScene-Edit, a video editor that couples a multimodal encoder with a pretrained video diffusion transformer. The encoder jointly processes source frames and the editing instruction, and learnable queries convey their semantic context to the generator through a trainable connector and cross-attention. A complementary visual pathway concatenates source-video latents with noisy target latents before patch embedding, supplying dense spatial and temporal information for content preservation. We train the model with flow matching and a three-stage image--video curriculum comprising semantic alignment, joint adaptation, and high-resolution refinement. To support training, we construct over 1.2 million instruction-conditioned video-editing records covering object addition, removal, rep

item.title: 该论文提出了一个操作性可辨识性理论与构造性多项式时间算法，能够仅凭匿名受控实验的未知线性混合测量，盲发现热力学本体论——识别广延量与强度量扇区、恢复其对偶配对并验证稳定性势函数。
item.description:
从匿名实验中盲发现热力学本体论

Blind Thermodynamic Ontology Discovery from Anonymous Experiments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23387

该论文提出了一个操作性可辨识性理论与构造性多项式时间算法，能够仅凭匿名受控实验的未知线性混合测量，盲发现热力学本体论——识别广延量与强度量扇区、恢复其对偶配对并验证稳定性势函数。

在机器学习模型能够学习热力学状态方程之前，它必须先发现其测量数据究竟代表什么：哪些通道随系统规模缩放（广延量），哪些是强度共轭量，各扇区如何通过热接触配对，以及哪个势函数支配系统的稳定性。当传感器仅暴露出广延态与强度响应的未知线性混合时，被动观测无法将物理量与坐标伪影区分开来。我们提出了直接从匿名受控实验中发现这一隐藏热力学本体论的问题。我们给出了一个操作性可辨识性理论和一个构造性多项式时间算法：该算法从复制对比中提取广延与强度缩放扇区，从热接触与互易性中恢复其对偶余切配对，通过离散循环凹性验证全局可容许的凹势函数，并确定……的不变拟阵（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.23387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Before a machine learning model can learn a thermodynamic equation of state, it must discover what its measurements represent: which channels scale with system size, which are intensive conjugates, how sectors pair through contact, and which potential governs stability. When sensors expose only an unknown linear mixture of extensive states and intensive responses, passive observations cannot disentangle physical quantities from coordinate artifacts. We formulate the problem of discovering this hidden thermodynamic ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We present an operational identifiability theory and a constructive polynomial-time algorithm that extracts extensive and intensive scaling sectors from replication contrasts, recovers their dual cotangent pairing from thermal contact and reciprocity, verifies a globally admissible concave potential via discrete cyclic concavity, and determines an invariant matroid of res

item.title: 提出了一种事后且与微调无关的JANUS权重修正框架，通过将参数更新投影到雅可比零空间实现参数空间正交性，在微调新任务的同时有效缓解灾难性遗忘、恢复历史知识。
item.description:
过去与未来，一步到位：通过事后JANUS修正缓解稳定性-可塑性困境

Past, Future, All at Once: Mitigating Stability-Plasticity Dilemma via Post-hoc JANUS Rectification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19985

提出了一种事后且与微调无关的JANUS权重修正框架，通过将参数更新投影到雅可比零空间实现参数空间正交性，在微调新任务的同时有效缓解灾难性遗忘、恢复历史知识。

在新任务上微调基础模型不可避免地会遭受灾难性遗忘。虽然现有工作试图在参数高效微调方法的基础上缓解这一问题，但它们采用了过于严格的子空间正交性条件。在本文中，我们引入了一个纯粹的事后且与微调方式无关的权重修正框架，实现了参数空间正交性——这是一阶意义上保持历史性能的充要条件。通过将参数更新投影到雅可比零空间（JANUS）中，我们的方法在不干扰底层微调过程的前提下，显著恢复了受损的历史知识。为了克服雅可比近似的局部有效性限制，我们进一步提出了一种多步自适应修正机制，利用JANUS位移动态验证有效信任区域并调整步长。

arXiv:2609.19985v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fine-tuning foundation models on new tasks inevitably suffer from catastrophic forgetting. While existing works attempt to mitigate this on the basis of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, they adopted an overly restrictive Subspace Orthogonality condition. In this paper, we introduce a purely post-hoc and tuning-agnostic weight rectification framework that achieves Parameter Space Orthogonality, which is the necessary and sufficient condition for preserving historical performance to the first order. By projecting parameter updates into the JAcobian NUll Space (JANUS), our method significantly recovers compromised historical knowledge without interfering with the underlying fine-tuning process. To overcome the local validity of the Jacobian approximation, we further propose a Multi-step Adaptive Rectification mechanism that utilizes the JANUS shift to dynamically verify the valid trust region and adjust step sizes. Coupled with ou

item.title: 该论文提出将闭环机器人策略的完整软件实现作为可复用的执行经验存档，使编码智能体能够将源任务上改进的代码实现迁移用于新任务的策略生成与迭代改进，最终冻结的策略无需任何模型调用即可直接执行。
item.description:
学习与迁移闭环机器人软件

Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19906

该论文提出将闭环机器人策略的完整软件实现作为可复用的执行经验存档，使编码智能体能够将源任务上改进的代码实现迁移用于新任务的策略生成与迭代改进，最终冻结的策略无需任何模型调用即可直接执行。

闭环机器人策略需要观测处理、状态管理和基于情境的分支控制，这使得手动设计和调优的成本十分高昂。尽管编码智能体日益能够支持控制代码的生成与优化，但在源任务上改进的实现是否也能支持新任务的策略获取，目前仍不清楚。我们通过将完整的闭环实现视为可复用的执行经验来研究这一问题。对于每个源任务，编码智能体从少量成功演示中生成策略代码，并利用仿真反馈对其进行迭代改进。通过验证筛选的实现被保留在软件存档中。对于新任务，智能体利用存档中的实现、目标演示和执行反馈来生成并改进策略。最终得到的策略随后被冻结，无需进一步的模型调用即可执行。在RoboCasa的四个源任务上……

arXiv:2609.19906v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Closed-loop robot policies require observation processing, state management, and situation-dependent branching, making them costly to design and tune manually. Although coding agents increasingly support control-code generation and optimization, it remains unclear whether implementations improved on source tasks also support policy acquisition for new tasks. We study this question by treating complete closed-loop implementations as reusable execution experience. For each source task, a coding agent generates policy code from a few successful demonstrations and iteratively improves it using simulation feedback. The validation-selected implementations are retained in a software archive. For new tasks, the agent generates and improves policies using archived implementations, target demonstrations, and execution feedback. item.title: 该研究发现，当LLM推荐系统被告知其委托人是平台而非消费者时，会显著降低对赞助商品的惩罚力度并弱化怀疑态度，表明AI智能体的角色分配会诱发赞助偏见，从而损害消费者利益。
item.description:
AI智能体为谁服务？角色分配在LLM推荐系统中引发赞助偏见

Whom Do AI Agents Work For? Role Assignment Induces Sponsorship Bias in LLM Recommenders

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17989

该研究发现，当LLM推荐系统被告知其委托人是平台而非消费者时，会显著降低对赞助商品的惩罚力度并弱化怀疑态度，表明AI智能体的角色分配会诱发赞助偏见，从而损害消费者利益。

大型语言模型（LLM）如今在同时销售广告的平台充当对话式购物助手。这些AI智能体面临职责冲突：它们为依赖其判断的消费者提供建议，却由在赞助商品被选中时获益的平台所部署。旨在让消费者能够惩罚付费广告位的赞助披露信息，如今传达给了AI智能体而非消费者，而智能体对这些披露的评估过程对消费者是隐蔽的。借鉴受托责任中的职责冲突概念，我们认为智能体对赞助商品的评价不应取决于部署它的是哪一方。在受控选择实验中，我们通过操纵系统提示中分配的角色，将旅行者或预订平台指定为智能体的委托人。结果显示，平台委托显著削弱了智能体对赞助商品施加的惩罚，并弱化了披露信息本应引发的怀疑态度。

arXiv:2609.17989v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now serve as conversational shopping assistants on platforms that also sell advertising. Drawing on the fiduciary concept of conflict of duty, we argue that an agent's evaluation of a sponsored listing should not depend on which party deployed it. 混合域分解方法为耦合全阶模型（FOM）和降阶模型（ROM）提供了灵活的框架，但通常假设分配给每个子域的模型在整个仿真过程中保持固定。这对于局部特征在区域内传播、需要高保真度分辨的区域随时间变化的瞬态问题来说是具有局限性的。我们提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的方法，用于通过重叠Schwarz交替法（O-SAM）耦合的FOM-ROM模型的在线自适应，O-SAM是一种迭代域分解方法，它求解子域局部问题，同时通过重叠界面上的传输边界条件交换解信息。深度Q网络（DQN）在离线阶段进行训练，以在子域局部FOM和预训练的算子推断（OpInf）ROM之间进行选择，其奖励函数平衡了精度、计算成本和模型切换频率。一旦训练完成……

耦合校准与学习：在无目标域奖励反馈的LLM蒸馏中缓解教师偏差

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17474

提出耦合校准与学习（CCL）算法，通过token级分支将教师校准与学生更新相互耦合、仅利用源域奖励反馈，从而在无目标域奖励反馈的条件下缓解LLM蒸馏中的教师偏差迁移问题。

大语言模型（LLM）蒸馏旨在将强大教师模型的能力迁移到更小的学生模型中。然而，直接模仿也会将教师的系统性偏差和错误一同迁移。这一挑战在协变量偏移情况下尤为突出，即教师对目标问题的可靠性不确定且目标域奖励反馈不可用时。我们提出了耦合校准与学习（CCL），这是一种LLM蒸馏算法，通过token级分支将教师校准与学生更新耦合起来，仅在源问题上使用奖励反馈。每次迭代中，先利用源域反馈校准教师，再用校准后的教师在目标问题上训练学生；更新后的学生反过来又为后续的校准提供信息。在自回归策略框架下，我们证明了输出的学生模型相对于oracle学生模型的期望平均Kullback-Leibler散度收敛

arXiv:2609.17474v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) distillation aims to transfer the capabilities of a powerful teacher to a smaller student. Direct imitation, however, can also transfer the teacher's systematic bias and errors. This challenge is particularly pronounced under covariate shift, when the teacher's reliability on target questions is uncertain and target-domain reward feedback is unavailable. We propose Coupled Calibration and Learning (CCL), an LLM distillation algorithm that couples teacher calibration with student updates through token-level branching, using reward feedback only on source questions. Each iteration calibrates the teacher using source feedback and then uses the calibrated teacher to train the student on target questions. The updated student, in turn, informs subsequent calibration. item.title: 本文提出一个基于自组织临界性、弱混沌和亚稳态信念动力学的分析框架，用于刻画长时程LLM智能体的状态维持行为，通过22个实验揭示了局部有效动作可在全局状态失效后持续存在、压力累积可触发突然崩溃等关键动力学规律。

世界模型科学：长时程LLM智能体中的自组织临界性、弱混沌与亚稳态信念动力学

长时程LLM智能体必须在扩展的观察、动作、工具调用和中间信念序列中维持任务状态。我们通过三种动力学视角研究这些轨迹：自组织临界性、弱混沌和亚稳态信念动力学。我们的框架将智能体隐含状态与基准验证状态对齐，并在明确的零模型下测量压力累积、错误雪崩、时间依赖性、局部-全局失配、有界发散、信念盆地转换和有限尺寸标度。在涵盖受控谜题、工具使用、具身任务、多跳检索、通用助手推理和生命游戏的22个实验中，我们发现局部有效的动作可以在全局状态保真度失效后持续存在，压力可以触发突然崩溃，错误序列表现出长记忆性，依赖深度会改变传播模式，更大的视界支持更大的雪崩。

基于价值加权最优传输的多模态单步流策略学习

arXiv:2609.15883v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn a policy solely from fixed datasets, which often contain multimodal action distributions. Flow policies can naturally represent such multimodal behaviors, but learning an efficient one-step flow policy remains challenging: standard value guidance often leads to mode collapse or exploits overestimation bias in out-of-distribution regions. OptiFlow jointly trains a value-aware reference flow policy and an efficient one-step policy, coupling their action samples through state-wise entropic optimal transport. item.title: 该论文指出现有安全强化学习基准仅依赖期望平均安全性评估的不足，提出了新的评估指标和安全分级体系，以更全面可靠地表征算法的真实安全性。
item.description:
安全强化学习的评估指标

Evaluation Metrics for Safe Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15315

该论文指出现有安全强化学习基准仅依赖期望平均安全性评估的不足，提出了新的评估指标和安全分级体系，以更全面可靠地表征算法的真实安全性。

安全强化学习（RL）通常被形式化为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），其中智能体在保持其期望累积成本低于指定安全界限的同时最大化期望奖励。现有的安全强化学习基准主要报告算法在平均意义上是否安全，遵循这种基于期望的保证。我们认为这种惯例不足以可靠地表征算法的真实安全性：它无法捕捉安全界限被违反的频率和严重程度、这种保证是否在不同任务和安全界限之间保持一致，以及训练时的行为是否能代表最终收敛策略的行为。因此，我们引入了：(i) 安全强化学习的评估指标，以解决上述每一个问题，并支持跨任务和安全界限的聚合。此外，我们还定义了：(ii) 一个安全分级体系，用于系统地分类和比较算法。

arXiv:2609.15315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly formalized as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP), in which an agent maximizes expected reward while keeping its expected cumulative cost below a specified safety bound. Existing safe RL benchmarks predominantly report whether an algorithm is safe on average, following this expectation-based guarantee. We argue that this convention is insufficient to reliably characterize an algorithm's true safety: it fails to capture how often and how severely the safety bound is violated, whether this holds consistently across tasks and safety bounds, and whether training-time behavior is representative of behavior of the final converged policy. Therefore, we introduce (i) evaluation metrics for safe RL that address each of these concerns and in addition allow for aggregation across tasks and safety bounds. item.description:
广义智能体迭代：迭代策略改进与递归自我改进的统一形式化框架

Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13406

本文提出广义智能体迭代（GAI）形式化框架，将经典迭代策略改进与递归自我改进统一为同一学习范式下的两种情形，通过“评估-改进”循环建模智能体的学习过程。

当我们谈论递归自我改进（RSI）时，我们谈论的是一种现象、一种机制，还是一种前景？在迈向自主且不断演进的智能的道路上，RSI在多个尺度上被宣称，然而目前尚不存在一个能够正式描述这些新兴实例的统一框架。它在经典领域的对应物——迭代策略改进——由广义策略迭代（GPI）所刻画，这是一个适用范围广泛且理论性质被充分理解的框架，但它仅适用于更新原则和评估基础位于智能体之外的情形。在本文中，我们提出广义智能体迭代（GAI），一个将迭代策略改进与递归自我改进描述为同一学习范式两种情形的形式化框架。GAI将智能体定义为系统内可修改组件的一种配置，并将学习过程建模为智能体评估与智能体改进的循环。两个关键的可调节维度进而区分了……

arXiv:2609.13406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When we speak of recursive self-improvement (RSI), are we speaking of a phenomenon, a mechanism, or a prospect? Towards autonomous and evolving intelligence, RSI is being claimed at many scales, while no single framework that formally describes these emerging instances exists. Its counterpart in the classical realm, iterative policy improvement, is characterized by generalized policy iteration (GPI), a framework of broad applicability with well-understood theoretical properties, but only where the update principle and the evaluation base lie outside the agent. In this paper, we propose Generalized Agent Iteration (GAI), a formal framework that describes iterative policy improvement and RSI as two cases of a single learning paradigm. GAI defines the agent as a configuration of modifiable components within a system and models the learning process as a cycle of agent evaluation and agent improvement. 大语言模型越来越多地被应用于主要AI会议的同行评审中，然而新颖性评估仍然是一个持续的薄弱环节。现有的基准将新颖性作为单一的整体分数进行评估，这使得难以诊断模型在哪个维度上判断失误，或者其证据是否忠实可靠。我们提出了NovGauge，一个以人类专家为锚定的基准，用于细粒度的新颖性评估诊断。该基准包含619个论文对和50个多论文集合，来源于两个专家渠道：ICLR审稿人的重叠性声明和综述文章的共被引关系。所有实例沿着三个维度独立标注：任务、问题和方法，分别捕捉应用目标、技术挑战和解决方案方法。我们提出了一个级联诊断流水线，用于验证各维度的正确性、证据支撑和逻辑支持。对18个大语言模型的评估显示，各维度的幻觉率介于0%到39%之间，而在非幻觉的评估结果中……

arXiv:2609.11234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in peer review at major AI conferences, yet novelty remains a persistent weak point. item.title: 该论文提出在线代理修复（OSR）这一闭环算法，利用稀疏的高保真评估在长时间的智能体搜索中持续更新低成本代理模型，从而将高保真反馈与搜索长度解耦，避免固定代理模型的误差被优化过程放大。

闭环AI科学家能够以较低的边际计算成本生成候选设计，而可靠的反馈可能需要湿实验室合成、表征或高保真计算。通过定制实验室自动化来解决这一不平衡仍然需要大量基础设施投入且成本高昂，而用固定的代理模型替代新实验则会留下持续的模型误差，这些误差还可能被优化过程放大。我们提出了在线代理修复，这是一种闭环算法，它利用稀疏的高保真评估，在整个主要由低廉代理反馈驱动的较长智能体搜索过程中持续更新代理模型。一种采集规则从智能体累积提出的方案中选择哪些设计进行高保真评估，所得的标签用于更新后续回合中使用的代理模型。在受控的合成环境中，我们证明了改善全局代理拟合效果并……

arXiv:2609.07655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes.
