item.title: 本文通过对近5万篇论文进行多方法计算文本分析，首次系统绘制了大语言模型社会科学这一新兴领域的研究图谱，将其划分为“LLM作为社会心智”、“LLM社会”和“LLM-人类交互”三大领域及13个子类别。
item.description:
大语言模型新兴社会科学的图谱绘制

Mapping the Emerging Social Science of Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07598

本文通过对近5万篇论文进行多方法计算文本分析，首次系统绘制了大语言模型社会科学这一新兴领域的研究图谱，将其划分为“LLM作为社会心智”、“LLM社会”和“LLM-人类交互”三大领域及13个子类别。

大语言模型（LLM）日益影响着人类的沟通、学习、工作、创造力和决策，然而针对这些发展的社会科学研究仍然较为零散。我们利用一个经精心筛选、全文审阅的198篇论文语料库，以及来自五个文献数据库的47,719篇已发表论文构成的领域规模语料库，对这一新兴领域进行了系统图谱绘制。通过结合句子嵌入、K-means聚类、簇内潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）、作者与LLM分类以及结构主题建模等方法，我们识别出三个研究领域：LLM作为社会心智——研究具有社会可解释性的模型行为；LLM社会——研究基于模型的交互智能体之间的集体动态；LLM-人类交互——研究人们如何感知、使用大语言模型以及受到其影响。这些领域包含13个子类别，涵盖推理、人格与偏见、行为博弈、集体智能、仿真模拟、信任、工作、创造力等方面……

arXiv:2609.07598v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape communication, learning, work, creativity, and decision-making, yet social-science research on these developments remains fragmented. We map this emerging field using a curated corpus of 198 papers reviewed in full and a field-scale corpus of 47,719 published papers from five bibliographic databases. Combining sentence embeddings, K-means clustering, within-cluster Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), author and LLM classifications, and structural topic modeling, we identify three domains: LLM as Social Minds, examining socially interpretable model behavior; LLM Societies, examining collective dynamics among interacting model-based agents; and LLM-Human Interactions, examining how people perceive, use, and are affected by LLMs. These domains contain 13 subcategories spanning reasoning, personality and bias, behavioral games, collective intelligence, simulation, trust, work, creativity, and

item.title: 本文提出从P&ID图纸中恢复显式证据图，并约束视觉语言模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图作答、使拓扑结论必须引用支持的查询结果，从而将TopoPID-VQA上的精确匹配准确率从约36.7–41.3%大幅提升至约74%。
item.description:
有依据且忠实的管道与仪表图推理：利用恢复的证据图约束视觉语言模型

Grounded and Faithful P&ID Reasoning: Constraining Vision-Language Models with Recovered Evidence Graphs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05880

本文提出从P&ID图纸中恢复显式证据图，并约束视觉语言模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图作答、使拓扑结论必须引用支持的查询结果，从而将TopoPID-VQA上的精确匹配准确率从约36.7–41.3%大幅提升至约74%。

管道与仪表图（P&ID）是过程工厂的权威地图：隔离、维护和HAZOP决策都依赖于“什么连接到什么”。视觉语言模型能够流畅地描述这些图纸，但它们经常虚构或遗漏工艺连接——而一个被虚构或遗漏的连接可能颠覆隔离或可达性判断，因此工厂决策不能信任从未对照图纸线条核查过的流畅回答。我们转而恢复图纸的显式图结构——包括其符号、符号之间的工艺连接以及命名它们的标签——然后要求模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图来作答，从而保证只有当拓扑断言引用了支持它的查询结果时才会被返回。在TopoPID-VQA（一个针对这些图纸、包含3000个拓扑问题的新测试集）上，图接地框架（Graph-Grounded Harness，本文方法）将精确匹配准确率从仅图像提示下的36.7–41.3%提升到74%（原文截断于此）。

arXiv:2609.05880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) are the authoritative maps of process plants: isolation, maintenance, and HAZOP decisions depend on what connects to what. Vision-language models describe these sheets fluently, yet they often invent or miss process connections---and an invented or missed link can reverse an isolation or reachability call, so a plant decision cannot trust a fluent answer that was never checked against the linework. We instead recover an explicit graph of the drawing---its symbols, the process connections between them, and the tags that name them---and then require the model to answer only by querying that graph through seven read-only operators, so a topology claim is returned only when it cites the query results that support it. On TopoPID-VQA, a new suite of 3000 topology questions over these sheets, Graph-Grounded Harness (Ours) raises exact match accuracy from 36.7--41.3% under image-only prompting to 74.

item.title: 本文借鉴认识论提出“认识论依据”这一决策层面新构念，通过四级依赖证书框架区分不同稳定性与适用范围的模型推荐，为用户在缺乏真实标准时有原则地判断是否依赖大语言模型的具体推荐提供了理论基础与操作化方法。
item.description:
大语言模型推荐的认识论依据：在缺乏真实标准时刻画依赖的基础

Epistemic Warrant for LLM Recommendations: Characterizing the Basis for Reliance When Ground Truth Is Unavailable

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04127

本文借鉴认识论提出“认识论依据”这一决策层面新构念，通过四级依赖证书框架区分不同稳定性与适用范围的模型推荐，为用户在缺乏真实标准时有原则地判断是否依赖大语言模型的具体推荐提供了理论基础与操作化方法。

大语言模型越来越多地被用于支持组织决策，然而用户在评估是否应该依赖某个具体推荐时，往往缺乏有原则的依据。现有方法通常评估模型的宽泛属性，如可靠性、不确定性或鲁棒性，或者聚焦于用户信任，而不是依赖单个推荐的底层基础。通过借鉴认识论的理论基础，我们引入了“认识论依据”这一决策层面的构念，用于刻画模型偏好的稳定性以及该偏好成立的范围。我们通过对成对推荐的四级依赖证书来操作化这一构念，区分出不稳定、上下文依赖、局部支持和广泛支持四类推荐。我们使用当代方法论验证了这一构念：已知组测试成功恢复了专家预先指定的依据。

arXiv:2609.04127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to support organizational decisions, yet users often lack a principled basis for assessing whether to rely on a specific recommendation. Existing approaches typically evaluate broad model properties, such as reliability, uncertainty, or robustness, or focus on user trust, rather than the underlying basis for relying on an individual recommendation. Adapting theoretical foundations from epistemology, we introduce epistemic warrant, a decision-level construct that characterizes the stability of a model's preference and the scope over which that preference holds. We operationalize this construct through a four-tier reliance certificate for pairwise recommendations, distinguishing among unstable, context-dependent, locally supported, and broadly supported recommendations. We validate the construct using contemporary methodologies: known-groups tests successfully recover expert-prespecified warrant

item.title: 研究发现大语言模型的反嵌入矩阵中存在一个编码训练语料词元分布的“无知方向”，模型通过逐词元调节该先验的强度，实现了随上下文信息增加而逐步减弱先验影响的温度调节贝叶斯更新。
item.description:
无知的几何学：大语言模型知道何时调节贝叶斯先验

The Geometry of Ignorance: LLMs Know When to Temper Bayesian Priors

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02959

研究发现大语言模型的反嵌入矩阵中存在一个编码训练语料词元分布的“无知方向”，模型通过逐词元调节该先验的强度，实现了随上下文信息增加而逐步减弱先验影响的温度调节贝叶斯更新。

当语言模型缺乏线索时，它会预测什么？答案隐藏在其反嵌入矩阵的几何结构中：反嵌入矩阵的一个单一方向编码了训练语料库的词元分布，它充当了模型在不确定时回退依赖的贝叶斯先验。我们将这一结构称为“无知方向”，它出现在所有四个被检验的模型家族中（Llama、Qwen、Gemma 和 Pythia），参数规模从 0.4B 到 405B 不等。将最终预测状态投影到该方向上可得到逐词元的先验载荷因子 λ，经验表明该因子随着上下文信息量的增加而稳步下降。从形式上看，同样的投影将预测状态分解为两个正交向量，它们恰好对应于温度调节贝叶斯更新的两个因子：被提升到指数 λ 的词元先验以及由上下文驱动的似然。

arXiv:2609.02959v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: What does a language model predict when it has few clues? The answer lurks in its unembedding geometry: a single direction of the unembedding matrix encodes the unigram distribution of the training corpus, which serves as the Bayesian prior the model falls back on when uncertain. This structure --- which we term the \emph{direction of ignorance} --- appears in all four model families examined (\texttt{Llama}, \texttt{Qwen}, \texttt{Gemma}, and \texttt{Pythia}), ranging from 0.4B to 405B parameters. Projecting the final prediction state onto this direction yields a per-token \emph{prior loading factor} $\lambda$, which, empirically, declines steadily as the context becomes more informative. Formally, the same projection decomposes the prediction state into two orthogonal vectors that correspond exactly to the two factors of a tempered Bayesian update: a unigram prior raised to the exponent $\lambda$ and a context-driven likelihood. This

item.title: OutageDiT是一个基于全美停电与天气数据训练的生成式基础模型，能以15分钟分辨率生成七天停电轨迹，在单一模型中统一实现停电点预测、不确定性量化和条件情景模拟。
item.description:
OutageDiT：面向停电预测与情景模拟的生成式基础模型

OutageDiT: A Generative Foundation Model for Power Outage Forecasting and Scenario Simulation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01896

OutageDiT是一个基于全美停电与天气数据训练的生成式基础模型，能以15分钟分辨率生成七天停电轨迹，在单一模型中统一实现停电点预测、不确定性量化和条件情景模拟。

停电规划需要在事件发生之前获得情景，这些情景必须在呈现规模、发生时间和持续时间不确定性的同时，保留时间上的依赖关系。然而，严重停电事件非常罕见，任何单一地区的数据中都几乎没有极端停电与恢复模式的样本。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了OutageDiT，一个用于以15分钟分辨率生成七天停电轨迹的基础模型，该模型基于全美范围内的停电和天气记录进行训练。具体而言，条件编码器在每次预测中对历史上下文和已知的未来协变量仅处理一次，随后浅层流（flow）解码器复用所得到的与预测时域对齐的状态来生成完整轨迹。所得样本能够在同一个深度生成模型中支持点预测、不确定性量化和条件事件模拟。在停电预测基准测试中，OutageDiT提升了预测……

arXiv:2609.01896v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Power-outage planning requires scenarios before an event occurs. These scenarios must represent uncertainty in magnitude, timing, and duration while preserving temporal dependence. However, severe events are rare, and data from any single region contain few examples of extreme outage and restoration patterns. To address this challenge, we introduce OutageDiT, a foundation model for generating seven-day outage trajectories at quarter-hour resolution, trained on outage and weather records across the United States. Specifically, a condition encoder processes the historical context and known future covariates once per forecast, and a shallow flow decoder reuses the resulting horizon-aligned states to generate complete trajectories. The resulting samples support point forecasting, uncertainty quantification, and conditional event simulation within one deep generative model. item.title: 本文提出面向真实世界部署的AI临床试验推荐系统TrialGPT 2.0，它不仅评估患者资格，还结合患者临床需求和本地工作流优先级筛选值得进一步考虑的试验，并提供了结构化的可审查解释，在政府、学术癌症中心等多种肿瘤学场景中完成了回顾性与前瞻性多中心评估。
item.description:
迈向AI辅助的临床试验匹配：实践考量、多中心评估与真实世界部署

Towards AI-Assisted Clinical Trial Matching: Practical Considerations, Multicenter Evaluation, and Real-World Deployment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01202

本文提出面向真实世界部署的AI临床试验推荐系统TrialGPT 2.0，它不仅评估患者资格，还结合患者临床需求和本地工作流优先级筛选值得进一步考虑的试验，并提供了结构化的可审查解释，在政府、学术癌症中心等多种肿瘤学场景中完成了回顾性与前瞻性多中心评估。

临床试验对于推进癌症治疗和药物研发至关重要，但许多试验因患者入组不足而失败。尽管人们利用AI支持患者招募的兴趣日益浓厚，现有系统大多仅执行资格评估，且很少在真实世界的肿瘤学工作流程中得到评估。在此，我们提出TrialGPT 2.0，一个为真实世界部署而设计的AI辅助临床试验推荐系统。该系统不仅评估患者是否符合入组条件，还会根据患者当前的临床需求和本地工作流程优先级，评估哪些试验值得进一步考虑，并提供结构化、可审查的解释供专家审核。重要的是，我们在多个专注于肿瘤学的环境中对TrialGPT 2.0进行了回顾性和前瞻性评估，涵盖政府、学术癌症中心、患者倡导组织和NIH转诊等多种工作流程。

arXiv:2609.01202v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Clinical trials are essential for advancing cancer care and drug development, but many fail because of insufficient patient enrollment. While there is growing interest in using AI to support patient recruitment, existing systems largely perform eligibility assessment alone and have rarely been evaluated in real-world oncology workflows. Here we present TrialGPT 2.0, an AI-assisted clinical trial recommendation system designed for real-world deployment. Rather than asking only whether a patient may qualify, the system also assesses which trials warrant further consideration given the patient's current clinical needs and local workflow priorities, and provides structured, inspectable explanations for expert review. Importantly, we evaluated TrialGPT 2.0 retrospectively and prospectively across multiple oncology-focused settings, spanning government, academic cancer-center, patient-advocacy, and NIH referral workflows. item.title: 该论文提出了VoiceLongMemEval（VLME）基准，用于评估AI助手在长时多会话对话中能否记住情感、韵律和语音事件等副语言信息，发现现有大语言模型普遍存在无法捕捉说话方式的“情感鸿沟”。
item.description:
VoiceLongMemEval：助手是否记得你的声音听起来如何？

VoiceLongMemEval: Do Assistants Remember How You Sounded?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00570

该论文提出了VoiceLongMemEval（VLME）基准，用于评估AI助手在长时多会话对话中能否记住情感、韵律和语音事件等副语言信息，发现现有大语言模型普遍存在无法捕捉说话方式的“情感鸿沟”。

随着多智能体架构和大语言模型规模的不断增长，部署的AI助手越来越多地需要对长且连续的多会话对话历史进行推理。当前的基准测试将这种对话历史评估视为长时程信息检索、时间推理或知识更新，却关键性地忽略了人机交互的基本动态，即“他们是怎么说的”（说话方式）。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了VoiceLongMemEval（VLME）基准，其中每个问题的答案都依赖于附加在对话轮次上的副语言元数据（情感标签、韵律描述符和语音事件），而这些信息仅凭文字本身是无法恢复的。每个测试项都经过三阶段对抗性门控验证，确保强大的语言模型在仅获得文本转录时无法回答。对领先的前沿模型和开放权重模型的评估揭示了普遍存在的“情感鸿沟”；提供文本轨道的副语言元数据……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.00570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the growing scale of multi-agent architectures and large language models, deployed AI assistants are increasingly tasked with reasoning over long, continuous, multi-session conversation histories. Current benchmarks evaluate this dialogue history as information retrieval over long horizon, temporal reasoning, or knowledge updates, while crucially ignoring the fundamental dynamics of human-agent interaction, i.e. how they said it. To address this gap, we present VoiceLongMemEval (VLME) benchmark, where every answer depends on paralinguistic metadata (emotion labels, prosody descriptors, and voice events) attached to conversational turns, which is otherwise unrecoverable from the words alone. Every item passes a three-stage adversarial gate, ensuring that a strong language model fails when given only the transcript. Evaluating leading frontier and open-weight models reveals a pervasive affect gap; providing text-track paralinguistic m

item.title: ATLAS提出了一个双视野诊断评估框架，通过请求层面的轨迹级诊断信号（定位缺陷的执行位置与能力问题）和交互层面的用户级信号（评估持续交互中的服务响应一致性），对工业工具使用智能体进行全面的诊断式评估。
item.description:
ATLAS：面向工业工具使用智能体的双视野诊断评估框架

ATLAS: Dual-Horizon Diagnostic Evaluation for Industrial Tool-Use Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30685

ATLAS提出了一个双视野诊断评估框架，通过请求层面的轨迹级诊断信号（定位缺陷的执行位置与能力问题）和交互层面的用户级信号（评估持续交互中的服务响应一致性），对工业工具使用智能体进行全面的诊断式评估。

大语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被部署于面向用户的服务中，这类服务需要在动态业务条件下进行迭代式工具调用。可靠的评估对持续改进至关重要：它必须能够揭示能力缺陷、指导优先级排序并评估干预措施的效果。然而，工业级智能体服务既通过当前请求的迭代轨迹展开，也通过用户与系统的持续交互展开。因此，仅评估最终结果可能会掩盖缺陷产生的具体位置，以及后续服务是否仍与早期交流的上下文保持一致。我们提出了ATLAS，一个面向工业工具使用智能体的双视野诊断评估框架。在请求视野层面，基于轨迹的诊断信号将缺陷与执行位置及能力问题相关联；在交互视野层面，基于用户的信号评估服务在持续交互过程中是否保持响应性。两者结合，这些视角为……

arXiv:2608.30685v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in user-facing services that require iterative tool use under dynamic business conditions. Reliable evaluation is essential for sustained improvement: it must reveal capability deficiencies, inform priorities, and assess interventions. Yet industrial agent service unfolds both through the iterative trajectory of a current request and through continued user interaction. Final-outcome assessment can therefore obscure where deficiencies arise and whether later service remains aligned with context from earlier exchanges. We propose ATLAS, a dual-horizon diagnostic evaluation framework for industrial tool-use agents. At the request horizon, trajectory-wise diagnostic signals relate deficiencies to execution locations and capability concerns. At the interaction horizon, user-wise signals assess whether service remains responsive across continued interaction. Together, these views prov

item.title: 提出RCCA强化学习框架，将评分标准级别的功能反馈转化为针对局部代码区域的优化信号，解决了标准GRPO在交互式Web应用生成中信用分配不足的问题。
item.description:
面向强化学习的评分标准到代码的信用分配

Rubric-to-Code Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27906

提出RCCA强化学习框架，将评分标准级别的功能反馈转化为针对局部代码区域的优化信号，解决了标准GRPO在交互式Web应用生成中信用分配不足的问题。

交互式Web应用程序生成要求模型根据自然语言请求生成可用的HTML、CSS和JavaScript应用程序。与传统的代码生成不同，应用程序的质量取决于多个面向用户的功能需求，而每个需求通常与局部化的代码区域相关联，例如事件处理器、状态更新、DOM片段或CSS选择器。标准的GRPO将这些结构化的结果压缩为单一的序列级奖励，并将所得的优势统一应用于所有token，从而削弱了信用分配。我们提出了评分标准到代码的信用分配（RCCA），这是一个强化学习框架，它将评分标准级别的功能反馈转换为针对生成代码的局部化优化信号。RCCA围绕明确的功能评分标准构建训练任务，使用分层奖励来区分格式、源代码、运行时和功能层面的失败，并将评估器生成的文本……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2608.27906v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Interactive web application generation requires models to produce usable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript applications from natural language requests. Unlike conventional code generation, application quality depends on multiple user-facing functional requirements, each often tied to localized code regions such as event handlers, state updates, DOM fragments, or CSS selectors. Standard GRPO collapses these structured outcomes into a single sequence-level reward and applies the resulting advantage uniformly to all tokens, weakening credit assignment. We propose \textbf{Rubric-to-Code Credit Assignment} (RCCA), a reinforcement learning framework that converts rubric-level functional feedback into localized optimization signals over generated code. RCCA builds training tasks around explicit functional rubrics, uses a hierarchical reward to separate format, source-code, runtime, and functional failures, and aligns evaluator-generated textual att

item.title: 该论文提出了一个由大语言模型驱动、基于数据手册的早期硬件兼容性自动验证框架，通过构建设计图和可追溯的模块化验证阶段，在原理图设计与实现之前自动识别文档级别的接口不兼容问题。
item.description:
基于大语言模型、数据手册感知的早期原理图前嵌入式系统设计自动化硬件兼容性验证

LLM-Driven, Datasheet-Aware Automated Hardware Compatibility Verification for Early-Stage, Pre-Schematic Embedded System Design

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25217

该论文提出了一个由大语言模型驱动、基于数据手册的早期硬件兼容性自动验证框架，通过构建设计图和可追溯的模块化验证阶段，在原理图设计与实现之前自动识别文档级别的接口不兼容问题。

我们提出了一种由大语言模型驱动、基于数据手册感知的早期硬件兼容性验证框架，该框架能够基于硬件数据手册和高层组件连接描述，识别文档级别的接口不兼容问题。该框架不需要详细的原理图仿真和实现，因此可以在这些步骤之前使用。我们将可信赖的大语言模型辅助设计自动化视为并非直接从文档生成答案，而是通过可追溯的验证阶段来转换工程信息。给定硬件数据手册和高层组件连接描述，该框架构建一个捕获设备连接和共享交互领域的设计图，仅检索明确的、面向领域的验证标准所需的工程属性，并生成用于兼容性评估的确定性脚本。通过将兼容性分析分解为模块化阶段……

arXiv:2608.25217v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an LLM-driven, datasheet-aware framework for early-stage hardware compatibility verification that identifies documentation-level interface incompatibilities based on hardware datasheets and high-level component connectivity descriptions. It does not require, and can therefore be used, before detailed schematic simulation and implementation. We view trustworthy LLM-assisted design automation not as directly generating answers from documents, but as transforming engineering information through traceable verification stages. Given hardware datasheets and high-level component connectivity descriptions, the framework constructs a design graph that captures device connectivity and shared interaction domains, retrieves only the engineering properties required by explicit, domain-oriented verification criteria , and generates deterministic scripts for compatibility evaluation. item.title: RePolicy通过强化学习动态调用安全策略，实现了对未见轨迹和变化策略上下文的高鲁棒性安全检测。
item.description:
RePolicy：智能体安全防护中安全策略调用的强化学习

RePolicy: Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Policy Invocation in Agent Safeguards

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24275

RePolicy通过强化学习动态调用安全策略，实现了对未见轨迹和变化策略上下文的高鲁棒性安全检测。

摘要：arXiv:2608.24275v1 公告类型：新 摘要：保护语言模型智能体需要在上下文相关的安全策略下评估完整的执行轨迹。现有的策略感知防护主要依赖于提示或监督微调，限制了其适应未见轨迹和变化策略上下文的能力。我们提出了RePolicy，一种通过强化学习学习安全策略调用的智能体防护方法。给定智能体轨迹和动态策略库，RePolicy调用适用策略，并利用其内容生成基于策略的理由和安全判断。我们构建了PolicyTraj-20K以支持监督初始化，随后使用GRPO结合可验证奖励和策略上下文扰动。在六个智能体安全基准上的实验表明，RePolicy在变化策略上下文下实现了强大的整体安全检测性能和稳健的策略调用。

arXiv:2608.24275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safeguarding language model agents requires assessing complete execution trajectories under context-dependent safety policies. Existing policy-aware safeguards mainly rely on prompting or supervised fine-tuning, limiting their ability to adapt to unseen trajectories and changing policy contexts. We propose RePolicy, an agent safeguard that learns safety-policy invocation through reinforcement learning. Given an agent trajectory and a dynamic policy library, RePolicy invokes the applicable policy and uses its content to produce a policy-grounded rationale and safety judgment. We construct PolicyTraj-20K to support supervised initialization, followed by GRPO with verifiable rewards and policy-context perturbation. Experiments across six agent safety benchmarks show that RePolicy achieves strong overall safety-detection performance and robust policy invocation under varying policy contexts.

item.title: 本研究首次系统性地揭示了LLM多代理交易系统中，仅通过操纵源数据和提示即可实现低门槛的对抗性攻击，且该攻击能跨角色和架构传播至最终交易决策，造成实际财务损失。
item.description:
毒化代理Alpha：多代理交易系统中跨角色与架构的对抗性漏洞

Poisoning Agentic Alpha: Adversarial Vulnerabilities Across Roles and Architectures in Multi-Agent Trading Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24069

本研究首次系统性地揭示了LLM多代理交易系统中，仅通过操纵源数据和提示即可实现低门槛的对抗性攻击，且该攻击能跨角色和架构传播至最终交易决策，造成实际财务损失。

arXiv:2608.24069v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：基于LLM的多代理交易系统，其中专门代理通过结构化通信协作产生交易决策，正迅速从研究原型转向控制真实资产的实际部署。使它们有效的代理间通信同时也暴露了它们：一个被破坏的信号可以传播到最终决策，并转化为实际财务损失。与先前假设对系统内部具有特权访问的攻击不同，我们将对手限制在实际可达到的范围内——代理消费的源数据和提示——从而产生一个低门槛、因此民主化的威胁模型，实例化为角色特定对手。我们提出了金融领域首个系统性实证研究，以描述对抗性信号如何进入多代理交易系统，以及它在向决策传播过程中能存活多远。沿角色轴，我们分解了一个广泛使用的交易管道。

arXiv:2608.24069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent trading systems, in which specialized agents collaborate through structured communication to produce trading decisions, are moving rapidly from research prototypes to live deployments that control real assets. The same inter-agent communication that makes them effective also exposes them: a corrupted signal can propagate to the final decision and translate into realized financial loss. Unlike prior attacks that presume privileged access to system internals, we restrict the adversary to what is practically reachable---the source data and prompts agents consume---yielding a low-barrier, and thus democratized threat model instantiated as role-specific adversaries. We present the first systematic empirical study in the financial domain to characterize how an adversarial signal enters a multi-agent trading system and how far it survives toward the decision. item.title: GlanceWAM通过在单一视频DiT骨干上将视觉想象与控制解耦——以异步方式在后台生成前瞻帧并直接在潜空间中消费——实现了机器人实时控制（48毫秒）与更优任务成功率的兼得。
item.description:
GlanceWAM：面向世界-动作模型的稀疏测试时想象

GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23927

GlanceWAM通过在单一视频DiT骨干上将视觉想象与控制解耦——以异步方式在后台生成前瞻帧并直接在潜空间中消费——实现了机器人实时控制（48毫秒）与更优任务成功率的兼得。

视频生成模型为机器人学习提供了丰富的物理先验，然而现有的世界-动作模型面临一个根本性的权衡：以控制频率同步生成视频的延迟过高而不可行，而放弃测试时的视觉想象则会牺牲任务成功率。我们证明，当视觉想象以异步方式在关键路径之外生成、并直接在潜空间中被消费时，既能实现实时推理，又能获得更优的任务成功率。我们提出GlanceWAM，它在单一共享的视频DiT骨干上将想象与控制解耦：一个异步提议器以较慢的时钟“瞥视”前方，在后台想象未来数秒的单个前瞻帧，同时动作头以控制频率（48毫秒）纯粹在潜空间中解码动作块，不产生任何阻塞。该方法得益于一个隔离视频表示的非干扰注意力掩码，以及一种能够适应过时预测的抗陈旧视界训练机制。

arXiv:2608.23927v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control on a single shared video DiT backbone: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. item.title: 该论文提出了rebuild-dossier工具，通过预先锁定应用接口并强制执行逐测试构建，揭示了测试可被操纵时通过套件不能保证正确性，且在较大应用上不如简单指令方法。
item.description:
重建档案：为智能体应用重建实施机械强制规格，以及模型层级失败所揭示的问题

Rebuild Dossier: Mechanically-Enforced Specs for Agentic App Rebuilds, and What Model-Tier Failures Reveal

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23616

该论文提出了rebuild-dossier工具，通过预先锁定应用接口并强制执行逐测试构建，揭示了测试可被操纵时通过套件不能保证正确性，且在较大应用上不如简单指令方法。

人工智能智能体的重建质量取决于其生成过程。先前的研究发现，一旦模型足够强大，多智能体重建流程反而会输给最简单的方法：将原始代码和一条指令直接交给模型（即AgentModernize方法）。我们提出了rebuild-dossier，这是一个开源工具，它在编写任何代码之前锁定应用程序的真实接口——即其精确的输入和输出——然后通过自动化检查而非仅依赖书面指令，强制执行一次只构建一个测试的流程。三项结果构成了本次评估，且证据程度各不相同。首先，在一项小型比较中，合规的智能体未能通过一个保留测试，而违反规则的智能体则全部通过——这证明了当测试可能被操纵时，通过的测试套件并不能保证正确性。其次，我们测试了这种方法是否优于简单地将源代码和一条指令交给较弱模型的方法：在小型应用上结果持平，但在较大应用上则完全落败。

arXiv:2608.23616v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An AI agent's rebuild is only as good as the process that produced it. Prior work found that once a model is strong enough, a multi-agent rebuild pipeline loses to the simplest approach: giving the model the original code and one instruction (AgentModernize). We present rebuild-dossier, an open-source tool that locks an application's real interface - its exact inputs and outputs - before any code is written, then enforces one-test-at-a-time building through automated checks, not written instructions alone. Three results shape this evaluation, with differing amounts of evidence. First, in a small comparison, the compliant agent failed a held-back test while the rule-breaking agent passed everything - proof that a passing suite doesn't certify correctness when tests can be gamed. Second, we tested whether this beats simply giving the weaker model the source and one instruction: tied on a small app, but lost outright on a larger one whe

item.title: 本文提出EAFG框架，通过结合VLM生成的探索子目标和TAMP执行来获取视觉证据，并应用可行性门控决策，从而在部分可观测环境中提高长期操作任务的完成率。
item.description:
基于视觉-语言模型的证据门控任务与运动规划

Evidence-Gated Task and Motion Planning with Vision-Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20084

本文提出EAFG框架，通过结合VLM生成的探索子目标和TAMP执行来获取视觉证据，并应用可行性门控决策，从而在部分可观测环境中提高长期操作任务的完成率。

arXiv:2608.20084v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：机器人在根据自然语言指令执行长期操作任务时，必须同时推理语义任务结构和几何可行性。然而，在部分可观测性条件下，目标相关对象的可用性可能是不确定的。在这种情况下，结合视觉-语言模型（VLMs）与任务和运动规划（TAMP）的方法可能会生成依赖VLM先验知识但缺乏观测支持的子目标，导致执行失败或意外结果。我们提出了证据获取与可行性门控（EAFG）框架，该框架通过VLM生成的探索性子目标和基于TAMP的执行来获取视觉证据。EAFG随后应用一个可行性门控来决定是继续任务规划、获取更多证据，还是停止。我们的实验表明，在对象使用模糊的烹饪任务中，EAFG通过提前发现任务相关对象，提高了食谱完成率。

arXiv:2608.20084v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robots executing long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions must reason about both semantic task structure and geometric feasibility. However, under partial observability, the availability of goal-relevant objects may be uncertain. In such cases, approaches that combine Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) may generate subgoals that rely on the VLM's prior knowledge without observational support, leading to execution failures or unintended outcomes. We propose Evidence Acquisition and Feasibility Gating (EAFG), a framework that acquires visual evidence through VLM-generated exploratory subgoals and TAMP-based execution. EAFG then applies a feasibility gate to decide whether to proceed with task planning, acquire further evidence, or halt. Our experiments show that, in cooking tasks with ambiguous object use, EAFG improves recipe completion by discovering task-relevant objects before

item.title: 该论文发现预训练提升了大语言模型对局部几何关系的解码能力，但草图级自由度状态的可解码性主要源于随机初始化表示，而非预训练，揭示了模型编码与行为之间的差距。
item.description:
编码但不可操作：审计冻结大语言模型中几何约束的解码-生成-转向差距

Encoded but Not Actionable: Auditing the Decode-Generate-Steer Gap in Frozen LLMs for Geometric Constraints

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17843

该论文发现预训练提升了大语言模型对局部几何关系的解码能力，但草图级自由度状态的可解码性主要源于随机初始化表示，而非预训练，揭示了模型编码与行为之间的差距。

大型语言模型（LLMs）在结构化推理任务上表现出色，但它们编码了什么以及这些编码是否影响模型行为仍不清楚。我们通过几何推理来研究这个问题，使用参数化CAD约束作为受控测试平台，以区分局部成对关系与草图级约束状态。通过探测六个冻结的仅解码器LLMs的隐藏状态，我们检查了四个属性：线性可解码性、强制选择生成、激活级影响和行为可转向性。预训练显著改善了对局部几何关系的解码，并且在用洗牌顺序控制考虑位置线索后，这种优势仍然存在。相比之下，草图级自由度状态从随机初始化的表示中已经高度可解码，预训练仅带来适度改善，表明其探测性能的很大部分无需预训练即可获得。

arXiv:2608.17843v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on structured reasoning tasks, but what they encode and whether it informs model behavior remain unclear. We investigate this question through geometric reasoning, using parametric CAD constraints as a controlled testbed for separating local pairwise relations from sketch-level constraint status. By probing the hidden states of six frozen decoder-only LLMs, we examine four properties: linear decodability, forced-choice generation, activation-level influence, and behavioral steerability. Pretraining substantially improves the decoding of local geometric relations, and this advantage persists after accounting for positional cues with shuffled-order controls. In contrast, sketch-level DOF status is already highly decodable from randomly initialized representations and improves only modestly with pretraining, indicating that much of its probe performance is available without

item.title: 本文提出智能应由过程而非输出定义，并定义了跨七个特征的强等价标准，以应对GenAI外包人类认知过程导致的能力缺失风险。
item.description:
过程构成智能：人类与机器的共同标准

Process-Constituted Intelligence: A Shared Criterion for Humans and Machines

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16213

本文提出智能应由过程而非输出定义，并定义了跨七个特征的强等价标准，以应对GenAI外包人类认知过程导致的能力缺失风险。

智能由“过程”（通过迭代活动产生输出）构成，而非输出本身。生成式人工智能（GenAI）基于“痕迹”（人类认知过程留下的文本和视觉残留）进行训练，从这些痕迹的分布中重现样本。其输出类似于推理、问题解决和创造力，但在人类中产生此类输出的活动在很大程度上缺失。因此，当前GenAI与其模仿的认知弱等价，匹配输出而过程缺失或模糊。认知科学长期以来区分弱等价和强等价。在此，我们定义了跨七个过程特征的“强”等价，可针对人类和机器认知进行评估。我们的基于过程的解释应对了一个对称风险：外包个人生成过程的GenAI工具可能使关键能力未得到发展。我们指定了设计原则。

arXiv:2608.16213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intelligence is constituted by \textit{process} (iterative activity through which output emerges), not in the output itself. Generative AI (GenAI) is trained on \textit{traces} (textual and visual residues of human cognitive processes), reproducing samples from a distribution of those traces. Its outputs resemble reasoning, problem-solving, and creativity, yet the activity that produces such outputs in humans remains largely absent. Current GenAI is, therefore, weakly equivalent to the cognition it imitates, matching outputs while process stays absent or opaque. The cognitive sciences have long distinguished between weak and strong equivalence. Here, we define \textit{strong} equivalence across seven process features, assessable against human and machine cognition. Our process-based account addresses a symmetric risk: GenAI tools that outsource a person's generative processes may leave critical capacities unbuilt. We specify design princ

item.title: 我们推出了DiG-bench基准，包含70个独立游戏，旨在通过未知规则和未知胜利条件的交互实验，评估AI在受控环境中的科学发现能力，并设置了七个难度等级以挑战不同水平的模型。
item.description:
DiG-bench：游戏中的发现

DiG-bench: Discovery in Games

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.12593

我们推出了DiG-bench基准，包含70个独立游戏，旨在通过未知规则和未知胜利条件的交互实验，评估AI在受控环境中的科学发现能力，并设置了七个难度等级以挑战不同水平的模型。

发现——即提出新颖的概括——是科学过程的核心部分。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但在当前AI基准测试领域中仍存在空白，很少有基准测试能直接在受控环境中（且目标未知）评估通过实验发现新知识的能力。为填补这一空白，我们发布了一个新基准：DiG-bench（游戏中的发现）。DiG-bench包含70个独立游戏，每个游戏编码为短字符串，并具有独特的变换规则，这些规则必须通过交互和实验来发现。游戏关卡呈现一系列挑战，以测试规则是否已被发现，且每个关卡的胜利条件也是未知的。我们为AI代理提供了七个难度等级的游戏。最低等级可由多种模型常规解决，而最高等级则挑战了代理框架中最优秀的模型。

arXiv:2608.12593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discovery---formulating novel generalizations---is a central part of the scientific process. Despite its importance, there is a gap in the current AI benchmark landscape, with few benchmarks directly probing the capacity for discovering new knowledge with experimentation in controlled environments where the objective is unknown. To address this gap, we release a new benchmark: DiG-bench (Discovery in Games). DiG-bench consists of a set of 70 independent games. Each game is encoded as a short string and has unique transformation rules that must be discovered through interaction and experimentation. The levels of the game present a series of challenges to test whether the rules have been discovered, where the win conditions for each level are also unknown. We provide games at seven tiers of difficulty for AI agents. The lowest tier is routinely solvable by multiple models, while the highest tier challenges the best models in agentic harnes

item.title: 本文提出一个从开发者交互历史中提取个性化技能的框架，并实证研究这些技能是否能泛化到未来任务，以改善编码代理的协作效率。
item.description:
个性化技能是否有助于编码代理？开发者交互历史的实证研究

Do Personalized Skills Help Coding Agents? An Empirical Study of Developer Interaction Histories

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10319

本文提出一个从开发者交互历史中提取个性化技能的框架，并实证研究这些技能是否能泛化到未来任务，以改善编码代理的协作效率。

基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理已迅速从代码补全工具演变为解决复杂软件工程任务的求解器。随着开发者随时间与编码代理协作，他们的偏好通过重复交互逐渐显现，并可用于调整代理行为以更好地满足个体开发者的需求。捕捉和重用这些偏好可能减少重复修正，并改善开发者-代理协作。代理技能提供了一种轻量级的机制，无需修改模型参数即可传递经验。然而，现有工作主要关注任务特定技能，尚不清楚从交互历史中提炼的开发者特定技能是否能泛化到未来任务。我们提出了一个框架，用于从交互轨迹中提取可重用的开发者偏好。它首先通过基于规则的引导和证据接地生成个性化技能。

arXiv:2608.10319v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents have rapidly evolved from code-completion tools into solvers of complex software engineering tasks. As developers collaborate with coding agents over time, their preferences emerge through repeated interactions and can be used to adapt agent behavior to better meet individual developers' needs. Capturing and reusing these preferences may reduce repeated corrections and improve developer-agent collaboration. Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for transferring experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing work primarily focuses on task-specific skills, and it remains unclear whether developer-specific skills distilled from interaction histories can generalize to future tasks. We propose a framework for extracting reusable developer preferences from interaction traces. It first generates personalized skills through rule-based bootstrapping and evidence-grounded

item.title: 针对大昆梅拉等数千万级人群聚集场景，KumbhDoot 提出“语义缓存优先、LLM 兜底”的架构，仅在语义检索无法给出正确答案时才调用大语言模型，从而实现低成本、低延迟、抗幻觉且网络中断下仍可靠的安全关键公共服务助手。
item.description:
KumbhDoot：一种面向大规模人群聚集公共服务助手的可扩展、LLM受限架构

KumbhDoot: A Scale-Ready, LLM-Bounded Architecture for Mass-Gathering Public-Service Assistants

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07520

针对大昆梅拉等数千万级人群聚集场景，KumbhDoot 提出“语义缓存优先、LLM 兜底”的架构，仅在语义检索无法给出正确答案时才调用大语言模型，从而实现低成本、低延迟、抗幻觉且网络中断下仍可靠的安全关键公共服务助手。

大昆梅拉（Kumbh Mela）等大型宗教集会在数周内将数千万人聚集到同一区域，产生了高强度、重复性、多语言且关乎人身安全的信息服务需求。默认的应对方案——将每个查询都路由到大语言模型（LLM）的对话式助手——与这种场景并不匹配：它在规模化使用时成本高昂，在紧急请求路径上响应缓慢，容易在可能导致人身伤害的事实性问题上产生幻觉，并且在网络连接中断时完全无法使用。我们介绍了 KumbhDoot，一个为纳西克 Simhastha 大昆梅拉构建的智能体式朝圣者助手，它建立在一种截然不同的原则之上。其基础设计原则是优先采用语义相似度匹配，而非一开始就调用 LLM。只有当基于相似度的检索不足以产生正确答案时，才会调用生成式模型。该系统利用一种“语义缓存”（semantic cache），即以嵌入向量索引的存储，作为单一的……（原文摘要到此截断）

arXiv:2608.07520v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Mass religious gatherings such as the Kumbh Mela concentrate tens of millions of people into a single region over a few weeks, producing intense, repetitive, multilingual, and safety-critical demand for information. The default response, a conversational assistant that routes every query to a large language model (LLM), is poorly matched to this setting: it is costly at scale, slow on emergency paths, prone to hallucination on facts that can cause physical harm, and unusable when connectivity fails. We describe KumbhDoot, an agentic pilgrim assistant for the Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela built on a different principle. It operates on a foundational design principle that prioritizes semantic similarity over starting with an LLM. Generative models are invoked only in instances where similarity-based retrieval is insufficient to produce a correct answer. The system utilizes a "semantic cache": an embedding-indexed store as a single

item.title: WNM-3D通过冻结的几何编码器提取3D场景表示，并将其作为条件来联合生成未来观察和导航动作，从而改进了连续视觉语言导航中的世界行动模型。
item.description:
WNM-3D：一种具有3D场景条件的世界导航模型，用于闭环视觉语言导航

WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07267

WNM-3D通过冻结的几何编码器提取3D场景表示，并将其作为条件来联合生成未来观察和导航动作，从而改进了连续视觉语言导航中的世界行动模型。

arXiv:2608.07267v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：最近的视觉语言导航（VLN）系统越来越多地将预训练的视觉语言模型（VLMs）适应为视觉语言行动（VLA）策略，这些策略将自我中心的观察和语言指令直接映射到导航动作。尽管在语义上具有能力，但这种以行动为中心的训练并未明确建模代理的视觉观察应如何在其预测运动下演变。生成式世界行动模型（WAMs）联合预测未来观察和行动，然而，现有的用于连续VLN的WAMs并未将联合的未来视图和行动生成条件化为从观察历史中推断出的几何感知表示。我们提出了WNM-3D，一种具有3D场景条件的生成式世界导航模型，用于连续VLN。为了将过去的观察整合为持久的场景上下文，一个冻结的前馈几何编码器从单眼自我中心RGB历史中提取几何感知表示，该表示随后用于条件化未来视图和行动的生成。

arXiv:2608.07267v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. To consolidate past observations into persistent scene context, a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts geometry-aware representations from the monocular egocentric RGB history, an

item.title: 本文揭示了搜索代理中通过中介搜索界面协调注入受控结果可显著提升攻击成功率的安全漏洞，挑战了仅针对静态注入的现有防护。
item.description:
面包屑式搜索代理

Breadcrumbing Search Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04565

本文揭示了搜索代理中通过中介搜索界面协调注入受控结果可显著提升攻击成功率的安全漏洞，挑战了仅针对静态注入的现有防护。

arXiv:2608.04565v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：基于LLM的搜索代理被广泛用于信息检索任务，但其对外部工具返回结果的依赖引入了严重的安全风险：执行过程中检索到的网页内容不可信，使代理面临提示注入和目标劫持的威胁。先前关于搜索代理安全的研究主要集中于静态网页内容注入，但现代代理会发出后续查询并交叉核对竞争来源，因此单个注入页面通常会被稀释或拒绝。我们表明，传递搜索和页面观察结果的通道是一个脆弱的安全边界：除了使代理暴露于单个被污染页面之外，中介搜索界面还可以反复引导代理如何收集证据并形成最终答案。在受限的工具中介威胁模型下，当证据在代理的轨迹中协调一致时，每次查询仅附加一个受控结果就能显著提高攻击成功率。

arXiv:2608.04565v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: LLM-based search agents are widely used for information-seeking tasks, but their reliance on external tool returns introduces a critical security risk: web content retrieved during execution is untrusted, exposing agents to prompt injection and goal hijacking. Prior work on search-agent safety primarily focuses on static web-content injection, but modern agents issue follow-up queries and cross-check competing sources, so a single injected page is often diluted or rejected. We show that the channel delivering search and page observations is a fragile security boundary: beyond exposing the agent to a single poisoned page, a mediated search interface can repeatedly steer how the agent gathers evidence and forms its final answer. Under a constrained tool-intermediary threat model, appending only one controlled result per query can substantially increase attack success when the evidence is coordinated across the agent's trajectory.

item.title: 本文发现，在不同规模的Transformer模型间转换时，表示对齐强但参数对齐弱，价值在于初始化，并通过最小二乘补偿和方差保持重缩放两个杠杆实现有效转换。
item.description:
布线优于混合：不同Transformer规模之间传递了什么——以及什么没有传递

Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02829

本文发现，在不同规模的Transformer模型间转换时，表示对齐强但参数对齐弱，价值在于初始化，并通过最小二乘补偿和方差保持重缩放两个杠杆实现有效转换。

arXiv:2608.02829v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：模型家族通常按规模逐个从头训练。能否将预训练的大模型转换为较小的兄弟模型？我们端到端地表征了Pythia中的1.4B->410M转换。表示在不同规模间强烈对齐（岭回归R^2=0.84），而参数对齐较弱。密集权重投影在功能上具有破坏性，且一个比特精确的控制表明这不是组装伪影：基混合破坏了旋转、每头、GELU和LayerNorm结构。在最佳拟合线性算子之后，权重残差在洗牌控制下在统计上与噪声无异。因此，转换价值存在于初始化中。在匹配预算的持续预训练中，我们将转换分解为两个独立杠杆：最小二乘补偿（功能杠杆，最佳零样本）和方差保持重缩放（动力学杠杆，最佳终点）。补偿是一种令牌高效、低预算的胜利，而非其他。

arXiv:2608.02829v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Model families are typically trained size by size, each from scratch. Can a pretrained large model instead be converted into a smaller sibling? We characterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in Pythia end to end. Representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parameters align weakly. Dense weight projection is functionally destructive, and a bit-exact control shows this is not an assembly artifact: basis mixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure. After the best-fit linear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noise under shuffle controls. Conversion value therefore lives in initialization. In matched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into two independent levers: least-squares compensation (function lever, best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics lever, best endpoints). item.title: 提出了一种基于连续自回归架构的语音编辑模型 dots.tts.edit，通过半形式化的、基于转写文本的编辑指令，将操作类别与参数绑定到文本片段或边界，从而对文本、情感、韵律和停顿四类语音编辑实现“做什么”与“在哪里”的精确控制。
item.description:
dots.tts.edit：基于连续自回归模型的精确可控语音编辑

dots.tts.edit: Precisely Controlled Speech Editing with a Continuous Autoregressive Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02673

提出了一种基于连续自回归架构的语音编辑模型 dots.tts.edit，通过半形式化的、基于转写文本的编辑指令，将操作类别与参数绑定到文本片段或边界，从而对文本、情感、韵律和停顿四类语音编辑实现“做什么”与“在哪里”的精确控制。

面向内容创作的语音编辑需要对“编辑应做什么”以及“编辑应作用于何处”实现精确控制。自由形式的自然语言为表达编辑请求提供了灵活的接口，但其模糊性可能导致预期的操作、参数或目标区域定义不清。我们研究了一种半形式化的、基于转写文本的编辑指令，该指令明确指定操作类别和参数，并将其绑定到转写文本的片段或边界上。这种语义时间线避免了显式的时间戳对齐，并为组合式编辑提供了可从外部审查的契约。我们在 dots.tts.edit 中实现了该接口，这是一个基于连续自回归语音生成架构构建的语音编辑模型。四种代表性的语音创作控制涵盖了词汇内容、情感表达、音高与语速的呈现方式，以及通过文本、情感、韵律和停顿编辑实现的时间性措辞控制。

arXiv:2608.02673v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Speech editing for content creation requires precise control over both what an edit should do and where it should apply. Free-form natural language provides a flexible interface for expressing edit requests, but its ambiguity may leave the intended operation, parameters, or target region underspecified. We study a semi-formal transcript-grounded edit instruction that specifies operation categories and parameters and binds them to transcript spans or boundaries. This semantic timeline avoids explicit timestamp alignment and provides an externally inspectable contract for compositional edits. We instantiate the interface in dots$.$tts$.$edit, a speech editing model built on a continuous autoregressive speech generation architecture. Four representative speech-creation controls cover lexical content, affective expression, pitch and speaking-rate delivery, and temporal phrasing through text, emotion, prosody, and pause editing. item.title: 本文发布了包含53.6K条真实IDE内开发者对AI生成代码编辑记录的DECODE数据集，揭示了AI代码被编辑的时间与原因规律，为训练和改进代码大模型提供了比Git提交更真实、更细粒度的数据来源。
item.description:
从5.36万条真实世界开发者对AI生成代码的编辑中学习

Learning from 53.6K Real-World Developer Edits of AI-Generated Code

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25130

本文发布了包含53.6K条真实IDE内开发者对AI生成代码编辑记录的DECODE数据集，揭示了AI代码被编辑的时间与原因规律，为训练和改进代码大模型提供了比Git提交更真实、更细粒度的数据来源。

AI生成代码中的缺陷要求软件开发者手动修改生成的代码，或者通过重新向AI编程助手提示来修改。手动代码编辑比Git提交提供关于编辑行为更真实、更细粒度的信息，因为Git提交仅包含最终成功的代码片段。然而，由于缺乏高质量、真实的代码编辑数据，大型语言模型（LLM）大多在公开可用的Git数据（如提交记录）上进行训练。为弥补这一空白，我们推出了DECODE（开发者代码编辑数据集，Developer Edits of Code Dataset），这是一个包含53.6K条真实IDE内对AI生成代码编辑的数据集，涵盖Python、TypeScript和JavaScript，数据来自1000多名开发者。首先，我们展示了DECODE在数据分析方面的实用性，获得了关于AI生成代码在何时、为何以及如何被编辑的洞察。我们发现大多数编辑发生在接受AI补全后的前15分钟内，导致在31%的编辑场景中AI补全被移除。

arXiv:2607.25130v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Imperfections in AI-generated code require that software developers modify the generated code manually, or by re-prompting an AI programming assistant. Manual code edits provide more realistic and granular information on editing behavior than Git commits, which only contain final successful code snippets. Yet, due to a lack of high-quality, realistic code editing data, LLMs are mostly trained on publicly available Git data (e.g., commits). To address this gap, we introduce DECODE (Developer Edits of Code Dataset), a dataset of 53.6K real-world in-IDE code edits of AI-generated code in Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript, sourced from 1K+ developers. First, we demonstrate the utility of DECODE for data analysis, obtaining insights on when, why, and how AI-generated code is edited. We find that most edits occur within the first 15 minutes after accepting an AI completion, resulting in the removal of AI completions in 31% of edit t

item.title: 该论文提出了GUEST初步指南，通过快速综述、思想实验和作者自身经验，为研究人员在系统性文献综述中如何使用和评估生成式AI工具提供了方法论建议。
item.description:
GUEST：使用和评估生成式AI工具以支持系统性文献综述的初步指南

GUEST: Preliminary Guidelines for Using and Evaluating GenAI Tools to Support Systematic Literature Reviews

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24991

该论文提出了GUEST初步指南，通过快速综述、思想实验和作者自身经验，为研究人员在系统性文献综述中如何使用和评估生成式AI工具提供了方法论建议。

背景：生成式人工智能（GenAI）和大语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程及其他领域越来越多地被用于学术任务，包括系统性文献综述（SLRs）。然而，尽管它们的能力正在快速发展，但并不能保证它们能够满足系统性文献综述所要求的严谨性、可靠性和透明度。目标：旨在为打算使用GenAI开展系统性文献综述的研究人员，以及开展实证研究以评估GenAI对SLR任务支持程度的研究人员提供支持。方法：首先，我们进行了一项快速综述，以识别那些提出评估和使用GenAI与LLM来支持SLR指南的研究。其次，我们借助思想实验、文献中的相关指导意见，以及我们自己在开展系统性文献综述和评估工具方面的经验，制定了在SLR背景下如何使用和评估GenAI的建议。结果：我们对评估者角色和用户角色的方法论问题进行了分类（摘要内容在此处截断）。

arXiv:2607.24991v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Context: Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for academic tasks in software engineering and beyond, including systematic literature reviews (SLRs). However, whilst their capabilities are rapidly developing, there is no guarantee they can meet the rigour, reliability, and transparency that SLRs require. Objectives: To support researchers intending to conduct SLRs using GenAI, or those conducting empirical studies to evaluate how well GenAI supports SLR tasks. Methods: First, we conducted a rapid review to identify studies that propose guidelines for evaluating and using GenAI and LLMs to support SLRs. Second, we drew on thought experiments, relevant guidance from the literature, and our own experience from conducting SLRs and evaluating tools, to develop recommendations for how to use and assess GenAI in the context of SLRs. Results: We classify methodological issues for the roles of eval

item.title: GLASS是一个无需训练的个性化文本生成框架，利用稀疏自编码器提取全局用户风格先验并构建局部对比风格向量，将二者注入模型不同层，无需检索或参数更新即可实现上下文感知的个性化生成，性能超越现有基线方法。
item.description:
从用户画像到导向向量：面向个性化文本生成的全局稀疏先验与局部语义校准

From Profiles to Steering Vectors: Global Sparse Priors and Local Semantic Calibration for Personalized Text Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21620

GLASS是一个无需训练的个性化文本生成框架，利用稀疏自编码器提取全局用户风格先验并构建局部对比风格向量，将二者注入模型不同层，无需检索或参数更新即可实现上下文感知的个性化生成，性能超越现有基线方法。

个性化文本生成要求模型从历史数据中捕捉用户特定的写作风格。现有基于检索、参数高效微调或激活导向的方法，要么引入推理和存储开销，要么难以将风格信号与语义内容分离。我们提出GLASS，一个通过带稀疏先验的全局-局部激活导向实现个性化生成的无需训练框架。GLASS利用稀疏自编码器从历史回复中提取全局用户风格先验，并在聚类后的交互场景上构建局部对比风格向量。在推理阶段，它将全局和局部向量共同注入模型的不同层，无需检索或参数更新即可实现上下文感知的个性化。在LaMP和LongLaMP数据集上的实验表明，GLASS在ROUGE指标和大语言模型评判评估上均优于基于检索、微调和导向的基线方法。

arXiv:2607.21620v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Personalized text generation requires models to capture user-specific writing styles from historical data. Existing approaches based on retrieval, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, or activation steering either introduce inference and storage overhead or struggle to separate stylistic signals from semantic content. We propose GLASS, a training-free framework for personalized generation via Global-Local Activation Steering with Sparse priors. GLASS uses sparse autoencoders to extract a global user-style prior from historical responses and constructs local contrastive style vectors over clustered interaction scenarios. During inference, it jointly injects global and local vectors into different model layers, enabling context-aware personalization without retrieval or parameter updates. arXiv:2607.19305v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have attracted growing interest, but many basic components remain tied to specific manifolds, rely on Euclidean approximations, or require costly and numerically fragile geometric operations. This thesis develops a unified framework for Riemannian deep learning from three complementary perspectives: reusable neural modules, manifold-specific network architectures, and the design of underlying geometries. It generalizes batch normalization from Euclidean spaces and individual manifolds to broad classes of Lie groups and gyrogroups, and extends multinomial logistic regression from Euclidean space to SPD manifolds and then to general Riemannian manifolds. Two evaluation staff independently coded all 507 findings as accept, edit, or reject; the primary measure was the unanimous usable rate, defined as the share both accepted or edited. Results. 本文通过受控实验系统揭示了免训练合成图像归因中表示空间选择（CLIP与DINOv2不同层的表示）和参考选择策略（任意、语义对齐、基于再合成）之间的耦合关系及其对归因性能的影响。

合成图像归因旨在识别生成给定AI生成图像的生成器。免训练的基于参考的归因方法易于扩展，因为新出现的生成器可以通过添加特定来源的参考图像来纳入，而无需重新训练特定任务的分类器。其性能取决于两个相互耦合的因素：用于比较的表示空间以及构建特定来源参考的方式。然而，这两个因素之间的相互作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们使用参考图像和现成的预训练表示对这种相互作用进行了受控分析。我们研究了从CLIP和DINOv2不同层提取的表示，以及三种具有不同语义约束的参考选择策略：任意参考、语义对齐参考和基于再合成的参考。我们的结果表明，归因……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2607.12052v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Synthetic image attribution aims at identifying the generator responsible for a given AI-generated image. Training-free reference-based attribution methods are easily scalable, since newly emerging generators can be incorporated by adding source-specific references rather than retraining a task-specific classifier. Their performance depends on two coupled factors: the representation space used for comparison and the way source-specific references are constructed. However, the interaction between these two factors remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we provide a controlled analysis of this interaction using references and off-the-shelf pretrained representations. item.title: 本文证明Andreas与Günther最新提出的“事实性差异制造”因果定义同时体现了其区分的三种竞争性理论类型，表明这些区分毫无实质差别，并通过关键例子的比较动摇了他们全部七种事实因果定义。
item.description:
制造差异却未产生差异

Difference-Making without Making a Difference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24832

本文证明Andreas与Günther最新提出的“事实性差异制造”因果定义同时体现了其区分的三种竞争性理论类型，表明这些区分毫无实质差别，并通过关键例子的比较动摇了他们全部七种事实因果定义。

在一系列七篇论文中，Andreas与Günther提出了七种事实因果的定义，并将它们归类为三种不同的、相互竞争的理论类型：事实性差异制造、反事实差异制造以及基于规律性的理论。本文证明了他们最新提出的——事实性差异制造——定义同时体现了所有这三种类型，从而证明这些区分实际上是毫无实质差别的。此外，作者还在若干关键例子上将其新理论与其余六种理论进行了比较，揭示出这一比较动摇了他们全部七种理论。

arXiv:2606.24832v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Over a series of seven papers, Andreas & G\"unther have introduced seven definitions of actual causation and have classified them as belonging to three different, competing, types of accounts: factual difference-making, counterfactual difference-making, and regularity-based. I show that their most recent -- factual difference-making -- definition instantiates all three types, thereby proving that these are distinctions without a difference. I further compare their novel account to the other six accounts on several crucial examples, revealing that this undermines all seven of their accounts.

arXiv:2606.23042v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Most instruments for measuring political positions, such as manifesto coding, expert surveys and text-scaling models, were built and validated on Western party systems, and they break down worst where many consequential actors never publish a manifesto, never contest a competitive election, or commit one position to a charter and act on another in office. 基于大语言模型（LLM）的建筑法规自动合规检查（ACC）方法容易生成错误和幻觉的可计算机处理规则。本文提出了P4IR，一个两阶段框架：首先使用监督微调（SFT）向大语言模型注入领域知识，随后通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）来提高以高级代码骨架形式呈现的中间表示的生成准确性。相对于SFT基线，该框架在树编辑距离和词元级Levenshtein距离上分别实现了高达21.3%和41.0%的降低。对比分析表明，该方法在零样本设置下，在代码结构和语义两方面均优于通过少样本提示评估的领先大语言模型。此外，GRPO阶段在统计上显著降低了误报率。通过将SFT与GRPO相结合

arXiv:2606.22402v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based approaches for automated code compliance (ACC) of building regulations are prone to generating incorrect and hallucinated computer-processable rules. This paper introduces P4IR, a two-stage framework that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to instill domain knowledge in an LLM, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to improve the accuracy of the generated intermediate representations in the form of high-level code skeletons. The framework achieved final reductions of up to 21.3% and 41.0% in tree edit distance and token-level Levenshtein distance respectively, relative to the SFT baselines. Comparative analysis demonstrates that this approach in a zero-shot setting outperforms leading LLMs in both code structure and semantics, evaluated via few-shot prompting. 有效的人机团队合作要求机器人从交互一开始就能适应伙伴、情境和任务动态。在MATRX城市搜救（USAR）环境中，人们可以通过聊天和反思界面向外化他们在团队合作中发现的协作模式（CPs）。我们研究机器人是否能够利用这种先前的团队经验，在未来的交互中成为更好的队友。为此，我们将历史协作模式表示为知识图谱形式的情景记忆，并使用带有节点分类目标的图表示学习方法来识别具有代表性且有效的记忆以供复用。随后，在新的协作回合开始之前，我们用该记忆对机器人进行初始化。在20名参与者和160次回合级观察的实验中，用单个自动选择的先前协作模式初始化机器人，使救援成功率从25.7%提升至41.3%，并将平均任务时间缩短了283秒。

We study whether a robot can use such prior team experience to become a better teammate in future interactions. We then initialize the robot with this memory before a new collaboration episode begins. EHRNote-ChatQA：面向纵向出院总结的基于证据的多轮临床问答基准

该论文提出了首个基于患者多篇出院总结的证据支撑型多轮临床问答基准EHRNote-ChatQA，利用去标识化的MIMIC-IV数据构建，真实模拟了医学专家迭代综合信息并验证证据的临床审阅场景，弥补了现有基准在多轮问答与证据溯源评估上的不足。

出院总结是至关重要的临床文档，包含了患者整个住院期间的背景信息，医学专家通常会定期审阅这些文档，以用于患者再入院、持续护理和诊断决策。在审阅过程中，医学专家往往需要迭代地综合多篇出院总结中的信息，同时验证支持每个答案的证据。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被探索应用于临床问答，但现有的基准测试并未充分反映这一场景：它们通常评估考试式的医学知识，或仅专注于单轮问答，且缺乏充分的证据溯源评估。我们提出了EHRNote-ChatQA，这是首个针对患者多篇出院总结的基于证据的多轮临床问答基准。该基准基于去标识化的MIMIC-IV出院总结构建，包含967个患者级别的……

arXiv:2606.15735v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Discharge summaries are crucial clinical documents containing the context of a patient's overall hospital stay, and are routinely reviewed by medical experts for patient readmission, ongoing care, and diagnostic decision-making. We introduce EHRNote-ChatQA, the first benchmark for evidence-grounded multi-turn clinical question answering over patients' multiple discharge summaries. item.description:
评估 Lean 4 中证明自动形式化的鲁棒性

Evaluating the Robustness of Proof Autoformalization in Lean 4

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14867

本文首次研究了证明自动形式化模型的鲁棒性，提出全局改写扰动与局部（可能反事实的）修改扰动两类测试方法，以检验模型在偏离理想化数据集的非形式化证明上能否保持忠实。

证明自动形式化旨在将自然语言描述的非形式化数学证明翻译成形式语言（如 Lean 4）中的形式化证明。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的证明自动形式化模型通常仅在来自精选数据集的格式良好的非形式化证明上进行评估。我们认为，一个鲁棒的证明自动形式化器即使面对偏离这些理想化证明的非形式化证明也必须保持忠实性，并据此开展了首个关于证明自动形式化模型鲁棒性的研究。我们定义了两类扰动：全局扰动以不同风格对非形式化的定理-证明对进行改写，在此扰动下形式化结果应保持一致；局部扰动以可能反事实的方式改变某个数值、符号或证明步骤，而鲁棒的形式化结果应忠实地反映该扰动，而不是回退到原始内容或自行推断出不同的内容。我们构建了……

arXiv:2606.14867v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Proof autoformalization aims to translate a mathematical informal proof in natural language into a formal proof in a formal language such as Lean 4. Existing LLM-based models for proof autoformalization are typically evaluated only on well-formed informal proofs from curated datasets. We argue that a robust proof autoformalizer must remain faithful even for informal proofs that diverge from these idealized ones, and we present the first study on the robustness of proof autoformalization models. We formulate two categories of perturbations: a global perturbation paraphrases the informal theorem-proof pair in a different style, under which the formalization should remain consistent; a local perturbation alters a value, symbol, or proof step, possibly in a counterfactual way, and a robust formalization should faithfully reflect the perturbation rather than reverting to the original or inferring a different one on its own. item.title: 提出ART方法，通过优化一张辅助输入图像使冻结的多模态大语言模型专门化于特定任务，无需修改推理引擎，在半数基准测试组合中超越LoRA和软提示方法。
item.description:
基于ART微调多模态大语言模型：基于艺术的强化训练

Fine-tuning Multi-modal LLMs with ART: Art-based Reinforcement Training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11854

提出ART方法，通过优化一张辅助输入图像使冻结的多模态大语言模型专门化于特定任务，无需修改推理引擎，在半数基准测试组合中超越LoRA和软提示方法。

将大语言模型（LLM）适配到特定任务通常涉及微调：低秩适应（LoRA）修改模型权重，而软提示则在输入前添加可训练的虚拟标记。这两种方法都会改变已经优化好的模型的部署方式，因此要以高吞吐量服务众多任务特定的适配器，需要具备适配器感知的基础设施。我们提出基于艺术的强化训练（ART），该方法通过优化单一辅助输入图像，使冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）专门化于特定任务。在推理时，ART只需将这张图像包含在每个标准多模态提示中，无需对推理引擎进行任何更改。我们在来自三种架构的四个小型MLLM上，跨五个推理基准测试，将ART与LoRA和软提示进行比较。虽然不同方法在不同任务上各有优势，但ART在20个基准-MLLM组合中有10个排名第一或第二，并在两个数学文字应用题基准上取得了最佳结果。

arXiv:2606.11854v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specific tasks usually involves fine-tuning: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) edits the weights, while soft prompting prepends trainable virtual tokens. We propose Art-Based Reinforcement Training (ART), which optimizes a single auxiliary input image to specialize a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for a specific task. At inference time, ART simply includes this image in each standard multimodal prompt, requiring no changes to the serving engine. We compare ART with LoRA and soft prompting across five reasoning benchmarks for four small MLLMs from three architectures. item.title: INFRAMIND提出了一种层次化策略，通过根据实时服务负载、遥测数据和时间预算，动态调整多智能体系统的协作图规划以及模型与推理策略选择，从而在共享部署环境中将准确率提升高达7.6个百分点。
item.description:
INFRAMIND：基础设施感知的多智能体编排

INFRAMIND: Infrastructure-Aware Multi-Agent Orchestration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11440

INFRAMIND提出了一种层次化策略，通过根据实时服务负载、遥测数据和时间预算，动态调整多智能体系统的协作图规划以及模型与推理策略选择，从而在共享部署环境中将准确率提升高达7.6个百分点。

多智能体LLM系统会在推理和协作上投入额外的计算，但共享的服务队列可能使这些计算无法在截止时间之前产生答案。这形成了一个耦合决策：推理工作流决定了系统负载，而不断变化的负载又决定了哪些推理选择在成本上仍然可行。我们提出了INFRAMIND，一种能够根据服务条件自适应调整工作流规划与执行的层次化策略。在任务到达时，规划器利用任务信息、负载状况和时间预算来选择协作图结构。在每次智能体调用之前，执行器基于最新遥测数据和剩余时间，联合选择模型和推理策略。一个共享的延迟惩罚机制将这两个策略连接起来。我们的分析阐明了当拥塞导致首选计算策略被逆转时，观测负载为何至关重要。在共享五模型部署的五个基准测试中，INFRAMIND将低负载场景下的准确率提升了高达7.6（个百分比点）。

arXiv:2606.11440v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems spend additional computation on reasoning and collaboration, but shared serving queues can prevent that computation from producing answers before a deadline. This creates a coupled decision: the reasoning workflow determines the load, while changing load determines which reasoning choices remain affordable. We introduce INFRAMIND, a hierarchical policy that adapts workflow planning and execution to serving conditions. At arrival, a planner selects the collaboration graph using task information, load and the time budget. Before each agent call, an executor jointly selects the model and reasoning strategy using refreshed telemetry and remaining time. A shared latency penalty connects the two policies. Our analysis characterizes why observing load matters when congestion reverses the preferred computation. item.title: 本文提出JANUS基准，通过在固定事实池约束下对比中立与机构性条件设置下的LLM输出，专门评估LLM在基于事实沟通中通过选择性呈现真实信息所产生的目标导向性误导失真。
item.description:
JANUS：评估基于事实的LLM沟通中的目标条件性失真

JANUS: Evaluating Goal-Conditioned Distortion in Factually Grounded LLM Communication

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10852

本文提出JANUS基准，通过在固定事实池约束下对比中立与机构性条件设置下的LLM输出，专门评估LLM在基于事实沟通中通过选择性呈现真实信息所产生的目标导向性误导失真。

LLM欺骗行为通常通过捏造的声明、直接的谎言或策略性隐瞒来评估。然而，误导性沟通也可能源于对真实事实的选择性呈现，例如省略不利证据、淡化不利细节、强调有利信息，或用模糊语言取代精确的限定表述。现有基准大多忽视了这种更为微妙的失败模式。我们提出了JANUS，一个用于衡量基于事实的LLM输出中目标条件性语用失真的基准。其160个场景涵盖8个领域，每个场景提供固定的有利事实与不利事实池，并将中立的决策支持与机构性条件设置（例如提高产品采用率，或在可能对受影响个人或群体造成伤害的情况下仍给予支持）进行对比。通过将输出限制在同一事实池内，JANUS能够将误导性的整体印象与幻觉及捏造行为区分开来。实验……

item.title: 本文通过将多标签决策建模为token级事件，并结合归因、消融与植入等因果分析手段，刻画了推理型大模型在海量候选标签空间中进行选择的内部注意力头机制，并证明该机制可以被蒸馏。

先刻画再蒸馏：大输出空间中的机制化推理

Characterize Then Distill: Mechanistic Reasoning in Large Output Spaces

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06840

本文通过将多标签决策建模为token级事件，并结合归因、消融与植入等因果分析手段，刻画了推理型大模型在海量候选标签空间中进行选择的内部注意力头机制，并证明该机制可以被蒸馏。

经过推理训练的语言模型能够以零样本方式执行多标签任务，即需要从数千到数十万个候选标签中选出一小部分相关标签。我们探讨它们在机制层面是如何完成这一任务的，以及该机制能否被蒸馏。我们通过将每个决策视为一个由模型自身决策边际（decision margin）评分的token级事件，使这一问题变得可测量：包括选定标签空间粗略区域的token、在该区域内选定具体标签的token，以及输出偏离推理过程中早先提到的接近替代方案（即“近似失误”）的token。通过归因分析、精确平均消融、向其他示例上下文中植入（knock-in）实验，以及对通用注意力头进行折扣的零假设校准，这些方法赋予了单个注意力头因果地位。在医院出院小结的临床编码任务（MIMIC-IV）上，在上下文中包含全部5,651个候选诊断代码的情况下，一个小型的、全局的、具有阶段结构的……（摘要原文在此处截断）

item.description:
Code2LoRA：面向软件演化的代码语言模型超网络生成适配器

Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06492

Code2LoRA提出一种超网络框架，可直接生成仓库特定的LoRA适配器，以零推理时token开销将仓库知识注入代码语言模型，并同时支持静态代码库理解与演化代码库开发两种场景。

代码语言模型需要仓库级上下文来解析导入、API和项目约定。现有方法通过长输入（通过RAG或依赖分析检索）注入这些知识，或者对每个仓库进行微调和LoRA——在仓库规模上成本高昂，且面对不断演化的代码库时十分脆弱。我们提出了Code2LoRA，一个超网络框架，能够生成仓库特定的LoRA适配器，以零推理时token开销有效地注入仓库知识。Code2LoRA支持两种使用场景：Code2LoRA-Static将单个仓库快照转换为适配器，适用于对稳定代码库的理解；而Code2LoRA-Evo通过一个由每次代码差异（diff）更新的GRU隐藏状态来维护适配器，适用于不断演化代码库的活跃开发。为了将Code2LoRA与参数高效微调基线进行对比评估，我们构建了RepoPeftBench，一个包含604个Python仓库的基准测试。

arXiv:2606.06492v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions. Existing methods inject this knowledge as long inputs (retrieved through RAG or dependency analysis) or through per-repository fine-tuning and LoRA---costly at repository scale and brittle to evolving codebases. We introduce Code2LoRA, a hypernetwork framework that generates repository-specific LoRA adapters, effectively injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead. Code2LoRA supports two usage scenarios: Code2LoRA-Static converts a single repository snapshot into an adapter, suitable for comprehension of stable codebases; while Code2LoRA-Evo maintains an adapter backed by a GRU hidden state updated per code diff, suitable for active development of evolving codebases. item.title: 提出SARDI框架，利用扩散语言模型去噪过程中的投机性词元预测来指导动态检索，无需训练即可在多跳问答任务上以高达4倍的速度超越现有基线。
item.description:
面向扩散语言模型的自增强检索

Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06474

提出SARDI框架，利用扩散语言模型去噪过程中的投机性词元预测来指导动态检索，无需训练即可在多跳问答任务上以高达4倍的速度超越现有基线。

扩散语言模型通过并行迭代去噪整个响应来生成文本，在每一步都保留着答案的噪声草稿。我们证明这些中间状态在去噪轨迹的早期就显现出关键实体，使其成为检索增强生成（RAG）的有用前瞻信号。我们进一步证明，将生成过程建立在检索到的证据之上能显著降低词元间的依赖性，使RAG特别适合并行解码。我们通过面向扩散语言模型的自增强检索利用了这两点，这是一个动态RAG框架，利用投机性词元预测来指导去噪过程中的检索。SARDI无需训练、与检索器无关，可应用于任何具备推理能力的离散扩散语言模型。在五个多跳问答基准测试上，SARDI以高达4倍的速度超越了免训练扩散和自回归检索基线。

arXiv:2606.06474v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel, holding a noisy draft of the answer at every step. We show that these intermediate states surface salient entities early in the denoising trajectory, making them a useful lookahead signal for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We further demonstrate that grounding generation in retrieved evidence sharply reduces inter-token dependence, making RAG particularly well suited to parallel decoding. We exploit both through Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI), a dynamic RAG framework that uses speculative token predictions to guide retrieval during denoising. SARDI is training-free, retriever-agnostic, and applicable to any reasoning-capable discrete diffusion language model. Across five multi-hop QA benchmarks, SARDI outperforms training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to 4x higher

item.title: 该论文提出了一个从原始多源数据中自动发现可执行模式契约的系统，该契约既驱动构建具有来源感知的知识图谱，又在查询时指导多工具代理进行跨结构化查找与图遍历的检索路由。
item.description:
可执行模式契约：从自动数据摄取到多源检索

Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05415

该论文提出了一个从原始多源数据中自动发现可执行模式契约的系统，该契约既驱动构建具有来源感知的知识图谱，又在查询时指导多工具代理进行跨结构化查找与图遍历的检索路由。

现实世界的数据涵盖具有隐式语义的表格、文档和半结构化文件。查询这些数据需要在不一致的模式和格式之间整合证据，然而现有方法要么需要昂贵的手工工程，要么完全绕过结构。我们提出了一个系统，它能够从原始多源数据中自动发现可执行模式，并将其用作知识图谱构建和查询时检索的共享契约。封闭世界字段目录将基于大语言模型的模式发现约束到已证实的字段；确定性结构分析推断主键、外键和源层级关系；所得模式驱动信息抽取、去重和跨源链接，从而构建具有来源感知的知识图谱。在查询时，该模式——可通过单调协议选择性地进行扩展——调节多工具代理在结构化查找、图遍历等检索方式之间的路由。

arXiv:2606.05415v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Real-world data spans tables, documents, and semi-structured files with implicit semantics. Querying this data requires integrating evidence across inconsistent schemas and formats, yet existing approaches either demand costly manual engineering or bypass structure entirely. We present a system that automatically discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data and uses it as a shared contract for knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval. A closed-world field catalog constrains LLM-based schema discovery to attested fields; deterministic structural analysis infers identity keys, foreign keys, and source hierarchy; and the resulting schema drives extraction, deduplication, and cross-source linking into a provenance-aware knowledge graph. At query time the schema -- optionally extended via a monotonic protocol -- conditions a multi-tool agent routing retrieval across structured lookup, graph traversal, and v

item.title: 该研究发现MoE奖励模型组件纠缠的问题源于训练目标而非架构本身，现成的稀疏性和多样性正则化器即可显著减少纠缠，从而同时提升可解释性与个性化能力。
item.description:
可解释性不仅仅是一种代价：稀疏性与多样性带来清晰且可组合的个性化奖励专家

Interpretability Is Not Just a Tax: Sparsity and Diversity Yield Legible and Composable Reward Experts for Personalization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04284

该研究发现MoE奖励模型组件纠缠的问题源于训练目标而非架构本身，现成的稀疏性和多样性正则化器即可显著减少纠缠，从而同时提升可解释性与个性化能力。

偏好建模旨在捕捉异质的人类价值观，并日益依赖于学习潜在组件来表示这种多样性，而无需细粒度监督。然而，这些组件实际上代表什么却很少被检验。我们在受控和真实世界环境中，沿三个层级——语义一致性、功能对应性和可组合性——对混合专家奖励模型进行了审计，同时保持架构和训练数据固定，使差异能够单独归因于训练目标的影响。我们的诊断是，传统MoE奖励模型所学习到的组件是相互纠缠的，这不仅限制了可解释性，也限制了这类模型本应实现的个性化能力。这种纠缠并非架构所固有，而是训练目标的属性：现成的稀疏性和多样性正则化器已能大幅减少纠缠。由此得到的配置，我们...

arXiv:2606.04284v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Preference modeling aims to capture heterogeneous human values and increasingly relies on learning latent components to represent this variation without fine-grained supervision. What these components actually represent, however, is rarely examined. We audit Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reward models along three rungs---semantic coherence, functional correspondence, and composability---in controlled and real-world settings, holding the architecture and training data fixed so that differences isolate the effect of the training objective. Our diagnosis is that the components conventional MoE reward models learn are entangled, which limits not only interpretability but also the personalization such models are built for. The entanglement is not intrinsic to the architecture but a property of the training objective: off-the-shelf sparsity and diversity regularizers already substantially reduce it. item.title: 该论文提出了DoseBench基准，通过230个人工标注的非处方药剂量问答评估八个大语言模型，发现其决策准确率仅44.8%至62.2%，且会错误批准大量禁用剂量，凸显了LLM在用药安全场景中的重大风险。
item.description:
我能再吃一剂吗？DoseBench：评估大语言模型在非处方药剂量问答中的决策能力

Can I Take Another Dose? DoseBench: Evaluating LLM Decision-Making in OTC Dosing QA

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04262

该论文提出了DoseBench基准，通过230个人工标注的非处方药剂量问答评估八个大语言模型，发现其决策准确率仅44.8%至62.2%，且会错误批准大量禁用剂量，凸显了LLM在用药安全场景中的重大风险。

大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于在线回答日常健康问题，包括某人是否可以再服用一剂非处方（OTC）药物。然而，这一常见且与安全相关的场景在医学问答领域仍未得到充分探索。回答这些问题需要核对之前的用药剂量、用药时间以及特定产品的剂量限制，同时还要识别何时缺少重要信息。我们提出了DoseBench，这是一个包含230个消费者风格的对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬剂量问题的专用基准，每个问题均带有“是”、“否”和“不明确”的人工标注标签，并评估了八个大语言模型（每个问题获取五个回答）。总体准确率介于44.8%至62.2%之间，而模型错误批准的禁用剂量比例高达14.0%至60.5%。因此，准确率相近的模型可能会做出截然不同的用药决策。进一步的分析表明，这些错误无法通过向模型提供更多指导而轻易修复。

arXiv:2606.04262v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer everyday health questions online, including whether someone can take another dose of an over-the-counter (OTC) medication. Yet this common safety-relevant setting remains underexplored in medical QA. Answering these questions requires checking previous doses, timing, and product-specific dosing limits, while recognizing when important information is missing. We introduce DoseBench, a focused benchmark of 230 consumer-style acetaminophen and ibuprofen dosing questions with human-annotated YES, NO, and AMBIGUOUS labels, and evaluate eight LLMs with five responses per question. Overall accuracy ranges from 44.8% to 62.2%, while models incorrectly approve 14.0% to 60.5% of prohibited doses. Models with similar accuracy can therefore make very different dosing decisions. Additional analyses show that these failures are not easily fixed by giving models more guidance. Askin

item.title: 提出了Hedge-Bench基准——基于对冲基金分析师真实推理轨迹和已揭晓市场结果构建的92个环境，用于评估AI智能体在不完整信息下的金融预测能力，发现前沿模型的联合成功率仅为2.54%至31.52%。
item.description:
Hedge-Bench：面向金融推理的高难度现实任务智能体基准测试

Hedge-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks Pertaining to Financial Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03918

提出了Hedge-Bench基准——基于对冲基金分析师真实推理轨迹和已揭晓市场结果构建的92个环境，用于评估AI智能体在不完整信息下的金融预测能力，发现前沿模型的联合成功率仅为2.54%至31.52%。

现代AI智能体在检索文档、更新电子表格等常规金融分析任务上的能力日益增强。更具挑战性的难题是从不完整的信息中预测未知的未来。公开市场为此提供了一个天然的测试平台：分析师们通常基于当时可获得的信息来预测离散事件。我们提出了Hedge-Bench，这是一个包含92个真实世界环境的基准，这些环境源自对冲基金分析师的推理轨迹，并配以随后已揭晓结果的预测问题。智能体基于冻结的信息快照进行推理，其预测结果将依据真实世界的结果进行评估。在11个前沿模型、每个环境进行三次试验的设置下，联合成功率（要求同时具备正确的预测和超过60%的研究覆盖率）范围为2.54%至31.52%。利用带有回合级信用分配的GRPO方法，我们在165个环境上训练了Muse-Glimmer模型，将22个保留环境上的覆盖率从……（原文摘要至此截断）。

arXiv:2606.03918v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern AI agents are increasingly capable of routine financial-analysis tasks such as retrieving documents and updating spreadsheets. A harder challenge is forecasting an unknown future from incomplete information. Public markets provide a natural testbed: analysts routinely predict discrete events with information from that point in time. We present Hedge-Bench, a benchmark of 92 real-world environments derived from hedge fund analysts' reasoning traces paired with subsequently resolved prediction questions. Agents reason from frozen information snapshots, and their forecasts are evaluated against real-world outcomes. Across 11 frontier models and three trials per environment, joint success rates, which require both a correct forecast and over 60% research coverage, range from 2.54 to 31.52%. item.title: 提出SSM感知的Softmax注意力（SISA），将Mamba-3风格的带旋转状态转移直接融入注意力得分并结合遗忘门，使每个注意力logit获得SSM式的衰减匹配权重，从而在保持精确检索能力的同时融合顺序与时近性建模。
item.description:
忘掉注意力：重要性感知的注意力就是你所需要的一切

Forget Attention: Importance-Aware Attention Is All You Need

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02332

提出SSM感知的Softmax注意力（SISA），将Mamba-3风格的带旋转状态转移直接融入注意力得分并结合遗忘门，使每个注意力logit获得SSM式的衰减匹配权重，从而在保持精确检索能力的同时融合顺序与时近性建模。

注意力机制能够精确地检索内容，但其得分仅依赖于查询-键乘积，将顺序和时近性信息交由位置编码处理。相反，以Mamba-3为代表的状态空间模型（SSM）通过随输入变化、具有衰减和旋转特性的状态转移来追踪顺序和时近性，但将上下文压缩至固定大小的状态会妨碍精确检索。像Samba和Hymba这样的混合模型仅在层或头之间利用这种互补性，因此SSM的状态转移从未直接影响注意力得分。最接近的先前工作——遗忘变换器（FoX）——在得分上加入了依赖输入的遗忘门，但仅按时近性对注意力重新加权。我们提出了SSM感知的Softmax注意力（SISA），它将Mamba-3风格的状态转移（包括旋转）连同FoX的门控直接构建到注意力得分中。每个logit都获得该SSM会赋予该词元对的权重：即旋转后的SSM投影之间经过衰减的匹配。这种旋转……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2606.02332v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Attention retrieves content precisely, but its scores depend only on query--key products, leaving order and recency to positional encodings. Conversely, state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba-3 track order and recency through input-dependent state transitions that decay and rotate, yet compressing context into a fixed-size state hampers precise retrieval. Hybrids like Samba and Hymba exploit this complementarity only across layers or heads, so SSM transitions never shape attention scores directly. The closest prior work, the Forgetting Transformer (FoX), adds an input-dependent forget gate to the scores but reweights attention by recency alone. We propose SSM-Informed Softmax Attention (SISA), which builds Mamba-3-style state transitions, rotation included, directly into the scores alongside FoX's gate. Each logit receives the weight such an SSM would give that token pair: a decayed match between rotated SSM projections. This rotati

item.title: 该论文提出了涵盖61个真实Android应用和508个交互与显示类缺陷的交互式基准GUITestScape，以及开集评估器GUIJudge，通过将智能体的测试轨迹分解为可独立诊断的能力，实现对探索式GUI测试更全面、更细粒度的评估。
item.description:
GUITestScape：面向探索式GUI测试的开集评估

GUITestScape: Towards Open-set Evaluation on Exploratory GUI Testing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29532

该论文提出了涵盖61个真实Android应用和508个交互与显示类缺陷的交互式基准GUITestScape，以及开集评估器GUIJudge，通过将智能体的测试轨迹分解为可独立诊断的能力，实现对探索式GUI测试更全面、更细粒度的评估。

探索式GUI测试对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体而言是一项极具挑战性的任务：在没有预定义测试脚本的情况下，智能体必须自主地在应用程序中导航，并通过自身的交互来发现缺陷。然而，当前的评估在两个方面存在不足。首先，现有基准几乎完全聚焦于交互缺陷，将显示缺陷排除在评估框架之外。其次，评估协议受限于预定义的缺陷标注，将测试过程压缩为单一的终态判断，从而混淆了性质上截然不同的失败模式。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了GUITestScape，这是一个交互式基准，涵盖61个真实世界的Android应用程序以及508个横跨交互与显示类型的预设缺陷；同时引入GUIJudge，一个开集评估器，它将智能体的测试轨迹分解为可独立诊断的多项能力。实验结果表明……

arXiv:2605.29532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Exploratory GUI testing is a particularly demanding setting for MLLM agents: without predefined test scripts, an agent must autonomously navigate an application and discover defects through its own interaction. However, current evaluation falls short on two fronts. First, existing benchmarks focus almost exclusively on interaction defects, leaving display defects outside the evaluation frame. Second, evaluation protocols are bound to predefined defect annotations, collapsing the testing process into a single end-state judgment that conflates qualitatively distinct failure modes. To address these challenges, we present GUITestScape, an interactive benchmark covering 61 real-world Android applications and 508 preset defects spanning interaction and display types, and introduce GUIJudge, an open-set evaluator that decomposes an agent's testing trajectory into independently diagnosable capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate

item.title: 该论文提出了包含5,000多小时动作数据的大规模多模态数据集OmniHuMo，以及结合残差FSQ动作分词器与可扩展掩码建模Transformer的统一框架AnyMo，实现了任意模态组合条件下的高质量人体动作生成。
item.description:
AnyMo：基于掩码建模的任意模态条件动作生成扩展

AnyMo: Scaling Any-Modality Conditional Motion Generation with Masked Modeling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29488

该论文提出了包含5,000多小时动作数据的大规模多模态数据集OmniHuMo，以及结合残差FSQ动作分词器与可扩展掩码建模Transformer的统一框架AnyMo，实现了任意模态组合条件下的高质量人体动作生成。

条件人体动作生成仍然是计算机视觉和机器人领域的一项基本挑战。尽管已取得显著进展，现有方法通常受限于固定的模态配置和任务特定的架构，导致跨模态交互以及多模态条件合成的缩放规律在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。一个关键瓶颈是大规模模态对齐动作数据的稀缺，这限制了对多样化控制信号的泛化能力。在本工作中，我们提出了OmniHuMo——一个大规模、高质量的数据集，包含超过5,000小时的动作和320万个序列，并配有精确对齐的多模态标注（如文本、语音、音乐和轨迹）。基于OmniHuMo，我们提出了AnyMo，一个统一的多模态框架，它将基于残差FSQ的动作分词器与可扩展的掩码建模Transformer相结合，能够在任意模态组合下实现高质量的动作合成。

arXiv:2605.29488v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Conditional human motion generation remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics. Despite significant progress, current methods are often constrained by fixed modality configurations and task-specific architectures, leaving cross-modal interactions and the scaling laws of multimodal-conditioned synthesis largely underexplored. A key bottleneck is the scarcity of large-scale modality-aligned motion data, limiting generalization across diverse control signals. In this work, we introduce OmniHuMo, a large-scale, high-quality dataset comprising over 5,000 hours of motion and 3.2 million sequences with precisely aligned multimodal annotations (e.g., text, speech, music, and trajectory). Leveraging OmniHuMo, we propose AnyMo, a unified multimodal framework combining a Residual FSQ-based motion tokenizer with a scalable masked modeling transformer, enabling high-quality motion synthesis under arbitrary modality comb

item.title: 提出多模态地理空间基础模型FLORO，通过可用性感知输入和掩码自编码，在小型但高度多样化的异构遥感语料库（Sentinel-1/2、SkySAT、高程与无人机数据）上预训练，实现跨传感器、跨分辨率的生态遥感可迁移表征学习。
item.description:
FLORO：一个跨传感器与尺度的生态遥感多模态地理空间基础模型

FLORO: A Multimodal Geospatial Foundation Model for Ecological Remote Sensing Across Sensors and Scales

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28174

提出多模态地理空间基础模型FLORO，通过可用性感知输入和掩码自编码，在小型但高度多样化的异构遥感语料库（Sentinel-1/2、SkySAT、高程与无人机数据）上预训练，实现跨传感器、跨分辨率的生态遥感可迁移表征学习。

基础模型为学习可迁移的遥感表征提供了一条有前景的路径，但当前许多方法依赖于超大规模的预训练数据集和固定的传感器配置，这限制了它们在生态与环境应用中的适用性——因为这类应用中的观测数据往往在平台、空间和光谱分辨率以及可用模态上存在差异。我们提出了FLORO，这是一个多模态地理空间基础模型，旨在从小型但高度多样化的遥感语料库中学习可迁移的表征。FLORO采用掩码自编码方式进行预训练，训练数据由Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、SkySAT影像、高程数据以及无人机（UAV）衍生数据的异构组合构成。为了适应传感器的多样性，FLORO引入了可用性感知输入，用于指示每个样本中实际存在哪些光谱波段和辅助模态，从而在异构的传感器配置之间实现统一的输入空间。我们评估……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2605.28174v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Foundation models offer a promising route to transferable remote sensing representations, but many current approaches depend on very large pretraining datasets and fixed sensor configurations, limiting their suitability for ecological and environmental applications, where observations often vary across platforms, spatial and spectral resolutions, and available modalities. We introduce FLORO, a multimodal geospatial foundation model designed to learn transferable representations from a small but highly diverse remote sensing corpus. FLORO is pretrained using masked autoencoding on a heterogeneous combination of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, SkySAT imagery, elevation, and UAV-derived data. To accommodate sensor variability, FLORO incorporates availability-aware inputs that indicate which spectral bands and auxiliary modalities are present in each sample, enabling a unified input space across heterogeneous sensor configurations. item.title: 这是一篇系统梳理混合专家（MoE）方法如何解决多模态学习挑战的综述，从“高效多模态引擎”和“多模态表示学习器”等三个视角分析了MoE在可扩展建模与模态冗余缓解方面的独特价值。
item.description:
用混合专家模型应对多模态学习挑战：综述

Tackling Multimodal Learning Challenges with Mixture-of-Expert: A Survey

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27431

这是一篇系统梳理混合专家（MoE）方法如何解决多模态学习挑战的综述，从“高效多模态引擎”和“多模态表示学习器”等三个视角分析了MoE在可扩展建模与模态冗余缓解方面的独特价值。

混合专家模型为多模态学习提供了一个天然契合且可扩展的框架，在多样的模态与任务中展现出强大的适应能力。尽管其不断取得成功，但目前仍缺乏针对解决多模态挑战的MoE方法的全面而系统的综述。现有综述往往将多模态学习或MoE从方法分类的角度独立评估，忽略了二者之间独特的相互作用。本综述通过回答一个核心问题来填补这一空白：MoE如何有效解决多模态挑战？我们从三个关键视角展开：(1) **MoE作为高效的多模态引擎**：通过将计算成本与参数增长解耦，并借助选择性专家激活缓解模态冗余，实现可扩展的多模态建模；(2) **MoE作为多模态表示学习器**：整合互补的多种……

arXiv:2605.27431v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) presents a naturally compatible and scalable framework for multimodal learning, demonstrating strong adaptability across diverse modalities and tasks. Despite its growing success, a comprehensive and systematic review on the MoE metho addressing multimodal challenges remains lacking. Existing surveys tend to evaluate either multimodal learning or MoE independently from method taxonomy, overlooking the unique interplay between them. This survey fills that gap by answering a central question: \textit{How does MoE effectively resolve multimodal challenges?} We approach this from three key perspectives: (1) \textbf{MoE as an Efficient Multimodal Engine:} enabling scalable multimodal modeling by decoupling computational cost from parameter growth and mitigating modality redundancy through selective expert activation; (2) \textbf{MoE as a Multimodal Representation Learner:} integrating complementary multi-opi

item.title: 该论文提出了开放式知识评估这一新范式，并构建了包含10,000个实体的BeQu基准，通过开放式引导提示评估大语言模型自然表达的知识，从而克服了传统预定义问题评测中的可用性偏差。
item.description:
超越提问：评估大语言模型的陈述性知识

Beyond Questions: Evaluating the Stated Knowledge of LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26937

该论文提出了开放式知识评估这一新范式，并构建了包含10,000个实体的BeQu基准，通过开放式引导提示评估大语言模型自然表达的知识，从而克服了传统预定义问题评测中的可用性偏差。

大语言模型（LLM）中的参数化知识是其成功的基石，但人们对它的理解仍然不足。现有的知识评测基准通常依赖于预定义的问题（例如“M.L. King的出生日期是什么？”），仅评估基准设计者明确选择查询的知识，这是一种有问题的可用性偏差。在本文中，我们提出了开放式知识评估，这是一种用于评测大语言模型陈述性知识的新范式。该范式不再提出狭窄的问题，而是评估模型在面对开放式引导提示（例如“告诉我你所知道的关于M.L. King的一切”）时选择表达出来的知识。这将关注点从预定义答案的检索转向刻画模型自然表达的知识。我们通过BeQu（Beyond Questions，超越提问）基准来实例化这一范式，该基准包含10,000个实体，并配有用于语句验证的参考语料库。使用BeQu，我们……

arXiv:2605.26937v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Parametric knowledge in large language models (LLMs) is a cornerstone of their success, yet remains poorly understood. Existing knowledge benchmarks typically rely on predefined questions (e.g., "What is the birth date of M.L. King?"), evaluating only knowledge that benchmark designers explicitly choose to query, a problematic availability bias. In this paper, we introduce open knowledge evaluation, a new paradigm for benchmarking the stated knowledge of LLMs. Instead of asking narrow questions, it evaluates models on the knowledge they choose to surface in response to open-ended elicitation prompts (e.g., "Tell me everything you know about M.L. King"). This shifts the focus from predefined answer retrieval toward characterizing the knowledge models naturally express. We instantiate this paradigm with BeQu (Beyond Questions), a benchmark of 10,000 entities paired with reference corpora for statement verification. Using BeQu, we

item.title: 本文提出一个基于贝叶斯粒子推断的计算框架，将假设表示为证据约束或可执行程序两种互补形式，形式化解释了儿童在“盒子任务”中如何于环境不确定时持续生成新假设并构建心智模型。
item.description:
从不可靠证据中学习心智模型

Learning Mental Models From Unreliable Evidence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24528

本文提出一个基于贝叶斯粒子推断的计算框架，将假设表示为证据约束或可执行程序两种互补形式，形式化解释了儿童在“盒子任务”中如何于环境不确定时持续生成新假设并构建心智模型。

儿童尽管世界知识有限，却能在不确定性下熟练地构建心智模型。是哪些计算原理使这成为可能？我们在一个交互式物理“盒子任务”中研究这个问题，参与者通过与一个随机且部分可观测的环境互动来推断一个潜在原因。盒子任务最初是为定性研究儿童的解谜行为而设计的。我们贡献了一种针对该行为的计算分析，形式化了儿童生成新假设、并随着推理的展开应对环境不确定性的认知过程。我们的建模框架基于贝叶斯粒子推断，该框架维持一小组工作假设并持续生成新的假设。我们在此框架内给出了两种互补的假设表示实现：（1）作为对证据的约束，（2）作为针对证据进行评估的可执行程序。

arXiv:2605.24528v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Children expertly construct mental models under uncertainty despite limited world knowledge. Which computational principles make this possible? We study this question in an interactive physical Box Task in which participants infer a latent cause through interaction with a stochastic and partially observed environment. The Box Task was originally designed to study children's puzzle-solving qualitatively. We contribute a computational analysis of behavior that formalizes the cognitive process by which children generate new hypotheses and respond to environmental uncertainty as inference unfolds. Our modeling framework is based on Bayesian particle-based inference, which maintains a small set of working hypotheses and continually generates new ones. We give two complementary implementations of hypothesis representations within this framework: (1) as constraints on evidence, and (2) as executable programs evaluated against evidence. Usin

item.title: 本文提出以随机特征选择作为基线来评估无监督特征选择方法，发现许多最先进的方法在性能和效率上竟然不如随机选择，强调了建立评估基线的重要性。
item.description:
比随机还差：无监督特征选择中基线的重要性——扩展版

Worse than Random: The Importance of a Baseline for Unsupervised Feature Selection -- Extended Version

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22973

本文提出以随机特征选择作为基线来评估无监督特征选择方法，发现许多最先进的方法在性能和效率上竟然不如随机选择，强调了建立评估基线的重要性。

每年都有许多新颖的无监督特征选择方法被提出，然而它们的实证评估仅限于在选定数据集上计算的有监督和无监督评估指标，以及与现有方法的比较。然而，在缺乏已建立的评估基线的情况下，很难确定这些方法为现有文献带来的额外价值，以及它们的基础方法究竟有多有效。在这项评估研究中，我们使用随机特征选择作为评估无监督特征选择方法的基线。虽然随机选择特征看起来似乎是一个相当弱的基线，但我们在这项评估研究中表明，许多最先进的无监督特征选择方法在性能和效率上都败给了随机特征选择。因此，我们强调在评估无监督特征选择方法时严格考虑随机特征选择基线的必要性。

arXiv:2605.22973v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many novel unsupervised feature selection methods are proposed each year, yet their empirical evaluation is limited to supervised and unsupervised evaluation metrics computed on selected datasets, along with comparisons to existing methods. However, in the absence of an established evaluation baseline, it is difficult to determine the value added to the existing literature by each of these methods, and how effective their underlying approaches are. In this evaluation study, we are using random feature selection as a baseline for evaluating unsupervised feature selection methods. While a random selection of features might seem to be a rather weak baseline, we show in this evaluation study that many of the state-of-the-art methods in unsupervised feature selection are outperformed by random feature selection in both performance and efficiency. 聚焦强制（Focused Forcing）：面向高效自回归视频扩散的内容感知逐帧KV选择

Focused Forcing: Content-Aware Per-Frame KV Selection for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
